questions.name: #2 Shakespeare
questions.en:
A young man from a small provincial town — a man without independent wealth, without powerful family connections and without a university education — moved to London in the late 1580's and, in a remarkably short time, became the greatest playwright not of his age alone but of all time.
How was this achievement of magnitude made?
How did Shakespeare become Shakespeare?
questions.zh:
一个来自小城镇的年轻人——没有独立财富，没有显赫家世，也没有大学学历——在16世纪80年代末搬到伦敦，并在极短的时间内，不仅成为他那个时代，更是有史以来最伟大的剧作家。
如此巨大的成就是如何取得的？
莎士比亚是如何成为莎士比亚的？

questions.name: #3 Tesla & Edison
questions.en:
Tesla actually worked for Edison early in his career.
Edison offered to pay him the modern equivalent of a million dollars to fix the problems he was having with his DC generators and motors.
Tesla fixed Edison's machines and when he asked for the money he was promised, Edison laughed him off and had this to say, "Tesla, you don't understand our American humor."
questions.zh:
特斯拉在职业生涯早期其实为爱迪生工作过。
爱迪生提出给他相当于现在一百万美元的报酬，让他解决直流发电机和电动机的问题。
特斯拉修好了爱迪生的机器，当他去要承诺的报酬时，爱迪生一笑置之，说道：“特斯拉，你不懂我们美国人的幽默。”

questions.name: #4 Yellow
questions.en:
Yellow is considered as the most optimistic color.
Yet surprisingly, people lose their tempers more often in yellow rooms and babies cry more in them.
The reason may be that yellow is the hardest color for eyes to take in.
So it can be overpowering if overused.
questions.zh:
黄色被视为最乐观的颜色。
但令人惊讶的是，人们在黄色房间里更容易发脾气，婴儿在里面也哭得更厉害。
原因可能是黄色是眼睛最难接受的颜色。
所以如果过度使用，它会让人感到压抑。

questions.name: #5 Akimbo
questions.en:
Akimbo, this must be one of the odder-looking words in the language and puzzles us in part because it doesn't seem to have any relatives.
What's more, it is now virtually a fossil word, until recently almost invariably found in arms akimbo, a posture in which a person stands with hands on hips and elbows sharply bent outward, one signaling impatience, hostility, or contempt.
questions.zh:
Akimbo 这个词看起来挺古怪的，让人困惑，部分原因是它似乎没有任何同源词。
而且，它现在几乎成了一个化石词，直到最近几乎都出现在 arms akimbo 这个短语里，描述的是一个人双手叉腰、肘部向外弯的姿势，通常表示不耐烦、敌意或轻蔑。

questions.name: #6 Domestication
questions.en:
Domestication is an evolutionary, rather than a political development.
They were more likely to survive and prosper in an alliance with humans than on their own.
Humans provided the animals with food and protection, in exchange for which the animals provided the humans their milk and eggs and yes — their flesh.
questions.zh:
驯化是进化过程，而非政治发展。
它们与人类结盟，比独自生存更有可能存活并繁衍。
人类为动物提供食物和保护，作为交换，动物为人类提供奶、蛋，当然还有它们的肉。

questions.name: #7 Grand Canyon
questions.en:
The Grand Canyon is 277 miles long, up to 18 miles wide and attains a depth of over a mile.
While the specific geologic processes and timing that formed the Grand Canyon are the subject of debate by geologists, recent evidence suggests the Colorado River established its course through the canyon at least 17 million years ago.
questions.zh:
大峡谷全长277英里，最宽处达18英里，深度超过一英里。
虽然地质学家对于大峡谷形成的具体地质过程和年代仍有争议，但最新证据表明，科罗拉多河至少在一千七百万年前就已流经峡谷。

questions.name: #8 Avi Loeb
questions.en:
“The situation is similar to a pregnant woman that has twin babies in her belly,” says Avi Loeb of the Harvard-Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics.
He's proposing the idea in a paper that's been accepted for publication in the Astrophysical Journal Letters.
questions.zh:
哈佛-史密森天体物理中心的阿维·勒布说：“这情况就像孕妇肚子里怀着双胞胎一样。”
他在一篇已被《天体物理杂志通讯》接收的论文中提出了这个想法。

questions.name: #9 Moods
questions.en:
Moods may also have an effect on how information is processed, by influencing the extent to which judges rely on pre-existing, internal information, or focus on new, external information.
Positive moods promote more holistic and top-down processing style, while negative moods recruit more stimulus-driven and bottom-up processing.
questions.zh:
情绪还可能通过影响判断者依赖已有内部信息或关注新外部信息的程度，来左右信息的处理方式。
积极情绪促进更整体、自上而下的处理风格，而消极情绪则引发更多刺激驱动、自下而上的处理方式。

questions.name: #10 Alphabet
questions.en:
The problem begins with the alphabet itself.
Building a spelling system for English using letters that come from Latin — despite the two languages not sharing exactly the same set of sounds — is like building a playroom using an IKEA office set.
questions.zh:
问题从字母本身开始。
用源自拉丁语的字母来为英语构建拼写系统——尽管这两种语言并不共享完全相同的发音——就像用宜家的办公家具套装来搭建一个游戏室。

questions.name: #11 Modern Buildings
questions.en:
Modern buildings have to achieve certain performance requirements, at least to satisfy those of building codes, to provide a safe, healthy, and comfortable environment.
However, these conditioned environments demand resources in energy and materials, which are both limited in supply, to build and operate.
questions.zh:
现代建筑必须达到一定的性能要求，至少满足建筑规范，以提供安全、健康、舒适的环境。
然而，这些受控环境在建造和运行过程中需要消耗能源和材料资源，而这两者供应有限。

questions.name: #12 Medical Test
questions.en:
Three professors from Hamburg University's medical faculty traveled last month to Ingeborg's sitting room in East Berlin to test her on the work she carried out in pre-war Germany.
They were impressed and a special ceremony took place at Hamburg University Medical Centre on Tuesday, in which she finally received the Ph.D. that the Nazis stole from her.
questions.zh:
上个月，汉堡大学医学院的三位教授专程前往东柏林英格博格的起居室，对她战前在德国从事的研究进行了考核。
他们对她印象深刻，于是周二在汉堡大学医学中心举行了一场特别仪式，她终于拿到了纳粹曾从她手中夺走的博士学位。

questions.name: #14 US Student Debt
questions.en:
The numbers on US student debt, after all, are truly staggering.
The average 2015 US university graduate who took out loans to help pay for tuition enters the workforce with $35,000 in student debt.
In the US, total student debt exceeds $1.15 trillion — dwarfing, for instance, the nation's credit card debt.
questions.zh:
美国学生债务的数字确实惊人。
2015年，美国大学毕业生中，那些贷款支付学费的人，平均背负3.5万美元的学生债务进入职场。
在美国，学生债务总额超过1.15万亿美元——比如，比全国的信用卡债务还要高出一大截。

questions.name: #19 Administration Option
questions.en:
Another administration option is to bake marijuana at a relatively low temperature to kill any dangerous microorganisms and then allow that patient to eat it or drink it.
Both of these methods of administration make smoking the drug unnecessary.
However, criticism of medical marijuana has also been raised because as a natural plant, it cannot be patented and marketed by pharmaceutical companies and is unlikely to win widespread medical acceptance.
questions.zh:
另一种使用方式是把大麻用相对较低的温度烘烤，以杀死有害微生物，然后让患者食用或饮用。
这两种使用方式都让吸食这种药物变得没有必要。
然而，医用大麻也受到了批评，因为作为一种天然植物，它无法被制药公司申请专利并销售，因此不太可能获得广泛的医学认可。

questions.name: #20 Smoking Ban
questions.en:
A smoking ban is a public policy that includes criminal laws and health regulations that prohibit smoking in certain public places and workspaces.
There are varying definitions of smoking employed in this legislation.
The strictest definitions define smoking as being the inhalation of any tobacco substance while the loosest define smoking as possessing any lit tobacco product.
questions.zh:
禁烟令是一项公共政策，包含刑法和健康法规，禁止在某些公共场所和工作区域吸烟。
这项法律中对吸烟的定义各不相同。
最严格的定义将吸烟视为吸入任何烟草物质，而最宽松的定义则将吸烟视为持有任何点燃的烟草产品。

questions.name: #21 Welfare
questions.en:
Welfare has a special political meaning to the United States because it refers to how the poor receives financial aid.
In comparison, Welfare services are regarded as a universal right in other regions like Europe, where it is believed that all citizens should be able to obtain a minimal level of social support and well-being.
questions.zh:
在美国，福利有着特殊的政治含义，它指的是穷人如何获得经济援助。
相比之下，在欧洲等其他地区，福利服务被视为一项普遍权利，人们认为所有公民都应能获得最低限度的社会支持和福祉。

questions.name: #23 Radio Burst
questions.en:
First discovered in 2007, 'fast radio burst' continue to defy explanation.
These cosmic chirps last for a thousandth of a second.
The characteristics of the radio pulses suggested that they came from galaxies billions of light-years away.
However, new works points to a much closer origin – flaring stars within our own galaxy.
questions.zh:
2007年首次发现的'快速射电暴'至今仍无法解释。
这些宇宙'啁啾'信号仅持续千分之一秒。
无线电脉冲的特征表明它们来自数十亿光年外的星系。
然而，新研究指出它们起源更近——来自我们银河系内的耀星。

questions.name: #24 Statistics
questions.en:
The development of easy-to-use statistics is being taught and learned.
Students can make transformations of variables, create graphs of distributions of variables, and select among statistical analyses all at the click of a button.
However, even with these advancements, students sometimes still find statistics to be an arduous task.
questions.zh:

学生们只需点击按钮，就能转换变量、绘制变量分布图，以及选择统计分析方法。
然而，即便有了这些进步，学生们有时仍觉得统计是一项艰巨的任务。

questions.name: #25 Healthcare
questions.en:
In the fast-changing world of modern healthcare, the job of a doctor is more and more like the job of a chief executive.
The people who run hospitals and physicians' practices don't just need to know medicine.
They must also be able to balance budgets, motivate a large and diverse staff and make difficult marketing and legal decisions.
questions.zh:

管理医院和诊所的人不仅需要懂医学。
他们还必须能够平衡预算、激励多元化的庞大团队，并做出棘手的营销和法律决策。

questions.name: #26 Yellow
questions.en:
Cheerful sunny yellow is an attention getter.
While it is considered an optimistic color, people lose their tempers more often in yellow rooms, and babies will cry more.
It is the most difficult color for the eye to take in, so it can be overpowering if overused.
Yellow enhances concentration, hence its use for legal pads.
It also speeds metabolism.
questions.zh:
欢快的阳光黄很吸引眼球。
虽然它被视为一种乐观的颜色，但在黄色房间里人们更容易发脾气，婴儿也会哭得更厉害。
这是眼睛最难吸收的颜色，所以过度使用会显得过于刺眼。
黄色能提高注意力，因此常用于法律便签纸。
它还能加速新陈代谢。

questions.name: #27 Plato
questions.en:
Since Plato, philosophers have described the decision-making process as either rational or emotional: we carefully deliberate or we 'blink' and go with our gut.
But as scientists break open the mind's black box with the latest tools of neuroscience, they're discovering that this is not how the mind works.
Our best decisions are a finely tuned blend of both feeling and reason, and the precise mix depends on the situation.
questions.zh:
从柏拉图开始，哲学家们就把决策过程描述为要么理性要么感性：要么我们仔细权衡，要么我们“眨眼”凭直觉行事。
但随着科学家用最新的神经科学工具打开大脑的黑匣子，他们发现这并非大脑的工作方式。
我们最好的决策是感觉和理性的精妙融合，而具体的比例取决于具体情况。

questions.name: #28 Hemisphere
questions.en:
The brain is divided into two hemispheres, called the left and right hemispheres.
Each hemisphere provides a different set of functions, behaviors, and controls.
The right hemisphere is often called the creative side of the brain, while the left hemisphere is the logical or analytic side of brain.
questions.zh:

每个半球提供不同的功能、行为和控制能力。
右半球常被称为大脑的创造侧，而左半球则是逻辑或分析侧。

questions.name: #29 Introvert and Extrovert
questions.en:
Introvert (or those of us with introverted tendencies) tends to recharge by spending time alone.
They lose energy from being around people for long periods of time, particularly large crowds.
Extroverts, on the other hand, gain energy from other people.
Extroverts actually find their energy is sapped when they spend too much time alone.
They recharge by being social.
questions.zh:
内向的人（或者说有内向倾向的人）往往通过独处来恢复精力。
长时间待在人群中，尤其是拥挤的场合，会让他们感到疲惫。
相反，外向的人则从他人身上获取能量。
如果独处太久，外向的人反而会觉得精力被耗尽。
他们通过社交来充电。

questions.name: #30 Global Warming
questions.en:
Global warming is defined as an increase in the average temperature of the earth's atmosphere.
This trend began in the middle of the 20th century and is one of the major environmental concerns of scientists and governmental officials worldwide.
The changes in temperature result mostly from the effect of increased concentrations of greenhouse gasses in the atmosphere.
questions.zh:
全球变暖指的是地球大气平均温度上升的现象。
这一趋势始于20世纪中期，如今已成为全球科学家和政府官员最关注的环境问题之一。
气温变化主要源于大气中温室气体浓度增加所带来的影响。

questions.name: #32 War on Women
questions.en:
While the Republican field is packed with male candidates, so far, some of the sharpest Clinton critics have come from women.
Democrats successfully campaigned on an alleged GOP perpetrated "war on women" in 2012, but faltered in 2014 when they tried the same tactic.
With Hillary Clinton as the likely Democratic nominee, the fight for women voters will be a central part of the 2016 campaign.
questions.zh:
虽然共和党那边男候选人扎堆，但到目前为止，批评克林顿最犀利的却是一些女性。
2012年，民主党靠着指责共和党发动“对女性战争”成功拉票，但2014年故技重施时却碰了壁。
随着希拉里·克林顿很可能成为民主党总统候选人，争夺女性选票将成为2016年大选的核心议题。

questions.name: #33 Mitigation
questions.en:
As far as politics go, the responses are just as varied.
Mitigation is common and calls for a reduction of emissions and less reliance on fossil fuels.
Coal burning power plants are now replaced with hydraulic power plants and electrical cars are replacing some gasoline efficient cars.
Many people, however, feel that this is not enough.
questions.zh:
在政治层面，各方的回应也各不相同。
常见的应对措施是呼吁减少排放并降低对化石燃料的依赖。
如今，燃煤发电厂已被水力发电厂取代，电动汽车也在逐步替代部分节能汽油车。
然而，许多人认为这还远远不够。

questions.name: #34 The Border
questions.en:
The border itself between Mexico and United States is fraught with a mix of urban and desert terrain and spans over 1,900 miles.
Both the uninhabited areas of the border and urban areas are where the most drug trafficking and illegal crossings take place.
Crime is prevalent in urban cities like El Paso, Texas and San Diego, California.
questions.zh:
美国和墨西哥之间的边境线既有城市也有沙漠，绵延超过1900英里。
边境的无人区和城市区域是毒品走私和非法越境最猖獗的地方。
在德克萨斯州的埃尔帕索和加利福尼亚州的圣迭戈等城市，犯罪活动十分普遍。

questions.name: #35 Free Trade
questions.en:
Free trade is an economic policy under which the government does not interfere with trade.
No tariffs are applied to imports or exports, and people are allowed to trade goods and services as they please.
Supply and demand dictates the prices for which goods and services sell and are the only factors that determine how resources are allocated in society.
questions.zh:
自由贸易是一种政府不干预贸易的经济政策。
进出口商品都不征收关税，人们可以自由买卖商品和服务。
商品和服务的价格由供需决定，这也是决定社会资源如何分配的唯一因素。
questions.full:

questions.name: #36 Possession of Arms
questions.en:

questions.name: #37 Trade Unions
questions.en:
Trade unions originated in Europe during the industrial revolution.
Because of the machinery that had become commonplace, skilled labor became less in demand so employers had nearly all of the bargaining power.
Employers mistreated the workers and paid them too little for the work they did.
Trade unions were organized that would help in the improvement of working condition.

由于机器变得普遍，对熟练劳动力的需求减少，雇主几乎掌握了所有的议价能力。
雇主虐待工人，支付的报酬远低于他们所做的工作。
工会组织起来，旨在改善工作条件。

questions.name: #38 Unions
questions.en:
Unions take the power out of the employer's hands on many issues.
There are examples of cases where workers were engaging in sexual or racial harassment, but were protected by their unions and allowed to keep their jobs.
Poor workers and excellent workers often receive the same pay and raises, giving no reason for a person to work harder than necessary at their jobs.
questions.zh:
工会在许多问题上削弱了雇主的权力。
有些案例中，工人涉及性骚扰或种族骚扰，却受到工会保护而保住了工作。
表现差和表现优秀的工人往往获得相同的工资和加薪，这让人们没有理由在工作中付出额外努力。

questions.name: #39 Danny Danziger
questions.en: Using more than fifty interviews, award-winning writer Danny Danziger creates a fascinating mosaic of the people behind New York's magnificent Metropolitan Museum of Art from the aristocratic, acerbic director of the museum, Philippe de Montebello, to the curators who have a deep knowledge and passionate appreciation of their collections, from the security guards to the philanthropists who keep the museum's financial life blood flowing.
questions.zh: 获奖作家丹尼·丹齐格通过五十多次采访，生动描绘了纽约大都会艺术博物馆背后形形色色的人物——从贵族出身、言辞犀利的馆长菲利普·德·蒙特贝罗，到对藏品怀有深厚知识与热爱的策展人，再到保安和维持博物馆财务命脉的慈善家们。

questions.name: #40 Galaxy
questions.en:
One of the unidentifiable objects in this study lies just outside Centaurus A (NGC 5128), an elliptical galaxy located about 12 million light-years from Earth.
The other is in a globular cluster of stars found just outside NGC 4636, another elliptical galaxy located 47 million light-years from Earth in the constellation Virgo.
questions.zh:
这项研究中有一个无法识别的天体，就位于半人马座A（NGC 5128）星系附近，这是一个距离地球约1200万光年的椭圆星系。
另一个则位于一个球状星团中，就在NGC 4636星系附近，这是另一个椭圆星系，位于室女座，距离地球4700万光年。

questions.name: #41 Business Climate
questions.en:
The climate for doing business improved in Egypt more than in any other country last year, according to a global study that revealed a wave of company-oriented reforms across the Middle East.
The World Bank rankings, which look at business regulations, also showed that the pace of business reforms in Eastern Europe was overtaking East Asia .
questions.zh:
去年，埃及的营商环境改善程度超过了其他任何国家，一项全球研究显示中东地区涌现了一波以企业为导向的改革浪潮。
世界银行对商业法规的排名还显示，东欧的商业改革步伐正在超越东亚。

questions.name: #42 Donor Countries
questions.en:
In 2005, donor countries agreed on an accord to harmonize their practices.
Since then, aid officials have complained that too little has changed on the ground.
Conferences of donors in developing countries still tend to be dominated by a small group of north European governments, with the US often absent.
questions.zh:

自那以后，援助官员们抱怨说，实际情况几乎没有改变。
在发展中国家举行的捐助国会议仍然往往由少数北欧国家政府主导，而美国常常缺席。

questions.name: #43 Will of the Government
questions.en:
In a genuine republic the will of the government is dependent on the will of the society, and the will of the society is dependent on the reason of the society.
In Federalist 51, for example, James Madison claimed that the extent and the structure of the government of the United States make it dependent on the will of the society.
questions.zh:

例如，在《联邦党人文集》第51篇中，詹姆斯·麦迪逊声称，美国政府的规模和结构使其依赖于社会的意志。

questions.name: #44 Analysts
questions.en:
Analysts were impressed by the improvement in margins reported across all regions, apart from the United Kingdom, and said that this reflected a clear effort to improve profitability across the business.
Although the turnaround is still in its early stages and the valuation looks full, given the challenge of turning around such a large and complex business, this is certainly an impressive start.
questions.zh:
分析师们对除英国外所有地区利润率提升的报告印象深刻，并表示这反映了公司为提升整体盈利能力所做的明确努力。
尽管转型仍处于早期阶段，且鉴于扭转如此庞大复杂业务的挑战，估值看似已充分反映，但这无疑是一个令人印象深刻的开始。

questions.name: #45 Coastal Wetlands
questions.en:
The coastal wetlands have environmental and economic importance.
Wetlands provide natural wealth.
They have important filtering capabilities.
As the runoff water passes, they retain excess nutrients and some pollutants.
They maintain water flow during dry periods.
Thousands of people depend on groundwater for drinking.
They act as natural sponges of flood waters and contain soil erosion.
They control floods and save the buildings from collapsing during heavy rains.
questions.zh:
沿海湿地对环境和经济发展都至关重要。
湿地是天然的财富。
它们有着强大的过滤能力。
当径流经过时，湿地会截留多余的养分和部分污染物。
在干旱时期，它们能维持水流。
成千上万的人依赖地下水作为饮用水源。
湿地就像天然的吸水海绵，能减少洪水影响并防止水土流失。
它们控制洪水，在大雨中保护建筑物免于倒塌。

questions.name: #46 Mobile Commerce
questions.en:
IT may well change the way you live, yet again.
Welcome to the world mobile commerce, where your hand-held device, be it a mobile phone, a personal digital assistant (PDA) or any other wireless application will soon be used for commercial transactions.
Skeptical?
Consider these facts In Japan, mobile phones are used for location based services where the mobile service providers tie up with a host of other players.

它很可能会再次改变你的生活方式。

看看这些事实：在日本，手机被用于基于位置的服务，移动服务提供商与许多其他参与者合作。

questions.name: #47 Learning English
questions.en:
In the past, naming English as a separate subject seemed relatively easy.
The textbook selected and graded items of language which were put into content and then practiced intensively.
New items were carefully controlled so that students could cope quite easily.
Now English is used as a medium of instruction.
questions.zh:

教科书会挑选和分级语言项目，把它们放进课文里，然后让学生反复练习。
新内容被严格控制，这样学生就能比较轻松地掌握。
现在，英语被用作教学媒介语言了。

questions.name: #49 Paper Writing
questions.en:
Many papers you write in college will require you to include quotes from one or more sources.
Even if you don't have to do it, integrating a few quotes into your writing can add life and persuasiveness to your arguments.
The key is to use quotes to support a point you're trying to make rather than just include them to fill space.
questions.zh:
大学里写的很多论文都会要求你引用一个或多个来源的内容。
即使不是必须的，在文章中适当加入几句引文也能让论点更生动、更有说服力。
关键是要用引文来支持你试图论证的观点，而不是仅仅为了凑篇幅而引用。

questions.name: #50 Historian
questions.en:
As a historian, if you really want to understand the sensibilities of those who lived in the past, you must be like a novelist and get into the skins of your characters and think and feel as they do.
You are asked to imagine what it's like to be a peasant in medieval times, asking the sort of questions a peasant might ask.
What the writer is saying is that a historian needs imaginative sympathy with ordinary people in the past.
questions.zh:
作为历史学家，如果你真想理解古人的情感，就得像小说家一样，设身处地地体会他们的所思所感。
你得想象自己是个中世纪的农民，提出农民可能会问的问题。
作者的意思是，历史学家需要对过去的普通人抱有共情式的想象力。

questions.name: #54 Furniture
questions.en: There are perhaps three ways of looking at furniture: some people see it as purely functional and useful, and don't bother themselves with aesthetics; others see it as essential to civilized living and concern themselves with design and how the furniture will look in a room - in other words, function combined with aesthetics; and yet others see furniture as a form of art.

questions.name: #55 CD Quality Sound
questions.en:
Reiss took a stab at settling the argument with a meta-analysis — a study of studies — on whether people can really perceive better-than-CD quality sound.
He analyzed data from 18 studies, including more than 400 participants and nearly 13,000 listening tests.
Overall, listeners picked out the better-than-CD-quality track 52.3 percent of the time.
Statistically significant, if not all that impressive.
questions.zh:
赖斯尝试用元分析——也就是对多项研究进行综合分析——来解决这场争论，探讨人们是否真的能听出比CD音质更好的声音。
他分析了18项研究的数据，涉及400多名参与者和近13000次听力测试。
总体而言，听众在52.3%的情况下能分辨出比CD音质更好的曲目。
这在统计上显著，虽然算不上特别惊人。

questions.name: #56 The English Revolution
questions.en:
There are three main interpretations of the English Revolution.
The longest lasting interpretation was that the Revolution was the almost inevitable outcome of an age-old power struggle between parliament and crown.
The second sees it as a class struggle, and a lead-up to the French and other revolutions.
Finally, the third interpretation sees the other two as too fixed, not allowing for unpredictability, and that the outcome could have gone either way.
questions.zh:
关于英国革命，主要有三种解释。
流传最久的一种解释是，革命是议会与王权之间长期权力斗争几乎不可避免的结果。
第二种解释将其视为一场阶级斗争，是法国大革命及其他革命的前奏。
最后，第三种解释认为前两种都过于绝对，没有考虑到不可预测性，结果本可能走向另一个方向。

第二种解释将其视为一场阶级斗争，是法国大革命及其他革命的前奏。
Finally, the third interpretation sees the other two as too fixed, not allowing for unpredictability, and that the outcome could have gone either way.
最后，第三种解释认为前两种都过于绝对，没有考虑到不可预测性，结果本可能走向另一个方向。

questions.name: #57 Tsunami
questions.en:
The tsunamis could provide crucial information about the habitability of ancient Mars.
The first one occurred when the planet must have been relatively warm and amenable for life, because it carved out backwash channels as it returned to the sea.
By contrast, the planet had become much cooler by the time the second tsunami hit.
questions.zh:
这些海啸可能为古代火星的宜居性提供关键信息。
第一次海啸发生时，火星必定相对温暖且适宜生命存在，因为海水退回海洋时冲刷出了回流通道。
相比之下，第二次海啸来袭时，火星已经变得寒冷得多。

questions.name: #58 Amusement Ride
questions.en:
"Thompson recognized and exploited all the ingredients of a successful amusement ride," writes Judith A. Adams in The American amusement Park Industry.
"His coasters combined an appearance of danger with actual safety, thrilled riders with exhilarating speed, and allowed the public to intimately experience the Industrial Revolution's new technologies of gears, steel, and dazzling electric lights."

朱迪斯·A·亚当斯在《美国游乐园产业》一书中写道：“汤普森识别并利用了成功游乐设施的所有要素。”
他的过山车外观惊险实则安全，让乘客在令人兴奋的速度中尖叫，并让公众亲身感受工业革命带来的齿轮、钢铁和耀眼的电灯等新技术。

questions.name: #59 Physical Characteristics
questions.en:
Usually, age is determined by physical characteristics, such as teeth or bones.
Great if you have a body.
Researchers have tried unsuccessfully to use blood.
But in this study, the scientists used immune cells called T-cells.
T-cells recognize invaders through receptors that match molecules on bacteria, viruses, even tumors.
The cellular activity that produces these receptors also produces a type of circular DNA molecule as a by-product.
questions.zh:
通常，年龄是通过牙齿或骨骼等身体特征来判定的。
有身体当然很好。
研究人员曾尝试用血液来判定年龄，但没有成功。
但在这项研究中，科学家们使用了被称为T细胞的免疫细胞。
T细胞通过受体识别入侵者，这些受体与细菌、病毒甚至肿瘤上的分子相匹配。
产生这些受体的细胞活动也会产生一种环状DNA分子作为副产品。

questions.name: #60 Material and Non-material
questions.en:
For the purposes of argument, culture is divided into material and non-material, and the speaker's aim is to show how they both affect each other.
Material developments in tools and technology can affect non-material culture, our customs and beliefs, and the other way around.
Genetics is used as an example as it has changed the way we think about life, but also our beliefs have affected its rate of development.
questions.zh:
为了讨论方便，文化被分为物质和非物质两部分，演讲者的目的是展示它们如何相互影响。
工具和技术的物质发展会影响非物质文化、我们的习俗和信仰，反之亦然。
遗传学被用作例子，因为它改变了我们对生命的看法，同时我们的信仰也影响了它的发展速度。

questions.name: #61 Human Predilection
questions.en:
Networking is easy and fun because it taps into this human predilection to talk about ourselves when asked.
Consider successful networking as little more than the process of guiding a person to tell you about his life, what he's doing, the company that employs him, and his current industry.

成功的社交，无非就是引导对方讲述他的生活、工作、所在公司以及当前行业的过程。

questions.name: #62 Vulnerable Group
questions.en:
The second group that is particularly vulnerable are night shift workers, and the third group that is particularly vulnerable are people with sleep disorders, particularly sleep apnea.
One out of three men and one out of six women have sleep apnea.
And yet, 85 percent are undiagnosed and untreated.
And it more than doubles the risk of cancers.
questions.zh:
第二类特别容易受影响的是夜班工人，第三类则是睡眠障碍患者，尤其是睡眠呼吸暂停患者。
三分之一男性和六分之一女性患有睡眠呼吸暂停。
然而，85%的患者未被诊断和治疗。
这会使患癌风险增加一倍以上。

questions.name: #63 Heavily Hunted Species
questions.en:
It's not that human activities didn't impact wildlife at all of course.
Heavily hunted species, like white-tailed deer, grey squirrels, and raccoons, were photographed somewhat less often in hunted areas.
Coyotes showed up more often in hunted areas.
While most species didn't avoid hiking trails, the predators actually preferred them.
questions.zh:
当然，并不是说人类活动对野生动物完全没有影响。
像白尾鹿、灰松鼠和浣熊这些被大量捕猎的物种，在狩猎区域被拍摄到的频率略低一些。
郊狼在狩猎区域出现得更频繁。
虽然大多数物种并不避开徒步小径，但捕食者实际上更喜欢它们。

questions.name: #64 Dolphins
questions.en:
Dolphins, whales and porpoises are all social animals, but some species are more sociable than others.
This depends on the environment because a species adopts the lifestyle most suitable for this.
Among dolphins, forming groups makes it easier for them to find food, reproduce and gain knowledge.
They are safer too, because dolphins can communicate danger when there are threats around.
questions.zh:
海豚、鲸鱼和鼠海豚都是群居动物，但不同种类的社交程度有所差异。
这取决于环境，因为物种会选择最适合其生存的生活方式。
在 dolphins 中，群体生活让它们更容易觅食、繁殖并获取知识。
它们也更安全，因为当周围有威胁时，海豚能够相互传递危险信号。

questions.name: #65 Atlantis
questions.en:
For centuries, Atlantis has been one of the western world's favorite legends, a tantalizing blend of fantasy and mystery.
Stories tell of a rich and glorious empire that was lost to the sea -- where some hope its ruins still lie, waiting to be discovered.
questions.zh:
几个世纪以来，亚特兰蒂斯一直是西方世界最喜爱的传奇之一，它巧妙融合了奇幻与神秘，令人心驰神往。
传说中，一个富饶辉煌的帝国沉入了大海——有些人仍希望它的遗迹静静躺在那里，等待被世人发现。

questions.name: #66 Marine Biologist
questions.en:
The speaker is a marine biologist who became interested in the Strandlopers, an ancient people who lived on the coastline, because of their connection to the sea.
Their way of life intrigued him.
As a child he had spent a lot of time by the sea, exploring and collecting things so he began to study them, and discovered some interesting information about their way of life, how they hunted, what tools they used, and so on.
questions.zh:
这位演讲者是一位海洋生物学家，他对斯特兰德洛珀人产生了兴趣，这是一个生活在海岸线上的古老民族，因为他们与海洋的联系。

questions.name: #68 Transportation by Water
questions.en:
Not a lot is known about how the transportation of goods by water first began.
Large cargo boats were being used in some parts of the world up to five thousand years ago.
However, sea trade became more widespread when large sailing boats travelled between ports, carrying spices, perfumes and objects made by hand.
questions.zh:
关于水上货物运输最初是如何开始的，人们所知甚少。
早在五千年前，世界某些地方就已经在使用大型货船了。
然而，当大型帆船在港口间航行，运载香料、香水以及手工制品时，海上贸易才变得更加普遍。

questions.name: #69 Fuel Combustion
questions.en:
Humans need to use energy in order to exist.
So it is unsurprising that the way people have been producing energy is largely responsible for current environmental problems.
Pollution comes in many forms, but those that are most concerning, because of their impact on health, result from the combustion of fuels in power stations and cars.
questions.zh:
人类需要消耗能量才能生存。
所以，人们一直以来生产能源的方式在很大程度上导致了当前的环境问题，这一点也不奇怪。
污染有多种形式，但最令人担忧的是那些因发电站和汽车燃烧燃料而产生的污染，因为它们对健康影响巨大。

questions.name: #70 History
questions.en:
History rubs shoulders and often overlaps with many other areas of research, from myths and epics to the social sciences, including economics, politics, biography, demography, and much else besides.
Some histories are almost pure narratives, while others go in for detailed, tightly-focused analyses of, for example, the parish records of a Cornish village in the 16th century.
questions.zh:
历史与许多其他研究领域紧密相连，常常相互重叠，从神话、史诗到社会科学，包括经济学、政治学、传记、人口学等等。
有些历史几乎是纯粹的叙述，而另一些则进行详细、聚焦的分析，比如对16世纪康沃尔村庄教区记录的研究。

questions.name: #71 Flags
questions.en:
In the Middle Ages, the design and use of flags were considered a means of identifying social status.
Flags were, therefore, the symbols not of nations, but of the nobility.
The design of each flag resembled the "devices" on the noble's Coat of Arms, and the size of the flags was an indication of how high the owner stood in the nobility.
questions.zh:
在中世纪，旗帜的设计和使用被视为识别社会地位的一种方式。
因此，旗帜代表的不是国家，而是贵族。
每面旗帜的设计都类似于贵族盾徽上的“图案”，而旗帜的大小则表明其主人在贵族阶层中的地位有多高。

研究结果发表在《应用生态学杂志》上。

questions.name: #75 Caterpillars
questions.en:
"The caterpillars that feed on trees are trying to match the hatching of their eggs to the timing of bud burst.
The caterpillars want to feed on the juiciest and least chemically protected leaves.
And it's not just the caterpillars, of course, that are important.
But the knock-on effect is on nesting birds, which are also trying to hatch their chicks at the same time that there's the maximum number of caterpillars."

但连锁反应会影响到筑巢的鸟类——它们也试图在毛毛虫数量最多的时候孵化雏鸟。

questions.name: #76 Samuel Shian
questions.en:
Study author Samuel Shian, a materials scientist, says this smart glass is cheaper than others, and uses minimal power much less, for example, than something like a curling iron.

questions.name: #77 Brain
questions.en:
The brain is divided into its 'hemispheres' by a prominent groove.
At the base of this lies nerve fibers which enable these two halves of the brain to communicate with each other.
But the left hemisphere usually controls movement and sensation in the right side of the body, while the right hemisphere similarly controls the left side of the body.
questions.zh:

在这条沟壑底部有神经纤维，使大脑的两个半球能够相互交流。
但左半球通常控制身体右侧的运动和感觉，而右半球则控制身体左侧。

questions.name: #78 Dyke and Earthquake
questions.en:
This study marks the first time scientists have linked dike formation to large, damaging earthquakes, and Wauthier is looking back through history for more examples.
She says researchers will never be able to predict exactly when an earthquake might strike after a dike intrusion.
But at least now, researchers and rift zone residents know they're not just in for bangs—they may also be in for shudders.
questions.zh:
这项研究首次让科学家将岩脉形成与破坏性大地震联系起来，沃蒂埃正在回顾历史以寻找更多实例。
她说，研究人员永远无法准确预测岩脉侵入后何时会发生地震。
但至少现在，研究人员和裂谷带居民知道，他们不仅要面对巨响，还可能遭遇震动。

questions.name: #79 Slang
questions.en:
Australians do speak English.
However, for some tourists and travelers, it can be difficult to understand the slang.
Also, the links between Australian and American English were seen to be very tenuous.
At least some colloquialisms in Australian English do not exist in other types of English.
questions.zh:

不过，对于一些游客和旅行者来说，理解这里的俚语可能有点困难。
而且，澳大利亚英语和美国英语之间的联系被认为非常薄弱。
至少澳大利亚英语中的一些口语表达在其他英语变体中是不存在的。

questions.name: #80 Not-for-profit University
questions.en:
A university is not a business.
More precisely, a not-for-profit college or university is significantly different than a for-profit business.
A university has no owners and it is a public trust.
A business has a single over-riding goal: the maximization of return for the owners.
A university has a multiplicity of goals: to foster learning, to create knowledge, and to serve its community.
questions.zh:
大学不是企业。
更准确地说，非营利性大学与营利性企业有显著不同。
大学没有所有者，它是一种公共信托。
企业只有一个首要目标：为所有者实现收益最大化。
大学有多重目标：促进学习、创造知识以及服务社会。

questions.name: #81 Middle Ages
questions.en:
To understand the past you have to think as the people in the period you are studying thought.
The example of what it must have been like to be a peasant in the Middle Ages is used.
However, sensibilities change over time and we can't completely throw off the mentality of the present.
Therefore, every age will have a slightly different perspective on the same period of the past.
questions.zh:
要理解过去，你得像你所研究那个时代的人那样思考。
这里举了一个例子，说明中世纪农民的生活大概是什么样子。
不过，人们的感受会随着时间变化，我们不可能完全摆脱当下的思维方式。
因此，每个时代对同一段历史都会有不同的理解角度。

questions.name: #82 Trump
questions.en:
Trump has threatened to declare China a currency manipulator, but experts say he has little legal or economic basis to take such a step.
He has also threatened to impose a tariff of up to 45 percent on Chinese imports if Beijing doesn't behave a move that could lead to a trade war and damage the economies of both nations.
questions.zh:
川普威胁要把中国列为汇率操纵国，但专家表示，他采取这一步骤的法律和经济依据都不足。
他还威胁称，如果中国不改变做法，将对从中国进口的商品征收高达45%的关税，此举可能引发贸易战，损害两国经济。

questions.name: #83 Mic-robot
questions.en:
Each tube-shaped mic-robot is a sandwich of three materials.
A graphene outer layer, which binds to heavy metals.
A middle layer of nickel, which gives the bots magnetic polarity, so they can be pulled through wastewater with magnets.
And platinum inside for propulsion.
Just add a bit of peroxide to the wastewater, and it'll react with the platinum to form water and oxygen bubbles, which propel the tubes along.
questions.zh:
每个管状微型机器人由三种材料夹层构成。
外层是石墨烯，能吸附重金属。
中间层是镍，赋予机器人磁性极性，因此可以用磁铁将它们从废水中吸出。
内部是铂，用于推进。
只需在废水中加入少量过氧化氢，它就会与铂反应生成水和氧气气泡，从而推动管子前进。

questions.name: #84 Work
questions.en:
By beginning so early, he knows that he has plenty of time to do thoroughly all the work he can be expected to do.
All his work having been finished in good time, he has a long interval of rest in the evening before the timely hour when he goes to bed.
After a sound night's rest, he rises early next morning in good health and spirits for the labors of a new day.
questions.zh:
因为开始得早，他知道自己有充足的时间把所有该做的工作都做得滴水不漏。
所有工作都提前利索地完成了，晚上在按时上床睡觉之前，他有一段长长的休息时间。
一夜好眠之后，第二天一早他精神饱满地起床，以充沛的精力迎接新一天的工作。

questions.name: #85 Television Viewing
questions.en:
Parents need to take control of the television viewing of pre-schoolers and children of early school age.
A workable technique is to make a simple but firm weekly plan as to what programs will be permitted and how much time overall may be spent in viewing.
Any child's weekly schedule normally involves a certain amount of time for school, naps, outdoor play and indoor play.
questions.zh:
家长需要管控学龄前和小学低年级孩子的电视观看时间。
一个可行的办法是制定简单但严格的周计划，规定允许看哪些节目以及总共能看多久。
任何孩子的周日程通常都包含固定的上学、午睡、户外和室内玩耍时间。

questions.name: #86 Undesirable Programs
questions.en:
Parents can communicate their personal feelings about undesirable programs both by discouraging their children from watching them and by writing to their local television station or to the programs sponsors.
The public does have a voice.

questions.name: #87 Legal Writing
questions.en:
Legal writing is usually less discursive than writing in other humanities subjects, and precision is more important than variety.
Sentence structure should not be too complex; it is usually unnecessary to make extensive use of adjectives or adverbs, and consistency of terms is often required.
questions.zh:
法律写作通常不像其他人文学科那样天马行空，准确性比多样性更重要。
句子结构不宜过于复杂，通常没必要大量使用形容词或副词，而且术语一致性往往是必须的。

questions.name: #88 Edison and Tesla
questions.en:
Tesla came over from Graz and went to work for Thomas Edison.
Nonetheless Edison offered him a job, promising Tesla fifty thousand dollars if Tesla could redesign Edisons breakdown-prone DC generator designs.
The new generator designs were a vast improvement over Edisons originals.
Upon completing the job Tesla went to Edison to collect the $50,000 promised for the task.
"Tesla", Edison replied, "you don't understand our American humour." And Tesla was never paid.
These two men became arch-rivals.
questions.zh:
特斯拉从格拉茨来到美国，为托马斯·爱迪生工作。
尽管如此，爱迪生还是给了特斯拉一份工作，并承诺如果他能重新设计爱迪生那些容易出故障的直流发电机，就付给他五万美元。
新设计的发电机比爱迪生原来的设计有了很大的改进。
完成工作后，特斯拉去找爱迪生，要求兑现承诺的五万美元。
“特斯拉，”爱迪生回答说，“你不懂我们美国人的幽默。”特斯拉最终也没拿到那笔钱。
这两人后来成了死对头。

questions.name: #89 Margaret Simons
questions.en:
Margaret Simons explains the changes taking place in the Australian media.
She analyses audiences, our major media organisations, the role of government and the implications of all of these for our society and our democracy.
Her examination leads her to the conclusion that the challenges facing the content providers in the modern world are part of a broader striving.
questions.zh:
玛格丽特·西蒙斯解读了澳大利亚媒体正在发生的变化。
她分析了受众、主要媒体机构、政府角色，以及这些因素对我们社会和民主的影响。
她的分析让她得出结论：现代世界内容提供者面临的挑战，是更广泛奋斗的一部分。

questions.name: #90 Kindermann
questions.en:
Kindermann says he thinks the compound could be a win-win for the planet and the animals.
"You know the methane is kind of a waste product.
And this energy, instead of losing it for the animal, it can be reused for the animal in terms of performance, and at the same time we are doing something for greenhouse gas emission and climate change." The product's not on the market yet - toxicology tests are ongoing.
questions.zh:
金德曼认为，这种化合物对地球和动物来说可能是双赢的。
“你知道，甲烷是一种废物。
这种能量，与其被动物浪费掉，不如重新用于提高动物的性能，同时我们也在为温室气体排放和气候变化做贡献。”该产品尚未上市——毒理学测试仍在进行中。

questions.name: #91 Generative Model
questions.en:
Today's technological market is dominated by two contrasting business models: the generative and the non-generative.
The generative models - the PCs, Windows, and Macs of this world - allow third parties to build upon and share through them.
The non-generative model is more restricted; appliances might work well, but the only entity that can change the way they operate is the vendor.
questions.zh:
如今的技术市场由两种截然不同的商业模式主导：生成式和非生成式。
生成式模式——比如个人电脑、Windows和Mac系统——允许第三方在其基础上进行开发并分享。
非生成式模式则更为受限；设备可能运行良好，但唯一能改变其运作方式的只有供应商。

questions.name: #92 World of Journalism
questions.en:
Never before has the world of journalism been so explosive, so global, and so competitive.
Forget hourly news flashes; we live in a world of 24-hour breaking news, with radio and TV stations and Internet news sites updating stories by the minute.
questions.zh:
新闻界从未像现在这样火爆、全球化且竞争激烈。
别再提每小时播报新闻了；我们生活在一个24小时滚动播报的世界里，广播、电视台和新闻网站每分钟都在更新报道。

questions.name: #93 Karl Marx
questions.en:
Karl Marx is arguably the most famous political philosopher of all time, but he was also one of the great foreign correspondents of the nineteenth century.
During his eleven years writing for the New York Tribune (their collaboration began in 1852), Marx tackled an abundance of topics, from issues of class and the state to world affairs.
questions.zh:
卡尔·马克思可以说是史上最著名的政治哲学家，但他同时也是19世纪最杰出的驻外记者之一。
在为《纽约论坛报》撰稿的十一年间（他们的合作始于1852年），马克思探讨了从阶级和国家问题到世界事务的大量主题。

questions.name: #94 Linguistic Morality
questions.en:
In multi-lingual countries, code-mixing, the use of more than one variety in the same utterance or sentence and code-switching, the use of different languages or varieties between sentences is common and natural.
Despite its frequency, or perhaps because of it, some scholars and self-appointed guardians of linguistic morality, view both code-mixing and code-switching as a sign of linguistic deficiency.
questions.zh:
在多语言国家，人们在同一句话或句子中混用多种语言变体，以及在句子之间切换不同语言或变体，都是常见且自然的现象。
尽管这种现象很普遍，或许正因如此，一些学者和自诩的语言道德卫士却认为语码混合和语码转换是语言能力不足的表现。

questions.name: #95 Unconscious and Intuition
questions.en:
When buying a house, for example, it's best to let our unconscious mull over the many variables.
But when we're picking stocks and shares, intuition often leads us astray.
The trick is to determine when to lean on which part of the brain.
And to do this, we need to think harder and smarter about how we think.
questions.zh:
比如买房时，最好让我们的潜意识仔细权衡各种因素。
但在选股票时，直觉往往会误导我们。
关键在于判断什么时候该依赖大脑的哪一部分。
要做到这点，我们需要更深入、更聪明地思考我们是如何思考的。

questions.name: #96 Tool-user
questions.en:
The human animal's status as the only clever tool-user who can talk about our feelings is crumbling.
Prairie dogs can make up words for new animals.
Crows are born with the ability to make tools.
As biologists delve into these subjects, they're demonstrating that we're not nearly as unique as we once thought.
It's the perfect time, scientifically speaking, to reassess our place in the animal kingdom.
questions.zh:
人类这种动物作为唯一能言说情感的聪明工具使用者的地位正在动摇。
草原犬鼠能为新动物创造词汇。
乌鸦天生就有制造工具的能力。
随着生物学家深入研究这些课题，他们正证明我们远没有曾经以为的那么独特。
从科学角度来说，现在正是重新评估我们在动物界地位的最佳时机。

questions.name: #97 Cotton
questions.en:
Just about everyone on the planet wears at least one article of clothing made from cotton at some point during the day, inevitably.
By-products of the plant show up as well in something that person is doing.
The source of cotton's power is its nearly terrifying versatility and the durable creature comforts it provides.

棉花的副产品也会出现在人们正在做的某件事中。
棉花之所以如此强大，源于其近乎惊人的多功能性以及它提供的持久舒适感。

questions.name: #98 Abstract Preparation
questions.en:
The preparation of abstracts is an intellectual effort, requiring general familiarity with the subject.
To bring out the salient points of an author's argument calls for skill and experience.
Consequently, a considerable amount of qualified manpower that could be used to advantage in other ways must be diverted to the task of facilitating access to information.

要提炼出作者论点的关键点，需要技巧和经验。
因此，大量本可用于其他领域的合格人力，不得不转而从事促进信息获取的工作。

questions.name: #99 Changes in Meaning
questions.en:
Most words have experienced several changes in meaning throughout their history, so that it is impossible to say which stage in their meaning is the "true" meaning.
And if we attempt to go back to "the beginning", we find it is impossible, for the origins of many words are difficult to trace back.

大多数词汇在其历史中都经历了多次含义变化，所以很难说其中哪个阶段才是它们的“真正”含义。
如果我们试图回到“起点”，会发现这根本不可能，因为许多词汇的起源都难以追溯。

questions.name: #101 Search for Meaning
questions.en:
Much of what people do today disguises a desperate search for meaning, the result of the crisis of belief that has become a major problem of the western world.
On the one hand, the elites and their high culture suffer a loss of confidence, and aimless consumerism is widespread; on the other, powerful new myths arise, as with sporting heroes.
questions.zh:
如今人们做的很多事情，其实都是在掩饰对意义的迫切追寻，这是信仰危机的结果，而信仰危机已成为西方世界的一大难题。
一方面，精英阶层及其高雅文化失去了自信，无目的的消费主义盛行；另一方面，强大的新神话又涌现出来，比如体育英雄的出现。

questions.name: #102 Programming Art
questions.en:
Programming is the art of expressing solutions to problems so that a computer can execute those solutions.
Much of the effort in programming is spent finding and refining solutions.
Often, a problem is only fully understood through the process of programming a solution for it.

编程是一门将问题的解决方案表达出来，让计算机能够执行的技艺。
编程工作中很大一部分精力都花在寻找和优化解决方案上。
很多时候，只有通过为问题编写解决方案的过程，才能真正理解这个问题。

questions.name: #103 Disaster
questions.en:
The definition of a disaster varies by organization.
Various entities have different "pain thresholds" that define when an incident becomes a disaster.
A bank, for example, will have different criteria than a poison-control hotline.
With this fact in mind, any organization should begin the process of implementing "first alert" and response teams after it has completed a business impact analysis.
questions.zh:
不同组织对灾难的定义各不相同。
各个机构对“痛苦阈值”的定义不同，这决定了事件何时升级为灾难。
例如，银行的标准与毒物控制热线不同。
考虑到这一点，任何组织在完成业务影响分析后，都应着手组建“第一警报”和应急响应团队。

questions.name: #104 Thesis
questions.en:
Once you've picked a general topic for your paper, you need to come up with a thesis.
Your thesis is the main and focal point of your paper and it's the position you'll take on your particular topic.
Formulating a strong thesis is one of the most important things you need to do to ace your paper.
questions.zh:
一旦你为论文选定了大致主题，就需要提出一个论点。
你的论点是论文的核心和焦点，也是你对特定主题所持的立场。
形成一个有力的论点是写出优秀论文最关键的事情之一。

questions.name: #105 Online Shopping
questions.en:
A unique characteristic of online shopping environments is that they allow vendors to create retail interfaces with highly interactive features.
One desirable form of interactivity from a consumer perspective is the implementation of sophisticated tools to assist shoppers in their purchase decisions by customizing the electronic shopping environment to their individual preferences.
questions.zh:
在线购物环境的一个独特之处在于，它允许商家打造具有高度互动功能的零售界面。
从消费者角度看，一种理想的互动形式是运用精密工具，通过根据个人偏好定制电子购物环境来帮助购物者做出购买决策。

questions.name: #106 Values of Literature
questions.en:
Certainly one of the important values of literature is that it nourishes our emotional lives.
An effective literary work may seem to speak directly to us especially if we are ripe for it.
The inner life that good writers reveal in their characters often gives us glimpses of some portion of ourselves.
We can be moved to laugh, cry, tremble, dream, ponder, shriek, or rage with a character by simply turning the page instead of turning our lives upside down.
questions.zh:
文学的一个重要价值无疑在于它能丰富我们的情感世界。
一部优秀的文学作品仿佛能直接与我们对话，尤其是当我们恰好准备好去理解它时。
优秀作家在角色中揭示的内心世界，常常让我们瞥见自己的一部分。
我们只需翻动书页，就能与角色一同欢笑、哭泣、颤抖、梦想、沉思、尖叫或愤怒，而不必颠覆自己的生活。

questions.name: #107 Botswana
questions.en:
Although Botswana's economic outlook remains strong, the devastation that AIDS has caused threatens to destroy the country's future.
In 2001, Botswana had the highest rate of HIV infection in the world.
With the help of international donors it launched an ambitious national campaign that provided free antiviral drugs to anyone who needed them, and by March 2004, Botswana's infection rate had dropped significantly.
questions.zh:
尽管博茨瓦纳的经济前景依然强劲，但艾滋病造成的破坏可能摧毁这个国家的未来。
2001年，博茨瓦纳的艾滋病毒感染率位居世界第一。
在国际捐助者的帮助下，该国启动了一项雄心勃勃的全国性运动，向所有需要的人免费提供抗病毒药物。到2004年3月，博茨瓦纳的感染率已大幅下降。

questions.name: #108 Gift-giving
questions.en:
Over the centuries, the holiday evolved, and by the 18th century, gift-giving and exchanging handmade cards on Valentine's Day had become common in England.
Handmade Valentine's cards made of lace, ribbons, and featuring cupids and hearts eventually spread to the American colonies.
The tradition of Valentine's cards did not become widespread in the United States, however, until the 1850s.
questions.zh:
几个世纪以来，这个节日不断演变，到了18世纪，情人节互赠礼物和手工贺卡在英国已经很普遍了。
用蕾丝、丝带制成，印有丘比特和心形图案的手工情人节贺卡，后来传到了美洲殖民地。
不过，情人节贺卡的传统直到19世纪50年代才在美国广泛流行起来。

questions.name: #109 Beauty Contests
questions.en:
Beauty contests, whether it's Miss Universe or Miss Teen International, are demeaning to women and out of sync with the times.
Opponents say that they are nothing more than symbols of decline.
Since Australians Jennifer Hawkins and Lauryn Eagle were crowned Miss Universe and Miss Teen International respectively, there has been a dramatic increase in interest in beauty pageants in this country.
questions.zh:
选美比赛，不管是环球小姐还是国际少女小姐，都是在贬低女性，而且跟不上时代了。
反对者认为，这些比赛不过是衰落的象征。
自从澳大利亚的詹妮弗·霍金斯和劳伦·伊格尔分别当选环球小姐和国际少女小姐以来，这个国家对选美比赛的兴趣急剧上升。

questions.name: #110 Learning Method
questions.en:
There is no single method of learning that guarantees success.
How we learn that depends on many different factors.
And what works best for you will not necessarily be the same as the approach used for the other students even they study the same course.
We are all unique as learners, although some patterns emerge from any groups of students.
questions.zh:
没有哪一种学习方法能保证成功。
我们如何学习取决于很多不同的因素。
对你最有效的方法未必和其他学生相同，即使他们学的是同一门课。
作为学习者，我们每个人都是独特的，尽管在某些学生群体中也会出现一些共性。

questions.name: #113 Flattened World
questions.en:
The beginning of the twenty-first century will be remembered, not for military conflicts or political events, but for a whole new age of globalization - a 'flattening' of the world.
The explosion of advanced technologies now means that suddenly knowledge pools and resources have connected all over the planet, leveling the playing field as never before.
questions.zh:
21世纪初将被铭记，不是因为军事冲突或政治事件，而是因为一个全新的全球化时代——世界变得‘平坦’。
先进技术的爆发意味着，如今知识和资源在全球范围内突然连接起来，以前所未有的方式拉平了竞争环境。

questions.name: #114 Foreign Plant
questions.en:
Although it hails from a remote region of the western Himalayas, this plant now looks entirely at home on the banks of English rivers.
Brought to the UK in 1839, it quickly escaped from Victorian gardens and colonized river banks and damp woodlands.
Now it is spreading across Europe, New Zealand, Canada and the US.
questions.zh:
虽然这种植物来自遥远的西喜马拉雅地区，但现在它在英格兰的河岸上长得完全像本土植物一样。
它在1839年被带到英国，很快从维多利亚时代的花园中逃逸，并在河岸和潮湿的林地中扎根繁衍。
如今，它正在欧洲、新西兰、加拿大和美国蔓延开来。

questions.name: #115 MBA Students
questions.en:
Along with customary classes on subjects such as finance, accounting, and marketing, today's MBA students are enrolling on courses for environmental policy and stewardship.
Indeed, more than half of business schools require a course in environmental sustainability or corporate social responsibility, according to a survey of 91 US business schools, published in October 2005.
questions.zh:
除了金融、会计、营销这些常规课程，如今的MBA学生还会选修环境政策与管理方面的课程。
事实上，根据2005年10月发布的一项针对91所美国商学院的调查，超过一半的商学院要求学生必修环境可持续性或企业社会责任课程。

questions.name: #116 Restaurant Location
questions.en:
The physical location of a restaurant in the competitive landscape of the city has long been known as a major factor in its likely success or failure.
Once restaurants are established in such environments they can do little about their location.
All they can do is work to improve customer access to their premises.
questions.zh:
在竞争激烈的城市餐饮业中，餐厅的地理位置向来是决定其成败的关键因素。
一旦餐厅在这样的环境中立足，它们对位置便无能为力了。
它们唯一能做的就是努力改善顾客到店的便利性。

questions.en: Thus, a country might possess a sizeable rural population, but have an economic system in which the interests of the voters were predominantly related to their incomes, not to their occupations or location; and in such a country the political system would be unlikely to include an important agrarian party.

questions.name: #118 Long-distance Fliers
questions.en:
The researchers think that long-distance fliers such as the American golden-plover and the white-rumped sandpiper picked up the spores while lining their nests.
Then when the birds arrive in new places they molt, leaving behind the feathers and their precious cargo-to start growing again at the other end of the world.
questions.zh:
研究人员认为，像美洲金鸻和白腰滨鹬这样的长途飞行鸟类，在筑巢时把孢子带上了。
然后，当这些鸟到达新地方时，它们会换羽，留下羽毛和珍贵的孢子——让它们在地球的另一端重新生长。

questions.name: #119 Roman Writers
questions.en:
Roman writers and orators began to expand their imaginative and intellectual horizons and refine the Latin language through the study of Greek literature.
Early Roman literature had two kinds the recording and examination of public life and behavior through life stories of famous men, and the particularly Roman art of satirical comedy and drama.
questions.zh:
罗马的作家和演说家开始通过研习希腊文学来拓展他们的想象和智力视野，并精炼拉丁语。
早期罗马文学有两种形式：一种是通过名人的生平记录和审视公共生活与行为，另一种是特别具有罗马特色的讽刺喜剧和戏剧艺术。

questions.name: #120 Discrimination
questions.en:
Many people believe that employers discriminate against older people because youths have more energy and creativity.
This is not true.
The main reason for hiring younger workers is payroll.
In most countries, your salary is dependent on how many years of work experience you have.
It is far more cost efficient to hire postgraduates, fresh out of university, than senior staff with over twenty years of industry knowledge.
questions.zh:
很多人觉得雇主歧视年长者，因为年轻人更有精力和创造力。
这并非事实。
雇佣年轻员工的主要原因在于薪资。
在大多数国家，工资取决于你的工作年限。
雇佣刚毕业的研究生比拥有二十多年行业经验的资深员工要划算得多。

questions.name: #121 Life Expectancy
questions.en:
Life expectancy has increased dramatically in the last century.
Most people these days will live for over 70 years.
This is more than double the lifespan of the average human in the seventeenth century.
We can attribute our longevity to advances in medicine and lifestyle.
While everyone agrees that living longer is wonderful, overpopulation is becoming a serious environmental concern.
questions.zh:
过去一个世纪里，人类的平均寿命大幅提高。
如今大多数人能活到70岁以上。
这比17世纪人类平均寿命的两倍还要多。
我们的长寿归功于医学进步和生活方式的改善。
虽然人人都认为活得更久是好事，但人口过剩正成为一个严重的环境问题。

questions.name: #122 Ecotourism
questions.en:
You may have heard of the new fad known as ecotourism.
This means tourism which is environmentally friendly, and conscious about conserving the environment.
The key is to minimize the physical, social and behavioral impacts of overseas travel.
Tour groups will often work with local and indigenous communities to design respectful and memorable programs for visitors.
questions.zh:
你可能听说过生态旅游这个新潮流。
这是一种环保且注重保护环境的旅游方式。
关键是要尽量减少海外旅行对自然、社会和人文方面的影响。
旅游团通常会与当地和原住民社区合作，为游客设计既尊重文化又令人难忘的行程。

questions.name: #123 Charles Darwin
questions.en:
Darwin published his paper "On the Origin of Species" in 1859.
It is one of the most well-known pieces of scientific literature.
In the paper, Darwin proposes the theory of natural selection.
He states for any generation of any species, there will always be a struggle for survival.
Individuals who are better suited to the environment are "fitter", and therefore have a much higher chance of surviving and reproducing.
questions.zh:
达尔文在1859年发表了论文《物种起源》。
这是最著名的科学文献之一。
在这篇论文中，达尔文提出了自然选择理论。
他指出，任何物种的任何一代都会面临生存竞争。
更适应环境的个体更‘适合’，因此生存和繁殖的机会要大得多。

questions.name: #124 Environment Problems
questions.en:
Environment problems caused by hard rock mining involve water pollution by metals themselves, chemicals used in processing, acid drainage, and sediment.
Metals and metal-like elements in the ore are toxic and prone to cause trouble by ending up in nearby streams and water tables as a result of mining operations.
questions.zh:
硬岩开采造成的环境问题包括金属本身、加工中使用的化学品、酸性排水以及沉积物对水体的污染。
矿石中的金属及类金属元素具有毒性，在采矿作业中容易流入附近的溪流和地下水位，从而引发问题。

questions.name: #125 Botanic Gardens
questions.en:
Botanic gardens are scientific and cultural institutions established to collect, study, exchange and display plants for research and for the education and enjoyment of the public.
There are major botanic gardens in each capital city.
Zoological parks and aquariums are primarily engaged in the breeding, preservation and display of native and exotic fauna in captivity.
questions.zh:
植物园是科学文化机构，旨在收集、研究、交换和展示植物，以支持科研、公众教育和休闲观赏。
每个首府城市都有大型植物园。
动物园和水族馆主要致力于圈养本土及外来动物的繁殖、保护和展示。

questions.name: #126 The Speaker
questions.en:
It is difficult to tell whether the speaker approves of Hemingway's lifestyle or not.
He was famously macho and spent a lot of time hunting wild animals, going to wars and getting into fights.
All these things got into his books, and the speakers thinks that this is not necessarily a good thing as it means that too many people prefer to read about his life than read his books.
questions.zh:
很难说演讲者是否认可海明威的生活方式。
他出了名地硬汉，花大量时间猎杀野生动物、参与战争、打架斗殴。
所有这些都写进了他的书里，但演讲者认为这未必是好事，因为这意味着太多人宁愿读他的生平，也不愿读他的作品。

questions.name: #127 Clouds
questions.en:
Howard believed that all clouds belonged to three distinct groups: cumulus, stratus and cirrus.
He added a fourth category, nimbus, to describe a cloud in the act of condensation into rain, hail or snow.
It is by observing how clouds change color and shape that weather can be predicted, and as long as the first three of cloud keep their normal shape there won't be any rain.
questions.zh:
霍华德认为所有云朵都可以分为三种不同的类型：积云、层云和卷云。
他又增加了第四类——雨云，用来描述正在凝结成雨、冰雹或雪的云。
通过观察云朵颜色和形状的变化可以预测天气，只要前三种云保持正常形状，就不会下雨。

questions.name: #128 Cup Class Boats
questions.en:
At the end of this year, we will launch the cup class boats.
So these will be about twice the power.
The sailors are down in cockpits, unlike today.
A lot of power is being generated by these four grinders that are providing hydraulic power, and that energy is being used to control the flying surface, the hydrofoil and is also being used to control the wing and the flaps.

questions.name: #129 Marriage Too Early
questions.en:
Marriage is a big step in anyone's life and there is an argument to be made against getting married too early.
As any newlywed couple knows, there is a huge amount of financial pressure associated with marriage.
Firstly, the wedding reception and honeymoon will cost you an arm and a leg.
Then there's the matter of home loans, rent and energy bills.
questions.zh:
婚姻是人生中的一大步，有人认为不宜过早结婚。
任何新婚夫妇都知道，婚姻伴随着巨大的经济压力。
首先，婚宴和蜜月会花费你一大笔钱。
然后还有房贷、房租和能源账单的问题。

questions.name: #130 Leading Business Schools
questions.en: In an attempt to lure new students, leading business schools - including Harvard, Stanford, the University of Chicago and Wharton - have moved away from the unofficial admissions and prerequisite of four years' work experience and instead have set their sights on recent college graduates and so-called early career professionals with only a couple years of work under their belt.

questions.name: #131 Blue
questions.en:
While blue is one of the most popular colors, it is one of the least appetizing.
Food researchers say that when humans searched for food, they learned to avoid toxic or spoiled objects, which were often blue, black, or purple.
When food dyed blue is served to study subjects, they lose appetite.
questions.zh:
虽然蓝色是最受欢迎的颜色之一，但它也是最不让人有食欲的颜色。
食品研究人员指出，人类在寻找食物时学会避开有毒或腐烂的东西，而这些物体往往是蓝色、黑色或紫色的。
当研究人员给实验对象端上染成蓝色的食物时，他们的食欲就消失了。

questions.name: #132 Chronic Disease
questions.en:
If you have a chronic disease such as heart disease, diabetes, asthma, or back or joint pain, exercise can have important health benefits.
However, it is important to talk to your doctor before starting an exercise routine.
He or she might have advice on what exercises are safe and any precautions you might need to take while exercising.

如果你患有心脏病、糖尿病、哮喘或腰背关节疼痛等慢性病，锻炼能带来重要的健康益处。
不过，在开始锻炼计划前，务必先咨询医生。
医生可能会就哪些运动安全、锻炼时需注意哪些事项给出建议。

questions.name: #133 Augustus
questions.en:
Augustus was given the powers of an absolute monarch, but he presented himself as the preserver of republican traditions.
He treated the Senate, or state council, with great respect, and was made Consul year after year.
He successfully reduced the political power of the army by retiring many soldiers, but giving them land or money to keep their loyalty.
questions.zh:
奥古斯都被赋予了绝对君主的权力，但他却把自己塑造成共和传统的捍卫者。
他非常尊重元老院（即国务委员会），因此年复一年地当选执政官。
他通过让许多士兵退役，并给予土地或金钱来保持他们的忠诚，成功削弱了军队的政治权力。

questions.name: #134 Ford Company
questions.en:
The Ford Company provides plenty of opportunities for its employees.
It guarantees not only comfortable and appropriate working conditions, but also many other advantages.
Therefore, becoming a part of the Ford Motor company is always profitable and beneficial.
Moreover, it is important to mention that Ford Motors provides its employees with effective and useful services and takes care of their well-being.

福特公司为员工提供了大量的机会。
它不仅保证舒适且合适的工作条件，还提供了许多其他优势。
因此，成为福特汽车公司的一员总是有利可图的。
此外，值得一提的是，福特汽车为其员工提供有效且有用的服务，并关心他们的福祉。

questions.en:
Such cross-protection is usually seen between two animals.
But Gore studies the same sort of mutualism in microbes.
He and his team demonstrated the first experimental example of that cross-protective relationship in drug-resistant microbes, using two strains of antibiotic-resistant E. coli bacteria: one resistant to ampicillin, the other to chloramphenicol.

questions.name: #137 Pluto
questions.en:
Pluto lost its official status as a planet yesterday, when the International Astronomical Union downsized the solar system from nine to eight planets.
Although there had been a passionate debate at the IAU General Assembly Meeting in Prague about the definition of a planet, and whether Pluto met the specifications, the audience greeted the decision to exclude it with applause.
questions.zh:
冥王星昨天正式失去了行星地位，国际天文学联合会将太阳系行星数量从九颗缩减为八颗。
尽管在布拉格举行的国际天文学联合会大会上，关于行星的定义以及冥王星是否符合标准曾引发激烈辩论，但与会者还是以掌声欢迎了将其排除在外的决定。

questions.name: #138 Written Examinations
questions.en:
Written examinations are a fact of life for most high school and university students.
However, recent studies have shown that this traditional form of assessment may not be an accurate indicator of academic performance.
Tests have shown that many students experience anxiety during exam weeks, which leads to poorer results.
As a result, some learning institutions are replacing exams with alternative assessments such as group work and oral presentations.
questions.zh:
对于大多数高中生和大学生来说，笔试是生活中不可避免的一部分。
然而，最近的研究表明，这种传统的评估方式可能无法准确反映学业表现。
测试显示，许多学生在考试周期间会感到焦虑，从而导致成绩下降。
因此，一些教育机构正在用小组作业和口头报告等替代评估方式来取代考试。

questions.name: #139 Early Rising
questions.en:
The great advantage of early rising is the head start it gives us in our day's work.
The early riser has done a large amount of hard work before other men even get out of bed.
In the early morning, the mind is fresh, and there are few sounds or other distractions.
In many cases, the early riser also finds time to take some exercise in the fresh morning air.
questions.zh:
早起的一大好处就是能让我们一天的工作有个好的开始。
当别人还没起床时，早起的人已经完成了一大堆辛苦的工作。
清晨时分，头脑清醒，而且很少有噪音或其他干扰。
很多时候，早起的人还能抽空在清新的晨间空气里锻炼一下身体。

questions.name: #141 Adulthood
questions.en:
Once most animals reach adulthood, they stop growing.
In contrast, even plants that are thousands of years old continue to grow new needles, add new wood, and produce cones and new flowers, almost as if parts of their bodies remained "forever young".
The secrets of plant growth are regions of tissue that can produce cells that later develop into specialized tissues.
questions.zh:
大多数动物一旦成年，就会停止生长。
相比之下，即使是数千年的老树，也会继续长出新针叶、新木材，结出球果和新花，仿佛它们身体的某些部分永远年轻。
植物生长的秘诀在于一些组织区域，这些区域能产生细胞，随后发育成特化组织。

In the United States and other developed countries, the current growth rate is very low.
In most developing countries, the human population is growing at a rate of nearly 3 people per second.
Because of this bustling growth rate, the human population is well on its way to reaching 9 billion within lifetime.

由于这种迅猛的增长速度，人类人口在本世纪内有望达到90亿。

questions.en:
The diversity of human language may be compared to the diversity of the natural world.
Just as the demise of plant species reduces genetic diversity, and deprives humanity or potential medical and biological resources.
So extinction of language takes with it a wealth of culture, art and knowledge.
questions.zh:
人类语言的多样性，就好比自然界的多样性。
就像植物物种的消失会减少基因多样性，并剥夺人类潜在的医疗和生物资源。
语言的消亡同样会带走丰富的文化、艺术和知识。

So extinction of language takes with it a wealth of culture, art and knowledge.

questions.name: #149 Breeding Areas
questions.en:
Major breeding areas, and breeding islands, are shown as dark green areas or darts.
Open darts are shown no-breeding records on islands, and are also used for offshore sightings, that is from ships or boats.
Other areas where species are not meant to be seen are plain pale green, with pale green hatching where records are usually sparse.

其他通常看不到该物种的区域用浅绿色表示，记录通常稀少的区域则用浅绿色斜线标注。

questions.name: #150 Industrial Revolution
questions.en:
As to the Industrial Revolution, one cannot dispute today the fact that it has succeeded in inaugurating in a number of countries a level of mass prosperity which was undreamt of in the days preceding the Industrial Revolution.
But, on the immediate impact of the Industrial Revolution, there were substantial divergences among writers.

不过，对于工业革命的直接影响，作家们之间存在着很大的分歧。

questions.name: #151 Stress
questions.en: This study tracked about 1,000 adults in the United States, and they ranged in age from 34 to 93, and they started the study by asking, 'How much stress have you experienced in the last year?' They also asked, 'How much time have you spent helping out friends, neighbors, people in your community?' And then they used public records for the next five years to find out who died.
questions.zh: 这项研究跟踪了美国约1000名成年人，年龄从34岁到93岁不等。研究开始时，他们问参与者：‘过去一年你经历了多少压力？’还问了：‘你花了多少时间帮助朋友、邻居和社区里的人？’随后，他们在接下来的五年里利用公共记录来查明哪些人去世了。

questions.name: #152 Vanilla
questions.en:
The uniquely scented flavor of vanilla is second only to chocolate in popularity on the world’s palate.
It’s also the second most expensive spice after saffron.
But highly labor intensive cultivation methods and the plant’s temperamental life cycle and propagation mean production on a global scale is struggling to keep up with the increasing demand for the product.
questions.zh:
香草独特的风味在全球受欢迎程度仅次于巧克力。
它也是仅次于藏红花的第二昂贵的香料。
但劳动密集型种植方式、植物多变的生命周期和繁殖特性，使得全球产量难以跟上日益增长的需求。

questions.name: #153 Shuttle
questions.en:
The shuttle was designed to be a space truck; it's a multi-purpose vehicle.
We've done a tremendous number of different things with it.
It's the most versatile space vehicle that has ever been built.
We've used it to launch satellites.
We've used it to repair satellites in orbit and put them back into orbit.
We've used it to capture satellites and bring them back to Earth for repair.
questions.zh:
航天飞机被设计成太空卡车，是一种多用途飞行器。
我们用它在太空中完成了大量不同的任务。
它是有史以来功能最全的太空飞行器。
我们用它将卫星送入轨道。
我们在轨道上维修卫星，并将它们重新送回轨道。
我们还用它捕获卫星，带回地球进行维修。

questions.en:
We've outfitted it with the space lab built by our European partners and used it before the era of the space station to do scientific research.
We used it as part of our partnership with the Russians, which is still continuing, first as part of the Mir space station.
And now, of course, we're using it to build the new international space station, which is a huge international partnership.

我们给它配备了欧洲伙伴建造的空间实验室，并在空间站时代之前用它来做科学研究。
我们用它作为与俄罗斯合作的一部分，这种合作仍在继续，首先是作为和平号空间站的一部分。
当然，现在我们用它来建造新的国际空间站，这是一个庞大的国际合作项目。

questions.name: #155 Gorillas
questions.en:
While killing gorillas is already illegal in the country, declaring the subspecies as critically endangered would probably bring more funding and support for saving it.
Protecting the entirety of the gorilla's 7,700 square mile territory would no doubt prove impossible, but  Dr. Plumptre and his colleagues are talking with the government and community leaders about establishing two new protected areas that would encompass 60 percent of the remaining gorillas' habitat.
questions.zh:
虽然在该国猎杀大猩猩已经是非法的，但将该亚种列为极度濒危物种可能会为拯救它带来更多资金和支持。
保护大猩猩全部7700平方英里的领地无疑是不可能的，但普拉姆特雷博士及其同事正在与政府和社区领袖讨论建立两个新的保护区，这将涵盖剩余大猩猩栖息地的60%。

questions.name: #156 Immune Machinery
questions.en:
'When a virus invades your cells, it kicks your immune machinery into motion.
The first responders are signaling proteins, called interferon.
And they trigger downstream immune responses.
So you can kind of think of them as the hormones of the immune system.
They're triggered and then they stimulate a bunch of other immune responses that are more specific to that pathogen.'
Michelle Baker, a comparative immunologist at the Australian Animal Health Laboratory.
questions.zh:
当病毒侵入你的细胞时，它会启动你的免疫系统。
第一反应者是一种叫做干扰素的信号蛋白。
它们会触发下游的免疫反应。
所以你可以把它们看作免疫系统的激素。
它们被触发后，会刺激一系列针对该病原体的更具体的免疫反应。
米歇尔·贝克，澳大利亚动物健康实验室的比较免疫学家。

questions.name: #157 Immunology
questions.en:
In the spirit of comparative immunology, Baker and her colleagues looked at how another mammal—the black flying fox, a type of bat—handles infections.
They sequenced its immunity genes, and observed the immune response in normal bat cells.
And they found that, unlike us—the bats always have interferons on patrol.
Meaning the proteins do not wait to be activated by invaders.
questions.zh:
本着比较免疫学的精神，贝克和她的同事研究了另一种哺乳动物——黑狐蝠（一种蝙蝠）是如何应对感染的。
他们测序了它的免疫基因，并观察了正常蝙蝠细胞中的免疫反应。
他们发现，与我们不同，蝙蝠总是有干扰素在巡逻。
这意味着这些蛋白质不需要等待入侵者来激活。

questions.name: #158 Interferon
questions.en:
So why not switch on those interferons 24/7 in humans?
Well in us, they also tend to cause lots of inflammation and cell damage.
Like the symptoms you feel from the flu—a lot of that is your immune system's fault.
But the key might be to do as the bats do.
questions.zh:
那为什么不在人类身上全天候开启干扰素呢？
对我们来说，它们也容易引起大量炎症和细胞损伤。
就像你感受到的流感症状——其中很多都是免疫系统造成的。
但关键可能在于像蝙蝠那样做。

questions.name: #159 Violence on Television
questions.en:
It's not good for a child to be exposed constantly to television violence.
Research has shown such exposure has at least four effects: children may become less sensitive to the pain and suffering of others; may become more fearful of the world around them; may be more likely to behave in an aggressive manner toward others; may get an unrealistic sense of the amount of true violence in the world.
questions.zh:
孩子经常接触电视暴力并不好。
研究表明，这种接触至少有四种影响：孩子可能对他人的痛苦和遭遇变得不那么敏感；可能对周围的世界更加恐惧；可能更倾向于对他人表现出攻击性行为；可能对世界上真正的暴力程度产生不切实际的认知。

questions.name: #160 Children
questions.en:
Children need to discover their own strengths and weaknesses in order to find fulfillment as adults in both work and play.
Watching television does not lead to these discoveries; it only limits children's involvement in those real-life activities that might offer their abilities a genuine testing ground.
And young children's need for fantasy is gratified far better by their own make-believe activities than by the adult-made fantasies they are offered on television.
questions.zh:
孩子们需要发现自己的长处和短处，才能在成年后于工作和娱乐中找到满足感。
看电视并不能带来这些发现；它只会限制孩子们参与那些可能真正考验他们能力的现实活动。
而幼儿对幻想的需求，通过他们自己编造的游戏活动，远比电视上成年人制作的幻想内容更能得到满足。

questions.name: #161 Parents
questions.en:
Parents can demonstrate while the child is still very young that TV is a medium to be used selectively.
They can point children in the direction of informative, educational programs.
There are some remarkable things for preschoolers to see and enjoy on television, and parents can impart the wonders of it while discouraging undesirable programs.
Parents should remember that while television does provide preschoolers with considerable useful information, it doesn't make them smarter.
questions.zh:
孩子还很小的时候，父母就可以示范，电视是一种要选择性使用的媒介。
他们可以引导孩子去看那些有知识性、教育性的节目。
电视上有一些很棒的节目适合学龄前儿童观看和享受，父母可以在介绍这些精彩内容的同时，劝阻孩子看那些不好的节目。
父母应该记住，虽然电视确实给学龄前儿童提供了大量有用的信息，但并不会让他们变得更聪明。

questions.name: #162 Television
questions.en:
Television is bound to have tremendous impact on a child.
When a parent is concerned about the effects of television, he should consider a number of things: what TV offers the child in terms of information and knowledge, how many hours a week a youngster his age should watch television, the impact of violence and sex, and the influence of commercials.
questions.zh:
电视必然会对孩子产生巨大影响。
当家长担心电视的影响时，需要考虑几个方面：电视给孩子提供了哪些信息和知识，他这个年龄段的孩子每周应该看多少小时电视，暴力和色情内容的影响，以及广告的作用。

questions.name: #163 Body Composition
questions.en:
Your body's composed of trillions of cells - lots of different types of cells that make up different organs and other parts of your body.
Your body is also where 10 times that number of bacteria call 'home sweet home.' But don't be afraid - these bacteria do more good than harm to you.
questions.zh:
你的身体由数万亿个细胞组成——这些细胞种类繁多，构成了不同的器官和身体其他部分。
你的身体同时也是十倍于细胞数量的细菌的“温馨家园”。不过别担心——这些细菌对你的好处远大于坏处。

questions.name: #164 Cell
questions.en:
All cells share some common characteristics that make them living things.
All organisms are composed of cells, the basic fundamental unit of life.
They contain DNA as a heritable genetic material, and they can reproduce.
They transcribe DNA into RNA and translate RNA into proteins on ribosomes.
They can also regulate transport across a cell membrane and require chemical energy for some cellular processes.
questions.zh:
所有细胞都有一些共同特征，这让它们成为生命体。
所有生物都由细胞构成，细胞是生命的基本单位。
它们含有DNA作为可遗传的遗传物质，并且能够繁殖。
它们将DNA转录成RNA，并在核糖体上把RNA翻译成蛋白质。
它们还能调控跨细胞膜的运输，并且某些细胞过程需要化学能。

questions.name: #165 Bacteria
questions.en:
The number one biggest difference between the bacteria in your body and the cells making up your body are these tiny cellular components called organelles.
You've actually learned a lot about organelles in other lessons without knowing it.
Organelles are simply membrane-bound compartments within a cell, such as the nucleus, mitochondria, chloroplasts, golgi, and endoplasmic reticulum.
questions.zh:
你身体里的细菌和你身体本身的细胞之间最大的区别，就在于那些微小的细胞结构，也就是细胞器。
其实你在其他课程里已经学到了不少关于细胞器的知识，只是自己没意识到。
细胞器就是细胞内有膜包裹的小隔间，比如细胞核、线粒体、叶绿体、高尔基体和内质网。

questions.name: #167 Co-evolutionary Relationship
questions.en:
The co-evolutionary relationship between cows and grass is an underappreciated wonder, also the key to understanding just about everything about modern meat.
For the grasses, which have evolved to withstand the grazing of ruminants, the cow maintains and expands their habitat by preventing trees and shrubs from gaining a foothold and hogging the sunlight; the animal also spreads grass seed, plants it with his hooves, and then fertilizes it with his manure.
questions.zh:
牛和草之间共同进化的关系是一个被低估的奇迹，也是理解现代肉类一切的关键。
对于已经进化到能忍受反刍动物啃食的草类来说，牛通过阻止树木和灌木占据地盘、抢夺阳光来维持并扩大它们的栖息地；牛还会传播草籽，用蹄子将种子踩入土中，再用粪便施肥。

questions.name: #168 Grass and Cow
questions.en:
In exchange for these services the grasses offer ruminants a plentiful and exclusive supply of lunch.
For cows have evolved the special ability to convert grass - which single-stomached creatures like us can't digest - into high-quality protein.
They can do this because they possess what is surely the most highly evolved digestive organ in nature: the rumen.
questions.zh:
作为这些服务的回报，草给反刍动物提供了丰富且专属的午餐。
因为牛进化出了一种特殊能力，能把草——像我们这样单胃生物无法消化的东西——转化为优质蛋白质。
它们能做到这一点，是因为它们拥有自然界中进化程度最高的消化器官：瘤胃。

questions.name: #169 Man-made Light
questions.en:
Have you ever pictured a world without light?
Just think how much we rely on man-made light sources in our lives, without engineers, we wouldn’t be able to live the way we do.
No street lights, no TV, no computer displays, no house light. Engineers design and build all these things, and they also design, build and run the electricity systems that power all these light sources.
questions.zh:
你有没有想象过一个没有光的世界？
想想我们在生活中多么依赖人造光源，没有工程师，我们就无法像现在这样生活。
没有路灯，没有电视，没有电脑屏幕，没有家里的灯光。工程师设计并建造了所有这些，他们还设计、建造和运行着为这些光源供电的电力系统。

questions.name: #170 Young Artist
questions.en:
When the young artist was asked about his drawing, he explained that he had started by taking a photograph of himself sitting by a window at home.
He then drew his face from the photograph and replaced the buildings which were outside the window with trees.
This gave the picture a softer, more artistic background.
questions.zh:
当这位年轻艺术家被问及他的画作时，他解释说，他先是拍了一张自己坐在家中窗边的照片。
然后他根据照片画了自己的脸，并把窗外的建筑换成了树木。
这样一来，画面背景就变得柔和，更具艺术感了。

questions.name: #171 Pension Schemes
questions.en:
Clearly, times are changing and while many people are saving for their retirement, many more still need to do so.
Most countries have a range of pension schemes that are designed to provide individuals with an income once they stop working.
People need to take advantage of these if they are to have sufficient money throughout their retirement years.
questions.zh:
显然，时代在变，虽然很多人正在为退休储蓄，但还有更多人需要这样做。
大多数国家都有一系列养老金计划，旨在为人们停止工作后提供收入。
如果人们想在退休期间拥有足够的钱，就需要利用这些计划。

questions.name: #172 Sunshine
questions.en:
According to recent research, sunshine and warm weather have a positive effect on our moods.
The British Journal of Psychology has published a report in which it claims that anxiety levels fall when temperatures rise, while increased exposure to sunshine makes us think more positively about our lives.
questions.zh:
最近有研究表明，阳光和温暖的天气能改善我们的心情。
《英国心理学杂志》发表报告称，气温升高时焦虑水平会下降，而多晒太阳则让我们对生活更乐观。

questions.name: #173 Growing Star
questions.en:
A super-computer simulation by an international team of researchers has shown the formation of a rapidly growing star from supersonic gas streams in the early universe left over from the Big Bang.
The star ends its life with catastrophic collapse to leave a black hole with a mass of 34,000 times that of the Sun.
questions.zh:
国际研究团队用超级计算机模拟显示，早期宇宙中来自大爆炸的超声速气流形成了一颗快速增长的恒星。
这颗恒星最终灾难性坍缩，留下一个质量是太阳3.4万倍的黑洞。

questions.name: #174 Small Pebble
questions.en:
Analyses on a small pebble found in south-west Egypt cast significant questions on a widely-held view about the primitive pre-solar dust cloud which our Sun, Earth and other planets were formed from.
Researchers found exotic micro-mineral compounds in the 'Hypatia' stone that are not known to occur on Earth, elsewhere in our solar system, or in known meteorites or comets.
questions.zh:
在埃及西南部发现的一颗小卵石上的分析，对关于形成我们太阳、地球和其他行星的原始太阳前尘埃云的普遍观点提出了重大疑问。
研究人员在‘希帕蒂亚’石中发现了奇特的微矿物化合物，这些化合物在地球、太阳系其他地方、已知的陨石或彗星中均未发现。

questions.name: #175 Control of Genes
questions.en:
Scientists have discovered a way that bacteria in the gut can control genes in our cells.
Their work shows that chemical messages from bacteria can alter chemical markers throughout the human genome.
The signal chemicals are made when bacteria digest fruits and vegetables.
By communicating in this way, the bacteria may help to fight infections and to prevent cancer.
questions.zh:
科学家发现肠道里的细菌能控制我们细胞的基因。
他们的研究表明，细菌发出的化学信号可以改变人类基因组中的化学标记。
这些信号化学物质是细菌消化水果和蔬菜时产生的。
通过这种方式交流，细菌可能有助于抵抗感染和预防癌症。

questions.name: #176 Childhood Mortality
questions.en:
In a new study of childhood mortality rates between 1961 and 2010 in the United States and 19 economically similar countries, researchers report that while there's been overall improvement among all the countries, the  U.S. has been slowest to improve.
Infants in the  U.S. were 76 percent more likely to die.
questions.zh:
一项新研究对比了美国和其他19个经济水平相近的国家在1961年至2010年间的儿童死亡率，研究人员指出，尽管所有国家的整体情况都有所改善，但美国的改善速度是最慢的。
美国婴儿的死亡风险比其他国家的婴儿高出76%。

questions.name: #177 Women and Man
questions.en:
Women today tend to live longer than men almost everywhere worldwide -- in some countries by more than a decade.
Now, three centuries of historical records show that women don't just outlive men in normal times: They're also more likely to survive even in the worst of circumstances, such as famines and epidemics.

questions.name: #178 Human Activities
questions.en:
Human activities are exposing US rivers and streams to a cocktail of salts, with consequences for infrastructure and drinking water supplies.
So reports a new study that is the first to assess the combined, long-term changes in freshwater salinity and alkalization across the country.

人类活动正在让美国的河流与溪流暴露在一堆盐分中，这对基础设施和饮用水供应造成了影响。

questions.name: #180 Low-oxygen Sites
questions.en:
In the past 50 years, the amount of water in the open ocean with zero oxygen has gone up more than fourfold.
In coastal water bodies, including estuaries and seas, low-oxygen sites have increased more than tenfold since 1950.
Scientists expect oxygen to continue dropping even outside these zones as Earth warms.
questions.zh:
过去50年里，开阔海洋中无氧水体的量增加了四倍多。
自1950年以来，包括河口和海湾在内的沿海水域，低氧区域增加了十倍以上。
科学家预计，随着地球变暖，氧气含量将继续下降，即便在这些区域之外也是如此。

questions.name: #181 Middle Class
questions.en:
The reason why middle class people are more likely to play music, paint and act has been revealed in a major new study.
Research involving 78,000 people found that it was not wealth or social status that were strongly linked to people taking part in arts activities as amateurs or professionals, but rather, the level of education that lay behind arts participation.
questions.zh:
一项大型新研究揭示了中产阶级更倾向于演奏音乐、绘画和表演的原因。
一项涉及7.8万人的研究发现，人们以业余或专业身份参与艺术活动，与财富或社会地位关联不大，真正起决定作用的是教育水平。

questions.name: #183 Bookkeeper Fraud
questions.en:
A national study into fraud by bookkeepers employed at small and medium-sized businesses has uncovered 65 instances of theft in more than five years, with more than thirty one million dollars stolen.
Of the cases identified by the research, 56 involved women and nine instances involved men.
However, male bookkeepers who defrauded their employer stole three times, on average, the amount that women stole.
questions.zh:
一项针对中小企业簿记员欺诈行为的全国性研究发现，在五年多的时间里发生了65起盗窃事件，被盗金额超过3100万美元。
在研究中发现的这些案件中，56起涉及女性，9起涉及男性。
不过，欺骗雇主的男性簿记员平均盗窃金额是女性的三倍。

questions.name: #184 Zebrafish
questions.en:
A simple and inexpensive zebrafish model of concussion reveals the genetic pathways underlying the animal's remarkable ability to regenerate injured brain tissue.
Understanding the mechanisms of regeneration in the zebrafish brain could ultimately help identify new ways to promote recovery from head injury in humans.

理解斑马鱼大脑的再生机制最终可能有助于找到促进人类头部损伤恢复的新方法。

questions.name: #185 Prosthetics
questions.en:
High-tech prosthetics allow amputees to engage more fully in everyday life, even to compete in sporting events.
Researchers have demonstrated how brain activity is used to identify different terrains -- level ground and stairs, for example -- a key step in developing prosthetics that allow the user's prosthesis to automatically adjust to changing ground conditions in real time.

研究人员展示了如何利用大脑活动来识别不同的地形——比如平地或楼梯——这是开发假肢的关键一步，这种假肢能让用户的假肢实时自动适应不断变化的地面条件。
