questions.name: #187 Online User
questions.en:
Online user reviews have become an essential tool for consumers who increasingly rely on them to evaluate products and services before purchase.
The business models of online review platforms like Yelp and TripAdvisor, and e-commerce sites like Amazon and Expedia critically depend on them.
Should such sites pay users to encourage them to write reviews?
According to a new study, that is a bad idea.
questions.zh:
网上用户评价已成为消费者购物前评估产品和服务的重要工具，他们越来越依赖这些评价。
像Yelp、TripAdvisor这样的点评平台以及亚马逊、Expedia这样的电商网站，其商业模式都严重依赖这些评价。
这些网站是否应该付费鼓励用户写评论？
一项新研究表明，这是个坏主意。

questions.name: #189 Nuclear Weapons
questions.en:
About 46,000 nuclear weapons were produced during the Cold War era, leading to tremendous volumes of acidic radioactive liquid waste seeping into the environment.
A new study suggests yeast as a potentially safer and more cost effective way to help clean up these radioactive waste sites.
questions.zh:
冷战期间生产了约46000枚核武器，导致大量酸性放射性废液渗入环境。
一项新研究表明，酵母可能是一种更安全、更经济的方式来清理这些放射性废物场所。

questions.name: #190 Specific Compounds
questions.en: Specific compounds are transformed by and strongly associated with specific bacteria in native biological soil crust (biocrust) using a suite of tools called 'exometabolomics.' Understanding how microbial communities in biocrusts adapt to harsh environments could shed light on the roles of soil microbes in the global carbon cycle.

questions.name: #191 College Football
questions.en:
With revenue from college football at an unprecedented $3.4 billion annually, universities across the country invest millions each year in recruitment efforts for high school football players.
But with talented players typically receiving multiple scholarship offers, team rosters are in limbo until student athletes commit to a university.
questions.zh:
大学橄榄球年收入高达34亿美元，前所未有，全国各大学每年投入数百万美元招募高中橄榄球运动员。
但由于有天赋的球员通常会收到多份奖学金邀请，在学生运动员确定就读哪所大学之前，球队阵容一直悬而未决。

questions.name: #192 Virtual Assistants
questions.en:
Virtual assistants have become increasingly sophisticated -- and more human-like -- since the days when Clippy asked if you needed help with your document.
These assistants are intended to make programs and apps easier to use, but research suggests that human-like virtual assistants may actually deter some people from seeking help on tasks that are supposed to measure achievement.
questions.zh:
自Clippy问你需不需要帮忙处理文档以来，虚拟助手变得越来越复杂，也越来越像人类了。
这些助手本意是让程序和应用程序更好用，但研究表明，像人类一样的虚拟助手实际上可能会阻止一些人在衡量成就的任务上寻求帮助。

questions.name: #193 Survivors
questions.en:
Our survivors have told me many times that hate starts small and it grows when your neighbours, workmates and friends ignore it and do nothing.
Hate triumphs when intolerance and prejudice become ingrained across an entire society, from the pages of newspapers to the halls of government, from schoolrooms to boardrooms.
questions.zh:
幸存者们多次告诉我，仇恨始于细微之处，当你的邻居、同事和朋友视而不见、无动于衷时，它就会滋长。
当不容忍和偏见在整个社会根深蒂固——从报纸版面到政府大厅，从教室到董事会——仇恨便会得逞。

questions.name: #194 Teacher Training
questions.en:
We've been training fewer teachers in recent years while the population has been increasing and a very large cohort of teachers, the baby boomer teachers, are nearing retirement.
So all three of those things have converged to create what I think is going to be an even greater problem in coming years to what it is now, so we've got a lot of work to do a very rapid catch-up.
questions.zh:
近年来我们培训的教师数量在减少，而人口却在增长，而且一大批教师，也就是婴儿潮一代的教师，即将退休。
所以这三件事叠加在一起，我认为未来几年会造成比现在更严重的问题，因此我们有很多工作要做，必须迅速赶上。

questions.name: #195 Lunar Events
questions.en:
Three unusual lunar events will coincide on Wednesday night: a blue moon, a super moon and a blood moon.
A blue moon signifies two new moons during the same month, because the moon's orbit does not coincide completely with the calendar.
A super moon is when the moon gets the closest to earth.
And a blood moon happens when the earth, sun and moon are all lined up, making the moon appear red.
questions.zh:
周三晚上将同时出现三种罕见的月象：蓝月、超级月亮和血月。
蓝月指的是同一个月内出现两次新月，因为月球的轨道与日历并不完全吻合。
超级月亮是月球距离地球最近的时候。
而血月则发生在地球、太阳和月球排成一线时，使月亮看起来呈红色。

questions.name: #197 Current Law
questions.en:
The current law, which enables employers to fire new staff within the first 90 days without giving a reason, and without facing legal action for unfair dismissal, was introduced in 2009.
Under the new law, the 90-day trial will remain as it is for businesses with fewer than 20 employees.
Larger businesses will still be able to use the 90-day trial as a probationary period, but with greater protections for employees.
questions.zh:
现行法律于2009年实施，允许雇主在员工入职前90天内无理由解雇，且无需因不公平解雇面临法律诉讼。
根据新法，员工少于20人的企业仍可保留90天试用期不变。
较大企业仍可将90天试用期作为考察期，但需为员工提供更多保障。

questions.name: #198 Continuing Resolution
questions.en:
The so-called continuing resolution keeps the government funded until 8 February in the hope that Congress can reach a longer-term budget agreement in the meantime.
Thousands of federal employees who had been placed on temporary, unpaid leave since Saturday breathed a sigh of relief.

所谓的持续决议让政府能够维持运转到2月8日，希望国会在此期间能达成更长期的预算协议。
自周六以来被安排临时无薪休假的数千名联邦雇员松了一口气。

questions.name: #199 Fire Crews
questions.en:
Fire crews have worked through the night trying to control a number of bush fires burning in Western Australia's southwest.
The department upgraded the alert level from "watch and act" to "emergency" and advised residents to take necessary steps to ensure their safety.
Conditions there have eased overnight and the spread of the blaze has slowed.
The firefighting effort will be reassessed at first light.
questions.zh:
消防队员彻夜奋战，试图控制西澳大利亚州西南部多起丛林大火。
该部门将警报级别从“观察并行动”升级为“紧急”，并建议居民采取必要措施确保安全。
夜间火势有所缓解，火势蔓延速度减慢。
灭火工作将在天亮时重新评估。

questions.name: #200 Cup Village
questions.en:
The government is still not sure whether its alternative idea for the Auckland's America's Cup Village is viable, a week out from the start of the planning approval process.
Auckland Council is seeking approval to build eight bases across three wharves, but the government was in favour of focusing on the semi-industrial Wynyard Point, to lessen the extension of wharves.
questions.zh:
距离规划审批流程启动还有一周，政府仍不确定其关于奥克兰美洲杯村的替代方案是否可行。
奥克兰市议会正寻求获批在三个码头建造八个基地，但政府更倾向于集中在半工业化的温亚德角，以减少码头的延伸。

questions.name: #201 Hainan
questions.en:
If the dream is to turn this palm-fringed corner of Hainan into a tourist trap comparable to Florida's balmy space coast, there is still a lot to do.
Several idle building sites suggest that some investors have gambled rashly.
Signs have been taken down from a patch of scrub that was once earmarked for an amusement centre.
questions.zh:
要是想把海南这片棕榈环绕的地方打造成和佛罗里达温暖太空海岸相媲美的旅游胜地，还有好多事要做。
几处闲置的建筑工地表明，有些投资者赌得太草率了。
曾经规划建游乐中心的那片灌木丛，招牌已经拆掉了。

questions.name: #202 Fish in Distress
questions.en:
Our field teams have come across fish in distress or even eels stranded and it is simply that the water's got too hot.
Often dissolved oxygen concentrations go down as water temperature increases and animals may seek refuge outside the water, or in fact they may be stranded if the water's evaporating very quickly.
questions.zh:
我们的实地团队遇到过鱼群痛苦挣扎甚至鳗鱼搁浅的情况，原因就是水温太高了。
通常随着水温升高，溶解氧浓度会下降，动物可能会到水外寻求庇护，或者如果水蒸发得太快，它们实际上可能会搁浅。

questions.en:
The racial and identity politics were subtle and complex, but real, and in full operation every day.
The target of racial jokes changed erratically, and the cruelty would vary depending on the target's position in the 'coolness' hierarchy at school.

questions.name: #204 Tulip
questions.en:
How do we imagine the unimaginable If we're asked to think of an object - say, a yellow tulip - a picture immediately forms in our mind's eye.
But what if we try to imagine a concept such as the square root of a negative number?
questions.zh:

但如果我们试图想象一个概念，比如负数的平方根呢？

questions.name: #205 Hihi
questions.en:
Conservationists in New Zealand have come up with a novel way of raising money for one of the country's lesser-known endangered bird species - by holding a race to see which male stitchbird, or hihi, has the fastest sperm.
The Great Hihi Sperm Race will pit samples from birds collected from four different hihi colonies, and donors can place a ten NZ dollar bet on which of the 128 samples swims the fastest.
questions.zh:
新西兰的环保人士想出了一个新奇的办法，为该国一种不太为人所知的濒危鸟类筹款——举办一场比赛，看看哪只雄性缝叶吸蜜鸟（也叫hihi）的精子游得最快。
这场“大hihi精子赛”将把来自四个不同hihi群体的鸟类的精子样本进行比拼，捐赠者可以花10新西兰元下注，赌128个样本中哪个游得最快。

questions.name: #206 Reindeer Rebellion
questions.en:
Locals in central Finland are campaigning to have reindeer corralled all year round in a dispute with traditional herders.
In what's been described as a "reindeer rebellion", people living in North Ostrobothnia and Kainuu regions want tighter restrictions on herding, because they say that the free-range animals are damaging their crops and forests and harming their livelihoods.
questions.zh:
芬兰中部地区的居民正发起运动，要求全年圈养驯鹿，这与传统牧民产生了争执。
在被称为“驯鹿叛乱”的事件中，生活在北博滕区和凯努区的居民希望对放牧实施更严格的限制，因为他们认为这些自由放养的动物正在破坏他们的庄稼和森林，损害他们的生计。

questions.name: #207 The Javan Warty Pig
questions.en:
Scientists have captured the first footage in the wild of one of the world's rarest - and ugliest - pigs.
The Javan warty pig is under such threat from hunting and habitat loss that conservationists surveying its habitat believed it might already have been driven to extinction.
Camera traps have now revealed that small populations survive in Java's increasingly fragmented forests.
questions.zh:
科学家首次在野外拍摄到了世界上最稀有——也是最丑——的猪之一的画面。
爪哇疣猪面临狩猎和栖息地丧失的威胁，以至于调查其栖息地的保护人士曾认为它可能已经灭绝。
相机陷阱现已显示，在爪哇日益破碎的森林中，仍有少量种群存活。

questions.name: #208 Lego
questions.en:
Children will lack the work skills they need in the future because they are not spending enough time playing, a Lego executive has warned.
John Goodwin, head of Lego's charitable arm the Lego Foundation, says less time in the classroom and more time playing is the solution.
The foundation has a 25% stake in the Danish toy market, giving it a vested interest in encouraging play.
questions.zh:

乐高慈善机构乐高基金会负责人约翰·古德温表示，减少课堂时间、增加玩耍时间是解决方案。
该基金会持有丹麦玩具市场25%的股份，因此在鼓励玩耍方面有既得利益。

questions.name: #209 Mandarin
questions.en:
Mandarin learning has grown in popularity in the United Kingdom in the wake of the British government acknowledging the importance of China as a key partner after the nation leaves the European Union.
Earlier this month, the Foreign Office hosted a special celebration Mandarin lesson involving 140 British pupils from 14 secondary schools, to show the Chinese government the significant progress British people have made in learning the language.
questions.zh:
英国政府承认中国是其脱欧后的重要合作伙伴，此后，汉语学习在英国日益流行。
本月初，英国外交部举办了一场特别的庆祝汉语课，来自14所中学的140名英国学生参与其中，向中国政府展示英国人在学习汉语方面取得的显著进步。

questions.name: #210 Facebook
questions.en:
Facebook has defended itself against claims that using the site can damage mental health.
It said while there was evidence it could negatively affect mood, the way it affected people was determined by how they used it.
Facebook's downsides could be combated by making more use of the site and interacting positively.
A social media expert said the way Facebook was built made it hard to use it in those better ways.
questions.zh:
Facebook为自己辩护，反驳了使用该网站可能损害心理健康的说法。
该公司表示，虽然有证据表明它可能对情绪产生负面影响，但影响人们的方式取决于他们如何使用它。
通过更多地使用该网站并积极互动，可以抵消Facebook的负面影响。
一位社交媒体专家表示，Facebook的构建方式使得很难用那些更好的方式使用它。

questions.name: #211 Brain
questions.en:
In most animals, the brain is located in the head, protected by the skull and close to the primary sensory apparatus of vision, hearing, taste and olfaction.
In humans, it is an organ of thought.
While all vertebrates have a brain, invertebrates have either a centralized brain or collections of individual ganglia.
questions.zh:
大多数动物的脑子都长在头部，有颅骨保护着，紧挨着视觉、听觉、味觉和嗅觉这些主要感官。
对人类来说，脑子是思考的器官。
所有脊椎动物都有脑子，而无脊椎动物要么有一个集中的脑，要么是一堆分散的神经节。

questions.name: #212 Homework Assistance
questions.en:
Different types of maternal homework assistance have a different impact on the child's way of completing school assignments in grades 2 to 4 of elementary school, according to a new study.
Although all homework assistance presumably aims at helping the child, not all types of homework assistance lead to equally positive outcomes.
questions.zh:
一项新研究指出，在小学二至四年级，母亲辅导孩子做作业的不同方式，对孩子完成作业的方法会产生不同影响。
虽然所有形式的作业辅导都旨在帮助孩子，但并非每种辅导方式都能带来同样积极的效果。

questions.name: #213 Property Managers
questions.en:
A key finding in this study was the extent to which property managers expressed frustration at the amount of property owners who are financially unable, or just unwilling, to pay for repairs and ongoing maintenance of their rental properties.
Interior and exterior painting, re-carpeting, fixing leaks and replacing ovens were all examples of maintenance that property managers said they had trouble talking landlords into doing.
questions.zh:
这项研究的一个重要发现是，物业经理对许多业主感到沮丧，这些业主要么经济上无力，要么根本不愿意支付出租物业的维修和日常维护费用。
内部和外部粉刷、更换地毯、修补漏水以及更换烤箱，都是物业经理表示难以说服房东进行的维护工作。

questions.name: #214 Glaciers and Volcano
questions.en:
The fine details of how glaciers are linked to volcanic eruptions are unknown.
But volcanologists theorize pressure is key.
The idea is the weight of large ice sheets compresses the crust and mantle below.
That closes up channels within the rock through which magma travels up.
It leaves less room for surface water to make its way down into the rocks, where it can increase the pressure within magma chambers.
questions.zh:
冰川如何与火山喷发相关联的具体细节尚不清楚。
但火山学家推测，压力是关键因素。
其想法是，大型冰盖的重量会压缩下方的地壳和地幔。
这就会封闭岩浆上升所通过的岩石通道。
这样一来，地表水渗入岩石的路径就变少了，而渗入的水原本会增大岩浆房内的压力。

questions.name: #215 Layers of Body
questions.en: Published March 27 in Scientific Reports, a new study co-led by an NYU School of Medicine pathologist reveals that layers of the body long thought to be dense, connective tissues -- below the skin's surface, lining the digestive tract, lungs and urinary systems, and surrounding arteries, veins, and the fascia between muscles -- are instead interconnected, fluid-filled compartments.
questions.zh: 一项由纽约大学医学院病理学家共同领导的新研究于3月27日发表在《科学报告》上，该研究揭示，长期以来被认为是由致密结缔组织构成的身体层次——包括皮肤表层下方、消化道、肺部和泌尿系统内壁，以及围绕动脉、静脉和肌肉之间的筋膜——实际上是相互连接的充满液体的腔室。

questions.name: #216 Paracas Glyphs
questions.en:
Unlike the iconic Nasca lines—most of which are only visible from overhead—the older Paracas glyphs were laid down on hillsides, making them visible to villages below.
The two cultures also pursued different artistic subjects: Nasca lines most often consist of lines or polygons, but many of the newfound Paracas figures depict humans.
questions.zh:
和标志性的纳斯卡线条不同——它们大多只能从空中看到——更古老的帕拉卡斯符号被刻在山坡上，让下方的村庄也能看见。
这两种文化在艺术主题上也有所不同：纳斯卡线条通常由线条或多边形组成，但许多新发现的帕拉卡斯图案描绘的是人类。

questions.name: #217 Unwritten Rules
questions.en:
Every culture is riddled with unwritten rules, such as ones on punctuality.
They are the invisible scaffold that frames the behavior of individuals so that the collective can function in a frictionless and productive way.
But the rigor of these rules and the exactitude with which they are enforced varies dramatically.
Some nations tolerate singing in an elevator, swearing during an interview or entering a bank barefoot, while others frown upon such behaviors.
questions.zh:
每种文化都充满了不成文的规矩，比如关于守时的那些。
它们是看不见的框架，支撑着个人行为，让集体能够顺畅高效地运作。
但这些规矩的严格程度以及执行时的精确度却大相径庭。
有些国家能容忍在电梯里唱歌、面试时说脏话或光脚进银行，而另一些国家则对此类行为不以为然。

questions.name: #218 Nurse Sharks
questions.en:
Nurse sharks are thought to take advantage of dormant fish which would otherwise be too fast for the sharks to catch, although their small mouths limit the size of prey items, the sharks have large throat cavities which are used as a sort of bellows valve.
In this way, nurse sharks are able to suck in their prey.
Nurse sharks are also known to graze algae and coral.
questions.zh:
护士鲨被认为会利用休眠的鱼类，否则这些鱼游得太快，鲨鱼根本抓不到。虽然它们的小嘴限制了猎物的大小，但护士鲨有巨大的喉腔，能像风箱阀门一样使用。
通过这种方式，护士鲨能够将猎物吸入口中。
护士鲨也以啃食藻类和珊瑚而闻名。

questions.name: #219 Twitter
questions.en:
Twitter, a social network, will reportedly join forces with Bloomberg, a media company, to produce a 24-hour video news service.
Twitter has made strides in adding users in recent quarters, but not in boosting profits.
Jack Dorsey, a co-founder who recently returned as CEO, introduced limited live video broadcasts at the site, which were seen by 45m unique viewers in the first quarter of 2017.
questions.zh:
据报道，社交网络推特将与媒体公司彭博合作，推出24小时视频新闻服务。

questions.name: #220 Video clip
questions.en:
A video clip of a bloodied passenger being forcibly removed from a United Airlines flight to make room for airline staff turned into a PR disaster.
People used social media to complain that United should be beating the competition, not customers.
United’s boss, Oscar Munoz, apologized—eventually.
Lawyers for the passenger, David Dao, filed a petition to seize evidence related to the incident.
questions.zh:
一段视频显示，一名血迹斑斑的乘客被强行拖下美联航航班，只为给机组人员腾出座位，这成了一场公关灾难。
人们在社交媒体上抱怨，美联航应该击败竞争对手，而不是殴打顾客。
美联航CEO奥斯卡·穆尼奥斯最终道了歉。
乘客大卫·道的律师提交了请愿书，要求扣押与事件相关的证据。

questions.name: #221 Malaria Vaccine
questions.en:
The World Health Organisation said an experimental malaria vaccine will be tested on more than 750,000 children in Ghana, Kenya and Malawi next year.
The disease causes more than 400,000 deaths annually.
How the vaccine is implemented will be key to its success: it must be administered four times, with the final dose 18 months after the third.
questions.zh:
世界卫生组织表示，一种实验性疟疾疫苗明年将在加纳、肯尼亚和马拉维对超过75万名儿童进行测试。
这种疾病每年导致超过40万人死亡。
疫苗如何实施将是其成功的关键：必须接种四次，最后一剂在第三剂后18个月。

questions.name: #222 Baidu
questions.en:
China’s biggest online-search company, Baidu, said it would make its self-driving car technologies available to others.
In a bid to advance autonomous vehicles—and perhaps to become an industry standard in the same way that Google’s Android operating system is for smartphones—Baidu’s Apollo project will distribute technologies to developers and carmakers, initially for use in restricted environments, as soon as July.
questions.zh:
中国最大的在线搜索公司百度表示，将向其他公司开放其自动驾驶汽车技术。
为了推动自动驾驶汽车的发展——或许还想成为像谷歌安卓系统在智能手机领域那样的行业标准——百度的阿波罗项目将向开发者和汽车制造商提供技术，最初从7月起用于受限环境。

questions.name: #223 Public Register
questions.en:
Britain said it will introduce the world’s first public register of the owners of foreign companies holding property in the country.
The move comes in response to growing concern over tax evaders’ and money-launderers’ use of shell companies to hide their identities.
Most overseas companies that own property in London are registered in tax havens, particularly the British Virgin Islands.
questions.zh:
英国宣布将建立全球首个公开登记册，记录在英国持有房产的外国公司所有者。
此举是为了回应人们对逃税者和洗钱者利用空壳公司隐藏身份日益增长的担忧。
在伦敦拥有房产的大多数海外公司都注册在避税天堂，尤其是英属维尔京群岛。

questions.name: #224 Arrest of President
questions.en:
A South Korean court ordered the arrest of Park Geun-hye, the former president, on charges of bribery and abuse of power.
Ms Park, who was removed from office three weeks ago, will be jailed while prosecutors seek an indictment for her alleged role in a corruption scandal.
The court said that if Ms Park was not taken into custody she might “destroy evidence”.
questions.zh:
韩国一家法院以受贿和滥用职权为由，下令逮捕前总统朴槿惠。
三周前被免职的朴槿惠将被收监，同时检方正寻求就她在腐败丑闻中的涉嫌角色提起公诉。
法院表示，如果不拘留朴槿惠，她可能会“销毁证据”。

questions.name: #225 Consumer Confidence
questions.en:
The Conference Board’s consumer-confidence index, which measures both American consumers’ assessment of current conditions and their expectations, rose to its highest level since 2001.
Updated figures from the Commerce Department confirmed earlier estimates that the economy grew by 1.6% year-on-year in 2016, the slowest rate for five years—though growth picked up to 1.9% in the final quarter.
questions.zh:

美国商务部最新数据证实了早先的估算，2016年经济同比增长1.6%，为五年来最低增速，尽管最后一季度增速回升至1.9%。

questions.name: #226 Astronomic Discovery
questions.en:
Astronomers discovered seven planets, roughly Earth-sized, orbiting a dwarf star some 380 trillion kilometers from our own.
That is 40 light years away—fairly close and within range of planned big telescopes.
Scientists therefore think it offers the best chance yet to discover evidence of life, or why it hasn’t evolved, beyond the solar system.
questions.zh:
天文学家发现了七颗行星，大小与地球相仿，它们围绕着一颗距离我们约380万亿公里的矮星运行。
那大约是40光年远——相当近，属于计划中的大型望远镜的观测范围。
因此，科学家认为这提供了迄今为止最好的机会，去发现太阳系外存在生命的证据，或者解释为什么生命没有演化出来。

questions.name: #227 Consultation
questions.en:
The Mexican government began a 90-day consultation on the North American Free Trade Agreement with the country’s lawmakers and business community.
The discussion is required before holding talks with America to review NAFTA’s terms.
Donald Trump wants to renegotiate the trade pact—of which Canada is also a member—to get better terms for America.
questions.zh:
墨西哥政府启动了为期90天的磋商，就北美自由贸易协定征求本国立法者和商界的意见。
在与美国谈判以重新审视北美自由贸易协定条款之前，必须进行这一讨论。
唐纳德·特朗普希望重新谈判这一贸易协定——加拿大也是成员国之一——以便为美国争取更有利的条件。

questions.name: #228 Ford
questions.en:
Ford made a U-turn, scrapping plans for a 1.6 billion factory in Mexico to build compact cars, and diverting some of the investment to a plant near Detroit to produce electric vehicles.
Ford stressed that this was a commercial decision.
Donald Trump had criticized the proposed Mexican factory while campaigning on the theme of saving American jobs.
questions.zh:
福特来了个急转弯，取消了在墨西哥建一座16亿美元工厂生产紧凑型汽车的计划，并将部分投资转投到底特律附近的一家工厂，用于生产电动汽车。
福特强调，这是一个商业决策。

questions.name: #229 Dwayne Johnson
questions.en:
Dwayne Johnson has thanked fans for their support after he opened up about his battle with depression.
The 45 year old discussed his mother's suicide attempt and a period he described as the "worst time" of his life in an interview with The Express.
"Got tonnes of responses to this.
Thank you," he wrote on Twitter on Monday.
"We all go through the sludge and depression never discriminates.
questions.zh:
道恩·强森在公开自己与抑郁症的斗争后，感谢了粉丝们的支持。
这位45岁的明星在接受《快报》采访时，谈到了母亲的自杀未遂，以及他称之为人生“最糟糕时期”的一段经历。
“收到了大量回复。
谢谢你们，”他周一在推特上写道。
“我们都会经历低谷，而抑郁症从不区别对待任何人。”

questions.name: #230 YouTube
questions.en:
YouTube has banned videos that show people how to manufacture or modify guns and their accessories.
It had already banned videos linked to the sale of guns and accessories.
Many firearms enthusiasts noticed that some of their videos had been removed from the video-sharing website and some had their channels suspended.

许多枪支爱好者注意到，他们的一些视频被这个视频分享网站删除了，还有一些人的频道被暂停了。

questions.name: #231 Carbon Dioxide Emission
questions.en:
When countries assess their annual carbon dioxide emissions, they count up their cars and power stations, but bush fires are not included presumably because they are deemed to be events beyond human control.
In Australia, Victoria alone sees several hundred thousand hectares burn each year; in both 2004 and the present summer, the figure has been over 1 million hectares.
questions.zh:
各国在评估年度二氧化碳排放量时，会统计汽车和发电站的数据，但丛林火灾通常不被计入，大概是因为这些被视为人类无法控制的事件。
仅澳大利亚维多利亚州每年就有数十万公顷的土地被烧毁；在2004年和今年夏天，这一数字都超过了100万公顷。

questions.name: #232 Oberto
questions.en:
After a century of making sausage, the Oberto family is selling their namesake business to a large Canadian food conglomerate.
But the local management says Oberto’s employees, manufacturing plant and sponsored hydroplanes with the red-white-and-green livery will see few changes.
Premium Brand Holdings, which is based in Richmond, B.
, and owns dozens of food manufacturers and distributors, is set to buy “substantially all” of Oberto Brands’ assets.
questions.zh:
在做了整整一个世纪的香肠后，奥伯托家族决定将他们同名的企业卖给一家加拿大大型食品集团。
但当地管理层表示，奥伯托的员工、制造工厂以及那些带有红白绿涂装的赞助赛艇，都不会有太大变化。
总部位于里士满的豪华品牌控股公司。
它还拥有数十家食品制造商和分销商，准备收购Oberto Brands的‘几乎所有’资产。

questions.name: #233 Hubble Space Telescope
questions.en:
The successor to the Hubble Space Telescope has been delayed yet again and will not now launch until "approximately May 2020”.
The James Webb Space Telescope is also in danger of busting the cost cap put on the project by the US Congress.
Back in 2011, politicians on Capitol Hill said the observatory should not take more than 8 billion to build and 800 million to operate over five years in orbit.
questions.zh:
哈勃太空望远镜的继任者再次推迟发射，现在预计要到2020年5月左右才能升空。
詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜还面临突破美国国会设定的成本上限的风险。
早在2011年，国会山的政客们就表示，该天文台的建造费用不应超过80亿美元，而其在轨运行五年的运营成本也不应超过8亿美元。

questions.name: #234 Tambora
questions.en:
On 1815, on the island of Sumbawa in Indonesia, a handsome and long quiescent mountain named Tambora exploded spectacularly, killing a hundred thousand people with its blast and associated tsunamis.
No one living now has ever seen such fury.
Tambora was far bigger than anything any living human has experienced.
It was the biggest volcanic explosion in ten thousand years, 150 times the size of Mount St.
Helens, equivalent to sixty thousand Hiroshima- sized atom bombs.
questions.zh:
1815年，印度尼西亚松巴哇岛上，一座英俊而长期休眠的山——坦博拉火山——剧烈爆发，爆炸及其引发的海啸导致十万人丧生。
如今活着的人从未见过如此猛烈的景象。
坦博拉火山比任何在世人类经历过的火山都要大得多。
这是一万年来最大的一次火山爆发，规模是圣海伦斯火山的150倍。
相当于六万颗广岛原子弹的威力。

questions.name: #235 Exponential Growth
questions.en:
The exponential growth of the internet was heralded, in the 1990s, as revolutionizing the production and dissemination of information.
Some people saw the internet as a means of democratizing access to knowledge.
For people concerned with African development, it seemed to offer the possibility of leap frogging over the technology gap that separates Africa from advanced industrialized countries.
questions.zh:
上世纪90年代，互联网的指数级增长被赞誉为信息生产和传播的革命。
有些人将互联网视为知识获取民主化的工具。
对于关注非洲发展的人来说，它似乎提供了跨越非洲与先进工业化国家之间技术鸿沟的可能性。

questions.name: #236 Tree Frog
questions.en:
A miner in the state of Chiapas found a tiny tree frog that has been preserved in amber for 25 million years, a researcher said.
If authenticated, the preserved frog would be the first of its kind found in Mexico, according to David Grimaldi, a biologist and curator at the American Museum of Natural History, who was not involved in the find.
questions.zh:
一名研究人员称，恰帕斯州的一位矿工发现了一只被困在琥珀中长达2500万年之久的小树蛙。
美国自然历史博物馆的生物学家兼策展人大卫·格里马尔迪（未参与此次发现）表示，如果鉴定属实，这只保存完好的蛙将成为墨西哥发现的首个同类标本。

questions.name: #237 Uranus
questions.en:
Scientists have determined that the atmosphere above the planet Uranus is full of a gas that makes the distant planet smell like rotten eggs.
According to NASA, a global research team dissected infrared light from Uranus and found hydrogen sulfide in the planet's top clouds.
Hydrogen sulfide is a "colorless, flammable, extremely hazardous gas with a 'rotten egg' smell," according to the Occupational Health & Safety Administration.
questions.zh:
科学家们已经确定，天王星上空的大气中充满了一种气体，这使得这颗遥远的星球闻起来像臭鸡蛋。
据美国国家航空航天局称，一个全球研究团队分析了天王星的红外光，并在该行星的顶层云中发现了硫化氢。
根据职业健康与安全管理局的说法，硫化氢是一种“无色、易燃、极具危险的气体，带有‘臭鸡蛋’气味”。

questions.name: #238 Karl Marx
questions.en:
It has been 200 years since the birth of Karl Marx, but the German philosopher's relevance has never been greater.
The publication of Marx and Friedrich Engels' The Communist Manifesto in 1848 was not greeted with great fanfare — a reception unbecoming what is now considered the most influential political pamphlet of all time.
questions.zh:
卡尔·马克思已经诞生200年了，但这位德国哲学家的影响力比以往任何时候都要大。
1848年马克思和弗里德里希·恩格斯的《共产党宣言》出版时并没有引起轰动——这种反响与如今被视为有史以来最具影响力的政治小册子并不相称。

questions.name: #239 Castle Dove
questions.en:
Ministers have rehearsed for the Queen's death for the first time with a secret exercise to prepare for 10 days of national mourning, it has emerged.
The run-through, apparently known as Castle Dove, saw Cabinet ministers and Whitehall officials discuss 'D+1', the day after the monarch's death.
questions.zh:
据报道，部长们首次通过秘密演习模拟了女王去世后的应对流程，为为期十天的全国哀悼做准备。
这场代号为“城堡鸽”的预演中，内阁大臣和英国政府官员讨论了君主去世次日（即D+1）的相关事宜。

questions.en: Japan's Parliament tightened limits on overtime hours, responding to concerns about karoshi , or death by overwork, and seeking to improve productivity in a country where long hours are more a custom than business necessity.

questions.name: #241 Australian Workplaces
questions.en:
Australian workplaces are increasingly suffering from depression, anxiety and stress, according to a large study of mental health in corporate Australia.
Mental illness appears to have increased by a third in the last decade.
Depression is now the primary mental health disorder.
questions.zh:
一项针对澳大利亚企业心理健康的大规模研究显示，职场中抑郁、焦虑和压力问题日益严重。
过去十年间，精神疾病的发病率似乎增加了三分之一。
如今，抑郁症已成为最主要的心理健康问题。

questions.name: #242 More Food
questions.en:
Does it feel like everywhere you turn there's more food?
Fast food joints like McDonalds and Taco Bell abound.
And big box stores like Costco, Walmart and Target sell mounds of groceries.
Just the slightest pang of hunger and around the corner there's another restaurant or retailer enticing us to buy more food.
questions.zh:
是不是感觉走到哪儿都是吃的？
麦当劳、塔可钟这类快餐店遍地都是。
还有像好市多、沃尔玛、塔吉特这样的大卖场，堆满了各种食品杂货。
只要肚子稍微有点饿，转角就会冒出另一家餐厅或商店，引诱我们买更多吃的。

questions.name: #243 Money and Happiness
questions.en:
This will just take a minute.
We all know money can't buy happiness.
But according to a recent study, there may be a loophole.
A team of researchers finds that shelling out for services that save time can bring greater feelings of life satisfaction than, say, simply buying more stuff.
The results appear in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences.
questions.zh:
马上就完。
谁都知道钱买不来幸福。
不过最近有项研究说，可能有个空子可钻。
一组研究人员发现，花钱买服务省时间，比光买东西更能提升生活满足感。
这项结果发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上。

questions.name: #244 Uncaffeinated Adults
questions.en:
Researchers gathered 160 uncaffeinated adults, people who consumed less than 500 milligrams of caffeine a week.
These decaf subjects looked at pictures of various objects, then took either a placebo or a pill containing 200 milligrams of caffeine.
That’s roughly the amount you'd get from two cups of coffee.
questions.zh:
研究人员招募了160名不常摄入咖啡因的成年人，这些人每周摄入的咖啡因不到500毫克。
这些不喝咖啡因的受试者先观看各种物体的图片，然后服用了安慰剂或含有200毫克咖啡因的药片。
这大约相当于你从两杯咖啡中摄入的量。

questions.name: #245 Agreement
questions.en: Such an agreement would include recognition that the world must aim as soon as possible to hold global warming to 1.5-degree Celsius; a long-term low-carbon future; 5-year updated action plans that recognize the developing climate reality; and aid to those countries that did little to cause climate change but are most at risk from it.
questions.zh: 这项协议将包括：承认世界必须尽快将全球变暖控制在1.5摄氏度以内；规划长期低碳未来；制定每五年更新的行动计划以应对不断变化的气候现实；以及向那些对气候变化贡献甚微却面临最大风险的国家提供援助。

questions.name: #246 Studying Abroad
questions.en:
Studying abroad is a very popular option for students who come from a wealthy family.
Most people believe that overseas experience provides a deeper understanding of cultures and develops communication skills.
While this may be true, not all of these new experiences are useful for finding a job.
Employers tend to value interpersonal skills and industry knowledge more than cultural background.
questions.zh:
对于家境富裕的学生来说，出国留学是一个非常热门的选择。
多数人认为，海外经历能让人更深入地理解不同文化，并锻炼沟通能力。
虽然这可能是真的，但并非所有这些新经历都对找工作有帮助。
雇主往往更看重人际交往能力和行业知识，而不是文化背景。

Britain, then, as slower to create and develop a police force than the rest of Europe.

questions.name: #250 Girls v.s. Boys
questions.en:
Teenage girls are continuing to outperform boys in English while the gender gap in achievements in math and science has almost disappeared.
The figures show that last year 80% of 14-year-old girls reached at least the expected level 5 in English, compared with 65% of boys.
But in math, the girls are just 1% ahead of boys, while in science the difference is 2%.
questions.zh:
十几岁的女孩在英语方面持续领先男孩，而数学和科学成绩上的性别差距几乎消失了。
数据显示，去年80%的14岁女孩在英语上至少达到了预期的5级水平，而男孩只有65%。
但在数学上，女孩仅领先男孩1%，在科学上差距为2%。

questions.name: #251 Supernova
questions.en:
The term supernova was coined in the 1930s by a memorably odd astrophysicist named Fritz Zwicky.
Born in Bulgaria and raised in Switzerland, Zwicky came to the California Institute of Technology in the 1920s and there as once distinguished himself by his abrasive personality and erratic talents.
He didn’t seem to be outstandingly bright, and many of his colleagues considered him little more than “an irritating buffoon”.
questions.zh:
“超新星”这个词是20世纪30年代由一位名叫弗里茨·兹威基的古怪天体物理学家创造的。
兹威基出生于保加利亚，在瑞士长大，20世纪20年代来到加州理工学院，在那里，他以其尖刻的性格和捉摸不定的才华而闻名。
他看起来并不特别聪明，许多同事认为他不过是个“令人讨厌的小丑”。

questions.name: #252 Difficult Conversations
questions.en:
Surprisingly, despite what appear to be infinite variations, all difficult conversations share a common structure.
When you’re caught up in the details and anxiety of a particular difficult conversation, this structure is hard to see.
But understanding that structure is essential to improve how you handle your most challenging conversations.
questions.zh:
令人惊讶的是，尽管看似有无数种变化，所有棘手的对话其实都有共同的结构。
当你深陷于某次棘手对话的细节和焦虑中时，这种结构很难看清。
但理解这种结构对于改善你处理最具挑战性的对话的方式至关重要。

questions.name: #255 December Sales
questions.en:
Weakness in electronics, auto and gas station sales dragged down overall retail sales last month, but excluding those three categories, retailers enjoyed healthy increases across the board, according to government figures released Wednesday.
Moreover, December sales numbers were also revised higher.
questions.zh:
根据周三发布的政府数据，上个月整体零售额受到电子、汽车和加油站销售疲软的拖累，但排除这三个类别后，零售商的销售额全面健康增长。
此外，12月份的销售数据也被上调了。

questions.name: #256 Side Effects
questions.en:
Where there are effects, there are often side effects.
The car is a boon to mobility, but can lead to obesity, deaths and pollution.
Burning fossil fuel may keep economies going but wreck the climate in the long run.
In a similar way, there are side effects to information technology in education setting - from childcare to the classroom to the lecture hall and beyond.
questions.zh:
有作用的地方，往往也有副作用。
汽车方便了出行，但也可能导致肥胖、死亡和污染。
燃烧化石燃料也许能维持经济发展，但长期来看会破坏气候。
类似地，信息技术在教育环境中也有副作用——从托儿所到教室，再到报告厅，乃至更远的地方。

questions.name: #257 Free Market
questions.en:
The free market is extremely competitive and companies are constantly trying to gain an edge over their rivals.
Merchandizing and brand image play a major role in attracting customers, but they often lead to over-packaging.
This is a serious problem since most packaging these days are made of plastics which are not biodegradable.
Some people blame the manufacturers for their blatant disregard, while others point the finger at consumers.
questions.zh:
自由市场竞争异常激烈，企业总想方设法抢占先机。
商品推销和品牌形象在吸引顾客方面作用巨大，但这也常常导致过度包装。
这是个严重的问题，因为如今大多数包装都用塑料制成，而塑料无法生物降解。
有人指责制造商明目张胆地无视问题，也有人把矛头指向消费者。

questions.name: #260 English Revolution
questions.en: The English Revolution has been interpreted in several ways by historians: as a fight between the aristocratic Cavaliers, who were open to life, and the serious Puritans; as a battle for power between parliament and the monarchy over the rights of Englishmen that had been going on for centuries; and as a class war similar to the French Revolution, of which it was a forerunner.

questions.name: #262 Magnetar
questions.en:
The best comparison is likely a magnetar, a young neutron star with a powerful magnetic field, the researchers said.
Magnetars also produce bright X-ray flares.
While magnetars are thought to be young stars, the two flaring objects in this study reside near elliptical galaxies, which contain older stars.
So the objects are likely too old to be magnetars, the researchers said.
questions.zh:
研究人员表示，最可能的类比是磁星，这是一种拥有强大磁场的年轻中子星。
磁星还会产生明亮的X射线耀斑。
尽管磁星被认为是年轻的恒星，但本研究中两个产生耀斑的天体位于椭圆星系附近，而这些星系中居住着更古老的恒星。
因此研究人员认为，这些天体可能太老了，不可能是磁星。

questions.name: #263 Psychologist
questions.en:
Psychologist Saho Takagi, a graduate student at Kyoto University in Japan, strolls into one of Japan’s many cat cafes.
These establishments allow customers to pay an hourly fee for the chance to cuddle some cats.
They’re popular in Japan because so many apartment buildings forbid pet ownership.
But Takagi isn’t a typical customer She’s not there for feline affection, but to probe their minds.
questions.zh:
日本京都大学的研究生、心理学家高木沙步走进一家日本常见的猫咖。
这些店铺让顾客按小时付费，以便有机会抱抱猫咪。
它们在日本很受欢迎，因为很多公寓楼禁止养宠物。
但高木不是普通顾客，她来不是为了寻求猫咪的喜爱，而是为了探究它们的想法。

questions.name: #264 Culture Comparison
questions.en:
In comparing material with non-material culture - the first being the objects and technologies we create, and the second our customs, beliefs and attitudes - the speaker gives greater emphasis to the material culture.
He gives the example of the development of genetic science and the benefits it has brought to mankind , despite a fair amount of opposition.
questions.zh:
在对比物质文化与非物质文化时——前者指的是我们创造出的物品和技术，后者则是我们的习俗、信仰和态度——演讲者更侧重于物质文化。
他举了基因科学发展的例子，尽管遭遇了不少反对，但它仍为人类带来了诸多益处。

questions.name: #265 Copyright
questions.en:
The quest for a user-friendly copyright regime began a decade ago when the Hong Kong government launched a public consultation on "Copyright Protection in the Digital Environment" in December 2006.
Although this consultation initially sought to address internet-related challenges, such as those caused by peer-to-peer file­sharing technology, the reform effort quickly evolved into a more comprehensive digital upgrade of the Hong Kong copyright regime.
questions.zh:
对用户友好版权制度的追求始于十年前，当时香港政府在2006年12月就“数码环境下的版权保护”展开公众咨询。
虽然这次咨询最初旨在应对互联网带来的挑战，比如点对点文件分享技术所引发的问题，但改革很快演变为对香港版权制度更全面的数字化升级。

questions.name: #269 Language Appearance
questions.en:
It seems that language appeared from nowhere since no other species has anything resembling human language.
However, other animals do possess basic systems for perceiving and producing sounds that enable them to communicate.
These systems may have been in place before the appearance of language.
questions.zh:
语言似乎凭空出现，因为其他物种都没有类似人类语言的东西。
不过，其他动物确实拥有感知和发出声音的基本系统，使它们能够交流。
这些系统可能在语言出现之前就已经存在了。

questions.name: #270 Question Doddging
questions.en:
Clementson wanted to see if claims of question dodging actually held up, historically — not necessarily in the unique case of Trump.
So Clementson analysed the transcripts of 14 presidential debates, from 1996 to 2012 .
Overall, he found 51 accusations of question dodging — 26 by Dems, 25 by Republicans.
questions.zh:
克莱门森想看看，从历史上来看，回避问题的指控是否真的成立——不一定非要针对特朗普这个特例。
于是克莱门森分析了1996年至2012年间14场总统辩论的文字记录。
总体而言，他发现了51次回避问题的指控——其中26次来自民主党，25次来自共和党。

questions.name: #271 Paleontological Momentum
questions.en:
By this time, however, paleontological momentum had moved to England.
In 1812, at Lyme Regis on the Dorset coast, an extraordinary child named Mary Anning — aged 11, 12 or 13, depending on whose account you read — found a strange fossilized sea monster, 17 feet long and now known as the ichthyosaurus, embedded in the steep and 17 dangerous cliffs along the English Channel.
questions.zh:
然而到这个时候，古生物学的研究重心已经转移到了英国。
1812年，在多塞特海岸的莱姆里吉斯，一个名叫玛丽·安宁的非凡儿童——根据你读到的记载，她当时11岁、12岁或13岁——在英吉利海峡陡峭而危险的悬崖上发现了一具奇怪的海洋怪物化石，长17英尺，现在被称为鱼龙。

questions.name: #272 Specimen
questions.en:
They controlled for the birds' age, sex, body size and species.
And they found that the hunted specimens' brains were actually five percent smaller, on average, than the brains of birds that died by other means.
"The surprising thing is that, if you make a similar kind of analysis of liver or heart size, there is absolutely no difference there.
So this is specific to the brain”.

令人惊讶的是，如果对肝脏或心脏大小进行类似分析，则完全没有差异。
所以这是大脑特有的现象。

questions.name: #274 Use of IT
questions.en:
DeLone and McLean’s model has been criticized by some authors.
Indeed, this model is specific to contexts of voluntary use of information technology.
The usage variable remains a success variable of information systems if the user himself decides to adopt or reject the technology.
However, for mandatory uses, such as for ERP systems, the use of the technology is obvious.
The success of information systems cannot, therefore, be measured by usage.
questions.zh:
德龙和麦克莱恩的模型受到了一些作者的批评。
确实，这个模型特指自愿使用信息技术的场景。
如果用户自行决定是否采用该技术，使用量这个变量仍然是信息系统成功的一个指标。
然而，对于像ERP系统这样的强制性使用场景，技术的使用是显而易见的。
因此，信息系统的成功不能通过使用量来衡量。

questions.name: #275 The UN
questions.en:
Since its inception, the UN system has been working to ensure adequate food for all through sustainable agriculture.
The majority of the world's poorest people live in rural areas of developing countries.
They depend on agriculture and related activities for their livelihoods.
This makes them particularly vulnerable to man-made and natural influences that reduce agricultural production.
questions.zh:
自成立以来，联合国系统一直致力于通过可持续农业确保人人有足够的食物。
世界上最贫困的人口大多生活在发展中国家的农村地区。
他们依靠农业和相关活动维持生计。
这使他们特别容易受到人为和自然因素的影响，这些因素会降低农业产量。

questions.name: #276 Diplomacy
questions.en:
For diplomacy the starting point must be that globalization requires bridges and removes barriers.
A policy of containment is a difficult strategy in the age of the fibre-optic cable, the jumbo jet and the satellite dish.
There will always be the exception, such as the murderous regime in Iraq where the only safe strategy is to keep it in the isolation ward until it accepts the norms of international behavior, or the military dictatorship in Burma which has persistently failed to respond to dialogue.
It takes two to critically engage.
questions.zh:
就外交而言，出发点必须是全球化需要搭建桥梁、消除障碍。
在光纤电缆、大型喷气式客机和卫星天线的时代，遏制政策是一种难以实施的策略。
总会有例外，比如伊拉克的残暴政权，唯一安全的策略就是将其隔离，直到它接受国际行为准则；再比如缅甸的军事独裁政权，它一直拒绝通过对话解决问题。
批判性参与需要双方共同努力。

It contains many different adventures, and the path you take will depend on the choices you make along the way.

questions.name: #278 Russia
questions.en:
Long isolated from Western Europe, Russia grew up without participating in the development like the Reformation that many Russians taking pride in their unique culture, find dubious value.
Russia is, as a result, the most unusual member of the European family, if indeed it is European at all.
The question is still open to debate, particularly among Russians themselves.
questions.zh:
俄罗斯长期与西欧隔绝，没有参与像宗教改革这样的发展进程，许多俄罗斯人为自己独特的文化感到自豪，认为这些发展价值可疑。
因此，俄罗斯是欧洲家庭中最不寻常的成员，如果它真的属于欧洲的话。
这个问题仍有待讨论，尤其是在俄罗斯人自己中间。

questions.name: #280 Lenient Parents
questions.en:
Two sisters were at a dinner party when the conversation turned to upbringing.
The elder sister started to say that her parents had been very strict and that she had been rather frightened of them.
Her sister, younger by two years, interrupted in amazement.
"What are you talking about?" she said.
"Our parents were very lenient."
questions.zh:
两姐妹在一次晚宴上，话题聊到了教养问题。
姐姐开始说父母对她管教很严，她挺怕他们的。
比她小两岁的妹妹惊讶地打断了她。
“你在说什么呀？”她说。
“我们的父母非常宽容。”

questions.name: #281 Semiconductor Industry
questions.en:
The semiconductor industry has been able to improve the performance of electronic systems for more than four decades by making ever-smaller devices.
However, this approach will soon encounter both scientific and technical limits, which is why the industry is exploring a number of alternative device technologies.
questions.zh:
四十多年来，半导体行业通过不断缩小器件尺寸，提升了电子系统的性能。
然而，这种方法很快会触及科学和技术的极限，因此该行业正在探索多种替代器件技术。

questions.name: #282 Economic Situation
questions.en:
In his landmark account, first published over twenty years ago, the author argues that the ignorance and lethargy of the poor are direct results of the whole situation of economic, social and political domination.
By being kept in a situation in which critical awareness and response are practically impossible the disadvantaged are kept ‘submerged’.
questions.zh:
在他二十多年前首次出版的里程碑式著作中，作者认为穷人的无知和懒散是经济、社会和政治全方位压迫的直接后果。
由于被置于几乎无法进行批判性思考和回应的境地，弱势群体始终处于‘被淹没’的状态。

questions.name: #283 Black Swan
questions.en:
Before European explorers had reached Australia, it was believed that all swans were white.
Dutch mariner, Antonie Caen, was the first to be amazed at the sight of Australia's Black swans on the Shark Bay in 1636.
Explorer Willem de Vlamingh captured two of these creatures on Australia's Swan River and returned with them to Europe to prove their existence.
From that point on, black swans and Australia have been closely linked.
questions.zh:
在欧洲探险家到达澳大利亚之前，人们一直以为天鹅都是白色的。
荷兰水手安东尼·凯恩于1636年在鲨鱼湾首次目睹澳大利亚黑天鹅，感到无比惊奇。
探险家威廉·德·弗拉明在澳大利亚的天鹅河捕获了两只这种生物，并将它们带回欧洲以证明其存在。
从那时起，黑天鹅与澳大利亚便紧密联系在了一起。

questions.name: #284 Mental Illness
questions.en:
A mental illness is a health problem that significantly affects how a person feels, thinks, behaves, and interacts with other people.
People who experience mental illnesses and their family and friends suffer a great deal due to these illnesses.
According to the World Health Organization, depression will be one of the biggest health problems worldwide by the year 2020.
questions.zh:

患有心理疾病的人以及他们的家人和朋友会因为这些疾病而遭受巨大的痛苦。
根据世界卫生组织的预测，到2020年，抑郁症将成为全球最大的健康问题之一。

questions.name: #285 Social Media
questions.en:
Social media are playing an increasingly important role as information sources for travelers.
The goal of this study is to investigate the extent to which social media appear in search engine results in the context of travel-related searches.
It also provides evidence for challenges faced by traditional providers of travel-related information.
questions.zh:
社交媒体作为旅行者的信息来源，正扮演着越来越重要的角色。
这项研究旨在探讨在旅行相关搜索中，社交媒体出现在搜索引擎结果中的程度。
同时，它也揭示了传统旅行信息提供者所面临的挑战。

questions.name: #286 Infrastructure
questions.en:
The grid-based infrastructure enables large-scale scientific applications to be run on distributed resources.
However, in practice, grid resources are not very easy to use for the end-users who have to learn how to generate security credentials.
There is an imminent need to provide transparent access to these resources so that the end-users are shielded from the complicated details.
questions.zh:
基于网格的基础设施让大规模科学应用可以在分布式资源上运行。
但实际上，网格资源对终端用户来说并不太好用，他们还得学习如何生成安全凭证。
现在迫切需要提供对这些资源的透明访问，让终端用户不用操心那些复杂的细节。

questions.name: #287 Brain Development
questions.en:
Scientific studies show that by age three there is a gap in brain development between kids who read aloud and those who do not, and children from low-income families are disproportionately impacted by this gap.
Making sure all parents know the importance of reading aloud to their children is critical to closing the achievement gap.
questions.zh:
科学研究显示，到了三岁，经常听朗读的孩子和没听过的孩子之间会出现大脑发育差距，低收入家庭的孩子受这种差距的影响尤为严重。
确保所有父母都了解给孩子朗读的重要性，这对于缩小成绩差距至关重要。

questions.name: #288 Fast Food
questions.en:
Hundreds of millions of American people eat fast food every day without giving it too much thought, unaware of the subtle and not so subtle ramifications of their purchases.
They just grab their tray off the counter, find a table, take a seat, unwrap the paper, and dig in.
The whole experience is transitory and soon forgotten.
questions.zh:
每天有数亿美国人吃快餐，他们对此习以为常，完全没意识到自己的消费行为会带来哪些或明显或微妙的影响。
他们只是从柜台拿起餐盘，找个桌子坐下，撕开包装纸，然后大快朵颐。
整个过程转瞬即逝，很快就被抛之脑后。

questions.name: #290 Love
questions.en:
It seems that when it comes to love, men and women are designed to misconstrue, misread and misunderstand one another and themselves.
You discover that in fact they make good sense.
Being a deluded romantic is often the best way to make a good — biologically successful — choice about a potential partner on the basis.
questions.zh:
看来在爱情这件事上，男女天生就容易误解彼此，也误解自己。
你会发现，其实他们说的很有道理。
做个浪漫的糊涂虫，往往是做出明智——也就是生物学上成功——择偶选择的最佳方式。

questions.name: #291 Brain Secrets
questions.en:
Scientists know little about how exactly it works, especially when it comes to complex functions like memory formation.
Research is more advanced in animals, but experiments on humans are hard.
Yet, even today, some parts of the brain, like the motor cortex, are better understood.
Nor is complete knowledge always needed.
Machine learning can recognize patterns of neural activity; the brain itself gets the hang of controlling BCIS with extraordinary ease.
And neurotechnology will reveal more of the brain's secrets.
questions.zh:
科学家对它具体如何运作知之甚少，尤其是在记忆形成这类复杂功能方面。
动物研究更为深入，但在人类身上进行实验却很困难。
然而，即使是今天，大脑的某些部分，比如运动皮层，也已被更好地理解。
完全的知识也并非总是必需的。
机器学习可以识别神经活动的模式；大脑本身也能极其轻松地掌握控制脑机接口的技巧。
而神经技术将揭示更多大脑的秘密。

questions.name: #292 The Awards
questions.en:
This year the National Environmental Science Competition received excellent undergraduate and postgraduate entries from all across the country, with a wide range of projects.
We are delighted that our awards are encouraging exciting and valuable projects that go beyond research and analysis to develop solutions for a number of key problems.
Information about the shortlisted projects will be posted on our website in the first week in June.
questions.zh:
今年全国环境科学竞赛收到了来自全国各地的优秀本科生和研究生参赛作品，项目种类繁多。
我们很高兴我们的奖项正在鼓励那些激动人心且富有价值的项目，这些项目不仅限于研究和分析，还为若干关键问题开发解决方案。
入围项目的信息将在六月的第一周发布在我们的网站上。

questions.name: #293 Tesla
questions.en:
Tesla's theoretical work formed the basis of modern alternating current electric power systems.
Thomas Edison promised him almost one million dollars in today's money to undertake motor and generator improvement.
However, when Tesla asked about the money, Edison reportedly replied "Tesla, you don't understand our American humor.
"The pair became arch-rivals.
questions.zh:
特斯拉的理论工作奠定了现代交流电系统的基础。
托马斯·爱迪生承诺给他相当于现在近一百万美元的报酬，让他改进电机和发电机。
然而，当特斯拉提起这笔钱时，据说爱迪生回答说：“特斯拉，你不懂我们美国人的幽默。”
两人成了死对头。

questions.name: #294 Electric Car
questions.en:
First-year university students have designed and built a groundbreaking electric car that recharges itself.
Fifty students from the University's Faculty of Engineering spent five months cobbling together bits of plywood, foam and fiberglass to build the concept car.
They developed the specifications and built the car.
It's a pretty radical design: a four-wheel drive with a motor in each wheel.
questions.zh:
大学一年级学生设计并制造了一款能自行充电的突破性电动汽车。
来自大学工程学院的五十名学生花了五个月时间，用胶合板、泡沫和玻璃纤维拼凑出这款概念车。
他们制定了规格并制造了这辆车。
这是一个相当激进的设计：四轮驱动，每个轮子都有一个电机。

questions.name: #295 Grand Canyon 2
questions.en:
Few things in the world produce such amazement as one's first glimpse of the Grand Canyon; it took around more than 2 billion years to create this vast wonder - in some places.
17 miles wide, largely through the relentless force of Colorado River, which runs 277 miles along its length, a mile beneath its towering rims.
questions.zh:
世界上很少有东西能像第一次看到大峡谷那样令人惊叹；在某些地方，这个广阔的奇观花了超过20亿年才形成。
它宽达17英里，主要是科罗拉多河不懈的力量造就的，这条河沿着峡谷延伸277英里，在它高耸的岩壁下方一英里处流淌。

questions.name: #297 Statistical Information
questions.en:
The provision of accurate and authoritative statistical information strengthens modern societies.
It provides a basis for decisions to be made on such things as where to open schools and hospitals, how much money to spend on welfare payments and even which football players to replace at half-time.

questions.name: #298 Fence
questions.en:
Fence, humanly erected barrier between two divisions of land, used to mark a legal or other boundary, to keep animals or people in or out, and sometimes as an ornament.
In newly settled lands fences are usually made of materials at hand, e.g., stone, earth, or wood.
questions.zh:
篱笆是人类在两块土地之间竖起的屏障，用来标记法定或其他边界，防止动物或人进出，有时也用作装饰。
在新开垦的土地上，篱笆通常用随手可得的材料制成，比如石头、泥土或木头。

questions.name: #299 Parkinson
questions.en:
Northcote Parkinson, a British writer, formulated Parkinson's rule: "Work expands to fill the time allotted to it; or, conversely, the amount of work completed is in inverse proportion to the number of people employed." Simply said: If you have an hour to do a 5-minute job, it will take an hour to do it.
A large number of people accomplish less work than a smaller number of people.
questions.zh:
英国作家诺斯科特·帕金森提出了帕金森定律："工作会膨胀，占满分配给它的时间；或者反过来说，完成的工作量与雇佣的人数成反比。"简单来说：如果你有一小时来完成只需五分钟的工作，那就会花掉一小时。
一大群人完成的工作量反而比一小群人少。

questions.name: #300 Shrimp Farm
questions.en:
Shrimp farmers used to hold animals in nursery ponds for 30 to 60 days; now they try to move them into grow-out ponds in less than 30 days.
This reduces stress on the animals and dramatically increases survivals in the grow-out ponds.
Many farms that abandoned nursery ponds have gone back to them, and the results have been surprisingly positive.
They're using the old, uncovered, earthen, nursery ponds.
questions.zh:
以前虾农会把虾苗在育苗池里养上30到60天，现在他们尽量在30天内就把虾苗转到养成池。
这样可以减少虾的压力，大幅提高养成池的成活率。
很多放弃育苗池的养殖场又用回了它们，结果出人意料地好。
他们用的是那种传统露天土池育苗池。

questions.name: #301 Leader Waves
questions.en:
The next wave of leaders in industrial manufacturing will build an ecosystem that capitalizes on the promise of analytics and connectivity to maximize efficiency for themselves and their customers.
They will map out their strategies and prioritize measures that will bring the most value to their business, starting now with pilot projects, and building greater strengths in data analytics with cross-functional teams of experts.

他们将规划战略，优先考虑能为业务带来最大价值的措施，从现在开始进行试点项目，并通过跨职能专家团队增强数据分析能力。

questions.name: #302 Elephant
questions.en:
The elephant is the largest living land mammal.
During evolution, its skeleton has greatly altered from the usual mammal, designed for two main reasons.
One is to cope with the great weight of huge grinding cheek teeth and elongated tusk, making the skull particularly massive.
The other is to support the enormous bulk of such a huge body.
questions.zh:
大象是现存最大的陆地哺乳动物。
在进化过程中，它的骨骼与普通哺乳动物相比发生了很大变化，这主要是出于两个原因。
一个是为了适应巨大的磨牙和长牙的重量，使得头骨特别庞大。
另一个是为了支撑如此庞大身体的巨大重量。

questions.name: #303 Business School Admission
questions.en:
Business school admissions officers said the new drive to attract younger students was in part the result of a realization that they had inadvertently limited their applicant pool by requiring several years' work experience.
Talented students who might otherwise have gone to business school instead opted for a law or policy degree because they were intimidated by the expectation of work experience.
questions.zh:
商学院招生官表示，吸引更年轻学生的新举措部分源于他们意识到，要求多年工作经验无意中限制了申请者群体。
那些本可能选择商学院的有才华的学生，因为对工作经验的要求感到畏惧，转而选择了法律或政策学位。

questions.name: #305 Orientalists
questions.en:
Orientalists, like many other nineteenth-century thinkers, conceive of humanity either in large collective terms or in abstract generalities.
Orientalists are neither interested in nor capable of discussing individuals; instead, artificial entities predominate.
Similarly, the age-old distinction between "Europe" and "Asia" or "Occident" and "Orient" herds beneath very wide labels of every possible variety of human plurality, reducing it in the process to one or two terminal collective realities.
questions.zh:
东方学家，如同许多19世纪的思想家一样，要么从宏大的集体角度，要么从抽象的普遍性来理解人类。
东方学家既不感兴趣也没有能力讨论个体；相反，人为的实体占据主导。
同样，古老的“欧洲”与“亚洲”或“西方”与“东方”之分，将人类多样性的各种可能都归拢在极其宽泛的标签之下，在此过程中将其简化为一两种终极的集体现实。

questions.name: #306 Divorce
questions.en:
Researchers have found that divorce has different kinds of negative impacts on the planet, including higher demand for resources and a lower rate of efficiency in the use of household resources.
People have been talking about how to protect the environment and combat climate change, but divorce is an overlooked factor that needs to be considered.
questions.zh:
研究人员发现，离婚对地球有多种负面影响，包括资源需求增加以及家庭资源使用效率降低。
人们一直在讨论如何保护环境和应对气候变化，但离婚是一个被忽视的因素，需要加以考虑。

questions.name: #308 Nutritionally Bankrupt
questions.en:
Globalization has affected what we eat in ways we are only beginning to understand.
Modern food production no longer relates to our biological needs but is in direct conflict with them.
The relationship between diet and our fertility, our risk of cancer, heart disease and mental illness is becoming clearer.
Yet much of our food is nutritionally bankrupt.
questions.zh:
全球化对我们饮食的影响，我们才刚刚开始有所了解。
现代食品生产已不再满足我们的生理需求，反而与之直接冲突。
饮食与生育能力、癌症、心脏病及精神疾病风险之间的关系正变得越来越清晰。
然而，我们吃的很多食物在营养上其实一文不值。

questions.name: #312 Companies
questions.en:
Companies will want to be known not just for the financial results they generate, but equally for the imprint they leave on society as a whole.
First, ensuring that their products contribute positively.
Second, operating in a way that approaches a "net-neutral" impact to the natural environment.
And third, cherishing their people.
questions.zh:
企业不仅希望以财务业绩闻名，同样也希望因对整体社会留下的印记而被认可。
首先，确保他们的产品能带来积极贡献。
其次，以接近“净中性”影响自然环境的方式运营。
第三，珍视他们的员工。

questions.name: #313 Recycling
questions.en:
When we recycle, used materials are converted into new products, reducing the need to consume natural resources.
If used materials are not recycled, new products are made by extracting fresh, raw material from the Earth, through mining and forestry.
Recycling helps conserve important raw materials and protects natural habitats for the future.
questions.zh:
回收利用时，废旧材料被转化为新产品，从而减少了对自然资源的消耗需求。
如果废旧材料不被回收，新产品就需要通过采矿和林业从地球中提取新的原材料来制造。
回收有助于保护重要的原材料，并为未来保护自然栖息地。

questions.name: #314 Tea Ceremony
questions.en:
The Japanese tea ceremony is a ritual tour influenced by Buddhism in which green tea is prepared and served to a small group of guests in a peaceful setting.
The ceremony can take as long as four hours and there are many traditional gestures that both the server and the guest must perform.
questions.zh:
日本茶道是一种受佛教影响的仪式流程，在宁静的环境中为少数宾客准备并奉上绿茶。
仪式可能长达四小时，且侍者和宾客都必须完成许多传统礼节动作。

questions.name: #315 Single Research
questions.en:
Rarely, however, does a single research study produce the certainty needed to assume that the same results will apply in all or most settings.
Rather, research is usually an ongoing process, based on many accumulated understandings and explanations that, when taken together, lead to a generalization about educational issues and practice, and ultimately, to the development of theories.
questions.zh:
不过，单一研究很少能提供足够的确定性，让我们相信同样的结果会适用于所有或大多数情况。
相反，研究通常是一个持续的过程，基于许多积累的理解和解释，这些结合起来，才能对教育问题和实践形成概括，并最终发展出理论。

questions.name: #316 Only Family
questions.en:
Imagine living all your life as the only family on your street.
Then, one morning, you open the front door and discover houses all around you.
You see neighbors tending their gardens and children walking to school.
Where did all the people come from?
What if the answer turned out to be that they had always been there—you just hadn' t seen them?
questions.zh:
想象一下，你一辈子都是这条街上唯一的一户人家。
然后，某天早上，你打开前门，发现周围全是房子。
你看到邻居们在打理花园，孩子们正走去上学。
这些人都是从哪儿冒出来的？
如果答案是：他们一直都在那里——只是你一直没看见他们呢？

questions.name: #317 Colloquialism
questions.en:
Australians speak English of course.
But for many tourists and even some locals, Australian English has only tenuous links with mother tone.
Our speech is prepared with words and phrases whose arcane meanings are understood only by the initiate.
It is these colorful colloquialisms that Australian slang set to truly explain.
questions.zh:
澳大利亚人当然说英语。
但对很多游客甚至一些本地人来说，澳大利亚英语与母语的联系微乎其微。
我们的言语中充满了只有圈内人才懂的晦涩词汇和短语。
正是这些丰富多彩的口语表达，才是澳大利亚俚语真正要解释的。

questions.name: #319 Yield of Plants
questions.en:
The maximum yield of plants, determined by their genetic potential, is seldom achieved because factors such as insufficient water or nutrients, adverse climate conditions, plant diseases, and insect damage will limit growth at some stage.
Plants subjected to these biotic and abiotic constraints are said to be stressed.

植物基因潜力决定的最大产量很少能达到，因为缺水少肥、气候恶劣、病害虫害等因素总会在某个阶段限制生长。
遭受这些生物和非生物限制的植物，就被认为处于胁迫状态。

questions.en:
You used to think that being green was a luxury for your company, but climate change has made you realize that you can no longer ignore it.

questions.name: #321 Black Swan （B）
questions.en:
Before the discovery of Australia, people in the old world were convinced that all swans were white, an unassailable belief as it seemed completely confirmed by empirical evidence.
The sighting of the first black swan might have been an interesting surprise for a few scientists, but that is not where the significance of the story lies.
questions.zh:
在发现澳大利亚之前，旧世界的人们坚信所有天鹅都是白色的，这一信念看似坚不可摧，因为经验证据完全证实了它。
第一只黑天鹅的目击可能让少数科学家感到有趣的惊讶，但故事的意义并不在于此。

questions.name: #322 Working Unions
questions.en:
Therefore, the working unions in modern society are not very important.
They preserve their functions only in the underdeveloped countries.
On the contrary, in the developed states, workers refuse to join the unions, preferring individual work.
Thus, working unions cannot survive the assault of modern economic trends and slowly move to a complete decline.
Their initial purposes have little to do with the hectic pace of modern life.
questions.zh:
因此，工会在现代社会中并不是很重要。
它们仅在欠发达国家中保留其功能。
相反，在发达国家，工人拒绝加入工会，更倾向于个人工作。
因此，工会在现代经济趋势的冲击下难以生存，逐渐走向完全衰落。
它们最初的目标与现代生活的快节奏几乎无关。

questions.name: #326 Father (B)
questions.en:
Every morning, no matter how late he had been up, my father rose at 5:30, went to his study, wrote for a couple of hours, made us all breakfast, read the paper with my mother, and then went back to work for the rest of the morning.
Many years passed before I realized that he did this by choice, for a living, and that he was not unemployed or mentally ill.
questions.zh:
每天早上，不管前一天晚上多晚睡，我父亲都会在五点半起床，去书房写上一两个小时，然后给我们所有人做早餐，和我母亲一起看报纸，之后回去继续工作整个上午。
很多年后我才意识到，他这样做是出于选择，为了谋生，而且他既不是失业也不是精神有问题。

questions.name: #327 Tourism
questions.en:
Tourism is a challenging sector which divides statistics since businesses serve tourists, also serve local people.
Therefore, it is not straightforward to estimate how much business sectors' revenues and how many jobs are due to tourist expenditures.
questions.zh:

所以，很难直接算出旅游消费到底给各个行业带来了多少收入，又创造了多少就业机会。

Investigators also compared those microbes with those living in 52 other soil samples taken from all around the planet.
The park had organisms that also exist in deserts, frozen tundra, forests, rainforests, and prairies.

公园中只有一小部分微生物被发现已经收录在数据库中。

questions.name: #329 Introvert and Extrovert (B)
questions.en:
Although introvert and extrovert personality types differ from one another on various grounds, the major difference between the two is their source of rejuvenation.
While for extroverts, this may mean interaction or excursions with friends and family, the same may mean reading a book or listening to music for introverts.
questions.zh:
虽然内向和外向的性格类型在多个方面有所不同，但两者之间的主要区别在于他们恢复精力的来源。
对于外向者来说，这可能意味着与朋友或家人互动或外出游玩，而对于内向者来说，则可能意味着读书或听音乐。

questions.name: #331 Constellation
questions.en:
A constellation is an area on the celestial sphere in which a group of stars forms an imaginary outline or pattern, typically representing an animal, mythological person or creature, or an inanimate object.
The origins of the earliest constellations likely go back to prehistory.
questions.zh:
星座是天球上的一片区域，其中的一群星星构成一个想象中的轮廓或图案，通常代表动物、神话人物或生物，或是无生命的物体。
最早一批星座的起源可能可以追溯到史前时期。

questions.name: #332 Fractional Reserve Banking
questions.en:
Fractional reserve banking is a banking system in which banks only hold a fraction of the money their customers' deposit as reserves.
This allows them to use the rest of it to make loans and thereby essentially create new money.
This gives commercial banks the power to directly affect the money supply.
questions.zh:
部分准备金银行制度是指银行只将客户存款的一部分作为准备金持有的体系。
这样银行就能用剩余资金放贷，从而实际上创造出新的货币。
这赋予了商业银行直接影响货币供应量的能力。

questions.name: #333 Opening of Parliament
questions.en:
The ritual of the state opening of parliament still illustrates the basis of the British constitution.
The sovereignty of the Royal Family has passed to the sovereignty of parliament, leaving the monarchy with the trappings of power, while prime ministers are still denied the kind of status that is given to American and French presidents.
questions.zh:
英国议会开幕大典的仪式至今仍彰显着英国宪法的根基。
王室的至高权力已转移至议会，君主仅保留权力的象征，而首相仍无法获得美法总统享有的那种地位。

questions.name: #334 Triumph of Capitalism
questions.en:
Most peasants remained self-sufficient and sceptical about money - and with good reason: the triumph of capitalism probably made them worse off.
They now had to deal with a centralized imperial state that was collecting tax more efficiently, giving more power to landlords, and slowly reducing customary peasant rights to land and produce.
questions.zh:
大多数农民仍然自给自足，对金钱持怀疑态度——这也不无道理：资本主义的胜利很可能让他们的境况更糟。
他们现在不得不面对一个中央集权的帝国国家，这个国家更高效地征税，赋予地主更多权力，并逐渐削弱农民对土地和农产品的传统权利。

questions.name: #335 Economic Planning
questions.en:
Another method governments use to try and influence the private sector is economic planning.
For a long time now, socialist and communist states have used planning as an alternative to the price mechanism, organizing production and distributing their resources according to social and strategic needs, rather than based on purely economic considerations.
questions.zh:
政府用来影响私营部门的另一种方法是经济规划。
长期以来，社会主义和共产主义国家一直用规划来替代价格机制，根据社会和战略需求而非纯粹的经济考量来组织生产和分配资源。

questions.name: #336 Foam-filled Furniture
questions.en:
Foam-filled furniture is very dangerous if it catches fire, and foam quickly produces a high temperature, thick smoke and poisonous gases - including carbon monoxide.
Therefore, set levels of fire resistance have been established for new and second-hand upholstered furniture and other similar products.
questions.zh:
如果泡沫填充家具着火，非常危险，泡沫会迅速产生高温、浓烟和有毒气体——包括一氧化碳。
因此，针对新的和二手软垫家具及其他类似产品，已制定了防火等级标准。

questions.name: #337 Bergson's Theory
questions.en:
The starting point of Bergson's theory is the experience of time and motion.
Time is the reality we experience most directly, but this doesn't mean that we can capture this experience mentally.
The past is gone and the future is yet to come.
The only reality is the present, which is real through our experience.
questions.zh:
柏格森理论的起点是时间和运动的体验。
时间是我们最直接体验到的现实，但这并不意味着我们能在头脑中捕捉这种体验。
过去已逝，未来未至。
唯一的现实是当下，它通过我们的体验而真实存在。

questions.name: #338 Parent Teacher Conferences
questions.en:
Schools host parent teacher conferences four times a year and it is important for families to attend.
This is your chance to meet with teachers and ask questions about your child's progress.
It can be helpful to write down questions ahead of time.

学校每年举办四次家长会，家长参加很重要。
这是你和老师见面、询问孩子学习进展的好机会。
提前把问题写下来会很有帮助。

questions.name: #339 Second World War
questions.en:
For the first two or three years after the Second World War, a new title would often sell out within a few months of publication.
However, unless public demand for the book was unusually high, they were rarely able to reprint it.
With paper stocks strictly rationed, they could not afford to use up precious paper or tie up their limited capital with a reprint.
questions.zh:
二战后的头两三年，新书出版后往往几个月内就会售罄。
不过，除非公众对这本书的需求异常旺盛，否则他们很少能重印。
由于纸张供应严格配给，他们既舍不得用宝贵的纸张，也不愿把有限的资金压在重印上。

questions.name: #340 Atlantic Coast
questions.en:
The Atlantic coast of the peninsula can be thought of as the cold side, and the sea on this coast tends to be clear and cold, with a variety of seaweeds growing along the rocky shoreline.
On a hot day, however, this cold water can be very refreshing and is said to be less hospitable to sharks, which prefer warmer waters.
questions.zh:
半岛的大西洋沿岸可以看作是寒冷的一侧，这片海域通常清澈寒冷，岩石海岸线上生长着各种海藻。
不过在炎热的天气里，这冷水倒能让人感到神清气爽，而且据说鲨鱼不太喜欢这种水域，它们更偏爱温暖的海水。

questions.name: #341 Shoestring Budget
questions.en:
All the works of art shown in this exhibition were purchased on a shoestring budget.
The criteria that the curators had to follow were that works must be acquired cheaply, appeal to a broad range of tastes, and fit with unusual environments.
Thus, many of our better known modern artists are not represented.
questions.zh:
这次展览中的所有艺术品都是用很少的预算买来的。
策展人必须遵循的标准是：作品必须便宜购买、迎合广泛口味，并且适合特殊环境。
因此，许多我们熟知的现代艺术家并未参展。

questions.name: #342 Ponds
questions.en:
There are many kinds of pond, but nearly all are small bodies of shallow, stagnant water in which plants with roots can grow.
Water movement is slight and temperatures fluctuate widely.
The wealth of plants ensures that during daylight hours oxygen is plentiful.
However, at night, when photosynthesis no longer takes place, oxygen supplies can fall very low.
questions.zh:
池塘种类繁多，但几乎都是浅而静止的小水体，适合有根植物生长。
水流缓慢，温度变化很大。
丰富的植物确保白天氧气充足。
然而到了夜晚，光合作用停止，氧气供应会变得非常低。

questions.name: #343 Alexander the Great
questions.en:
Before the time of Alexander the Great, the only eastern people who could be compared with the Greeks in the fields of science and philosophy were from the Indian sub-continent.
However, because so little is known about Indian chronology, it is difficult to tell how much of their science was original and how much was the result of Greek influence.
questions.zh:
在亚历山大大帝时代之前，东方民族中能在科学与哲学领域与希腊人相提并论的，只有印度次大陆的人。
然而，由于对印度年代学知之甚少，很难判断他们的科学有多少是原创的，又有多少是受希腊影响的结果。

questions.name: #344 Letter Writing
questions.en:
While far fewer people these days write letters and therefore have less use for stamps, there are still a few categories of stamp which attract collectors.
Stamps in common use for an indefinite period - until the price goes up - are called "definitive" issues, while a more collectible type of stamp is the "commemorative" issue, honoring people, events and anniversaries.
questions.zh:
如今写信的人少多了，邮票用得也少了，但还是有几类邮票能吸引收藏者。
长期通用、直到涨价才停用的邮票叫“普通邮票”，而更值得收藏的是纪念人物、事件和周年纪念的“纪念邮票”。

questions.name: #345 Succulent Plants
questions.en:
Most succulent plants are found in regions where there is little rainfall, dry air, plenty of sunshine, porous soils and high temperatures during part of the year.
These conditions have caused changes in plant structures, which have resulted in greatly increased thickness of stems, leaves and sometimes roots, enabling them to store moisture from the infrequent rains.
questions.zh:

这些条件导致了植物结构的变化，使得茎、叶甚至根部显著增厚，从而能够储存来自罕见降雨的水分。

questions.name: #346 Australian Mining Industry
questions.en:
Australia has one of the world's most important mining industries.
It is a major exporter of coal, iron ore, gold and copper and is self-sufficient in all minerals bar petroleum.
Since the first discoveries, the coal in 1798, mineral production has risen every year.
In the decade to 1992 it doubled.

自1798年首次发现煤炭以来，矿产产量逐年增长。
到1992年的十年间，产量翻了一番。

questions.name: #347 Case Approach
questions.en:
It was found that while many companies express interest in Jacobson's use case approach, actual scenario usage often falls outside what is described in textbooks and standard methodologies.
Users therefore face significant scenario management problems not yet addressed adequately in theory or practice, and are demanding solutions to these problems.
questions.zh:
研究发现，虽然许多公司对雅各布森的用例方法表示感兴趣，但实际场景的使用往往超出了教科书和标准方法所描述的范围。
因此，用户面临着理论和实践尚未充分解决的重大场景管理问题，并迫切要求解决这些问题。

questions.name: #348 Economic Well-being

questions.name: #350 High Quality of Life
questions.en:
In spite of the spectacularly high quality of life for the vast majority of the people who live in the European Union, its inhabitants seem obsessed by the region's relative decline in the world.
Slow economic growth rates and high unemployment have reinforced the impression that Europe is unhappy with today and unsure of tomorrow.

缓慢的经济增长和高失业率加深了这样一种印象：欧洲对现状不满，对未来迷茫。

questions.name: #351 Economies of Scale
questions.en:
If countries can specialize in certain goods they can benefit from economies of scale and lower average cost.
This is especially true in the industry with high fixed costs or that require a high level of investment.
The benefits of the economy of scale will ultimately lead to lower prices for consumers and greater efficiency for exporting firms.
questions.zh:

这在固定成本高或需要大量投资的行业中尤为明显。
规模经济的好处最终会为消费者带来更低的价格，并为出口企业带来更高的效率。

A new study comprehensively reveals how civil wars impact wildlife in countries affected by conflict.
Researchers found that the main impacts of civil wars on native mammals are often indirect, ultimately arising from institutional and socio-economic changes, rather than from direct military tactics.

questions.name: #354 Stressful Occupations
questions.en:
Just how stressed are teachers?
A recent Gallup poll found teachers are tied with nurses for the most stressful occupation in America today.
Unfortunately, that stress can have a trickle-down effect on their students, leading to disruptive behavior that results in student suspensions.
questions.zh:
老师们到底有多大的压力？
最近盖洛普的一项民调显示，在美国，老师和护士并列成为压力最大的职业。
不幸的是，这种压力会像多米诺骨牌一样影响到学生，导致他们出现破坏性行为，最终被停学。

questions.name: #355 Water Towers
questions.en:
Global water consumption has increased almost fourfold in the past 100 years, and many regions can only meet their water demand thanks to essential contributions from mountain regions.
In 30 years, almost a quarter of the world's lowland population will strongly depend on runoff from the mountains.
Only sustainable development can ensure the important function of mountain areas as Earth's 'water towers'.
questions.zh:
过去一百年里，全球用水量几乎翻了四倍，许多地区能勉强满足用水需求，全靠山区提供的关键水源。
三十年后，全球近四分之一低地人口的用水将严重依赖山区的径流。
只有可持续发展才能确保山区作为地球“水塔”的重要功能得以延续。

questions.name: #357 Obesity
questions.en:
Some people are at higher risk of developing obesity because they possess genetic variants that affect how the brain processes sensory information and regulates feeding and behavior.
The findings support a growing body of evidence that obesity is a disease whose roots are in the brain.

有些人更容易患肥胖症，因为他们携带的基因变异会影响大脑处理感官信息以及调节进食和行为的方式。
这些发现支持了越来越多的证据表明，肥胖是一种根源在大脑的疾病。

questions.name: #358 Data Leak
questions.en: In 2016, the world's largest ever data leak dubbed "The Panama Papers" exposed a scandal, uncovering a vast global network of people -- including celebrities and world leaders, who used offshore tax havens, anonymous transactions through intermediaries and shell corporations to hide their wealth, grow their fortunes and avoid taxes.

questions.name: #359 Electronic Blood Vessels
questions.en:
Researchers have developed electronic blood vessels that can be actively tuned to address subtle changes in the body after implantation.
The blood vessels -- made of a metal-polymer conductor membrane that's flexible and biodegradable -- mimic natural blood vessels, were conductive in vitro experiments, and were able to effectively replace key arteries in rabbits.
questions.zh:
研究人员开发出了一种电子血管，植入后可以主动调节，以应对体内细微的变化。
这种血管由柔性且可生物降解的金属聚合物导电膜制成，模仿天然血管，在体外实验中具有导电性，并能有效替代兔子的关键动脉。

questions.name: #360 Immune System
questions.en:
Whether flu or coronavirus, it can take several days for the body to ramp up an effective response to a viral infection.
New research describes how different cells in the immune system work together, communicate, and - in the case of cells called neutrophils - bring about their own death to help fight off infections.
The findings could have important implications for the development of vaccines and anti-viral therapies.
questions.zh:
无论是流感还是冠状病毒，身体都需要几天时间才能对病毒感染做出有效反应。
新研究描述了免疫系统中不同细胞如何协同工作、沟通，以及——以中性粒细胞为例——通过自身死亡来帮助抵抗感染。
这些发现可能对疫苗和抗病毒疗法的开发具有重要意义。

questions.name: #362 Artificial Intelligence
questions.en:
Researchers have designed an artificial intelligence model that is better able to predict how much students are learning in educational games.
The improved model makes use of an AI training concept called multi-task learning, and could be used to improve both instruction and learning outcomes.

这个改进的模型运用了名为多任务学习的人工智能训练概念，有望同时优化教学与学习成果。

questions.name: #363 Brain Scans
questions.en:
Scientists studying brain scans of people who were asked to come up with inventive uses for everyday objects found a specific pattern of connectivity that correlated with the most creative responses.
Researchers were then able to use that pattern to predict how creative other people's responses would be based on their connections in this network.
questions.zh:

随后，研究人员能够利用这种模式，根据他人脑网络中这些连接的强度，预测他们回答的创意程度。

questions.name: #364 Stone Tools
questions.en:
Modern humans arrived in westernmost Europe 41,000 to 38,000 years ago, about 5,000 years earlier than previously known, according to an international team of researchers that discovered stone tools used by modern humans dated to the earlier time period in a cave near the Atlantic coast of central Portugal.
The tools document the presence of modern humans at a time when Neanderthals were thought to be present in the region.
questions.zh:
一个国际研究团队在葡萄牙中部大西洋沿岸的一个洞穴中发现了现代人类使用的石器，这些石器的年代显示现代人类在4.1万至3.8万年前到达欧洲最西端，比之前已知的时间早了约5000年。
这些工具证实了现代人类的存在，而此前人们认为该地区当时仍有尼安德特人活动。

questions.name: #365 Lemurs
questions.en:
A research team has systematically investigated the cognitive abilities of lemurs, which have relatively small brains compared to other primates.
Conducting systematic tests with identical methods revealed that cognitive abilities of lemurs hardly differ from those of monkeys and great apes.
Instead, this study revealed that the relationship between brain size and cognitive abilities cannot be generalized and it provides new insights into the evolution of primates.

questions.name: #366 Sake Yeast
questions.en:
Researchers have found that that a mutant strain of sake yeast produces high levels of the amino acid ornithine.
Ornithine has been found to reduce fatigue and improve sleep quality, and the non-genetically modified mutant yeast strain discovered in this study could be easily applied to brewing sake, a traditional Japanese alcoholic beverage, as well as wine and beer.

questions.name: #367 Child-delivering
questions.en:
Women who deliver their first child by cesarean section (C-section) are less likely to conceive a second child than those who deliver vaginally, despite being just as likely to plan a subsequent pregnancy, according to researchers.
The team followed more than 2,000 women for three years after they delivered their first child.

该团队跟踪调查了2000多名女性，在她们生下第一胎后持续观察了三年。

questions.name: #368 Critical Protein
questions.en:
Researchers have conducted a study that has determined the role that a critical protein plays in the development of hair cells.
These hair cells are vital for hearing.
Some of these cells amplify sounds that come into the ear, and others transform sound waves into electrical signals that travel to the brain.

其中一些细胞会放大进入耳朵的声音，另一些则将声波转化为电信号，传输到大脑。

questions.name: #369 Zoom
questions.en:
The coronavirus pandemic has shifted many of our interactions online, with Zoom video calls replacing in-person classes, work meetings, conferences and other events.
Will all that screen time damage our vision?
Maybe not.
It turns out that our visual perception is highly adaptable, according to new research.
questions.zh:
新冠疫情让很多互动都搬到了线上，Zoom视频通话取代了面对面的课堂、工作会议、会议和其他活动。
这么多屏幕时间会不会损害我们的视力？
也许不会。
新研究表明，我们的视觉感知其实适应能力很强。

questions.name: #371 Closure Activities
questions.en:
Closure activities allow participants to consolidate learning, say goodbye to group mates, and attend to any unfinished business prior to the ending of the group experience.
Generally, these activities involve some reflection upon what has been learned or accomplished during the preceding time together and a sharing of those thoughts or insights with other participants.

通常，这些活动涉及对先前共同经历中所学或所成进行反思，并与其他参与者分享这些想法或见解。

questions.en:
This course provides an introduction to the history and development of the British legal system.

questions.name: #374 Credit Unions
questions.en:
Credit unions are nonprofit organizations that were imported to the United States from Germany in the early 1900s.
They were regulated in 1934 by the Federal Credit Union Act, which limits membership to "groups having a common bond of occupation or association".
Groups from particular geographical areas also were eligible to join credit unions.
questions.zh:
信用合作社是非营利组织，20世纪初从德国引入美国。
1934年，《联邦信用合作社法案》对其进行了规范，规定会员资格仅限于“具有共同职业或协会纽带”的群体。
来自特定地理区域的群体也有资格加入信用合作社。

questions.name: #375 Microscopic Invaders
questions.en:
We all know about bacteria, viruses and microscopic protozoa.
We can watch the way that these tiny agents move into our bodies and damage our organs.
We have a growing understanding of how our body mounts defensive strategies that fight off these invaders, and have built some clever chemical that can help mount an assault on these bio-villains.

questions.name: #376 Market Research
questions.en:
There are two main types of market research.
Quantitative research involves collecting a lot of information by using techniques such as questionnaires and other forms of survey.
Qualitative research involves working with smaller samples of consumers, often asking them to discuss products and services while researchers take notes about what they have to say.
questions.zh:
市场调研主要有两种类型。
定量研究通过问卷及其他调查方式收集大量信息。
定性研究则针对较小的消费者样本，常让研究人员记录他们对产品和服务的讨论内容。

questions.name: #377 Mature Tree
questions.en:
The wonderful framework of mature trees creates a secluded, enclosed atmosphere that unites a great variety of plantings to inspire visitors in all seasons.
Spring in the garden is marked by leafing up and flowering of trees and the eruption of the flowers in the bulb meadows, and woodland understory.
questions.zh:
这片由成熟树木构成的绝妙框架，营造出一种幽静、封闭的氛围，将种类繁多的植物融为一体，让游客在每个季节都能感受到灵感。
花园里的春天，以树木抽芽开花、球茎草地和森林下层植被中花朵的绽放为标志。

questions.name: #378 Different Dimensions
questions.en:
The fact is that those different types of services affect many different dimensions of well-being of people.
And define the human well-being is also extremely challenging.
However, we identified that there are certain items provide basic material for life, whether it be food, shelter or happiness.
questions.zh:
实际上，这些不同类型的服务影响着人们福祉的多个方面。
而定义人类福祉本身也极具挑战性。
不过，我们发现有些物品提供了生活的基本物质，无论是食物、住所还是幸福。
