questions.name: #379 Negative Immigration
questions.en:
There is a tendency, especially in the popular press to concentrate on the negative effects of immigration.
In that context, this lecture listing the benefits it brings to more developed nations are much more welcome.
Also, it is delivered in a lively and amusing style.
questions.zh:
人们往往只关注移民的负面影响，尤其是在大众媒体中。
在这种背景下，这场讲座列举了移民给发达国家带来的好处，因此更受欢迎。
而且，讲座风格生动有趣。

questions.name: #380 Telecommunication
questions.en:
Today, telecommunication is widespread and devices that assist the progress are common in many parts of the world.
There is also a vast array of networks that connect these devices, including computer, telephone and cable networks.
Computer communication across the Internet, such as e-mail and instant messaging, is just one of many examples of telecommunication.
questions.zh:
如今，电信技术已十分普及，世界各地随处可见推动其发展的设备。
还有各种各样的网络将这些设备连接起来，包括计算机网络、电话网络和有线电视网络。
通过互联网进行的计算机通信，比如电子邮件和即时消息，只是电信的众多例子之一。

questions.name: #381 Electricity Discoveries
questions.en:
The Royal Institution is an organization that has been around for 209 years.
Many of the people that have worked here have been scientists themselves, including Michael Faraday.
He made the discoveries that made generating and using electricity much easier, making it possible for us all to switch on lights, cook our dinner, play games consoles much, much more.

他的发现使得发电和用电变得更加容易，让我们都能开灯、做饭、玩电子游戏等等。

questions.name: #382 School Shooting
questions.en:
Current policy responses do not address the fundamental question of why so many mass shootings take place in schools.
To answer this question, we need to get to the heart of how students experience school and the meaning that schools have in American life.
While some of these measures seem sensible, overall there is little empirical evidence that such security measures decrease the likelihood of school shootings.
questions.zh:
目前的政策应对措施并没有触及一个根本问题：为什么这么多大规模枪击事件发生在学校。
要回答这个问题，我们需要深入了解学生如何体验学校生活，以及学校在美国生活中的意义。
虽然其中一些措施看似合理，但总体而言，几乎没有实证证据表明这类安全措施能降低校园枪击事件发生的可能性。

questions.name: #384 Self-motivation
questions.en:
Research on motivation has suggested that a strong sense of autonomy is the key to developing the healthy self-motivation that allows children and teens to pursue their goals with passion and to enjoy their achievements.
But what we see in many of the kids we test or tutor is motivational patterns that are at the extremes of one, an obsessive drive to succeed and two, seeing little point in working hard.
questions.zh:
关于动机的研究表明，强烈的自主感是培养健康自我激励的关键，这种激励能让儿童和青少年充满热情地追求目标并享受成就。
但在我们测试或辅导的许多孩子身上，我们看到的是两种极端的动机模式：一是对成功的强迫性追求，二是认为努力毫无意义。

questions.name: #386 Sexual Infections
questions.en:
Roughly one million sexually transmitted infections are exchanged each day.
If untreated, they can lead to cervical cancer, pelvic inflammatory disease and infertility.
However, people are often reluctant to ask their doctors to test for such infections, so Eve Medical in Toronto developed a kit for women to screen themselves.
questions.zh:
每天大约有100万例性传播感染发生。
如果不治疗，它们可能导致宫颈癌、盆腔炎和不孕不育。
然而，人们往往不愿让医生检查这些感染，因此多伦多的Eve Medical公司开发了一套女性自检工具。

questions.name: #387 Ear Fluid
questions.en:
Normally, if we spin around in an office chair and suddenly stop, we feel like we're still moving.
That's because fluid in the inner ear responsible for detecting movement continues to whirl around due to inertia, making your brain think it's still in motion.
questions.zh:
通常情况下，如果我们坐在办公椅上转圈然后突然停下，会感觉自己还在动。
这是因为内耳中负责检测运动的液体由于惯性继续旋转，让大脑误以为身体仍在运动。

questions.name: #388 Disease Model
questions.en:
The disease model remains dominant in the U.S. because of its stakeholders.
First, the rehab industry, worth an estimated 35 billion dollars per year, uses the disease nomenclature in a vast majority of its ads and slogans.
Despite consistently low success rates, that's not likely to stop because it pulls in the cash.
Second, as long as addiction is labeled a disease, medical insurance providers can be required to pay for it.
questions.zh:
疾病模型在美国仍然占主导地位，因为这背后有既得利益者。
首先，康复产业每年估值约350亿美元，在其绝大多数广告和口号中都使用疾病术语。
尽管成功率一直很低，但这不太可能停止，因为能赚大钱。
其次，只要成瘾被贴上疾病的标签，就可以要求医疗保险机构为此买单。

questions.name: #389 Flu Season
questions.en:
This flu season is a particularly severe one, and it's not over yet — health officials say flu activity will likely remain elevated for at least several more weeks.
But if you already caught the flu, are you in the clear for the rest of the season?

questions.name: #390 Toasted Food
questions.en:
When we put toast in the toaster or add marshmallows to the top of our sweet potatoes for a baked holiday dish we expect them to turn brown and to develop a sweet, caramelized flavor.
Although we expect it to happen, do you know why certain foods take on these new colors and flavors as they are toasted?
questions.zh:
当我们把吐司放进烤面包机，或者在节日烤红薯上放棉花糖时，我们期待它们变成棕色，并产生一种香甜的焦糖味。
虽然我们预料到会这样，但你知道为什么某些食物在烤制时会呈现出新的颜色和味道吗？

questions.name: #391 Noninvasive Brain Stimulation
questions.en:
Noninvasive brain stimulation is having its heyday, as scientists and hobbyists alike look for ways to change the activity of neurons without cutting into the brain and implanting electrodes.
Next, the researchers wanted to figure out how much current they needed to apply to the human scalp to produce those electrical fields inside the brain.
questions.zh:
非侵入性脑部刺激正迎来全盛期，科学家和爱好者们都在寻找无需开颅植入电极就能改变神经元活动的方法。
接下来，研究人员想弄清楚需要向人类头皮施加多少电流才能在脑内产生那些电场。

questions.name: #392 Madagascar
questions.en:
Scientists have recommended actions the government of Madagascar's recently elected president, Andry Rajoelina should take to turn around the precipitous decline of biodiversity and help put Madagascar on a trajectory towards sustainable growth.
Madagascar's protected areas, some of the most important for biodiversity in the world, have suffered terribly in recent years from illegal mining, logging, and collection of threatened species for the pet trade.
questions.zh:
科学家们建议马达加斯加新当选的总统安德里·拉乔利纳政府采取行动，扭转生物多样性急剧下降的趋势，帮助马达加斯加走上可持续发展的道路。
马达加斯加的保护区是世界上对生物多样性最重要的地区之一，但近年来因非法采矿、伐木以及为宠物贸易收集濒危物种而遭受严重破坏。

questions.name: #393 Fake News
questions.en:
Fake news can distort people's beliefs even after being debunked.
For example, repeated over and over, a story such as the one about the Pope Endorsing Trump can create a glow around a political candidate that persists long after the story is exposed as fake.
A 2017 study published in the journal Intelligence suggests that some people may have an especially difficult time rejecting misinformation.
questions.zh:
假新闻即使被揭穿，也能扭曲人们的信念。
比如，像“教皇支持特朗普”这样的故事被反复传播后，会在政治候选人周围形成光环，即使后来被证实是假的，这种影响也会持续很久。
2017年发表在《智力》杂志上的一项研究表明，有些人可能特别难以拒绝错误信息。

questions.name: #395 Moon
questions.en:
The asteroid that slammed into the moon 3.8 billion years ago creating the Imbrium Basin may have had a diameter of at least 150 miles, according to a new estimate.
The work helps explain puzzling geological features on the moon's near side, and has implications for understanding the evolution of the early solar system.
questions.zh:
据最新估算，38亿年前撞击月球、形成雨海盆地的那颗小行星，直径可能至少达到了150英里。
这项研究有助于解释月球正面令人费解的地质特征，并对理解早期太阳系的演化具有重要意义。

questions.name: #396 Problem of Funding
questions.en:
The most important issue is concerned with the problem of funding.
Social services receive different donations or grants from the government.
However, these sums are not sufficient for the solution of all problems.
The second most important issue consists in the huge spending.
The money social services achieve is not enough for normal functioning.
The third problem, affecting human services, is the lack of skilled and experienced employees.
questions.zh:
最核心的问题在于资金筹措。
社会服务机构会从政府获得各种捐赠和拨款。
然而，这些资金并不足以解决所有问题。
第二大问题在于巨额的开支。
社会服务机构获得的资金不足以维持正常运转。
第三个影响人类服务的问题，是缺乏有技能和经验的员工。

questions.name: #397 Chasing the Flame
questions.en:
It is precisely in observing the intertwinings of success and failure that Chasing the Flame makes its greatest mark.
With piercing insight and relentless logic, it reveals the pitfalls of international politics and details an intricate struggle between individual and institution.
It haunts us with the poignant truth that even a great man can do only so much to reinvent the world.
questions.zh:
正是通过观察成功与失败的相互交织，《追火者》才留下了最深刻的印记。
凭借敏锐的洞察力和严密的逻辑，它揭示了国际政治的陷阱，并详细描绘了个人与机构之间复杂的斗争。
它用令人心酸的真相提醒我们，即使是伟人，在重塑世界方面也只能做到这么多。

questions.name: #398 Statistical Information (B)
questions.en:
The provision of accurate and authoritative statistical information strengthens our society.
It provides a basis for decisions to be made on public policy, such as determining electoral boundaries and where to locate schools and hospitals.
It also allows businesses to know their market, grow their business, and improve their marketing strategies by targeting their activities appropriately.

它也让企业了解市场、发展业务，并通过精准定位活动来改进营销策略。

questions.name: #400 Global Collapse
questions.en:
The global collapse of frogs and other amphibians due to the amphibian chytrid fungus exacerbated malaria outbreaks in Costa Rica and Panama during the 1990s and 2000s, according to new research.
The findings provide the first evidence that amphibian population declines have directly affected human health and show how preserving biodiversity can benefit humans as well as local ecosystems.
questions.zh:
一项新研究指出，20世纪90年代至21世纪初，蛙类及其他两栖动物因壶菌病在全球范围内数量锐减，这加剧了哥斯达黎加和巴拿马的疟疾疫情。
这些发现首次证明，两栖动物数量的减少直接影响了人类健康，并表明保护生物多样性既能造福人类，也有利于当地生态系统。

questions.name: #401 Protein
questions.en:
A single protein is a master regulator of mouse muscle function during aging, a new study finds.
Blocking this protein increased muscle strength and endurance in old animals.
It may play a role in age-related muscle weakening in humans.
questions.zh:
一项新研究发现，一种单一蛋白质是衰老过程中小鼠肌肉功能的主调控因子。
阻断这种蛋白质能增强老年动物的肌肉力量和耐力。
它可能在人类与年龄相关的肌肉衰弱中发挥作用。

questions.name: #404 Gambling Scenario
questions.en:
New research has shown robots can encourage humans to take greater risks in a simulated gambling scenario than they would if there was nothing to influence their behaviors.
Increasing our understanding of whether robots can affect risk- taking could have clear ethical, practical and policy implications, which this study set out to explore.
questions.zh:
新研究表明，在模拟赌博场景中，机器人能促使人类冒更大风险，比没有东西影响他们行为时更甚。
加深对机器人能否影响冒险行为的理解，可能具有明确的伦理、实践和政策意义，这正是本研究旨在探讨的。

questions.name: #405 Battery
questions.en:
Scientists have improved a promising battery technology, creating a single-crystal, nickel-rich cathode that is hardier and more efficient than before.
It's one step toward improved lithium-ion batteries that are common in electric vehicles today.
Increasing nickel content in the cathode is on the drawing board of lithium-ion battery makers largely because of its relatively low cost, wide availability and low toxicity compared to other key battery materials, such as cobalt.
questions.zh:
科学家们改进了一项前景广阔的电池技术，制造出了一种单晶、富镍的正极材料，比以前更耐用、更高效。
这是朝着改进如今电动汽车中常见的锂离子电池迈出的一步。
增加正极中的镍含量是锂离子电池制造商正在规划的方向，这主要是因为与其他关键电池材料（如钴）相比，镍成本相对较低、资源丰富且毒性较低。

questions.name: #406 Thymus
questions.en:
Researchers have rebuilt a human thymus, an essential organ in the immune system, using human stem cells and a bioengineered scaffold.
Their work is an important step towards being able to build artificial thymi which could be used as transplants.

他们的工作是朝着制造可用于移植的人工胸腺迈出的重要一步。

questions.name: #407 Memory Coding
questions.en:
Two new studies shed new light on how the brain encodes time and place into memories.
The findings not only add to the body of fundamental research on memory, but could eventually provide the basis for new treatments to combat memory loss from conditions such as traumatic brain injury or Alzheimer's disease.
questions.zh:
两项新研究揭示了大脑如何将时间和地点编码为记忆。
这些发现不仅丰富了记忆的基础研究，还可能最终为治疗创伤性脑损伤或阿尔茨海默病等导致的记忆丧失提供新疗法的基础。

questions.name: #408 Evolutionary Cousins
questions.en:
Compared to chimpanzees, our closest evolutionary cousins, humans are particularly prone to developing advanced carcinomas -- the type of tumors that include prostate, breast, lung and colorectal cancers -- even in the absence of known risk factors, such as genetic predisposition or tobacco use.
A recent study helps explain why.
questions.zh:
相比我们的近亲黑猩猩，人类特别容易患上晚期癌症——包括前列腺癌、乳腺癌、肺癌和结直肠癌等类型——即使没有已知的风险因素，比如遗传倾向或吸烟。
最近的一项研究有助于解释原因。

questions.name: #409 Hidden Law of Nature
questions.en: New research provides a solution for the century-and-half-old puzzle of why capillary condensation, a fundamentally microscopic phenomenon involving a few molecular layers of water, can be described reasonably well using macroscopic equations and macroscopic characteristics of bulk water.
questions.zh: 新研究为困扰了一个半世纪的谜题提供了
questions.answer:

Is it a coincidence or a hidden law of nature?

questions.name: #410 Mice
questions.en:
A new study in mice finds that a high-fat diet allows cancer cells to outcompete immune cells for fuel,  impairing immune function and accelerating tumor growth.
Cancer cells do so by rewiring their metabolisms to increase fat consumption.
Blocking this rewiring enhances anti-tumor immunity.
The findings suggest new strategies to target cancer metabolism and improve immunotherapies.
questions.zh:
一项针对小鼠的新研究发现，高脂饮食会让癌细胞在与免疫细胞争夺能量时占据上风，从而削弱免疫功能并加速肿瘤生长。
癌细胞通过重新调整自身代谢来增加脂肪消耗，从而实现这一点。
阻断这种代谢重编程可以增强抗肿瘤免疫力。
这些发现为靶向癌细胞代谢和改善免疫疗法提供了新思路。

questions.name: #412 Burial
questions.en:
Was burial of the dead practiced by Neanderthals or is it an innovation specific to our species?
Researchers have demonstrated, using a variety of criteria, that a Neanderthal child was buried, probably around 41,000 years ago, at the Ferrassie site (Dordogne, France).

questions.name: #413 Superhighway Network
questions.en:
Researchers have discovered a new superhighway network to travel through the Solar System much faster than was previously possible.
Such routes can drive comets and asteroids near Jupiter to Neptune's distance in under a decade and to 100 astronomical units in less than a century.
They could be used to send spacecraft to the far reaches of our planetary system relatively fast, and to monitor near-Earth objects that might collide with us.
questions.zh:
研究人员发现了一条新的太阳系高速公路网络，通过它旅行可以比以往快得多。
这些路径能在不到十年内将木星附近的彗星和小行星带到海王星的距离，并在不到一个世纪内带到100天文单位。
它们可以用来相对快速地发送航天器到我们行星系的遥远区域，并监测可能与我们相撞的近地天体。

questions.name: #414 Planet Nine
questions.en:
Astronomers think planets can exist in orbits far from their star, and propose a two-step process: interactions with the star or inner planets kick it out of the inner system, and then a passing star stabilizes the orbit to keep it bound.
This scenario could explain the hypothesized 'Planet Nine' in our solar system.
Astronomers have confirmed that one binary star system has a planet in a bound, highly eccentric orbit.
questions.zh:
天文学家认为，行星可以存在于远离恒星的轨道上，并提出了一个两步过程：与恒星或内行星的相互作用将其踢出内星系，然后一颗经过的恒星稳定其轨道，使其保持束缚状态。
这种情况可以解释我们太阳系中假设存在的‘第九行星’。
天文学家已经证实，在一个双星系统中，有一颗行星处于束缚的、高度偏心的轨道上。

questions.name: #415 Electric Current
questions.en: Almost 200 years after French physicist Jean Peltier discovered that electric current flowing through the junction of two different metals could be used to produce a heating or cooling effect, researchers say it is time to step up efforts to find new materials for the thermoelectric cooling market.

A team has developed Smellicopter: an autonomous drone that uses a live antenna from a moth to navigate toward smells.
Smellicopter can also sense and avoid obstacles as it travels through the air.

questions.name: #417 Black Hole
questions.en:
Researchers used the Frontera supercomputer to model for the first time a black hole merger of two black holes with very different sizes (128:1).
The research required seven months of constant computation.
The results predict the gravitational waves such a merger would produce, as well as characteristics of the resulting merged black hole.
questions.zh:
研究人员首次使用Frontera超级计算机模拟了两个大小悬殊（128:1）的黑洞合并过程。
这项研究需要连续七个月的计算。
结果预测了这种合并会产生的引力波，以及合并后黑洞的特征。

questions.name: #418 Natural Networks
questions.en:
Neural networks are some of the most important tools in AI.
So far, they run on traditional processors in the form of adaptive software, but experts are working on an alternative concept, the 'neuromorphic computer'.
In this case, neurons are not simulated by software but reconstructed in hardware components.
Researchers has now demonstrated a new approach to such hardware-targeted magnetic waves.
questions.zh:
神经网络是人工智能中最重要的工具之一。
目前，它们以自适应软件的形式运行在传统处理器上，但专家们正在研究另一种概念——‘神经形态计算机’。
在这种情况下，神经元不是通过软件模拟，而是用硬件组件重建。
研究人员现在展示了一种针对此类硬件的新方法，涉及磁波。

questions.name: #421 Protein Tau
questions.en:
Researchers have found a novel form of the Alzheimer's protein tau in the fluid surrounding the brain and spinal cord.
This form of tau -- known as MTBR tau -- indicates what stage of Alzheimer's a person is in and tracks with tangles of tau protein in the brain.

questions.name: #422 Thermometer
questions.en:
Researchers have discovered a brain molecule that functions as a 'thermometer' for the presence of others in an animal's environment.
Zebrafish 'feel' the presence of others via mechanosensation and water movements —which turns the brain hormone on.

questions.name: #423 Injury or Disease
questions.en:
Injury or disease that afflicts a relatively small number of brain cells causes a chain reaction that stops activity across a vast network of neural circuits, according to new research.
The study may help to explain why people can suffer from temporary but severe loss of cognitive function in cases of traumatic brain injury or disease.
questions.zh:
新研究指出，伤害或疾病即便只影响少量脑细胞，也会引发连锁反应，导致大片神经回路的活动停止。
这项研究或许有助于解释，为何在脑外伤或疾病情况下，人们会经历暂时但严重的认知功能丧失。

questions.name: #424 Organic Molecules
questions.en:
New research identifies a process that might have been key in producing the first organic molecules on Earth about 4 billion years ago, before the origin of life.
The process, which is similar to what might have occurred in some ancient underwater hydrothermal vents, may also have relevance to the search for life elsewhere in the universe.
questions.zh:

这个过程与某些古老的海底热液喷口中可能发生的情况类似，也可能对在宇宙其他地方寻找生命有参考价值。

questions.name: #425 Hydrogen Fuel
questions.en:
The power of the sun, wind and sea may soon combine to produce clean-burning hydrogen fuel, according to researchers.
A team integrated water purification technology into a new proof-of-concept design for a seawater electrolyzer, which uses an electric current to split apart the hydrogen and oxygen in water molecules.

研究人员称，太阳、风和海洋的力量可能很快就能结合起来，生产出清洁燃烧的氢燃料。
一个团队将水净化技术整合到一种新型海水电解槽的概念验证设计中，这种电解槽利用电流将水分子中的氢和氧分离出来。

questions.name: #426 Barley Grains
questions.en:
University of Adelaide researchers have uncovered fundamental new information about the malting characteristics of barley grains.
They say their finding could pave the way to more stable brewing processes or new malts for craft brewers.
Published in the Nature publication Scientific Reports, the researchers discovered a new link between one of the key enzymes involved in malt production for brewing and a specific tissue layer within the barley grain.

这项发表在《自然》旗下《科学报告》上的研究，发现了一种参与啤酒酿造麦芽生产的关键酶与大麦粒内特定组织层之间的新联系。

The technology is an important step towards ecologically sustainable energy storage.

这项技术是实现生态可持续能源存储的重要一步。

questions.name: #428 X-ray
questions.en:
Using an X-ray laser, a research team has investigated how water heats up under extreme conditions.
In the process, the scientists were able to observe water that remained liquid even at temperatures of more than 170 degrees Celsius.
The investigation revealed an anomalous dynamic behavior of water, which is of fundamental importance for the analysis of sensitive samples using X-ray lasers.
questions.zh:
研究团队利用X射线激光，探究了水在极端条件下的升温过程。
在此过程中，科学家们观察到水在超过170摄氏度时仍能保持液态。
这项研究揭示了水的一种异常动态行为，对于使用X射线激光分析敏感样本具有根本重要性。

questions.name: #429 European Wildcats
questions.en:
European wildcats, thought to be extinct 50 or so years ago in the Jura mountains, have since recolonized part of their former territory.
This resurgence in an area occupied by domestic cats has gone hand-in-hand with genetic crosses between the two species.
A team of biologists modeled the interactions between the two species to predict that hybridization will entail the irreversible genetic replacement of wildcats.
questions.zh:
大约50年前被认为已在侏罗山脉灭绝的欧洲野猫，后来又重新占据了它们部分原有的领地。
在与家猫共存的区域，这种复苏伴随着两个物种之间的基因杂交。
一个生物学家团队模拟了这两个物种之间的互动，预测杂交将导致野猫基因的不可逆替代。

questions.name: #430 Drug Overdose Deaths
questions.en:
The slight decline in drug overdose deaths in 2018 coincides with Chinese regulations on the powerful opioid carfentanil, rather than the result of domestic U.S. efforts to curb the epidemic, a new analysis reveals.
What many - including President Donald Trump - perceived as a decline in overdose deaths in 2018, appears to be a return to the historic exponential curve.
questions.zh:
一项新分析显示，2018年药物过量死亡人数略有下降，这与中国对强效阿片类药物卡芬太尼的监管有关，而非美国国内遏制疫情的努力所致。
包括唐纳德·特朗普总统在内的许多人认为2018年药物过量死亡人数有所下降，但这似乎只是回到了历史性的指数增长曲线上。

questions.name: #431 Deaf Children
questions.en:
Deaf children learning a sign language could certainly pursue the development of listening and spoken language skills if desired, and doing so would carry much less risk knowing the child would have mastery in at least one language.
If a child does not succeed in mastering either a spoken language or a sign language, we must then ask how much benefit the child derived from interventions in each language relative to the amount of time and resources dedicated to those interventions.
questions.zh:
失聪儿童如果想学手语，当然也可以发展听力和口语技能，而且这样做风险小得多，因为孩子至少能精通一门语言。
如果一个孩子既没能掌握口语也没能掌握手语，我们就必须问：相对于投入的时间和资源，孩子从每种语言的干预中获得了多少益处。

questions.name: #432 Summary and Abstract
questions.en:
The terms summary and abstract are often used interchangeably resulting in some confusion.
This problem arises because there are two distinct types of abstracts — descriptive and informative.
The informative abstract is another name for a summary; the descriptive is not.
The descriptive abstract is usually only two or three sentences in length, hence it is not a summary or very informative.
questions.zh:
“总结”和“摘要”这两个词经常混用，导致了一些混淆。
这个问题之所以出现，是因为有两种不同的摘要类型——描述性摘要和信息性摘要。
信息性摘要其实就是总结的另一种说法；而描述性摘要则不是。
描述性摘要通常只有两三句话的长度，因此它既不是总结，信息量也不大。

questions.name: #433 Sleep Behavior
questions.en:
Sleep behavior is also known as sleep disorder.
People with sleep disorder often talk or walk in their sleep.
They are not aware of what they are talking about or where they are going.
There isn't any serious effects on body in general but it may be connected to the mental health.
People with childhood traumas, unspeakable problem or depression are the ones with different sleep behavior.
questions.zh:
睡眠行为也被称为睡眠障碍。
有睡眠障碍的人常常在睡梦中说话或走路。
他们不知道自己在说什么或要去哪里。
总体上对身体没有严重影响，但可能与心理健康有关。
有童年创伤、难以言说的问题或抑郁的人，往往会有不同的睡眠行为。

questions.name: #434 Dynamics
questions.en:
How quickly this occurs depends on the dynamics of fertility, mortality and overseas migration.
While a moderate pace of demographic change allows for gradual adjustment of the economy and policies to the changing population demographics, rapid changes are more difficult to manage.
As a result, governments and society as a whole may need to take actions to address these issues.
questions.zh:
这个变化的速度取决于生育率、死亡率和海外移民的动态。
虽然人口变化速度适中可以让经济和政策逐步适应人口结构的变化，但快速变化则更难应对。
因此，政府和社会整体可能需要采取行动来解决这些问题。

questions.name: #435 Ozone
questions.en:
A total of five ozone ascents were taken at Bharati station (Indian mission) Antarctica from April to June 2016.
As a stratospheric temperature reduced to -82.24 ℃ on 20th June 2016 indicating the formation of stratospheric clouds, leading scientists at Bharati station feared that Montreal Accord has not succeeded to control the emission of ozone-depleting gases in the atmosphere.
questions.zh:
2016年4月至6月，印度南极考察站巴拉蒂共进行了五次臭氧探空观测。
2016年6月20日，平流层温度降至零下82.24摄氏度，表明形成了平流层云，巴拉蒂站的首席科学家担心《蒙特利尔议定书》并未成功控制大气中消耗臭氧层气体的排放。

questions.name: #437 Conservation Scientists
questions.en:
Conservation scientists have long tried to map how much of the planet remains undegraded by human activity.
Previous estimates using satellite imagery or raw demographic data found anywhere from 20 to 40 percent of the globe was free from obvious human incursions, such as roads, light pollution or the gaping scars of deforestation.
But an intact forest canopy can hide an emptied-out ecosystem below.
questions.zh:
环保科学家们长久以来一直试图绘制出地球上未被人类活动破坏的区域有多大。
以往利用卫星图像或原始人口数据进行的估算发现，全球有20%到40%的区域没有明显的人类侵入痕迹，比如道路、光污染或砍伐森林留下的巨大伤疤。
但一片完整的森林树冠可能掩盖了下层已经空荡荡的生态系统。

questions.name: #438 Decisions
questions.en:
These decisions are highly nuanced.
Of course we use a lot of data to inform our decisions, but we also rely very heavily on iteration, research, testing, intuition and human empathy.
Now, sometimes the designers who work on these products are called "data-driven," which is a term that totally drives us bonkers.
The fact is, it would be irresponsible of us not to rigorously test our designs when so many people are counting on us to get it right.
questions.zh:
这些决定非常微妙。
当然，我们大量使用数据来指导决策，但也非常依赖迭代、研究、测试、直觉和人类同理心。
有时，从事这些产品的设计师被称为“数据驱动”，这个词让我们完全抓狂。
事实上，当这么多人指望我们做对时，不严格测试我们的设计是不负责任的。

questions.name: #439 Mars Rover
questions.en:
The Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover will search for signs of ancient microbial life, which will advance NASA's quest to explore the past habitability of Mars.
The rover has a drill to collect core samples of Martian rock and soil, then store them in sealed tubes for pickup by a future mission that would ferry them back to Earth for detailed analysis.
Perseverance will also test technologies to help pave the way for future human exploration of Mars.
questions.zh:
火星2020毅力号探测器将寻找远古微生物的迹象，这有助于推进NASA探索火星过去宜居性的任务。
该探测器配备钻头，用于采集火星岩石和土壤的核心样本，并将其存储在密封管中，供未来的任务取回地球进行详细分析。
毅力号还将测试多种技术，为未来人类探索火星铺平道路。

questions.name: #440 Artificial Neural Networks
questions.en:
Artificial Neural Networks have recently become the state-of-the-art technique for crucial signal processing applications such as specific frequencies classification, structural health monitoring, diseases detection in power electronics circuitry and motor-fault detection.
This is an expected outcome as there are numerous advantages of using an adaptive and compact deep counterparts.
Particularly, it can be efficiently trained with a limited dataset of signals, besides requiring data transformation.
questions.zh:
人工神经网络最近成为了关键信号处理应用的最先进技术，比如特定频率分类、结构健康监测、电力电子电路中的疾病检测以及电机故障检测。
这是一个预期的结果，因为使用自适应且紧凑的深度对应模型具有众多优势。
特别是，它可以用有限的信号数据集高效训练，而且不需要进行数据转换。
questions.full:

questions.name: #441 Vaccines
questions.en:
Vaccines work by training and preparing the body’s natural defences – the immune system – to recognize and fight off viruses and bacteria.
If the body is exposed to those disease-causing pathogens later, it will be ready to destroy them quickly – which prevents illness.
When a person gets vaccinated against a disease, their risk of infection is also reduced.
questions.zh:
疫苗的作用是训练和调动人体的天然防御系统——也就是免疫系统——来识别并击退病毒和细菌。
如果之后身体接触到那些致病的病原体，它就能迅速将其摧毁，从而防止疾病发生。
当一个人接种了某种疾病的疫苗，他感染的风险也会降低。

The legislation, which Democrats hope to push through the Senate by the weekend, remains among the largest federal relief packages in modern American history.

questions.name: #443 Biology
questions.en:
Biology is the natural science that studies life and living organisms, including their physical structure, chemical processes, physiological mechanisms and evolution.
Certain unifying concepts consolidate it into a single and coherent field that recognizes genes as the basic unit of heredity, and evolution as the engine that propels the creation and extinction.
questions.zh:
生物学是一门自然科学，研究生命和生物体，包括它们的物理结构、化学过程、生理机制和进化。
一些统一的概念将其整合成一个单一且连贯的领域，该领域将基因视为遗传的基本单位，将进化视为推动物种产生和灭绝的动力。

questions.name: #444 Interdisciplinary Studies
questions.en:
Interdisciplinarity or interdisciplinary studies involves the combination of two or more academic disciplines into one activity.
It draws knowledge from several other fields like sociology, anthropology, psychology, economics etc. It is about creating something by thinking across boundaries.
It is related to an interdisciplinary field, which is an organizational unit that crosses traditional boundaries between academic disciplines or schools of thought.
questions.zh:
跨学科或跨学科研究指的是把两个或多个学术领域融合到一项活动中。
它从社会学、人类学、心理学、经济学等多个其他领域汲取知识，通过跨越边界思考来创造新事物。
它与跨学科领域相关，这种领域是一个跨越传统学科或学派界限的组织单位。

questions.name: #445 Chaplin
questions.en:
Sir Charles Spencer Chaplin was an English comic actor, filmmaker, and composer who rose to fame in the era of silent film.
He became a worldwide icon through his screen persona, “The Tramp”, and is considered one of the most important figures in the history of the film industry.
His career spanned more than 75 years, from childhood in the Victorian era until a year before his death in 1977, and encompassed both adulation and controversy.
questions.zh:
查尔斯·斯宾塞·卓别林爵士是一位英国喜剧演员、电影制作人和作曲家，他在无声电影时代一举成名。
他凭借银幕形象“流浪汉”成为全球偶像，被认为是电影史上最重要的人物之一。
他的职业生涯跨越了75年以上，从维多利亚时代的童年一直持续到1977年去世前一年，期间既有赞誉也有争议。

questions.name: #446 Chaplin and Sydney
questions.en:
Born in London to music-hall parents, Charlie Spencer Chaplin and his brother Sydney were placed in an orphanage at a very early age.
Becoming a vaudeville performer, he joined Fred Karno's company in 1906.
He made his film debut in Making a Living (1914) and introduced the famous seedy and soft-hearted gentleman-tramp routine, which became his hallmark.
Numerous films for various studios brought him world fame, all based on his mastery of pathos and slapstick acrobatics.
questions.zh:
查理·斯宾塞·卓别林生于伦敦，父母都是音乐厅演员，他和哥哥悉尼很小就被送进了孤儿院。
他成了杂耍演员，1906年加入了弗雷德·卡诺的剧团。
1914年，他在《谋生》中首次亮相银幕，并推出了那套著名的衣衫褴褛却心地善良的流浪汉角色，这成了他的标志。
他为多家制片厂拍了无数电影，凭借对悲情和滑稽杂耍的驾驭，赢得了世界声誉。

questions.name: #447 Sandra Lousada
questions.en:
London's National Portrait Gallery is currently celebrating the fifty-year career of photographer Sandra Lousada.
The twenty one portraits on display depict key figures in literature, film and fashion from the early 1960s.
Subsequent to the acquisition of forty portraits by Lousada, the display at The National Portrait Gallery highlights shots taken between 1960 and 1964, many of which feature in Lousada's book Public Faces Private Places.
questions.zh:
伦敦国家肖像美术馆正在庆祝摄影师桑德拉·卢萨达五十年的职业生涯。
展出的21幅肖像描绘了20世纪60年代初文学、电影和时尚领域的关键人物。
在收购了卢萨达的四十幅肖像后，国家肖像美术馆的展览重点展示了1960年至1964年间拍摄的照片，其中许多收录在卢萨达的《公众面孔，私人场所》一书中。

questions.name: #448 Returning Book
questions.en:
When returning a borrowed book, if there are missing pages, experts say transparency is key.
Librarians and etiquette coaches note a recent rise in damaged-book disputes, often caused by silent returns or unreported defects.
"If something goes wrong, acknowledge it," says one Toronto librarian.
"A simple apology and an offer to make it right prevents a small mistake from becoming a big misunderstanding."
questions.zh:
还书时如果发现有缺页，专家表示坦诚是关键。
图书管理员和礼仪教练指出，近期因书籍损坏引发的纠纷增多，常因悄悄归还或未报告破损所致。
多伦多一位图书管理员说：“出了问题就要承认。”
“简单道歉并提出补救，能避免小错变成大误会。”

questions.name: #450 Physical Activities
questions.en:
Participating regularly in physical activity has been shown to benefit an individual's health and wellbeing.
Regular physical activity is important in reducing the risk of chronic diseases, such as heart disease and stroke, obesity, diabetes and some forms of cancer.
The National Physical Activity Guidelines for Adults recommends at least 30 minutes of moderate-intensity physical activity, preferably every day of the week, to obtain health benefits.
questions.zh:
经常参加体育锻炼已被证明对个人的健康和幸福有益。
规律运动对于降低慢性病风险很重要，比如心脏病、中风、肥胖、糖尿病以及某些癌症。
《国家成人体育活动指南》建议，为了获得健康益处，每周最好每天进行至少30分钟的中等强度体育锻炼。

questions.name: #451 Noise
questions.en:
Prolonged exposure to loud noise alters how the brain processes speech, potentially increasing the difficulty in distinguishing speech sounds, according to neuroscientists.
Exposure to intensely loud sounds leads to permanent damage of the hair cells, which act as sound receivers in the ear.
Once damaged, the hair cells do not grow back, leading to noise-induced hearing loss.
questions.zh:
长期暴露在嘈杂噪音中会改变大脑处理语音的方式，可能增加区分语音的难度，神经科学家如是说。
暴露于极高强度的声音会导致耳内作为声音接收器的毛细胞永久性损伤。
毛细胞一旦受损就不会再生，从而引发噪音性听力损失。

questions.name: #452 English Colonies
questions.en:
English colonies emerged along the eastern seaboard for a variety of reasons.
People, primarily men, originally migrated to Virginia to find gold and silver to make a quick profit.
After it became evident that there were no precious metals in the area, men came to Virginia to start cultivating cash crops like tobacco.
questions.zh:
英国殖民者出于多种原因出现在东海岸沿线。
最初，主要是男性移民到弗吉尼亚寻找金银以快速获利。
当发现该地区没有贵金属后，男人们转而到弗吉尼亚种植烟草等经济作物。

questions.name: #453 Wordsworth
questions.en:
Early in the 19th century, Wordsworth opposed the coming of the steam train to the Lake District, saying it would destroy its natural character.
Meanwhile, Blake denounced the "dark satanic mills" of the Industrial Revolution.
The conservation of the natural environment, however, did not become a major theme in politics until quite recently.
questions.zh:
在19世纪初，华兹华斯反对蒸汽火车进入湖区，认为这会破坏其自然风貌。
与此同时，布莱克谴责工业革命中那些“黑暗的魔鬼工厂”。
然而，自然环境的保护直到最近才成为政治中的重要议题。

questions.name: #457 Surgical Infections
questions.en:
Surgical site infections are caused by bacteria that get in through incisions made during surgery.
They threaten the lives of millions of patients each year and contribute to the spread of antibiotic resistance.
In low- and middle-income countries, 11% of patients who undergo surgery are infected in the process.
questions.zh:
手术部位感染是由手术切口进入的细菌引起的。
它们每年威胁数百万患者的生命，并助长了抗生素耐药性的传播。
在低收入和中等收入国家，11%的手术患者在过程中被感染。

questions.en:
The scientists say this is the first documented instance of nectar that attracts a particular animal assistant being produced outside of a nectary.
In fact, the observed nectar bleeding might actually be an early system that evolved to include the nectaries found in other plants today.

questions.name: #459 Sad Truth
questions.en:
The sad truth is that happy sounds are infectious.
Now comes research that at least partly explains why.
It was published this week in the journal of Neuroscience.
A British research team played various sounds including laughter to people who are having their brain scanned by a functional MRI machine.
All the sounds activated the premotor cortical region of the brain — an area preparing facial muscles to move.
questions.zh:
可悲的事实是，快乐的声音会传染。
现在有研究至少部分解释了原因。
这项研究本周发表在《神经科学》期刊上。
一个英国研究团队向正在接受功能性核磁共振扫描的人播放各种声音，包括笑声。
所有声音都激活了大脑的前运动皮层区域——这个区域负责准备面部肌肉运动。

questions.name: #460 Aboriginal People
questions.en:
Aboriginal people are believed to have arrived as early as 60,000 years ago, and evidence of Aboriginal art in Australia dates back at least 30,000 years.

questions.en:
Tasmania is a large and relatively sparsely populated island off the south coast of Australia.
The island is of particular interest to natural scientists, who go there to research the unique wildlife.
Tasmania has, for example, twelve species of bird that are not found anywhere else in the world.

questions.name: #462 Tele-banking
questions.en:
The transition from the 'brick and mortar' structure to 'click and order' model started with the emergence of Information Technology and its use in the financial sector.
The use of technology in banking has resulted in availability of multiple delivery channels like ATMs, tele-banking, internet banking, and mobile banking.

questions.name: #463 Source of Funding
questions.en:
A study found that the research funded by the soft drinks industry had different results from research funded by other sources and went on to suggest that they may have been biased by the research itself.
The whole point of the scientific methods is to ensure the research results are not influenced by the source of funding.

科学方法的核心在于确保研究结果不受资金来源的影响。

questions.name: #464 Faster Communications
questions.en:
As we progress into the 21st century, communications are becoming faster and faster.

现在，能够阅读并理解这些图像，就像过去能够阅读普通文本一样重要。

questions.name: #465 Introverts' Thinking
questions.en:
As introverts are thinking, they reach back into long-term memory to locate information.
An introvert will often compare old and new experiences when making a decision, which slows the processing down but leads to carefully thought-out decisions.
This means that introverts have an active dialogue with themselves and usually walk around with many thoughts in their minds.
questions.zh:
当内向的人在思考时，他们会回溯长期记忆来寻找信息。
做决定时，内向者常常会对比新旧经历，这虽然拖慢了处理速度，但能带来深思熟虑的结果。
这意味着内向者会与自己进行积极的对话，脑子里通常装着很多想法。

questions.name: #466 Matthew Brady
questions.en:
In 1861, Matthew Brady, a well-known portrait photographer, approached President Lincoln requesting permission to move freely around the country photographing the Civil War.
Lincoln granted him permission to travel anywhere with the Union armies, and his record of this conflict brought home to millions the horrors of war.
questions.zh:
1861年，著名肖像摄影师马修·布雷迪找到林肯总统，请求允许他在全国各地自由拍摄内战。
林肯批准他随联邦军队自由行动，他对这场战争的记录让数百万人切身感受到战争的恐怖。

questions.name: #467 Civil War and Lincoln
questions.en:
The southerners did not accept Lincoln as a president because of certain reasons, based on historical grounds.
Southerners wished to protect their rights in the government and become more independent from the north.
They considered president elections to be unfair.
Moreover, they thought that their own rights will be ignored and limited.
All this caused the separation of the southern states and marked the beginning of the Civil War.
questions.zh:
南方人出于某些历史原因，不认可林肯当总统。
南方人希望保护自己在政府中的权利，并更加独立于北方。
他们认为总统选举不公平。
而且，他们觉得自己的权利会被忽视和限制。
这一切导致了南方各州的分裂，也标志着内战的开始。

questions.name: #468 Largest Moon
questions.en:
Previous research has offered circumstantial evidence that Ganymede, the largest moon in the solar system, contains more water than all of Earth's oceans put together.
However, temperatures there are so cold that the water on the surface is frozen solid.
Also, Ganymede’s ocean is thought to be 100 miles below the moon’s crust.
This means that the water vapor discovered by Hubble is not likely to represent the evaporation of this ocean.
questions.zh:
此前的研究提供了间接证据，表明太阳系最大的卫星——木卫三所拥有的水量比地球上所有海洋的总和还要多。
然而，那里的温度极低，表面的水都冻结成了固体。
此外，木卫三的海洋被认为位于其地壳下方100英里处。
这意味着哈勃望远镜发现的水蒸气不太可能是这片海洋蒸发所致。

questions.name: #470 Wolf
questions.en:
Over time a split would have appeared in wolf populations, he says: those wolves that feared humans, and those that didn’t. "So this would have facilitated, I think, the domestication process." At which point humans deliberately took wolves as pets.
But that domestication process, Frantz says, may have happened more than once: first in the west, in Europe.
And again in the far east, in Asia.
questions.zh:
他说，随着时间的推移，狼群中会出现分化：那些害怕人类的狼和那些不害怕人类的狼。“所以我认为，这促进了驯化过程。”在那个时候，人类开始有意地将狼作为宠物饲养。
但弗兰茨说，这种驯化过程可能不止发生了一次：第一次是在西方的欧洲。
然后再次发生在远东的亚洲。
questions.full:
Over time a split would have appeared in wolf populations, he says: those wolves that feared humans, and those that didn’t. "So this would have facilitated, I think, the domestication process." At which point humans deliberately took wolves as pets.

questions.name: #471 Bird Nests
questions.en:
Nell says that, in order to seek protection from their furry foes, birds actually prefer to build their nests in plots of swamp with a resident alligator.
In fact, in one study a graduate student planted fake alligators.
The birds seemed to prefer to build nests close to them.
“Where there’s a water source, there are alligators, so it’s sort of this moat of protection around these colonies.”
questions.zh:
内尔说，为了躲避毛茸茸的天敌，鸟类其实更喜欢在有鳄鱼栖息的沼泽地里筑巢。
事实上，在一项研究中，一名研究生放置了假鳄鱼。
鸟类似乎更喜欢在假鳄鱼附近筑巢。
“只要有水源，就有鳄鱼，所以这就像是这些鸟群周围的护城河。”

questions.name: #472 Selective History
questions.en:
History is selective.
What history books tell us about the past is not everything that happened, but what historians have selected.
They cannot put in everything: choices have to be made.
Choices must similarly be made about which aspects of the past should be formally taught to the next generation in the shape of school history lessons.
questions.zh:
历史是有选择性的。
历史书告诉我们的过去并不是所有发生过的事，而是历史学家筛选出来的。
他们不可能把一切都写进去：必须做出选择。
同样，在决定哪些过去的内容应该以学校历史课的形式正式传授给下一代时，也必须做出选择。

questions.name: #473 Economic Depression
questions.en:
An economic depression is a period of sustained, long-term downturn in economic activity in one or more economies.
It is more severe than a recession, which is a slowdown in economic activity over the course of a normal business cycle.
Economic depressions are characterized by their length, and by abnormally large increases in unemployment rate.
questions.zh:
经济萧条是指一个或多个经济体在长时间内持续低迷的经济活动期。
它比衰退更严重，衰退只是正常商业周期中经济活动的放缓。
经济萧条的特点是持续时间长，以及失业率异常大幅上升。

questions.name: #474 English Revolution (B)
questions.en:
The speaker reminisces about his views of the English Revolution when he was a student and how it seemed quite clear which side he was on - 'the aristocrats, not the puritans'.
Later he realized there was more to it than that and there were several ways of interpreting the Revolution: as a struggle between the king and parliament, as a class war or as an unpredictable situation without clear sides.
questions.zh:
演讲者回忆起自己学生时代对英国革命的看法，当时他觉得自己站在哪一边非常明确——'贵族那边，不是清教徒那边。'
后来他意识到事情没那么简单，对这场革命有多种解读方式：可以看作国王与议会的斗争、一场阶级战争，或者一个没有明确阵营的不可预测的局面。

questions.name: #477 Seismology
questions.en:
Seismology is the scientific study of earthquakes and the propagation of elastic waves through the Earth or through other planet-like bodies.
The field also includes studies of earthquake environmental effects such as tsunamis as well as diverse seismic sources such as volcanic, tectonic, glacial, fluvial, oceanic, atmospheric, and artificial processes such as explosions.
A related field that uses geology to infer information regarding past earthquakes is paleoseismology.
questions.zh:
地震学是一门科学，研究地震以及弹性波在地球或其他类行星体中的传播。
该领域还包括对地震环境效应（如海啸）的研究，以及多种地震源，例如火山、构造、冰川、河流、海洋、大气活动以及爆炸等人为过程。
一个利用地质学推断过去地震信息的相关领域是古地震学。

questions.name: #478 Children's Dream
questions.en:
As a child, you might dream one day of becoming an astronaut and, the next day, of becoming a ballet dancer — the possibilities are endless.
Eventually, this wealth of choice is whittled down by external circumstances and internal interests.
Similarly, precursor cells in early embryos make a series of stepwise 'decisions' governed by external forces and internal factors to generate the diverse array of cell types present in adult organisms.
questions.zh:
小时候，你可能今天梦想成为宇航员，明天又想当芭蕾舞演员——可能性是无限的。
最终，这种丰富的选择会因外部环境和内在兴趣而逐渐减少。
类似地，早期胚胎中的前体细胞在外部力量和内部因素的引导下，做出一系列逐步的‘决定’，从而生成成体生物中多样的细胞类型。

questions.name: #479 TV Advertising
questions.en:
From a child's point of view, what is the purpose of TV advertising?
Is advertising on TV done to give actors the opportunity to take a rest or practice their lines ?
Or is it done to make people buy things?
Furthermore, is the main difference between programs and commercials that commercials are for real, whereas programs are not, or that programs are for kids and commercials for adults?
questions.zh:
从孩子的角度看，电视广告的目的是什么？
电视上播广告是为了让演员休息或练习台词吗？
还是为了让人们买东西？
此外，节目和广告的主要区别在于广告是真实的而节目不是，还是节目给孩子看而广告给大人看？

questions.name: #480 Recurring Dream
questions.en:
Having the same dream again and again is a well-known phenomenon — nearly two-thirds of the population report having recurring dreams.
Being chased, finding yourself naked in a public place or in the middle of a natural disaster, losing your teeth or forgetting to go to class for an entire semester are typical recurring scenarios in these dreams.
questions.zh:

被追赶、发现自己赤身裸体出现在公共场所或自然灾害中、牙齿掉落、或者整个学期都忘了去上课，这些都是这些梦境中典型的重复场景。

questions.name: #481 Past, Present and Future
questions.en:
Modern science says: ‘The Sun is the past, the Earth is the present, the moon is the future.
‘ From an incandescent mass we have originated, and into a frozen mass, we shall turn.
Merciless is the law of nature, and rapidly and irresistibly we are drawn to our doom.
questions.zh:
现代科学说：太阳是过去，地球是现在，月亮是未来。
我们从一团炽热的质量中起源，最终将变成一团冰冷的质量。
自然法则无情，我们正被迅速而不可抗拒地拖向毁灭。

questions.name: #482 Reserve Requirements
questions.en:
Reserve requirements are the proportions of the deposits that banks must keep on hand and are not allowed to lend out.
For example, if the reserve requirement is 10% and you deposit one hundred dollars in a bank, the bank can lend ninety dollars of that one hundred dollars to someone else.
But it is not allowed to lend the remaining ten dollars.

准备金要求是指银行必须留存、不得贷出的存款比例。
比如，如果准备金率是10%，你往银行存100美元，银行就能把其中90美元贷给别人。
但剩下的10美元是不允许贷出的。

questions.name: #483 Leg Coordination
questions.en:
Finally, the experimenters examined real insects.
To see if leg adhesion might also play a role in the walking coordination of real flies, they put polymer drops on the flies’ legs to cover their claws and adhesive pads – – as if the flies were wearing boots — and watched what happened.
The flies quickly began to use bipod-like leg coordination similar to the one discovered in the simulation.
questions.zh:
最后，实验人员对真实的昆虫进行了观察。
为了弄清腿部粘附力是否也对真实苍蝇的行走协调起作用，他们在苍蝇腿上滴了聚合物，覆盖住它们的爪子和粘附垫——就像给苍蝇穿了靴子一样——然后观察发生了什么。
苍蝇很快就开始使用类似模拟中发现的 bipod 式腿部协调方式。

questions.name: #485 Greenhouse Gases
questions.en:
Current research models indicate that climate change associated with increasing levels of greenhouse gases is likely to lead to the soils in the interiors of the major continents drying out.
In response to a drying of cropland, people are likely to seek either new sources of irrigation water or new, wetter areas to farm.
If we choose desalination of seawater as a possible solution, large amounts of energy will be required.
questions.zh:
当前的研究模型表明，与温室气体浓度上升相关的气候变化很可能导致主要大陆内部地区的土壤变得干燥。
面对农田干旱，人们可能会寻找新的灌溉水源，或者转向更湿润的地区进行耕作。
如果我们选择海水淡化作为可能的解决方案，那将需要大量的能源。

questions.name: #486 Another Virtue
questions.en:
Another virtue that both propagate is that the present is meant to be enjoyed to the fullest.
It is no use fretting about the past for it cannot be undone or overturned and no use pondering too much, about the future for it remains unseen.
The day being thought about may never dawn on you.
The ultimate service, however, remains the one done for your fellow men.
questions.zh:
两者都推崇的另一美德是，当下应当尽情享受。
为过去烦恼毫无用处，因为它无法改变或推翻；对未来思虑过多也无益，因为它尚未到来。
你心心念念的那一天可能永远不会到来。
然而，最终极的奉献仍是为同胞所做的服务。

questions.name: #487 Literature
questions.en:
Literature allows us to move beyond the inevitable boundaries of our own lives and culture because it introduces us to people different from ourselves, places remote from our neighborhoods, and times other than our own.
Reading makes us more aware of life's possibilities as well as its subtleties and ambiguities.
questions.zh:
文学让我们能够超越自身生活和文化的必然局限，因为它向我们介绍了不同于我们自己的人、远离我们社区的地方，以及不同于我们时代的时光。
阅读让我们更清楚地意识到生活的种种可能性，以及其中的微妙与模糊之处。

questions.name: #488 Fin Whale Songs
questions.en:
Fin whale songs contain signals that are reflected and refracted within the crust, including the sediment and the solid rock layers beneath.
These signals, recorded on seismometers on the ocean bottom, can be used to determine the thickness of the layers as well as other information relevant to seismic research.
questions.zh:
长须鲸的歌声中包含的信号在地壳内部发生反射和折射，这些信号穿越了沉积物以及下方的坚硬岩层。
这些信号被海底地震仪记录下来，可以用来测定各层的厚度，并提供与地震研究相关的其他信息。

questions.name: #489 Cloud of Gas
questions.en:
Astronomers have recently discovered a large cloud of gas, in which many new stars are being formed, not far from our own solar system.
While it would seem surprising that this phenomenon hadn’t been previously noticed, the researchers explained that recent innovations in measuring the distance of gas clouds more accurately led to this discovery after older observations were reinterpreted.
questions.zh:
天文学家最近在离我们太阳系不远的地方发现了一大片气体云，其中正有许多新恒星在形成。
虽然这一现象此前未被注意到似乎令人惊讶，但研究人员解释说，最近在更精确测量气体云距离方面的创新，使得对旧观测数据重新解释后有了这一发现。

questions.name: #491 Rites of Passage
questions.en:
Rites of passage are one deep avenue to experience this love in our bones.
Once realized, the care for the earth, the connection and experience of nature, and our part and place in the whole, will inform our future, our care for all of life.
Without this care, and a true understanding of interdependence, our actions and lives may well be fragmented, divisive, and destructive.
questions.zh:
成人礼是深刻体验这种爱的途径之一。
一旦认识到这一点，对地球的关怀、与自然的联系和体验，以及我们在整体中的角色和位置，将指导我们的未来，以及我们对所有生命的关怀。
没有这种关怀，没有对相互依赖的真正理解，我们的行动和生活很可能是支离破碎、分裂且具有破坏性的。

questions.name: #492 Soil Disturbances
questions.en:
The soil disturbances by animals affect both physical and chemical soil properties.
These disturbances create vegetation-free areas, shape soil topography, alter soil density and structure, change infiltration properties and soil moisture, influence the nutrient situation, and contribute to carbon cycling and nutrient turnover (for a detailed account of species).
questions.zh:
动物对土壤的扰动会影响土壤的物理和化学特性。
这些扰动会形成无植被区域，改变土壤地形，影响土壤密度和结构，改变渗透性和水分状况，影响养分状况，并促进碳循环和养分周转（有关物种的详细说明）。

The soil disturbances by animals affect both physical and chemical soil properties.

questions.name: #493 Biopedturbation
questions.en:
Biopedturbation, the disturbance of soils by animals, is an important and often essential functional component of many ecosystems worldwide.
It determines the spatiotemporal characteristics of soil patches and thereby contributes to the ecosystems' diversity and heterogeneity.
questions.zh:
生物扰动，即动物对土壤的翻动，是全球许多生态系统中重要且常常必不可少的功能组成部分。
它决定了土壤斑块的时空特征，从而促进了生态系统的多样性和异质性。

questions.name: #494 Extraterrestrial Life
questions.en:
Hunters of extraterrestrial life may want to listen particularly closely for signals originating at star systems within that narrow band of galactic sky.
Advanced civilizations there may have already detected us using the transit method, they say, and may now be sending us a message.
You might think of this paper, then, like a treasure map, for intelligent life.
questions.zh:
寻找外星生命的人或许应该特别留意银河系中那片狭窄天空里的恒星系统发出的信号。
他们说，那里的高级文明可能已经通过凌星法发现了我们，现在或许正向我们发送信息。
你可以把这篇论文想象成一张寻找智慧生命的藏宝图。

questions.name: #495 Placebo
questions.en:
If a doctor expects a treatment to be successful, a patient may experience less pain and have better outcomes, according to a new study.
The findings reveal how social interactions between hypothetical healthcare providers and patients have the power to influence how patients perceive the effectiveness of a treatment, even when it is a placebo.
questions.zh:
一项新研究显示，如果医生预期治疗会成功，患者可能会感受到更少的疼痛，并获得更好的疗效。
研究结果揭示了想象中的医患互动如何影响患者对治疗效果的感知，即便治疗只是安慰剂也不例外。

questions.name: #496 Less Water
questions.en:
With climate change, plants of the future will consume more water than in the present day, leading to less water available for people living in North America and Eurasia, according to a new study.
The research suggests a drier future despite anticipated precipitation increases for places like the United States and Europe, populous regions already facing water stresses.
questions.zh:
一项新研究指出，随着气候变化，未来的植物将比现在消耗更多水分，导致北美和欧亚大陆居民可用水量减少。
该研究表明，尽管美国、欧洲等人口密集且已面临水资源压力的地区预计降水量会增加，但未来仍将更加干旱。

questions.name: #498 Bond Funds
questions.en:
Most bond funds have credit risk, which is the risk that companies or other issuers whose bonds are owned by the fund may fail to pay their debts ,including the debt owed to the holder of their bonds.
Some funds have little credit risk, such as those that invest in insured bonds or U.S. Treasury bonds.
But be careful: nearly all bond funds have interest rate risk, which means that the market value of the bonds they hold will go down when interest rates go up.
questions.zh:
大多数债券基金都有信用风险，也就是说基金持有的债券发行方（公司或其他机构）可能无法偿还债务，包括欠债券持有人的钱。
有些基金信用风险很低，比如那些投资于保险债券或美国国债的基金。
但要小心：几乎所有债券基金都有利率风险，这意味着当利率上升时，它们持有的债券市场价值会下降。

questions.name: #499 Wellness
questions.en:
Within “wellness” paradigm of care, there would still be a place for use of medications that help people feel differently, at least for a time: sedatives, tranquilizers, and so forth.
And you would still want to fund science that seeks to better understand the many pathways to debilitating mood states and to “psychosis” and yes, whatever biological vulnerabilities that may be present.
questions.zh:
在“健康”护理模式下，仍会存在使用药物来帮助人们改变感受的空间，至少是暂时性的：比如镇静剂、安定药等等。
你仍然会想要资助那些旨在更好地理解导致衰弱情绪状态和“精神病”的多种途径的科学，当然也包括可能存在的任何生物学易感性。

questions.name: #500 Gulf of Mutual Incomprehension
questions.en:
Six decades after the British novelist and chemist C. P. Snow famously decried the “gulf of mutual incomprehension” between the sciences and the humanities, the chasm often seems larger than ever.
Science has grown more technically demanding over the years, even as the shared public experience of art and culture has fragmented.
questions.zh:
英国小说家兼化学家C.P.斯诺曾痛斥科学与人文之间存在“相互理解的鸿沟”，六十年过去了，这条鸿沟似乎比以往任何时候都要深。
这些年来，科学在技术上变得越来越复杂，而公众在艺术和文化方面的共同体验却变得支离破碎。

questions.en:
A scientist's evidence is thought to be reliable because it will have been tested and verified at every stage.
This is not, of course, infallible as scientists are subject to human error as much as the rest of us.

当然，这并非万无一失，因为科学家和我们其他人一样，也会犯人为错误。

questions.name: #503 Vikings
questions.en:
Invaders, pirates, warriors - the history books taught us that Vikings were brutal predators who travelled by sea from Scandinavia to pillage and raid their way across Europe and beyond.
Now cutting-edge DNA sequencing of more than 400 Viking skeletons from archaeological sites scattered across Europe and Greenland will rewrite the history book.
questions.zh:
历史上说，维京人是侵略者、海盗、战士，他们从斯堪的纳维亚乘船出海，在欧洲乃至更远的地方一路烧杀抢掠，是一群残忍的掠夺者。
如今，通过对散落在欧洲和格陵兰岛各地的400多具维京人骨骼进行尖端DNA测序，历史书将被改写。

questions.name: #504 Writers
questions.en:
Writers may make the mistake of making all their sentences too compact.
Some have made this accusation against the prose of Gibbon.
An occasional loose sentence prevents the style from becoming too formal and allows the reader to relax slightly.
Loose sentences are common in easy, unforced writing, but it is a fault when there are too many of them.

松散句在轻松自然的写作中很常见，但如果用得太多就成了问题。

questions.name: #505 Student Exchange Program
questions.en:
A student exchange program complements formal education, while promoting tolerance, maturity and independence – all highly sought after qualities in today’s competitive job market.
Living in the host country, not as a tourist or guest but as a member of the community, is what makes the experience both challenging and rewarding.

questions.name: #506 Solar Energy
questions.en:
Not all solar energy capture devices make electricity directly.
For example, steam generated from solar energy can turn turbines, which then produce electricity.
And, in what could be especially useful in remote regions, solar steam can desalinate water and be used in sanitation and equipment sterilization.
questions.zh:

而在偏远地区尤其有用的是，太阳能蒸汽可以淡化海水，并用于卫生设施和设备消毒。

questions.name: #507 Fresh Water
questions.en:
In Abu Dhabi, where fresh water sources are very limited, sustainable water management is a high priority.
The region receives on average just 120 millimeters of rainfall every year but the country is seeing demand for water increase by almost 40% annually.
In this situation, it is clear that Abu Dhabi needs to boost the efficiency of water use by increasing water recycling.
questions.zh:
在阿布扎比，淡水资源十分有限，可持续水资源管理是重中之重。
该地区年均降雨量仅为120毫米，但全国用水需求每年增长近40%。
在这种情况下，阿布扎比显然需要通过提高水回收利用率来提升用水效率。

questions.name: #508 Microbe Reproduction
questions.en:
A microbe can either reproduce by dividing or it can conserve its energy and maintain only its most basic functions.
One possibility is that in the unfavorable conditions under the South Pacific floor, the microbes could have been dividing very slowly over centuries.
In this case, the microbes in the study may be the descendants of an even more distant past.
questions.zh:
微生物要么通过分裂繁殖，要么保存能量，只维持最基本的生命活动。
一种可能是，在南太平洋海底的不利条件下，这些微生物可能几个世纪以来一直以极其缓慢的速度分裂。
这样的话，研究中发现的微生物可能是更遥远过去的后代。

questions.name: #509 Running
questions.en:
People run for many different reasons, namely: for fun, for exercise, to raise money for charities, and so on.
Over the past decades, running has become an essential part of many health routines because of the publicity about its beneficial effects.
It is claimed that it is good for our heart, it reduces stress and it helps to prevent diseases like diabetes.
questions.zh:
人们跑步的原因各不相同，比如：为了乐趣、为了锻炼、为慈善募捐等等。
过去几十年里，由于跑步益处的广泛宣传，它已成为许多人健康习惯的重要组成部分。
据说跑步对心脏有益，能减轻压力，并有助于预防糖尿病等疾病。

questions.name: #510 Peer Checking
questions.en:
Peer checking is a very useful and productive way of developing your reviewing skills.
When you read your friend's work, you are assuming the role of the reader (and the teacher).
If your friend's work is well written, then it will be fluent and easy to read, and you will have no problems understanding the overall content.
questions.zh:
同伴互查是提升你审阅能力的一种非常有用且高效的方式。
当你阅读朋友的作品时，你是在扮演读者（和老师）的角色。
如果朋友的作品写得好，那么它会流畅易读，你理解整体内容就不会有问题。

questions.name: #511 Teaching Machine
questions.en:
In 1953 B.F. Skinner visited his daughter’s maths class.
The Harvard psychologist found every pupil learning the same topic in the same way at the same speed.
A few days later he built his first "teaching machine", which let children tackle questions at their own pace.
By the mid-1960s similar gizmos were being flogged by door-to-door salesmen.
Within a few years, though, enthusiasm for them had fizzled out.
questions.zh:
1953年，B.F. 斯金纳去他女儿的数学课上旁听。
这位哈佛心理学家发现，所有学生都在用同样的方式、以同样的速度学习同一个课题。
几天后，他造出了第一台“教学机器”，让孩子们可以按自己的节奏答题。
到60年代中期，类似的玩意儿已经由上门推销员四处兜售。
然而没过几年，人们对它们的热情就烟消云散了。

questions.name: #512 Ed Tech
questions.en:
Since then education technology (edtech) has repeated the cycle of hype and flop, even as computers have reshaped almost every other part of life.
One reason is the conservatism of teachers and their unions.
But another is that the brain-stretching potential of edtech has remained unproven.
questions.zh:
自那以后，教育技术就一直在炒作与失败之间循环，尽管计算机几乎重塑了生活的其他方方面面。
原因之一是教师及其工会的保守态度。
但另一个原因是，教育技术拓展大脑潜力的能力尚未得到证实。

questions.name: #513 Ed Tech (B)
questions.en:
Today, however, Skinner's heirs are forcing the sceptics to think again.
Backed by billionaire techies such as Mark Zuckerberg and Bill Gates, schools around the world are using new software to "personalize" learning.
This could help children stuck in dismal classes—but only if edtech boosters can resist the temptation to revive harmful ideas about how children learn.
To succeed, edtech must be at the service of teaching, not the other way around.
questions.zh:
不过如今，斯金纳的追随者们正迫使怀疑者重新思考。
在马克·扎克伯格和比尔·盖茨等亿万富翁技术专家的支持下，全球各地的学校正使用新软件来“个性化”学习。
这或许能帮助那些被困在沉闷课堂中的孩子——但前提是，教育科技的支持者能抵制住诱惑，不去复活那些关于儿童学习方式的有害观念。
要成功，教育科技必须服务于教学，而不是反过来。

questions.name: #514 Schooling Model
questions.en:
The conventional model of schooling emerged in Prussia in the 18th century.
Alternatives have so far failed to teach as many children as efficiently.
Classrooms, hierarchical year-groups, standardized curriculums and fixed timetables are still the norm for most of the world’s nearly 1.5 billion schoolchildren.
questions.zh:
我们现在熟悉的这种学校教育模式，其实起源于18世纪的普鲁士。
到目前为止，其他替代方案在高效教育儿童方面都没能比得上它。
对于全球近15亿学龄儿童来说，教室、按年级划分的层级、标准化的课程和固定的课表仍然是常态。

questions.name: #515 Losing and Winning
questions.en:
'Everyone loves a winner' is a common saying but surprisingly, people dislike losing more than they like winning, and it actually takes a lot to tempt us to take a risk.
Psychologists and economists from Princeton University found that people do not like to bet money in a 50:50 situation unless they can win twice the amount they could lose.
questions.zh:
"人人都爱赢家"是句常言，但出人意料的是，人们厌恶输的程度远超过喜欢赢，而且要想让我们冒险其实很难。
普林斯顿大学的心理学家和经济学家发现，在输赢各半的情况下，人们不愿意押注，除非赢的钱可能是输的两倍。

questions.name: #516 Team Working Ability
questions.en:
The ability to work in a team is one that is prized by employers and educationalists.
It is often requested in job advertisements and displayed on CVs.
When employers list their most important skills for promotion, 86% of people list team working skills.
These days, the willingness and ability to work with a group of people towards a single target has become increasingly important.
questions.zh:
雇主和教育工作者非常看重团队合作能力。
招聘广告中经常要求具备这种能力，简历上也会列出。
当雇主列出晋升最重要的技能时，86%的人会提到团队协作能力。
如今，愿意且能够与他人合作达成共同目标变得越来越重要。

questions.name: #517 Homesick
questions.en:
Everyone at some point can feel worried or anxious, homesick or isolated because they don't just fit in.
This often happens when you change your location or when changes happen to you, and the truth is that this happens to lots of people; and it's a normal part of life.
It's been recognized that around one third of students will experience poor mental health during their studies.
questions.zh:
每个人在某个时候都可能感到担忧、焦虑、想家或孤立，因为自己不太合群。
这通常发生在你换地方或生活发生变化的时候，事实上很多人都经历过，这是生活正常的一部分。
据估计，大约三分之一的学生在学习期间会出现心理健康问题。

questions.name: #518 European Eel
questions.en:
One of the most mysterious and endangered fish in Europe is the European eel.
Eels live very long and complex lives and during their lifetime will travel thousands of miles, transforming themselves as they go.
They can grow up to one metre long and have long and snake-like bodies with one pair of small fins at the sides.
They are secretive creatures and most of their early life at sea is a mystery.
questions.zh:
欧洲鳗是欧洲最神秘且濒危的鱼类之一。
鳗鱼寿命长，生活史复杂，一生中会游历数千英里，并在途中不断蜕变。
它们最长能长到一米，身体像蛇一样细长，两侧各有一对小鳍。
它们生性隐秘，早期在海中的大部分生活仍是个谜。

questions.name: #519 Positive Pressure
questions.en:
It is quite normal to feel under pressure, and pressure can sometimes be a positive force: it can make us feel energized and take action to get results.
But if the pressure becomes too much and we tip over into the feeling of being stressed, then it can have negative impact on us and our health.
However, stress is a very subjective phenomenon and it lacks a precise medical definition.
questions.zh:
感到有压力是很正常的，有时候压力还能起到积极作用：它能让我们充满活力，采取行动去取得成果。
但如果压力过大，我们陷入紧张的状态，就会对我们自身和健康产生负面影响。
不过，压力是一种非常主观的现象，缺乏精确的医学定义。

questions.name: #520 Too Much Information
questions.en:
We all know, that too much information can be a bad thing - this is as true in daily life as it is in business.
Filtering useful from useless information has become a growing problem, bringing confusion with it, but this is where data curation can help.
Curating data involves finding and displaying patterns in large volumes of disconnected and messy data to create meaningful information.
questions.zh:
我们都知道，信息太多可能不是好事——这在日常生活和商业中都是如此。
从无用信息中筛选出有用信息已经成为一个日益严重的问题，带来了混乱，但数据整理可以帮上忙。
数据整理涉及从大量杂乱无章的数据中发现并展示模式，从而创造出有意义的信息。

questions.name: #521 Bird's Positioning
questions.en:
Birds have a variety of methods by which they are able to find their way across the flyways, year in, and year out.
It seems that birds employ different geo-positioning strategies according to the conditions encountered during migration.
They seem able to use the position of the sun and stars, the Earth's magnetic field, smells and even landmarks to find their way.
questions.zh:
鸟类有各种各样的方法，年复一年地沿着迁徙路线找到方向。
看来鸟类会根据迁徙途中遇到的情况，采用不同的地理定位策略。
它们似乎能利用太阳和星星的位置、地球的磁场、气味甚至地标来认路。

questions.name: #522 Moon Transportation
questions.en:
Although it is difficult to take people back to the Moon, it is not impossible!
We can transport people but the logistical challenge of keeping them there, is a very different thing.
However, we have two of the components necessary to make this work: power from the Sun, and the minerals on the Moon itself.
Scientists and researchers are already busy working on this in laboratories.
questions.zh:
虽然把人送回月球很难，但并非不可能！
我们可以把人运过去，但如何让他们在那里生存，后勤挑战完全是另一回事。
不过，我们有两个关键要素：太阳的能量和月球本身的矿物。
科学家和研究人员已经在实验室里忙着攻克这个难题了。

questions.name: #523 Social Media
questions.en:
Our widespread participation in social media in recent years has led to the emergence of what is termed social media influencers'.
These online entrepreneurs are people who have created a positive reputation amongst their followers for providing knowledge or expertise on a particular subject.
The brands have seen them as a means of promoting their product or service to thousands and sometimes millions of people.
questions.zh:
近年来，我们广泛参与社交媒体，催生了所谓的“社交媒体影响者”。
这些网络创业者通过在特定领域提供知识或专长，在追随者中建立了良好的声誉。
品牌将它们视为向成千上万甚至数百万人推广产品或服务的一种手段。

questions.name: #524 Banking and Bank
questions.en:
In 1994, Microsoft's founder, Bill Gates, said that although banking is necessary, banks are really not!
At a time when many traditional institutions and ways of doing things are changing, banking is changing too.
There are now new ways of accessing loans and lending money.
Thanks to the rise of alternative finance, people can raise and invest money outside the traditional banking system.
questions.zh:
1994年，微软创始人比尔·盖茨曾说，虽然银行业务不可或缺，但银行本身其实并非必要。
在众多传统机构和做事方式都在变革的时代，银行业也在发生变化。
如今，获取贷款和出借资金都有了新的途径。
得益于替代性金融的兴起，人们可以在传统银行体系之外筹集和投资资金。

questions.name: #525 Inevitable Change
questions.en:
Change is inevitable in any sphere of life.
Although the results of change can bring great benefits, the process of change can be intensely traumatic, involve loss of choice, power and status, and when change happens in the workplace, it can even lead to loss of jobs.
Many businesses and organizations use a model called the Change Curve to understand and manage how people react to change.
questions.zh:
变化在生活的任何领域都是不可避免的。
虽然变化的结果能带来巨大好处，但变化的过程可能非常痛苦，涉及选择、权力和地位的丧失，而当变化发生在工作场所时，甚至可能导致失业。
许多企业和组织使用一种称为“变化曲线”的模型来理解和管理人们对变化的反应。

questions.name: #526 First Satellite
questions.en:
Since the Soviet Union successfully launched the first man-made satellite, Sputnik 1, in 1957, about 5,000 more satellites have been put into orbit around the Earth.
About 2,000 of these are active and although the rest are now dysfunctional, they remain in orbit, together with parts from all the rockets that carried them there.
These remnants are often referred to as space junk, space trash or orbital debris.
questions.zh:
自1957年苏联成功发射第一颗人造卫星斯普特尼克1号以来，又有大约5000颗卫星被送入地球轨道。
其中约2000颗仍在运行，其余虽已失效，但仍留在轨道上，连同所有运载它们的火箭部件。
这些残留物常被称为太空垃圾、太空废物或轨道碎片。

questions.name: #527 Camel Sculptures
questions.en:
A series of camel sculptures carved into rock faces in Saudi Arabia are likely to be the oldest large-scale animal reliefs in the world, a study says.
When the carvings were first discovered in 2018, researchers estimated they were created about 2,000 years ago.
This was based on their similarity to reliefs at Jordan's famous ancient city of Petra.
questions.zh:
一项研究称，沙特阿拉伯岩壁上雕刻的一系列骆驼雕塑很可能是世界上最古老的大型动物浮雕。
这些雕刻最初于2018年被发现时，研究人员估计它们创作于约2000年前。
这一判断是基于它们与约旦著名古城佩特拉浮雕的相似性。

questions.en:
Many families are fleeing their native countries due to sectarian repression and political uprisings.
Consequently, thousands of people have been stranded in foreign lands for months; other families have gone missing in the sea, marooned in small boats, as the neighboring foreign countries refuse to take them in.

questions.name: #529 Passion
questions.en:
Do something you are very passionate about and do not try to chase what is considered the hot passion of the day.
People say you have to have a lot of passion for what you’re doing, and it’s totally true.
You have to do it over a sustained period of time.
So, if you don’t love it, you’re going to give up.
questions.zh:
去做你真正热爱的事情，不要盲目追逐当下的热门。
人们常说，你必须对自己所做的事充满热情，这完全没错。
你需要长期坚持做这件事。
所以，如果你不爱它，你迟早会放弃。

questions.name: #537 Ancient Athens
questions.en:
In ancient Athens, a boy was socially located by his family identity, and Plato often refers to his characters in terms of their paternal and fraternal relationships.
Socrates was not a family man and saw himself as the son of his mother, who was apparently a midwife.
questions.zh:
在古雅典，一个男孩的社会地位是由他的家庭身份决定的，柏拉图常常通过父系和兄弟关系来指代他笔下的人物。
苏格拉底不是个顾家的人，他把自己看作是他母亲的儿子，而他母亲显然是个助产士。

questions.name: #538 Avalanche
questions.en:
An avalanche is rapidly descending large mass of snow, ice, soil, rock, or mixtures of these materials, sliding or falling in response to the force of gravity.
Avalanches, which are natural forms of erosion and often seasonal, are usually classified by their content such as a debris or snow avalanche.

雪崩是一种自然侵蚀现象，通常具有季节性，常根据其物质组成分类，例如碎屑雪崩或积雪雪崩。

questions.name: #539 Tea Ceremony (B)
questions.en:
Many non-Japanese know a thing or two about traditional tea ceremony, its history, intricacies and religious origins.
However, few people outside Japan have a deep understanding of the esoteric meaning of the practice.
Indeed, even in Japan, the secret meaning of tea ceremony is little understood except by those who have devoted their lives to the discipline.
questions.zh:
很多非日本人对传统茶道略知一二，了解它的历史、复杂细节和宗教起源。
然而，日本以外很少有人能深刻理解这种实践的深奥含义。
事实上，即使在日本，茶道的秘密意义也鲜为人知，只有那些毕生致力于这门学问的人才能领悟。

questions.name: #540 Car-free Zone
questions.en:
To reduce pollution, it is essential that the town center becomes a car-free zone.
A ring road should be built so that cars are diverted away from the town center.
The main shopping streets could be converted into a pedestrianized area.
If trees and flowers are planted, the town center will be transformed into a quiet and green space where residents can enjoy shopping and walking in a healthy environment.
questions.zh:
为了减少污染，镇中心必须成为无车区。
应该修建一条环城路，让车辆绕开镇中心。
主要商业街可以改造成步行区。
如果种上树木和鲜花，镇中心将变成一个安静绿色的空间，居民可以在健康的环境中享受购物和散步。

questions.name: #542 Bermuda Triangle
questions.en:
The Bermuda Triangle is a mythical section of the Atlantic Ocean roughly bounded by Miami, Bermuda and Puerto Rico where dozens of ships and airplanes have disappeared.
Unexplained circumstances surround some of these accidents, including one in which the pilots of a squadron of U.S. Navy bombers became disoriented while flying over the area; the planes were never found.
questions.zh:
百慕大三角是大西洋上一片神秘的区域，大致以迈阿密、百慕大和波多黎各为界，那里发生过数十起船只和飞机失踪事件。
其中一些事故伴随着无法解释的情况，比如一队美国海军轰炸机的飞行员在该区域上空飞行时迷失了方向，这些飞机后来再也没有找到。

questions.name: #543 Sibling Bullying
questions.en:
Sibling bullying associated with poor mental health outcomes years later.
Scientists found sibling bullying in early adolescence, irrespective of whether the individual was a victim, perpetrator, or both, has a long-term effect on both positive and negative mental health in late adolescence.
questions.zh:
兄弟姐妹间的欺凌与多年后不良的心理健康状况有关。
科学家发现，在青春期早期，无论个体是受害者、施暴者还是两者兼有，兄弟姐妹间的欺凌都会对青春期晚期的积极和消极心理健康产生长期影响。

questions.name: #544 Line Engraving
questions.en:
Line engraving on metal, which, to a great extent, was a development of the goldsmith’s craft of ornamenting armor and precious metals, did not emerge as a print-making technique until well into the 15th century.
Copper, the metal mainly used for engraving, was expensive, and engraving itself was laborious and took a long time.
questions.zh:
金属线刻在很大程度上是金匠装饰盔甲和贵金属工艺的发展成果，直到15世纪才作为一种版画技术出现。
主要用作雕刻的金属铜价格昂贵，而且雕刻本身既费力又耗时。

questions.name: #545 Hooked Patients
questions.en:
Some of the pain patients may become hooked.
Or their meds may find their way to friends or relatives who take them recreationally.
Or a prescription opioid user may transition to heroin.
Heroin is just another opioid drug, so the brain doesn’t distinguish whether it comes from a pharmacy or from a street drug dealer.
questions.zh:
有些疼痛患者可能会上瘾。
或者他们的药物可能被朋友或亲戚拿去当消遣药。
或者处方阿片类药物使用者可能转向海洛因。
海洛因只是另一种阿片类药物，大脑不会区分它是来自药店还是街头毒贩。

questions.name: #546 Internet Interruptions
questions.en:
Internet interruptions caused by extreme weather events sap billions of dollars annually from the global economy and can interfere with the delivery of essential data and services by governments, utilities, and first responders.
A Boston-based startup is trying to address that problem by applying climate resilience and adaption principles to the internet, which experts say is vulnerable to climate change.
questions.zh:
极端天气导致的网络中断每年给全球经济造成数十亿美元的损失，还会干扰政府、公用事业和应急部门传输关键数据和服务。
一家波士顿初创公司正尝试将气候韧性与适应原则应用于互联网，以解决这一问题。专家指出，互联网在气候变化面前十分脆弱。

questions.name: #547 Greenhouse Gases
questions.en:
Human beings most certainly contribute to climate change by adding greenhouse gases to the atmosphere, but this is only part of the equation.
Earth’s climate can change over time not only because of changes in the atmosphere but also because of interactions between the atmosphere and various geologic, chemical, biological, and geographic factors.
questions.zh:
人类向大气排放温室气体，无疑加剧了气候变化，但这只是问题的一部分。
地球气候随时间变化，不仅源于大气成分的改变，还受到大气与多种地质、化学、生物及地理因素相互作用的影响。

questions.name: #548 Newer Sites
questions.en:
Newer sites usually are more accessible than older ones.
Many facility owners and operators may not have the experience or knowledge to determine the level of accessibility on their sites.
If they have never received any complaints, they may mistakenly assume that no problems exist.
Inspect all areas of the site carefully to make an accurate assessment of its level of accessibility.
questions.zh:
新场地通常比旧场地更方便使用。
许多设施所有者和运营者可能缺乏经验或知识来判断其场地的无障碍程度。
如果他们从未收到过投诉，可能会错误地认为没有问题。
仔细检查场地的所有区域，以准确评估其无障碍水平。

questions.name: #550 Soft Drink
questions.en:
The main production of soft drink was stored in 1830’s. Since then from those experimental beginning, there was an evolution until in 1781 when the worlds first cola-flavored beverage was introduced.
These drinks were called soft drinks, only to separate them from hard alcoholic drinks.
Today, soft drink is more favorite refreshment drink than tea, coffee, juice, etc..
questions.zh:
软饮料的主要生产始于19世纪30年代。从那时起，经过一系列实验性的开端，直到1781年，世界上第一款可乐味饮料才问世。
这些饮料被称为软饮料，只是为了将它们与烈性酒精饮料区分开来。
如今，软饮料比茶、咖啡、果汁等更受欢迎，成为人们最喜爱的提神饮品。

questions.name: #551 Student Loan
questions.en:
Since 2003, borrowing for education advanced faster, in percentage terms, than all other types of consumer debt that includes mortgages, auto loans and credit cards, data from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York show.
As of the fourth quarter, student loans represented 10.5 percent of a record $ 13.1 trillion in household debt, up from 3.3 percent at the start of 2003.
questions.zh:
自2003年起，教育贷款的增长速度按百分比计算已超过所有其他类型的消费债务，包括抵押贷款、汽车贷款和信用卡，这是纽约联邦储备银行的数据显示的。
截至第四季度，学生贷款占创纪录的13.1万亿美元家庭债务的10.5%，而2003年初这一比例为3.3%。

questions.en:

questions.name: #553 Hottest Month
questions.en:
The Earth just had the hottest month in recorded history, and it’s even worse than normal.
The record comes in a run of unprecedentedly hot months.
Not only does it break through the all-time record set a year before, it also continues a now 10-month long streak of months that are the hottest ever according to NASA data.
The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration calculates temperatures slightly different.
questions.zh:
地球刚刚经历了有记录以来最热的一个月，而且情况比往常更糟。
这一纪录出现在一连串前所未有的高温月份之后。
它不仅打破了去年创下的历史纪录，还延续了根据NASA数据长达10个月的史上最热月份序列。
美国国家海洋和大气管理局计算温度的方式略有不同。

questions.name: #554 Smartphones
questions.en:
Smartphones have become an everyday essential for millions of us – we rely on them for everything from updating our social media profiles to banking.
Taking out a smartphone contract that bundles together your calls, data, and texts with the cost of the handset can help spread the cost – but can also mean you’ll pay more over the long run.
questions.zh:
智能手机已经成为我们数百万人的日常必需品——从更新社交媒体到办理银行业务，我们都离不开它。
签一份把通话、流量和短信费用与手机价格捆绑在一起的智能手机合约，虽然能分摊成本，但长期来看也可能让你花更多钱。

questions.name: #555 Meteorite
questions.en:
A meteorite that fell on Earth more than a century ago may contain some of the first concrete evidence for a cosmic mash-up in the early solar system.
Following the birth of our sun 4.5 billion years ago, it is thought that Jupiter’s formation caused two reservoirs of asteroids to gather in the solar system, one inside the giant planet’s orbit and one outside.
questions.zh:
一个多世纪前坠落地球的一颗陨石，可能含有早期太阳系宇宙碰撞的首批确凿证据。
据认为，在45亿年前太阳诞生后，木星的形成导致太阳系中聚集了两个小行星库，一个位于这颗巨行星轨道内侧，另一个在外侧。

questions.name: #556 Bad Habits
questions.en:
It is very easy to acquire bad habits, such as eating too many sweets or too much food, or drinking too much fluid of any kind, or smoking, etc..
The more we do a thing, the more we tend to like doing it.
In later stage, if we do not continue to do it, we feel unhappy.
This is called the 'force of habit' and the force of habit should be fought against.

questions.name: #557 Termites
questions.en:
Termites, the tiny creatures – have learnt to create a comfortable home in some of the world's toughest climates.
Outside, in the African Savannah the temperatures vary from forty degrees in the day to one degree at night.
Yet, inside the mound, the temperature stays constant.

外面，非洲大草原的温度从白天的四十度到夜晚的一度不等。
然而，蚁丘内部温度却保持恒定。

questions.name: #558 Soil
questions.en:
Soil is the top layer of the Earth's surface, mostly created from weathered rock.
It is made up of varying amounts of minerals, humus, or decayed organic matter, and useful living creatures like worms.
The finest rock particles within soil - forms sticky clay, the medium particles become silt, and the coarsest constitute sand.
While there is sufficient moisture, soil supports vegetation, providing a habitat for a variety of animals.
questions.zh:
土壤是地球表面的最上层，主要由风化岩石形成。
它包含不同量的矿物质、腐殖质或腐烂的有机物，以及像蚯蚓这样有用的生物。
土壤中最细的岩石颗粒形成黏土，中等颗粒变成淤泥，最粗的则构成沙子。
只要有足够的水分，土壤就能支撑植被生长，并为多种动物提供栖息地。

questions.name: #559 Pronunciation
questions.en:
Pronunciation is the way in which a word or a language is spoken.
This may refer to generally agreed-upon sequences of sounds used in speaking a given word or language in a specific dialect ("correct pronunciation") or simply the way a particular individual speaks a word or language.

questions.name: #561 Interludes
questions.en:
The interludes which break up the gameplay action, and which, because they can be made to a higher level of animation, often provide the most visually arresting sequences of a game.
Combined with a taste for bizarrely complicated, recursive plots, and long sequences of wordy explicatory dialogue, this turns the games into a bit of a drag.
questions.zh:
那些穿插在游戏操作之间的过场动画，因为可以做得更精致，往往成为游戏中最吸引眼球的视觉片段。
再加上对离奇复杂、层层嵌套的情节以及冗长解释性对白的偏好，这让游戏变得有点拖沓。

questions.name: #563 Blood Sugar
questions.en:
Australian scientists say they have developed pain-free blood sugar testing for diabetics, a non-invasive strip that checks glucose levels via saliva for diabetics.
Managing their blood sugar levels typically means pricking their fingers multiple times a day with a lancet and then placing a drop of blood on a testing strip.

控制血糖水平通常意味着每天要用采血针多次刺破手指，然后将一滴血滴在测试试纸上。

questions.name: #564 Stale Water
questions.en:
There are many reasons why water tastes stale when it is kept for a long time.
Microorganisms play a big role in this phenomenon.
When they grow, they release chemicals into the water from their metabolic activity.
This evaporates over time, so the absence of it from water left out for a long period brings about a change in taste.
questions.zh:
水放久了会有股怪味，原因有很多。
微生物在这个现象中扮演了重要角色。
它们生长时，代谢活动会向水中释放化学物质。
这些物质随时间蒸发，所以长期放置的水缺少它们，味道就变了。

questions.name: #565 Tests of drug
questions.en:
Tests of a drug known to stimulate brain activity have shown early success in reducing symptoms of sluggish cognitive tempo in 38 men and women with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder.
It also significantly corrected deficits in executive brain function, with fewer episodes of procrastination, improvements in keeping things in mind, and strengthened prioritization skills.

一种已知能刺激大脑活动的药物，在针对38名注意力缺陷多动障碍患者的早期试验中，成功缓解了他们认知迟缓的症状。
该药物还显著改善了大脑执行功能方面的缺陷，减少了拖延行为，增强了记忆力，并提升了优先处理事务的能力。

questions.name: #567 Optogenetics
questions.en:
Optogenetics is a research tool in neuroscience that uses light to alter the activity of genetically engineered light-sensitive nerve cells to better understand the function and behavior of clusters of neurons in animals.
Now, a team led by researchers from the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology has developed an implantable optogenetic light-emitting device that can be wirelessly recharged.
questions.zh:

现在，由韩国科学技术院的研究人员领导的一个团队开发出了一种可植入的光遗传学发光装置，该装置能够无线充电。

questions.name: #569 Permafrost
questions.en:
Permafrost is ground that is frozen year-round.
In the Arctic, ice-rich permafrost soils can be up to 260 feet thick.
Due to human-caused warming of the atmosphere from greenhouse gas emissions, a steady thawing of the permafrost is currently taking place where the upper layer of seasonally thawed soil is gradually getting thicker and reaching deeper into the ground.
questions.zh:
永冻土是指全年都处于冻结状态的地面。
在北极地区，富含冰的永冻土层厚度可达260英尺。
由于人类活动排放温室气体导致大气变暖，永冻土正在持续融化，季节性融化的表层土壤逐渐变厚，并向地下更深层延伸。
