questions.name: #570 Emerald
questions.en:
Emerald is defined by its green color.
To be an emerald, a specimen must have a distinctly green color that falls in the range from bluish green to green to slightly yellowish green.
To be an emerald, the specimen must also have a rich color.
Stones with weak saturation or light tone should be called "green beryl." If it is greenish yellow it is "heliodor." This color definition is a source of confusion.
questions.zh:
翡翠以其绿色来定义。
要成为翡翠，标本必须具有明显的绿色，范围从蓝绿色到绿色再到略带黄绿色。
要成为翡翠，标本还必须颜色浓郁。
饱和度低或色调浅的石头应称为“绿柱石”。如果呈黄绿色，则是“金绿柱石”。这种颜色定义是困惑的来源。

questions.name: #572 Impossible Dream
questions.en:
Whether you're climbing your way up the corporate ladder or overwhelmed with the organizational tasks of home and kids, a luxurious vacation to an exotic paradise may seem like an impossible dream.
You can only fantasize about an outdoor massage among fragrant island flowers or a nap after enjoying a brunch ripe with fruits fresh from the vine.
questions.zh:
不管你是正在职场奋力攀爬，还是被家里的琐事和孩子忙得焦头烂额，去一个异国天堂度个奢华假期，可能听起来就像个遥不可及的梦。
你只能幻想一下，在芬芳的岛花丛中享受户外按摩，或者吃完一顿满是新鲜水果的早午餐后打个盹儿。

questions.name: #573 Artificial Intelligence
questions.en:
Artificial intelligence has been one of the most controversial domains of inquiry in computer science since it was first proposed in the 1950s.
Defined as the part of computer science concerned with designing systems that exhibit the characteristics associated with human intelligence understanding language, learning, reasoning, solving problems.
questions.zh:
自从20世纪50年代首次提出以来，人工智能一直是计算机科学领域最具争议的研究方向之一。
它被定义为计算机科学的一个分支，专注于设计能够展现人类智能特征——如理解语言、学习、推理和解决问题——的系统。

questions.name: #574 Projected Temperature
questions.en:
It’s projected that, over the next hundred years, temperatures on Earth could rise an average of nearly five degrees Celsius.
While some animals might be able to migrate north to escape the brunt of the heat, plants can’t uproot themselves quite so easily.
Researchers wondered whether the creatures that disperse plant seeds might be able to help.
questions.zh:
据预测，未来一百年内，地球平均气温可能上升近五摄氏度。
有些动物或许能向北迁徙以避开高温的主要影响，但植物可没法这么轻易地把自己连根拔起。
研究人员想知道，那些传播植物种子的生物是否能帮上忙。

questions.name: #575 Major Disaster

When a major disaster strikes, the first people on the scene are often local organizations, residents and volunteers.

questions.name: #576 Global Order
questions.en:
The defining question about global order for this generation is whether China and the United States can escape Thucydides’s Trap.
The Greek historian’s metaphor reminds us of the attendant dangers when a rising power rivals a ruling power—as Athens challenged Sparta in ancient Greece, or as Germany did Britain a century ago.
questions.zh:
这一代人面临的全球秩序核心问题是，中美能否避开修昔底德陷阱。
这位希腊历史学家的比喻提醒我们，当崛起大国挑战守成大国时，伴随的风险——就像古雅典挑战斯巴达，或一个世纪前德国挑战英国那样。

questions.name: #577 Conscientiousness
questions.en:
Conscientiousness is a fundamental personality trait.
A conscientious person is good at self-regulation and impulse control.
This trait influences whether you will set and keep long-range goals, deliberate over choices, behave cautiously or impulsively, and take obligations to others seriously.
questions.zh:

这一特质会影响你是否会设定并坚持长期目标、谨慎或冲动地做选择，以及认真对待对他人的责任。

questions.name: #578 Calcium
questions.en:
Calcium plays an extremely important role in the production of plant tissues and enables plants to grow better.
It is responsible for keeping the cell walls of plants together.
It is also crucial in activating signals that coordinate certain cellular activities.
Calcium also increases the resistance to external attacks and increases the feed value of forage crops to livestock.
questions.zh:
钙在植物组织的生成中起着极其重要的作用，能让植物长得更好。
它负责维持植物细胞壁的完整性。
它还在激活协调某些细胞活动的信号中至关重要。
钙还能增强植物对外界侵害的抵抗力，并提高饲料作物对家畜的饲用价值。

questions.name: #579 Blue Whale
questions.en:
Blue whales are the largest living mammals.
Though reports of maximum length and weight vary from one account to another, Antarctic blue whales are known to have reached lengths to 100 feet and weights of over 150 tons before stocks were severely depleted by whaling operations.
North Atlantic blue whales may be expected to reach lengths of 80-85 feet.
questions.zh:
蓝鲸是现存最大的哺乳动物。
尽管不同记载中关于最大长度和体重的数据有所不同，但据我们所知，南极蓝鲸在因捕鲸活动而数量锐减之前，体长可达100英尺，体重超过150吨。
北大西洋蓝鲸的体长可能达到80到85英尺。

questions.name: #580 Nature of Reality
questions.en:
In attempts to understand the very nature of our reality, physicists sure have some mind-bending theories.
Like what if information is a tangible and fundamental aspect of physical reality itself – alongside matter and energy?
Or, alternatively, what if information is the fifth state of matter?
questions.zh:
为了理解现实的本质，物理学家们确实有一些令人费解的理论。
比如，如果信息与物质和能量一样，是物理现实本身一个可触及的基本方面呢？
或者，换个说法，如果信息是物质的第五种状态呢？

questions.name: #581 Tidal Energy
questions.en:
Tidal energy, also known as tidal power, is a renewable source of energy and a form of hydropower used to generate electricity from the energy of the tides.
Though not currently widely utilized, due to high costs and limited availability, it can be called the energy resource of the future given the current rate of depletion of energy resources.
questions.zh:
潮汐能，也叫潮汐发电，是一种可再生能源，属于水力发电的一种，利用潮汐的能量来发电。
虽然目前因为成本高、可用范围有限，还没有被广泛使用，但考虑到现在能源资源消耗的速度，它可以被称为未来的能源资源。

questions.name: #582 Labor Migration
questions.en:
Most countries are affected by labor migration.
In many rural places, the traditional extended family has been undermined by the need for family members to migrate to towns as an economic necessity.
Migration, therefore, presents a major challenge everywhere to social and economic policy.
questions.zh:
大多数国家都受到劳动力迁移的影响。
在许多农村地区，家庭成员为了经济需要不得不迁往城镇，这削弱了传统的大家庭结构。
因此，迁移给各地的社会经济政策带来了重大挑战。

questions.en: The question is asked: "How is understanding possible?" The technique for thinking of this approach is that, while Scripture is "something past a standard substance," Scripture is in the principle examination "content" which individuals endeavor to appreciate; in this sense, the benchmarks of seeing any substance applied to the Bible additionally paying little regard to whatever other additional, especially philosophical gauges are considered.

questions.name: #584 Canada
questions.en:
With a population of only just over 30 million living in the world's second largest country, Canada is justly renowned for vast tracts of wilderness untroubled by pollution either from industry or from intensive farming methods.
A major conservation issue is the battle to stop the logging of virgin forest in northern Ontario and on the west coast.
questions.zh:
加拿大作为世界第二大国，人口仅三千多万，以其广袤的荒野而闻名，这些荒野未受工业或集约化农业污染的困扰。
一个主要的保护问题是阻止在安大略省北部和西海岸砍伐原始森林的斗争。

questions.name: #585 Early Pictures
questions.en:
The majority of early pictures in the Gallery's care are by unknown artists, and fundamental questions, such as when, where and why they were painted still remain to be answered.
Through the application of scientific methods, this project has potential to unlock key evidence that will allow us to determine answers to these questions.

通过运用科学方法，这个项目有望发掘关键证据，帮助我们找到这些问题的答案。

在不同的学科背景下，它们的意思并不总是一模一样。

他取得的突破使电力的生产和利用变得更加简单，让我们能够做诸如开灯、做饭和玩电子游戏之类的事情。

questions.name: #590 Children Helping Others
questions.en:
Children as young as 14 months old will spontaneously help others for no reward.
But a study of 3-to-5-year-olds found that, although they would spontaneously draw pictures, if they were given a reward for drawing pictures, then later they wouldn’t make any drawings unless a reward was offered.

questions.name: #592 Plato
questions.en:
Plato often explores the father-son relationship and whether a father's interest in his sons has anything to do with how well his sons turn out.
A boy's social identity in ancient Athens was determined by his family identity, and Plato often refers to his characters in terms of their parental and fraternal relationships.
Socrates was not a family man and considered himself as his mother's son.
questions.zh:
柏拉图经常探讨父子关系，以及父亲对儿子的关注是否与儿子们的成长结果有关。
在古雅典，男孩的社会身份由家庭身份决定，柏拉图经常根据人物的父母和兄弟关系来指代他们。
苏格拉底并非一个以家庭为重的人，他自认为是母亲的儿子。

questions.name: #594 Examination of Domicile
questions.en: At an early stage in the examination of the domicile of dependency rule in so far as it related to married women it seemed to the Commission that it would be better to examine the whole concept of domicile, particularly as dependent domicile arises in the case of minors (children under the age of majority) and mentally disordered persons as well as in the case of married women.

questions.name: #595 Hunter-gatherer
questions.en:
The life of a hunter-gatherer is indeed, as Thomas Hobbes said of the state of nature, 'solitary, poor, nasty, brutish, and short'.
In some respects, to be sure, wandering through the jungle bagging monkeys may be preferable to the hard slog of subsistence agriculture.
questions.zh:
狩猎采集者的生活确实如托马斯·霍布斯描述的自然状态那样：'孤独、贫困、污秽、野蛮且短暂'。
当然，在某些方面，穿梭丛林捕猎猴子或许比辛苦的生存农业更可取。

questions.name: #596 Tissues and Organs
questions.en:
Tissues are grouped together in the body to form organs.
These include the brain, heart, lungs, kidneys, and liver.
Each body organ has a specific shape and is made up of different types of tissue that work together.
For example, the heart consists mainly of a specialized type of muscle tissue, which contracts rhythmically to provide the heart's pumping action.
questions.zh:
人体内的组织聚集在一起形成器官。
这些器官包括大脑、心脏、肺、肾脏和肝脏。
每个身体器官都有特定的形状，由不同类型的组织共同协作构成。
例如，心脏主要由一种特殊的肌肉组织构成，这种组织有节律地收缩，为心脏提供泵血功能。

questions.name: #597 Volunteering
questions.en:
For graduates looking to give something back, volunteering, either in the UK or overseas, is a popular option.
Voluntary projects can cost anything from nothing up to a few thousand pounds, and with that in mind it is essential to look into the project carefully before signing on the dotted line.
questions.zh:
对于想要回馈社会的毕业生来说，无论是在英国国内还是海外，做志愿者都是一个热门选择。
志愿项目的费用从零到几千英镑不等，因此，在签字之前仔细了解项目情况至关重要。

questions.name: #598 Competence in Chemistry
questions.en:
A level of competence in chemistry is essential to the professional practice of material conservation.
An understanding of scientific concepts and a basic scientific vocabulary enables the conservator to understand conservation problems, treatments, material techniques in a systematic and quantifiable way, which can be communicated not only to colleagues in the profession but also those from other disciplines.
questions.zh:
在材料保护的专业实践中，具备一定的化学能力是必不可少的。
理解科学概念并掌握基础科学词汇，能让保护人员以系统化和可量化的方式理解保护问题、处理方法和材料技术，这不仅可与同行交流，也能与其他学科的人沟通。

questions.name: #599 Extroverts
questions.en:
Extroverts tend to move quickly and try to influence situations directly, while introverts give themselves time to develop their insights before exposing them to the world.
Extroverts are happy making decisions in the thick of events, while introverts want to reflect before taking action.
questions.zh:
外向的人往往行动迅速，试图直接影响局势，而内向的人则会给自己时间深入思考，再将见解展现给世界。
外向的人乐于在事件高潮中做决定，而内向的人则倾向于在行动前先反思。

questions.name: #600 Job Hours
questions.en:
Most of us spend on average 18 hundred hours per year in our jobs, and will work for about 40 years before retirement.
When you consider the amount of time spent in the office, you soon realize how important it is to feel a sense of achievement at the end of the day, rather than just meeting financial objectives.
questions.zh:
我们大多数人平均每年花在工作上的时间有1800小时，退休前要工作大约40年。
考虑到在办公室度过的时间，你很快会意识到，每天结束时感受到成就感，而不仅仅是达到财务目标，是多么重要。

questions.en:
Quite obviously, a significant rise in the number of people in a given area or country will affect the demand for a whole host of goods and services.
Note that a change in the structure of the population will increase the demand for some goods but reduce the demand for others.

questions.name: #602 Orchestras
questions.en:
The advantage of the great European and American orchestras is that they were able to establish their iconic status in an age when their identity could become entrenched, there was less competition and it was easier to create a brand.
Not only did they have the best halls, they attracted the best musicians, who tended to stay put.
questions.zh:
欧美那些顶级乐团之所以能成为标志性存在，是因为它们在那个时代确立了自己的地位——那时竞争没那么激烈，塑造品牌也更容易，它们的特色也因此得以深入人心。
它们不仅拥有最好的音乐厅，还吸引了最优秀的音乐家，而这些音乐家往往愿意长期留任。

questions.name: #603 Effective Regulations
questions.en:
There is every reason to believe that effective regulations are not merely a luxury that only the rich can afford, but an important foundation for a thriving private sector and economic growth.
But the broad pattern of the past five years has been that the main reform efforts are taking place in rich countries.
questions.zh:
完全有理由相信，有效的监管不仅仅是富国才能负担得起的奢侈品，更是私营部门蓬勃发展和经济增长的重要基础。
但过去五年的总体趋势是，主要的改革努力都发生在富裕国家。

questions.name: #605 Language Diversity
questions.en:
Despite a number of events in recent years devoted to language diversity, language endangerment, and multilingualism, such as the International Year of Languages, public awareness of the issues is still remarkably limited.
Only one in four of the population know that half the languages of the world are so seriously endangered that they are unlikely to survive the present century.
questions.zh:

只有四分之一的人知道，世界上有一半的语言正面临严重濒危，很可能无法在本世纪存活下来。

questions.name: #606 Night Sky
questions.en:
Nature offers no greater splendor than the starry sky on a clear, dark night.
Silent, timeless, jeweled with the constellations of ancient myth and legend, the night sky has inspired wonder throughout the ages — a wonder that leads our imaginations far from the confines of Earth and the pace of the present day, out into boundless space and cosmic time itself.
questions.zh:
大自然最壮丽的景象莫过于晴朗黑夜中的星空。
静谧而永恒，缀满古老神话与传说的星座，夜空自古以来便激发着人们的惊叹——这种惊叹将我们的想象带离地球的束缚与当下的节奏，飞向无垠的宇宙空间与浩瀚的宇宙时间本身。

questions.name: #607 Paraphrasing
questions.en:
We define paraphrasing as putting a passage from an author into your own words.
However, what are your own words?
How different must your paraphrase be from the original?
The answer is it should be considerably different.
The whole point of paraphrasing is to show you have read and understood another person's ideas and can summarize them in your own writing style rather than borrowing their phrases.
questions.zh:
我们把引用他人段落并用自己的话重新表达称为改写。
但什么才是你自己的话呢？
你的改写必须与原文有多大不同？
答案是：应该有很大不同。
改写的核心在于证明你已阅读并理解了他人的观点，并能用自己的写作风格进行总结，而不是借用他们的措辞。

questions.name: #609 T Cells
questions.en:
Scientists are now trying to find ways to help treat patients by jumpstarting those lackluster T cells.
Much of the research in this field, known as cancer immunotherapy, has focused on finding ways to stimulate those T cells directly.
MIT researchers have now uncovered a possible new way to indirectly activate those T cells, by recruiting a population of helper immune cells called dendritic cells.
questions.zh:
科学家们现在正尝试通过重新激活那些不活跃的T细胞来帮助治疗患者。
这个被称为癌症免疫疗法的领域，大部分研究都集中在寻找直接刺激这些T细胞的方法上。
麻省理工学院的研究人员现在发现了一种可能的新方法，通过招募一种名为树突状细胞的辅助免疫细胞，间接激活这些T细胞。

questions.name: #610 Protein Songs
questions.en:
In recent years, scientists have created music based on the structure of proteins as a creative way to better popularize science to the general public, but the resulting songs haven't always been pleasant to the ear.
In a new study, researchers use the style of existing music genres to guide the structure of protein song to make it more musical.
questions.zh:
近年来，科学家们根据蛋白质结构创作音乐，作为一种向大众科普的创意方式，但生成的歌曲并不总是悦耳动听。
在一项新研究中，研究人员利用现有音乐流派的风格来指导蛋白质歌曲的结构，使其更具音乐性。

questions.name: #611 Underground Microbes
questions.en: Precambrian cratons -- some of Earth's oldest rocks -- were uninhabitable for microbes for much of their existence, with the longest period of habitability not much beyond a billion years, and many only for the past 50 million to 300 million years, according to a paper correlating Earth's deep biosphere with geologic history.
questions.zh: 根据一篇将地球深部生物圈与地质历史关联起来的论文，前寒武纪克拉通——地球上最古老的岩石——在其大部分存在时间里都不适合微生物生存，最长的宜居期也不过十亿年左右，许多克拉通仅在过去的5000万到3亿年间才变得宜居。

questions.name: #612 Obesity
questions.en: Chronic inflammation caused by obesity may trigger the development of cells that break down bone tissue, including the bone that holds teeth in place, according to new research at Buffalo University that sought to improve understanding of the connection between obesity and gum disease.
questions.zh: 布法罗大学的一项新研究旨在加深对肥胖与牙龈疾病之间联系的理解，该研究表明，由肥胖引起的慢性炎症可能会触发分解骨组织的细胞生成，包括固定牙齿的骨骼。
questions.full:

questions.name: #613 Team's Emotions
questions.en:
If you're putting together a team for a project, you might be inclined to pick people with cheerful, optimistic dispositions and flexible thinking.
But a new management study indicates your team might also benefit from people who are exactly the opposite, according to experts at Rice University, the University of Western Australia, Bond University and the University of Queensland.

questions.name: #614 Traffic Congestion
questions.en:
City planners predict that as more people move into urban areas, traffic jams will get worse.
That's why sustainability experts propose a new way to analyze traffic congestion.
Using more precise measures to describe the shape of cities and considering other socioeconomic factors, the model, which was applied to nearly 100 American cities, could lead to a better understanding of the link between congestion and land use.
questions.zh:
城市规划者预测，随着更多人迁入城市，交通堵塞会越来越严重。
因此，可持续发展专家提出了一种分析交通拥堵的新方法。
通过使用更精确的指标来描述城市形态，并考虑其他社会经济因素，这个应用于近100个美国城市的模型，有助于更好地理解交通拥堵与土地使用之间的联系。

questions.name: #615 Attractiveness
questions.en:
A new study found that while a 'beauty premium' exists across professions, it's partially because attractive people develop distinct traits as a result of how the world responds to their attractiveness.
They build a greater sense of power and have more opportunities to improve nonverbal communication skills throughout their lives.
questions.zh:
一项新研究发现，尽管各行业都存在'颜值红利'，但部分原因在于，由于外界对其外貌的反应，长相出众的人会培养出独特的性格特质。
他们一生中能建立起更强的自信，并拥有更多机会提升非语言沟通技巧。

questions.name: #616 Climate Pledges
questions.en:
Each year, the U.N. publishes a report evaluating the gap between the latest climate pledges and the Paris Agreement’s goals.
It concludes that the world is falling short.
This year’s report finds that the updated pledges would probably result in warming of around 2.7.
questions.zh:

报告指出，全球未能达到预期目标。
今年的报告发现，更新后的承诺可能导致全球变暖约2.7摄氏度。

questions.name: #617 Medicine and Values
questions.en:
How would you feel about a new therapy for your chronic pain, which — although far more effective than any available alternative — might also change your religious beliefs?
Or a treatment for lymphoma that brings one in three patients into remission, but also made them more likely to vote for your least preferred political party?
questions.zh:
你愿意尝试一种治疗慢性疼痛的新疗法吗？虽然它比现有任何替代方案都有效得多，但可能会改变你的宗教信仰。
或者一种治疗淋巴瘤的方法，能让三分之一的患者病情缓解，但同时也让他们更有可能投票给你最不喜欢的政党？

questions.name: #618 Income Inequality
questions.en:
Income inequality — a measure of how unevenly income is distributed through a population — has long been associated with a host of health and social problems including mental health issues, lack of trust, higher rates of imprisonment and lower rates of social mobility.
It may also affect academic achievement, through various routes.
questions.zh:
收入不平等——衡量收入在人口中分配不均程度的指标——长期以来一直与一系列健康和社会问题相关，包括心理健康问题、缺乏信任、更高的监禁率和更低的社会流动性。
它还可能通过多种途径影响学业成就。

questions.name: #619 Egg-shape
questions.en:
Egg-shape has long attracted the attention of mathematicians and biologists from an analytical point of view.
The shape has been highly regarded for its evolution as large enough to incubate an embryo, small enough to exit the body in the most efficient way, not roll away once laid, is structurally sound enough to bear weight and be the beginning of life for so many species.
questions.zh:
蛋形长期以来一直吸引着数学家和生物学家的分析兴趣。
这种形状因其进化优势而备受推崇：足够大以孵化胚胎，又足够小以最有效的方式离开母体，一旦产下便不会滚走，结构坚固足以承受重量，并成为众多物种生命的起点。

questions.name: #620 Children's Motor Skills
questions.en:
Residential density is related to children's motor skills, engagement in outdoor play and organized sports.
Finnish children living in the countryside spent more time outdoors and had better motor skills than their age peers in the metropolitan area.
On the other hand, children living in the metropolitan area participated the most in organized sports.
questions.zh:
住宅密度与孩子的运动技能、户外活动参与度以及有组织的体育活动有关。
住在乡下的芬兰孩子比住在都市区的同龄人花更多时间在户外，运动技能也更好。
另一方面，住在都市区的孩子参加有组织的体育活动最多。

questions.name: #621 Cancer
questions.en:
Cancer is most treatable when caught early.
But despite the vast resources aimed at finding ways to detect the disease in its initial stages, many people who qualify for existing screenings still do not receive them.
Some are unfamiliar with the constantly evolving guidelines on when and where to get tested.
Others have never been informed that they need exams in the first place.
questions.zh:
癌症越早发现越好治疗。
尽管投入了大量资源来寻找早期检测方法，但许多符合现有筛查条件的人仍未接受检查。
有些人不熟悉不断变化的检测时间和地点指南。
另一些人则根本不知道他们需要做检查。

questions.name: #622 Alien Life
questions.en:
Relatively soon, some prominent astrobiologists say, we will most likely have either found compelling evidence for extraterrestrial life or banished its possible existence to the ever shrinking edges of the cosmos beyond the rapidly expanding reach of our observations.
Such answers could come by the end of this century from any of a number of initiatives ardently seeking alien life.
questions.zh:
一些著名的天体生物学家认为，在不久的将来，我们很可能会要么找到外星生命的有力证据，要么将其可能的存在驱逐到宇宙不断缩小的边缘，而这些边缘正超出我们观测范围迅速扩展的界限。
到本世纪末，这些答案可能来自积极寻找外星生命的众多计划中的任何一个。

questions.en:
If a single medical objective could be applied to the entire range of cancers, it would be detecting the disease as soon as possible.
“At the highest level, finding any cancer early gives you the opportunity for curative treatments,” says the CEO of a research funding organization.

questions.name: #624 New Mineral
questions.en:
A diamond that formed deep in the earth’s mantle contains a mineral never seen before in nature.
The discovery is a rare glimpse into the deep mantle and may help reveal new information about the structure of the planet at depths of more than 660 kilometers.
This can help geologists better understand how the mantle controls the earth’s plate tectonics.
questions.zh:
一颗在地幔深处形成的钻石里，含有一种自然界从未见过的矿物。
这一发现让我们难得地窥见了深层地幔，或许还能揭示地球660多公里深处结构的新信息。
这能帮助地质学家更好地理解地幔如何控制地球的板块构造。

questions.name: #625 Certain Gestures
questions.en:
When learning a foreign language, most people fall back on traditional methods: reading, writing, listening and repeating.
But if you also gesture with your arms while studying, you can remember the vocabulary better, even months later.
Linking a word to brain areas responsible for movement strengthens the memory of its meaning.
questions.zh:
学外语时，大多数人还是依赖传统方法：读、写、听和重复。
但如果学习时同时用手臂做动作，你就能更好地记住词汇，甚至几个月后还能记得。
把一个词与负责运动的脑区联系起来，会强化你对它意义的记忆。

questions.name: #626 Carbon Dioxide
questions.en:
Every metric ton of carbon dioxide humans emit comes at a cost — not only in terms of the financial toll of the damage wrought by floods, heat waves and droughts but also the price in human lives.
Substantially curtailing emissions today could prevent tens of millions of premature deaths over the course of this century.
questions.zh:
人类每排放一吨二氧化碳都要付出代价——不仅是洪水、热浪和干旱造成的经济损失，还有人类生命的代价。
今天大幅减少排放，可以在本世纪内避免数千万人过早死亡。

questions.name: #627 Animals in Science
questions.en:
Many scholars attribute the 17th-century belief that animals were mere machines devoid of fear, pain or pleasure to the French mathematician, philosopher and scientist.
Animals’ feelings, even if present, were morally irrelevant to Descartes, who attempted to prove his point by subjecting dogs and rabbits to exquisite torture.
questions.zh:
许多学者认为，17世纪那种动物只是没有恐惧、痛苦或快乐的机器的观点，源自一位法国数学家、哲学家和科学家。
即使动物有情感，对笛卡尔来说在道德上也无足轻重，他试图通过残酷折磨狗和兔子来证明自己的观点。

questions.name: #628 Elephants
questions.en:
When a male African savanna elephant folds his ears while simultaneously waving them, he’s ready for a fight.
When a female folds her ears and accompanies the action with an ear flap, that means she’s also issuing a serious threat.
But when elephants come together and fold their ears, the animals are expressing a warm greeting.
questions.zh:
当一只雄性非洲草原象同时折起并扇动耳朵时，它准备要打架了。
当雌象折起耳朵并伴随一次扇耳动作，意味着她也在发出严重威胁。
但当大象聚在一起并折起耳朵时，它们是在表达热情的问候。

questions.name: #629 The Decreased Sunlight
questions.en:
The amount of sunlight that Earth reflects back into space has decreased measurably in recent years.
Whether the decline in earthshine is a short-term blip or yet another ominous sign for Earth’s climate is up in the air, scientists suggest.
questions.zh:
地球反射回太空的阳光量近年来明显减少了。
科学家表示，地球反照率的下降是短期波动还是地球气候的又一个不祥征兆，目前尚无定论。

questions.name: #630 The Next Food Revolution
questions.en:
Today’s global food system is responsible for around a third of greenhouse-gas emissions and meat production is one of the biggest culprits.
Despite this environmental impact, meat-eating is on the rise.
Plant-based and lab-grown alternatives can convert carnivores away from conventional meat and reduce emissions.
questions.zh:
当今全球粮食系统排放了约三分之一的温室气体，而肉类生产是最大的元凶之一。
尽管对环境有如此影响，肉类消费仍在增长。
植物基和实验室培育的替代品能让肉食者远离传统肉类，从而减少排放。

questions.name: #631 The Office of the Future
questions.en:
To bridge gaps between teams, one tactic is to set aside more of the office to showcase the work of each department, so that people who never encounter each other on Zoom can see examples of what their colleagues do.
Another option is to ply everyone with drink.
Expect more space to be set aside for socialising and events.
questions.zh:
为了拉近团队之间的距离，一个办法是在办公室留出更多空间来展示每个部门的工作，这样那些在Zoom上从未碰面的人也能看到同事们的工作成果。
另一个选择是让大家都喝点酒。
预计会有更多空间被预留出来用于社交和活动。

questions.name: #632 Windbreaks
questions.en:
Scientists already knew that the output of a single wind turbine could be improved with a windbreak.
While windbreaks slow wind speed close to the ground, above the height of the windbreak, wind speeds actually increase as air rushes over the top.
But for large wind farms, there’s a drawback.
questions.zh:
科学家们早就知道，单台风力涡轮机的发电量可以通过防风林来提升。
虽然防风林会减缓地面附近的风速，但在防风林高度以上，由于空气从顶部涌过，风速反而会增加。
但对于大型风电场来说，这有一个缺点。

questions.name: #633 The Reptiles’ Cold Tolerance
questions.en:
After the coldest night in south Florida in a decade, lizards were dropping out of palm trees, landing legs up.
The scientists who raced to investigate the fallen reptiles have now found that, despite such graceless falls, some of these tropical, cold-blooded creatures are actually more resilient to cold than previously thought.
questions.zh:

赶去研究这些坠落爬行动物的科学家们发现，尽管摔得如此狼狈，这些热带冷血动物中的一些实际上比之前认为的更耐寒。

questions.name: #634 Disaster by Climate Change
questions.en:
Flooding is already the most common natural disaster in the United States, occurring in every state and killing more people each year than hurricanes, tornadoes or lightning.
As warming drives sea levels higher and intensifies hurricanes, more residents should expect to deal with flooding.
questions.zh:
洪水已然是美国最常见的自然灾害，各州均有发生，每年造成的人员死亡远超飓风、龙卷风或雷击。
随着气候变暖推高海平面并加剧飓风强度，更多居民恐将面临洪涝威胁。
questions.full:
Flooding is already the most common natural disaster in the United States, occurring in every state and killing more people each year than hurricanes, tornadoes or lightning.
洪水已然是美国最常见的自然灾害，各州均有发生，每年造成的人员死亡远超飓风、龙卷风或雷击。
As warming drives sea levels higher and intensifies hurricanes, more residents should expect to deal with flooding.
随着气候变暖推高海平面并加剧飓风强度，更多居民恐将面临洪涝威胁。

questions.name: #635 Genetically Modified Cotton
questions.en:
Cotton plants native to Mexico may all look the same — unkempt and untamed bushes with flowers that shift from pale yellow to violet as pollinators visit them.
But genes from genetically modified cotton crops have made some of these native plants fundamentally different, changing their biology and the way they interact with insects.
questions.zh:
原产于墨西哥的棉花植物看起来可能都一样——都是些杂乱不驯的灌木，花朵在传粉者来访时从淡黄色变为紫罗兰色。
但来自转基因棉花作物的基因已使其中一些原生植物发生了根本性变化，改变了它们的生物学特性以及与昆虫互动的方式。

questions.name: #636 Food Crops
questions.en:
Feed crops are grown and harvested to feed livestock like cows and horses.
Also known as animal feed, these crops can be grown and harvested like food crops.
They can also be grown in large fields where animals can graze for the food.
Feed crops are typically engineered to meet the livestock’s specific nutritional needs.
questions.zh:
种植和收割饲料作物是为了喂养像牛和马这样的家畜。
这些作物也被称为动物饲料，可以像粮食作物一样种植和收割。
它们也可以种在大片田地里，让动物在那里吃草觅食。
饲料作物通常经过专门培育，以满足家畜特定的营养需求。

questions.name: #637 Engineering
questions.en:
Engineering requires many building blocks and tools.
To produce real world results, one must practically apply mathematics and sciences to tangible problems and scenarios.
Included in this category are the various technical topics which cut across engineering disciplines, encompassing many branches of mathematics and scientific disciplines.
questions.zh:
工程学需要许多基础构件和工具。
要想获得实际成果，就必须将数学和科学知识切实应用到具体问题和场景中。
这一类别涵盖了贯穿工程学科的各种技术主题，涉及数学和科学领域的众多分支。

questions.name: #638 Skylines
questions.en:
If you live in a city, you may take your skyline for granted, but let me remind you how cool it is.
Skyscrapers are amazing feats of engineering and a testament to humankind's progress.
What's more, skylines offer an array of architectural styles, as cities certainly weren't built in a day.
questions.zh:
如果你住在城市里，你可能对天际线习以为常，但让我提醒你它有多酷。
摩天大楼是令人惊叹的工程壮举，也是人类进步的见证。
更重要的是，天际线展现了多种建筑风格，毕竟城市不是一天建成的。

questions.name: #639 Fine Arts Department
questions.en:
At the Fine Arts Department, we place dual emphasis on studio art and art history, and are dedicated to the exploration of contemporary art while promoting traditional Chinese art and culture.
Our department has been a strategic base for training up artists and art historians, and has made significant contribution to the field of art nationally and internationally.
questions.zh:
在美术系，我们既重视工作室艺术也重视艺术史，致力于探索当代艺术，同时弘扬中国传统艺术与文化。
我们系一直是培养艺术家和艺术史学家的战略基地，并在国内外艺术领域做出了重要贡献。

questions.name: #640 Stars
questions.en:
Stars are the most widely recognized astronomical objects, and represent the most fundamental building blocks of galaxies.
The age and composition of the stars in a galaxy trace the dynamics and evolution of that galaxy.
Consequently, the study of the birth, life, and death of stars is central to the field of astronomy.
questions.zh:
恒星是最广为人知的天体，也是构成星系最基本的单元。
星系中恒星的年龄和成分，反映了该星系的动态和演化过程。
因此，研究恒星的诞生、演化和死亡是天文学的核心内容。

questions.name: #641 Interdisciplinarity
questions.en:
Interdisciplinarity refers to a method that merges traditional educational concepts in order to arrive at new approaches.
It is an increasingly important concept within both academic research and the private sector.
More than just pasting together different subjects, interdisciplinary work is the process of developing an integration of methods that are traditionally thought of as separate fields.
questions.zh:
跨学科是一种融合传统教育理念以探索新方法的手段。
无论是在学术研究还是私营领域，这一概念都变得越来越重要。
跨学科工作不只是简单拼凑不同学科，而是将传统上被视为独立领域的方法进行整合的过程。

questions.name: #642 Bilingualism
questions.en:
There are many benefits to bilingualism and exposure to multiple languages.
Children who learn multiple languages learn to be sensitive to their conversation partners; they make word and language choices based on their knowledge of others.
These are sophisticated social decisions that show advanced social skills.
questions.zh:
掌握双语、接触多种语言有很多好处。
学习多种语言的孩子会学会对谈话对象保持敏感；他们会根据对他人的了解来选择用词和语言。
这些都是复杂的社会决策，展现了高超的社交技巧。

questions.name: #643 IT Unit
questions.en:
This unit provides a practical and theoretical introduction to what it means to be an IT professional today.
Students will encounter a range of issues relevant to professional practice in the workplace, as well as an understanding of the wider responsibilities that professionals are called upon to uphold in society.

这一单元从实践和理论两方面介绍了当今IT专业人士的含义。
学生们将接触到一系列与职场专业实践相关的问题，并理解专业人士在社会中应承担的更广泛责任。

questions.name: #644 Dead Language
questions.en:
A dead language may still be studied through recordings or writings, but it is still dead or extinct unless there are fluent speakers.
Although languages have always become extinct throughout human history, they are currently dying at an accelerated rate because of globalization.
Many projects are under way aimed at preventing or slowing language loss.
questions.zh:
一种死语言可能仍能通过录音或文字记录来研究，但除非还有流利的使用者，否则它依然是死的或已灭绝的。
尽管在人类历史上语言一直有灭绝现象，但由于全球化，目前它们正以加速的速度消亡。
许多旨在防止或减缓语言消亡的项目正在进行中。

questions.name: #645 Australian Immigration
questions.en:
Australia has a proud modern immigration history.
Government discrimination has been banished, replaced by a skills-based
system generating unparalleled economic gain for Australia.
Creating an environment where innovation can thrive depends on immigration.
With a population where one in four people are born overseas, Australia is already well positioned to kick start a new period of growth.
questions.zh:
澳大利亚有着引以为豪的现代移民史。
政府歧视已被消除，取而代之的是以技能为基础的制度。
这个系统为澳大利亚带来了前所未有的经济收益。
营造一个能让创新蓬勃发展的环境，离不开移民的贡献。
在澳大利亚，每四个人中就有一个出生在海外，这种人口结构已经为开启新一轮增长做好了充分准备。

questions.name: #646 Hydropower
questions.en:
Hydropower is one of the renewable energies.
In the past, hydropower was used for simple purposes by building a water wheel on a watercourse and using it to drive a mill or machine.
Today this is how it works: the kinetic energy of the flowing water is converted into the mechanical energy of the turbine, which is converted into electrical energy, or electricity for short, in a generator.
questions.zh:
水力发电是可再生能源之一。
过去，人们在水道上建造水车，用它来驱动磨坊或机器，从而实现简单的水力利用。
如今的工作原理是：流动水的动能转化为涡轮机的机械能，再通过发电机转化为电能，简称电力。

questions.name: #647 Healthy Eating
questions.en:
The American Cancer Society recommends following a healthy eating pattern at all ages.
A new school year is the perfect time to try some healthier options for your child.
Whether you’re packing a lunch box or making lunch at the kitchen counter, you can ensure they’re eating healthy food that tastes good.
questions.zh:

新学年是尝试为孩子选择更健康食品的绝佳时机。
无论是准备便当盒还是在厨房台面上做午餐，你都能确保他们吃到既健康又美味的食物。

questions.name: #648 The Spanish Language
questions.en:
The Spanish language has a rich and complicated history.
It has navigated the rise and fall of great empires, has been a symbol of cultural identity, and has both been used as a tool of unity and caused considerable divisiveness.
Today, it is the world’s second-most spoken native language and is used by people in all corners of the globe.
questions.zh:
西班牙语有着丰富而复杂的历史。
它经历了伟大帝国的兴衰，既是文化认同的象征，也曾作为团结的工具，同时引发了巨大的分歧。
如今，它是世界上使用人数第二多的母语，全球各地的人们都在使用它。

questions.name: #649 Thomas Edison
questions.en:
Thomas Edison used his access to the railroad to conduct chemical experiments in a small laboratory he set up in a train.
During one of his experiments, a chemical fire started and the train caught fire.
The conductor rushed in and struck Edison on the side of the head, probably furthering some of his hearing loss.
questions.zh:
托马斯·爱迪生利用他在铁路上的便利，在火车上搭建了一个小实验室进行化学实验。
在一次实验中，化学品起火，导致火车着火。
列车员冲进来，打了爱迪生一侧头部，可能加剧了他的听力损失。

questions.name: #650 How the Eye Works
questions.en:
In a normal eye, the light rays come to a sharp focusing point on the retina.
The retina functions much like the film in a camera.
It is responsible for capturing all of the light rays, processing them into light impulses through millions of tiny nerve endings, then sending these light impulses through over a million nerve fibers to the optic nerve.
questions.zh:
正常眼睛中，光线会在视网膜上形成一个清晰的聚焦点。
视网膜的功能很像相机里的胶片。
它负责捕捉所有光线，通过数百万个微小的神经末梢将其处理成光脉冲，然后通过超过一百万个神经纤维将这些光脉冲传送到视神经。

questions.name: #651 Pig-nosed Turtle
questions.en:
Scientists have discovered a five-million-year-old pig-nosed turtle fossil in Melbourne, thousands of kilometers south of their typical home.
Pig-nosed turtles tend to be found in tropical freshwater ecosystems in northern Australia and New Guinea, only arriving here a few thousand years ago.
The creatures are now endangered and the sole survivors of an extinct group of tropical turtles from the northern hemisphere.
questions.zh:
科学家在墨尔本发现了一块五百万年前的猪鼻龟化石，这个地方比它们通常的栖息地偏南了数千公里。
猪鼻龟通常生活在澳大利亚北部和新几内亚的热带淡水生态系统中，直到几千年前才到达这里。
这种生物现在濒临灭绝，是来自北半球已灭绝的热带龟类群体中唯一的幸存者。

questions.name: #652 Sexual Selection
questions.en:
Usually, the female of the species invests more in parenting.
Females of many species choose their mates based on certain characteristics, such as large canine teeth in a male baboon or flashy tail feathers on a peacock, which in turn means those traits will be passed on to their male offspring.
Biologists call this process sexual selection, which is related to natural selection.
questions.zh:
通常情况下，雌性对后代的投入更多。
许多物种的雌性会根据某些特征选择配偶，比如雄性狒狒的大犬齿或孔雀的华丽尾羽，而这些特征又会遗传给它们的雄性后代。
生物学家称这个过程为性选择，它与自然选择相关。

questions.name: #653 The Astrophysics Division
questions.en:
In the Science Mission Directorate, the Astrophysics Division studies the universe.
The science goals of this division are breathtaking: we seek to understand the universe and our place in it.
We are starting to investigate the very moment of creation of the universe and are close to learning the full history of stars and galaxies.
We are discovering how planetary systems form and how environments develop.
questions.zh:
在科学任务理事会中，天体物理部负责研究宇宙。
这个部门的科学目标令人惊叹：我们试图理解宇宙以及我们在其中的位置。
我们开始探索宇宙诞生的那一刻，并且即将了解恒星和星系的完整历史。
我们正在发现行星系统如何形成，以及环境如何演变。

questions.name: #654 A Better Government Plan
questions.en:
A better government plan is based on the assumption that government has a positive role to play in improving people’s lives but could perform this function far more effectively than it does now.
What distinguishes the better government plan from the other two is that instead of changing the size of government, it reallocates spending in ways designed to improve government performance.
questions.zh:
一个好的政府计划基于这样的假设：政府在改善人民生活方面可以发挥积极作用，而且可以比现在做得更有效。
更好的政府计划与其他两个计划的不同之处在于，它不改变政府的规模，而是重新分配支出以提高政府绩效。

questions.name: #655 COVID-19
questions.en:
Currently in South Australia, the majority of people who have a positive COVID-nineteen test result will stay in the community in their home or in supervised or supported care.
A team of health professionals will carry out an assessment and ask you a series of questions, including identifying your symptoms, your medical history and if you can safely isolate away from others.

questions.name: #656 Enthusiasm
questions.en:
Enthusiasm seeks to contribute to a culturally and historically nuanced understanding of how emotions secure and ratify the truth of convictions.
More than just pure affective intensity, enthusiasm is about something: a certainty, clarity or truth.
Enthusiasm takes its starting point in religion, the social arena in which the concept was first debated and to which the term still gestures.
questions.zh:
热情试图从文化和历史的细微角度，帮助我们理解情感如何确认真理的信念。
热情不仅仅是纯粹的情感强度，它还关乎某种东西：确定性、清晰度或真理。
热情起源于宗教，这是该概念最初被讨论的社会领域，而这个词至今仍指向那里。

questions.name: #657 A Balanced Budget
questions.en:
Most state governments are subject to a requirement to pass a balanced budget.
However, a budget that may fit the statutory definition of a "balanced budget" may not be financially sustainable.
For example, a budget that is balanced by such standards could include the use of non-recurring resources, such as asset sales or reserves, to fund ongoing expenditures, and thus not be in structural balance.
questions.zh:
大多数州政府都必须通过平衡预算。
然而，符合法定“平衡预算”定义的预算，在财务上可能并不可持续。
例如，按这些标准平衡的预算可能包括使用非经常性资源，如资产出售或储备金，来资助持续性支出，因此未达到结构性平衡。

questions.name: #658 Connective Tissue Cells
questions.en:
Connective tissue cells provide structural strength to the body and also defend against foreign invaders like bacteria.
Two types of cells are native to connective tissue.
Other cells migrate into connective tissue from the bloodstream to fight diseases.
Special types of connective tissue are designed to be stronger and more rigid than most connective tissues.
questions.zh:
结缔组织细胞为身体提供结构强度，同时抵御细菌等外来入侵者。
两种细胞是结缔组织固有的。
其他细胞从血液迁移到结缔组织中，以对抗疾病。
特殊类型的结缔组织设计得比大多数结缔组织更坚固、更坚硬。

questions.name: #659 Microorganisms
questions.en:
Identification and characterisation of microorganisms is a key part of the management of food safety and quality, tracing contaminants and troubleshooting problems such as spoilage.
Knowing how to identify bacteria or other unknown microorganisms that you have encountered can help to assess whether it poses a safety concern or is likely to be heat resistant, for example.
questions.zh:
识别和描述微生物是食品安全与质量管理、追踪污染物以及排查变质等问题中的关键环节。
了解如何识别遇到的细菌或其他未知微生物，有助于评估其是否构成安全隐患，或者是否具有耐热性等特性。

questions.name: #660 Procrastination
questions.en:
To overcome procrastination you need to have an understanding of the reasons why you procrastinate and the function procrastination serves in your life.
You can't come up with an effective solution if you don't really understand the root of the problem.
As with most problems, awareness and self-knowledge are the keys to figuring out how to stop procrastinating.
questions.zh:
要克服拖延症，你得先搞清楚自己为什么会拖延，以及拖延在你生活中起什么作用。
如果你不了解问题的根源，就想不出有效的解决办法。
跟大多数问题一样，觉察和自我认知是找到停止拖延方法的关键。

questions.name: #661 Technologies
questions.en:
Technology strengthens learning and dominates over the conventional methods in too many aspects.
Technologies are advancing learning procedure by their multiple formats, variety of resources, numerous delivery channels and not restricted to time, space and place.
Social media is a new form of communication that transformed the entire landscape of information access and dissemination online.

科技在很多方面强化了学习，并超越了传统方法。
技术通过多种形式、丰富的资源、众多的传递渠道，且不受时间、空间和地点的限制，正在推进学习过程。
社交媒体是一种新的沟通形式，它彻底改变了在线信息获取和传播的整体格局。

questions.name: #662 Heart Disorders
questions.en:
In the past decades, dramatic changes in diet and lifestyle have fueled a rampant increase in heart disorders.
What is even more alarming is that heart conditions are no longer restricted to higher age groups, but affect young people as well.
Heart disorders like strokes are the most commonly known today and its symptoms include chest pain, weakness and heart attack.
questions.zh:
过去几十年里，饮食和生活方式的巨大变化导致心脏疾病急剧增加。
更令人担忧的是，心脏病不再仅限于老年人，年轻人也受到影响。
像中风这类心脏疾病如今最为常见，其症状包括胸痛、虚弱和心脏病发作。

Starting Tuesday, the feature is available to any users between the ages of thirteen and eighteen based on how they self-reported when they signed up for Instagram.

questions.name: #664 Friends
questions.en:
The people we know resemble us in the most basic social characteristics, such as gender and educational background.
Although our friends tend to be similar, many people are unaware of this because they did not pick their friends for their similarity.
Our social connections depend first and foremost on whom we get to meet.
This depends on the social contexts we enter and the activities we engage in.
questions.zh:
我们认识的人在最基本的社会特征上与我们相似，比如性别和教育背景。
尽管我们的朋友往往相似，但很多人没有意识到这一点，因为他们并非因相似性而选择朋友。
我们的社会联系首先取决于我们遇到谁。
这取决于我们进入的社会环境以及参与的活动。

questions.name: #665 Dark Matter
questions.en:
Dark matter is an elusive substance that provides the skeleton for what cosmologists call the cosmic web, the large-scale structure of the universe that, due to its gravitational influence, dictates the motion of galaxies and other cosmic material.
However, the distribution of local dark matter is currently unknown because it cannot be measured directly.
questions.zh:
暗物质是一种难以捉摸的物质，它为宇宙学家所谓的“宇宙网”提供了骨架。宇宙网是宇宙的大尺度结构，通过其引力作用，支配着星系及其他宇宙物质的运动。
然而，由于无法直接测量，目前局域暗物质的分布情况尚不清楚。

questions.name: #666 Microscope
questions.en:
The principal way a microbiologist studies microorganisms is by observing them through a microscope.
A microscope is a device that enlarges objects using a process called magnification.
The simplest form of a microscope is a magnifying glass consisting of a single lens.
Some glasses are slightly bent at the bottom, causing a magnifying effect if held at a certain height over an object.
questions.zh:
微生物学家研究微生物的主要方式是通过显微镜观察它们。
显微镜是一种利用放大过程来放大物体的设备。
最简单的显微镜形式是放大镜，它由一个单透镜组成。
有些眼镜底部略微弯曲，如果放在物体上方一定高度，会产生放大效果。

questions.name: #667 Cat's Age
questions.en:
Despite the youthful outward appearance, inside the cat will be getting older.
It is much easier to understand how to manage our cats’ lives, health and behaviour if we can associate their age with an equivalent of our own human years.
It has often been suggested that we simply need to multiply a cat’s age by seven to get a comparative human age.
questions.zh:
虽然外表看起来年轻，但猫的内部器官正在老化。
如果我们能把猫的年龄换算成人类的年龄，就更容易理解如何管理它们的生活、健康和行为。
人们常说，只需将猫的年龄乘以七，就能得到相应的人类年龄。

questions.name: #668 Agricultural Science
questions.en:
While advances in agricultural science have always been critical to ensuring we help feed the world, its impact and importance is even greater now, as population grows at a rapid rate and the availability of arable land steadily declines.
Science and technology solutions are essential to meeting growing demand for food, maintaining market competitiveness and adapting to land mitigating risks.
questions.zh:
农业科学的进步对于保障全球粮食供应一直至关重要，而如今随着人口快速增长和可耕地面积持续减少，其影响力和重要性更加凸显。
科技解决方案对于满足日益增长的粮食需求、保持市场竞争力以及适应并减缓土地风险至关重要。

questions.name: #669 Neuroscience
questions.en:
Neuroscience has traditionally been classed as a subdivision of biology.
Many researchers say that neuroscience means the same as neurobiology.
However, neurobiology looks at the biology of the nervous system, while neuroscience refers to anything to do with the nervous system.
Neuroscientists are involved in a much wider scope of fields, who study the evolutionary and medical aspects of the nervous system.
questions.zh:
神经科学传统上被归类为生物学的一个分支。
许多研究人员认为神经科学和神经生物学是一回事。
不过，神经生物学关注的是神经系统的生物学，而神经科学则涵盖与神经系统相关的所有方面。
神经科学家涉足的领域要广泛得多，他们研究神经系统的进化和医学方面。

questions.name: #670 Toy Play
questions.en:
There is ample evidence that toy play is a very important aspect of child development.
Children of all ages enjoy playing with toys and the different roles they play in their fantasy and make-believe games, but toys are more than simple playthings.
Many toys offer hands-on learning opportunities that can instill basic skills that will benefit them for the rest of their lives.
questions.zh:
大量证据表明，玩具游戏是儿童发展中非常重要的一环。
各个年龄段的孩子都喜欢玩玩具，并在他们的幻想和假装游戏中扮演不同的角色，但玩具不仅仅是简单的玩物。
许多玩具提供动手学习的机会，能灌输基本技能，这些技能将使孩子终生受益。

questions.name: #671 TV Shows
questions.en:
One of the benefits of watching the television shows is that you will get to learn and appreciate the different cultures.
As a movie enthusiast, you will watch different movies of different actors who originate in different countries.
This will give you a wider perspective of the various cultures, and you are likely to appreciate the contribution being made by individuals in different parts of the world.
questions.zh:
看电视剧的好处之一就是你能了解和欣赏不同的文化。
作为一个电影迷，你会看来自不同国家的演员演的各种电影。
这会让你对多样的文化有更广阔的视角，你很可能也会欣赏世界各地人们所做的贡献。

questions.name: #672 Breaking Habits
questions.en:
Breaking habits is very difficult.
The easiest way is to control your environment so that you do not encounter the cue which triggers your habit.
It is difficult to break any habit even when you are motivated to do so.
If you are ambivalent about breaking it, then you will be less likely to succeed.
questions.zh:
改掉习惯非常困难。
最简单的办法是控制你的环境，这样你就不会遇到触发习惯的线索。
即使你有动力，改掉任何习惯都很困难。
如果你对改掉它感到矛盾，那么你成功的可能性就会降低。

questions.name: #673 Data Accuracy
questions.en:
Stakeholder acceptance and use of analytics depends on their trust in the data.
End users and executives don’t always think about the behind-the-scenes work and preparation that went into a dashboard.
But they do have an intuitive grasp of and even an emotional connection to accurate data, making obviously inaccurate data a real challenge to overcome.
questions.zh:
利益相关者接受并使用分析工具，关键在于他们对数据的信任。
最终用户和高管们并不总是会想到仪表盘背后所付出的工作和准备。
但他们确实对准确数据有直观的理解，甚至情感上的联系，这使得明显不准确的数据成为需要克服的真正挑战。

questions.name: #674 Infectious Diseases
questions.en:
The threat from infectious pathogens is greater today than ever.
The outbreak or even resurgence of infectious diseases has shown how these types of diseases could in fact undermine a state’s control of what happens within its territory.
Yet, it is unclear whether growing recognition of the severity of the threat of infectious diseases has led to adequate policy responses and definitive action by states.
questions.zh:
如今，来自传染性病原体的威胁比以往任何时候都大。
传染病的爆发甚至再次出现，已经表明这类疾病实际上可能削弱一个国家对其领土内事务的控制。
然而，目前尚不清楚，对传染病威胁严重性的日益认识是否已促使各国采取足够有效的政策应对和果断行动。

questions.name: #675 Bananas and Potassium
questions.en:
Bananas are rich in the mineral potassium.
Potassium helps maintain fluid levels in the body and regulates the movement of nutrients and waste products in and out of cells.
Potassium also helps muscles to contract and nerve cells to respond.
It keeps the heart beating regularly and can reduce the effect of sodium on blood pressure.
Potassium may reduce the risk of kidney stones forming as people age.
questions.zh:
香蕉富含钾这种矿物质。
钾有助于维持体内液体平衡，并调节营养物质和废物进出细胞的过程。
钾还能帮助肌肉收缩，让神经细胞做出反应。
它能让心脏保持规律跳动，并减轻钠对血压的影响。
随着年龄增长，钾可能降低肾结石形成的风险。

questions.en:
Strong literacy aligns with the ways that individuals learn and socially interact.
It forms the foundation for a lifetime of communication with family, peers, and employers.
Ensuring strong reading and writing skills in the early stages of a child’s development is vitally important to preventing problems later in life, such as unemployment, societal disconnection, and even justice system involvement.

questions.name: #677 Rock
questions.en:
Most rocks are made of minerals containing silicon and oxygen, the most abundant elements in the Earth’s crust.
There are three kinds of rock: igneous, sedimentary and metamorphic.
Igneous rocks form when molten rock cools and solidifies.
Sedimentary rocks originate when particles settle out of water or air.
Metamorphic rocks result when existing rocks are changed by heat or pressure.
questions.zh:
大多数岩石由含有硅和氧的矿物组成，这两种元素是地壳中含量最丰富的。
岩石分为三类：火成岩、沉积岩和变质岩。
火成岩是当熔融的岩石冷却并凝固时形成的。
沉积岩源于颗粒从水或空气中沉降下来。
变质岩是现有岩石受热或受压而改变形成的。

questions.name: #678 Workplace Diversity
questions.en:
Workplace diversity means respecting and valuing the skills and differences that each staff member brings into the workspace.
A diverse workplace is an inclusive environment that provides equal rights and opportunities for all workers.
In Australia, it is law for workplaces to create a workplace free from discrimination and harassment.
Employers are responsible for putting measures into place to overcome employment disadvantage and discrimination in the workplace.
questions.zh:
职场多元化意味着尊重并重视每位员工带入工作场所的技能与差异。
多元化的职场是一个包容的环境，为所有员工提供平等的权利和机会。
在澳大利亚，法律要求工作场所必须营造一个没有歧视和骚扰的环境。
雇主有责任采取措施，消除就业中的不利条件和职场歧视。

questions.name: #679 Africa Disease Centre
questions.en:
Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention is a specialized technical institution of the African Union established to support public health initiatives of Member States and strengthen the capacity of their public health institutions to detect, prevent and respond quickly and effectively to disease threats.
It supports African Union Member States in providing coordinated and integrated solutions to the inadequacies in their public health infrastructure.
questions.zh:
非洲疾病预防控制中心是非洲联盟的一个专门技术机构，旨在支持成员国的公共卫生倡议，并加强其公共卫生机构迅速有效发现、预防和应对疾病威胁的能力。
它支持非洲联盟成员国提供协调统一的解决方案，以弥补其公共卫生基础设施的不足。

questions.name: #680 Fence
questions.en:
A typical fence with a few wires allows most animals – such as lions or wild dogs — to go over, under or through it.
For larger mammals, such as elephants and giraffes, we will create large fence-gaps that consist of a sloping, loose rock wall.
Because of rhinos’ short, stubby legs, they are unable to scale these rock piles.
questions.zh:
普通的几根铁丝围栏，像狮子或野狗这类动物大多能翻过去、钻过去或穿过去。
对于大象、长颈鹿这类大型哺乳动物，我们会设置大型围栏缺口，用松散的岩石堆成斜坡。
由于犀牛腿短粗，它们无法爬过这些石堆。

questions.name: #681 Decline of News Coverage
questions.en:
Lawmakers are pushing a plan to fight what they perceive as a threat to democracy: the sharp decline of local news coverage.
The United States has lost one third of its local newspapers in the past decade.
Those that remain are operating with far fewer reporters than they used to, as more than half of total journalism jobs in the United States have disappeared over the same period.
questions.zh:
立法者们正在推动一项计划，来应对他们认为对民主构成威胁的问题：地方新闻报道的急剧减少。
过去十年间，美国失去了三分之一的本地报纸。
那些幸存下来的报纸，其记者数量也远少于从前，因为同期美国新闻业的总岗位减少了一半以上。

questions.name: #682 Globalization
questions.en:
The benefits and disadvantages of globalization are the subject of ongoing debate.
The downside to globalization can be seen in the increased risk for the transmission of diseases.
Globalization has of course led to great good, too.
Richer nations now can come to the aid of poorer nations in crisis.
Increasing diversity in many countries has meant more opportunity to learn about and celebrate other cultures.
questions.zh:
全球化的利弊一直是人们争论的话题。
全球化的负面影响之一就是疾病传播的风险增加了。
当然，全球化也带来了很多好处。
现在，富裕国家可以在危机时刻帮助贫困国家。
许多国家日益多元化，这意味着我们有更多机会了解和庆祝其他文化。

questions.en:

Movies have the power to share new ideas and teach lessons about the past or future.
Sometimes, films only exist to entertain us.
Just like there are many different styles of art, there are many different styles of film.

有时候，电影的存在仅仅是为了娱乐我们。
就像艺术有多种风格一样，电影也有多种风格。

questions.name: #684 Facial Expressions
questions.en:
Being able to understand and interpret facial expressions is a big part of non-verbal communication skills.
There are often times in conversations when just listening to the words that someone is saying will only tell you half of the story.
Words don't always match how we feel, and our facial expressions often have a habit of giving us away.
questions.zh:

questions.name: #686 Onion
questions.en:
Varieties of onion differ in size, strength and colour.
The yellow onion is the most commonly known variety, which has pale golden skin, greenish-white flesh and a strong taste.
Red onions are an attractive, milder alternative to the yellow onion with their shiny purple skin.
Spring onions are immature onions pulled before the bulb is fully formed, and can be recognised by their long green leaves.
questions.zh:
洋葱的种类在大小、辣度和颜色上各不相同。
黄洋葱是最常见的品种，有着淡金色外皮、绿白色果肉和浓烈的味道。
红洋葱是黄洋葱的一种诱人且更温和的替代品，拥有闪亮的紫色外皮。
春洋葱是在鳞茎完全形成前拔出的未成熟洋葱，可以通过其长长的绿叶来识别。

questions.name: #687 Itchy Hands and Feet
questions.en:
When your hands and feet itch, the right treatment can bring you some relief.
How you treat the itching, though, depends a lot on the cause of the problem.
It may just be dry skin, which can be brought on by winter weather or too much scrubbing.
But sometimes, itchy hands and feet can signal another health condition.
questions.zh:
手和脚痒的时候，正确的治疗能让你舒服一些。
不过，怎么治痒很大程度上取决于问题的原因。
可能只是皮肤干燥，冬天或者过度搓洗都会引起。
但有时候，手和脚发痒也可能预示着其他健康问题。

questions.name: #688 Tea and Sugar
questions.en:
Like coffee, plain tea contains just a couple of calories per cup and no sugar.
But what’s added in it can change that situation.
A medium sweet tea and a large iced latte from fast food restaurants both pack about seven teaspoons of sugar.
However, the American Heart Association recommends no more than six teaspoons for the whole day.
questions.zh:
像咖啡一样，纯茶每杯只有几卡路里，不含糖。
但加入的东西可能会改变这种情况。
快餐店的中杯甜茶和大杯冰拿铁都含有大约七茶匙的糖。
然而，美国心脏协会建议全天摄入不超过六茶匙。

questions.name: #689 Lecture
questions.en:
A lecture tends to be a one-sided class where you and your fellow students will sit and take notes while a lecturer talks about a specific topic or gives a presentation.
This class is information- heavy so taking notes is essential and there may be little time to ask questions.
Lectures are the main method for your university to teach you the necessary material.
questions.zh:
讲座通常是一种单向授课方式，你和同学们坐在那里做笔记，讲师会谈论某个特定话题或进行演示。
这门课信息量很大，所以做笔记至关重要，而且可能没有太多时间提问。
讲座是大学教授你必要知识的主要方式。

questions.name: #690 Gender Inequality
questions.en:
Gender inequality is one of the oldest and most pervasive forms of inequality in the world.
It denies women their voices and devalues their work.
Despite some important progress to change this in recent years, in no country have women achieved economic equality with men, and women are still more likely to live in poverty.
questions.zh:
性别不平等是世界上最古老、最普遍的不平等形式之一。
它剥夺了女性的发言权，贬低了她们的工作价值。
尽管近年来在改变这一状况方面取得了一些重要进展，但没有任何一个国家实现了女性与男性的经济平等，女性仍然更有可能生活在贫困中。

questions.name: #691 Nuclear Systems
questions.en:
Designers of new nuclear systems are adopting novel approaches in the attempt to attain success.
First, they are utilizing a nuclear fuel cycle that encompasses steps from the mining of ore to the management of wastes.
Second, they are evaluating systems in terms of their sustainability - meeting present needs without jeopardizing the ability of future generations to prosper.
questions.zh:
新型核系统的设计者正在尝试采用创新方法以取得成功。
首先，他们利用的核燃料循环涵盖了从矿石开采到废物管理的各个环节。
其次，他们从可持续性的角度评估系统——满足当前需求，同时不损害后代繁荣发展的能力。

questions.name: #692 Calendars
questions.en:
Archaeologists have reconstructed methods of timekeeping that go back to prehistoric times at least as old as the Neolithic.
The natural units for timekeeping used by most historical societies are the day and the solar year.
Calendars are explicit schemes used for timekeeping.
The first historically attested calendars date to the Bronze Age, dependent on the development of writing in the ancient Near East.
questions.zh:
考古学家已经还原了至少可以追溯到新石器时代史前时期的计时方法。
大多数历史社会使用的天然计时单位是日和太阳年。
日历是用于计时的明确方案。
历史上最早有据可查的日历出现在青铜时代，这依赖于古代近东地区文字的发展。

questions.name: #693 Occupational Therapy
questions.en:
Occupational therapy helps people of all ages who have physical, sensory or cognitive problems.
It can help them regain independence in all areas of their lives.
Occupational therapists help with barriers that affect a person's emotional, social and physical needs.
They also help kids to improve their school performance, and aid their daily activities.
It also boosts their self-esteem and sense of accomplishment.

它能帮助他们在生活的各个方面重新获得独立。
职业治疗师会帮助解决影响一个人情感、社交和身体需求的障碍。
他们还能帮助孩子提升在校表现，辅助他们的日常活动。
这也能增强他们的自尊心和成就感。

questions.name: #694 Poverty Reduction Strategy
questions.en:
Canada's first-ever Poverty Reduction Strategy is built on the vision that all Canadians should be able to live in dignity.
It is also built on the belief that all Canadians deserve to be treated fairly and fully participate in the development of their communities.
To be effective, the strategy must have transparent indicators, clear targets and tangible actions.
questions.zh:
加拿大首个减贫战略基于这样一个愿景：所有加拿大人都能过上有尊严的生活。
它还基于这样一个信念：所有加拿大人都应得到公平对待，并充分参与社区发展。
为了有效，该战略必须有透明的指标、明确的目标和切实的行动。

questions.name: #695 Arms Races
questions.en:
Arms races may involve a more general competitive acquisition of military capability.
This is often measured by military expenditure, although the link between military expenditure and capability is often quite weak.
Such more general arms races are often observed among countries engaged in enduring rivalries, which may sometimes appear to follow each other’s military spending levels.
questions.zh:
军备竞赛可能涉及更广泛地竞争获取军事能力。
这通常通过军费支出来衡量，尽管军费支出与能力之间的联系往往相当薄弱。
这种更普遍的军备竞赛常见于长期敌对的国家之间，它们有时似乎会相互跟随对方的军费开支水平。

questions.name: #696 Magnetic Field
questions.en:
The magnetic field is a vector field - at each point it has a magnitude and direction.
The direction is defined as the direction of the force that a magnetic north pole would feel at that point.
Since like poles repel and opposite poles attract, this means that the magnetic field goes away from the north pole of a magnet and towards the south pole.
questions.zh:
磁场是一个矢量场——每个点都有大小和方向。
方向定义为该点处磁北极所受力的方向。
由于同极相斥、异极相吸，这意味着磁场从磁北极出发，指向磁南极。

questions.name: #697 Family Size
questions.en:
The world's poorest countries tend to have the largest family sizes and fertility rates.
When people have no economic security and cannot rely on their government, they often have children to ensure they will be looked after when they are older.
Where child mortality is high, there is an even greater impetus to have more children.
questions.zh:
世界上最贫困的国家往往家庭规模最大，生育率也最高。
当人们没有经济保障，又无法依赖政府时，他们常常通过生育孩子来确保自己晚年有人照料。
在儿童死亡率高的地方，人们更有动力多生孩子。

questions.name: #698 Minerals
questions.en:
Minerals are important for your body to stay healthy.
Your body uses minerals for many different jobs, including keeping your muscles, heart and brain working properly.
Minerals are also important for making enzymes and hormones.
Most people get the amount of minerals they need by eating a wide variety of foods.
If the intake is not enough, doctors may recommend a mineral supplement.
questions.zh:
矿物质对保持身体健康很重要。
你的身体需要矿物质来完成许多不同的任务，包括让肌肉、心脏和大脑正常运作。
矿物质对制造酶和激素也很关键。
大多数人通过吃各种食物来获取所需的矿物质。
如果摄入不足，医生可能会建议服用矿物质补充剂。

questions.name: #699 Coastal Ecosystems
questions.en:
Many scientists examining human impacts on coastal ecosystems have focused on agricultural runoff, because fertilizers that wash into the sea carry massive amounts of nutrients and pathogens that can harm marine environments.
But the impacts of human sewage receive far less attention.
Part of the reason may be that, unlike trash or oil spills, sewage can be invisible in the water.
questions.zh:
许多研究人类活动对沿海生态系统影响的科学家，都把注意力集中在农业径流上，因为流入海洋的肥料携带大量营养物和病原体，可能危害海洋环境。
但人类污水的影响却很少受到关注。
部分原因可能是，与垃圾或石油泄漏不同，污水在水中是看不见的。

questions.name: #700 Menopause Data
questions.en:
“Despite the fact that every woman goes through menopause, there’s not enough research,” Anna says.
“Our scientific understanding of menopause is vastly limited due to the lack of data.
Menopausal changes are correlated with women’s cardiovascular, cognitive, and overall health, so a database will allow us to better understand these connections.”
questions.zh:
安娜说：“尽管每个女性都会经历更年期，但相关研究仍然不足。”
“由于缺乏数据，我们对更年期的科学认知非常有限。”
“更年期变化与女性的心血管、认知及整体健康息息相关，因此建立数据库将有助于我们更好地理解这些关联。”

questions.name: #701 Geosphere
questions.en:
The geosphere includes all the stuff that makes up the crust and the core of the earth, and everything natural and lifeless that makes up the surface of the earth.
Examples are all the rocks and sand particles from dry land to those found at the bottom of the oceans.
The geosphere undergoes infinite processes constantly, which in turn modifies other spheres.
questions.zh:
地质圈包含了构成地壳和地核的所有物质，以及构成地球表面的所有天然无生命的东西。
比如从干燥陆地到海底的所有岩石和沙粒。
地质圈不断经历着无穷无尽的过程，这些过程反过来又改变着其他圈层。

questions.name: #702 Misinformation
questions.en:
Misinformation is everywhere.
It can be spread inadvertently if people make a genuine mistake.
In today’s environment, people get much of their news from social media, which lacks gate-keepers and therefore allows misinformation to spread fast and wide.
People are being bombarded with information and it has become difficult for them to separate fact from fiction.
questions.zh:
虚假信息无处不在。
如果人们无意中犯错，它就可能被不经意地传播。
在当今环境下，人们从社交媒体获取大量新闻，而社交媒体缺乏把关人，因此虚假信息得以快速广泛传播。
人们被信息轰炸，已经很难区分事实与虚构。

questions.name: #703 Trees and Winter
questions.en:
The shorter days are a sign to trees to begin to prepare for winter.
During winter there is not enough light for photosynthesis to occur, so as the days shorten throughout autumn, the trees begin to close down their food production systems and reduce the amount of chlorophyll in their leaves.
questions.zh:

冬天光照不足，无法进行光合作用，因此随着秋季白昼逐渐缩短，树木开始关闭自身的食物生产系统，并减少叶子中的叶绿素含量。

questions.name: #704 Tipping Etiquette
questions.en:
Travel planning is all about the details.
But while you may be a master at uncovering the cleanest hotels and practicing proper airplane etiquette, there’s an element of being a guest that stumps even the savviest of travelers.
Tipping etiquette — who to tip and how much of a tip to give — can be confusing.
questions.zh:
旅行规划全在于细节。
但即便你擅长找到最干净的酒店、懂得飞机上的礼仪，作为客人，有个方面连最老练的旅行者也会犯难。
小费礼仪——该给谁小费、给多少——确实让人困惑。

questions.name: #705 Fall Colors
questions.en:
Relish the fall colors while you can.
Scientists think that the rich reds, oranges and yellows of fall may be one of the many casualties of global warming.
Leaves change color in part because of cues taken from dropping temperatures.
As temperatures remain warmer through fall and winter nights, they could delay the beloved fall color shift.
questions.zh:
趁着还能欣赏，好好享受秋天的色彩吧。
科学家认为，秋天那浓郁的红、橙、黄可能是全球变暖的众多牺牲品之一。
叶子变色的部分原因是受到气温下降的信号影响。
随着秋冬夜晚的气温持续升高，它们可能会推迟我们喜爱的秋叶变色过程。

questions.name: #706 Vegetative Cover
questions.en:
The root systems of vegetative cover hold soils in place and prevent wind and water erosion.
It also ensures its supply of organic matter from dead leaves and the dropping of animal waste.
The vegetative cover also shelters the soils from excessive heat from the sun.
It helps to reduce evaporation and retain soil moisture needed for the breakdown of organic matter.
questions.zh:
植被的根系能固定土壤，防止风蚀和水蚀。
它还能通过落叶和动物粪便提供有机物质。
植被覆盖还能保护土壤免受阳光过度暴晒。
这有助于减少蒸发，保持土壤湿度，这是分解有机物所必需的。

questions.name: #707 Inclined Plane
questions.en:
An inclined plane is a simple machine with no moving parts.
It is simply an even sloping surface.
It makes it easier for us to move objects to higher or lower surfaces than if we lifted the objects directly upwards.
It is believed that ancient Egyptians used inclined planes to carry heavy stones to build pyramids.
questions.zh:
斜面是一种没有活动部件的简单机械。
它就是一个平整的斜坡面。
比起直接把物体向上提，斜面让我们更容易把物体移到更高或更低的平面上。
据信古埃及人曾用斜面来搬运重石建造金字塔。

questions.name: #708 Vanishing Teller Jobs
questions.en:
Technological advances are eliminating the need for bank tellers, threatening an entry point for women into the male-dominated industry which has sought to promote more females to leadership roles.
While the climb remains steep, some financial companies have managed to improve the gender balance in their executive ranks.
As teller jobs dwindle, there’s a risk that banks will raise the educational requirements for those jobs.
questions.zh:
科技进步正在让银行柜员变得多余，而这原本是女性进入男性主导行业的一个入口，该行业一直试图让更多女性担任领导职务。
虽然攀升之路依然艰难，但一些金融公司已经设法改善了高管层的性别平衡。
随着柜员岗位减少，银行有可能会提高这些岗位的学历要求。

questions.name: #709 Loggerhead Turtle
questions.en:
It’s time for this young loggerhead turtle to go to work.
We can tether turtles in these little cloth harnesses, put them into this tank and dull swimming place.
University of North Carolina biologist Ken Loman studies sea turtles that are programed from birth for an extraordinary journey.
Mother turtles buried the eggs on the beach and then returned to the sea and the eggs hatch about 50 to 60 days later.
questions.zh:
这只小蠵龟该去干活了。
我们可以用这些小布背带拴住海龟，把它们放进这个水箱和不太明亮的游泳区域。
北卡罗来纳大学的生物学家肯·洛曼研究那些从出生起就注定要踏上非凡旅程的海龟。
龟妈妈把蛋埋在沙滩上，然后返回大海，大约50到60天后蛋就会孵化。

questions.name: #710 Antarctic
questions.en:
The world's fifth largest continent: Antarctica is almost entirely covered by ice 2000 meters thick.
The area sustains varied wildlife including seals, whales, and penguins.
The Antarctic treaty signed in 1959 and enforced since 1961 provides for international governance of Antarctica.
questions.zh:
地球第五大洲南极洲几乎完全被厚达两千米的冰层覆盖。
这片区域滋养着多种多样的野生动物，比如海豹、鲸鱼和企鹅。
1959年签署、1961年生效的《南极条约》规定了南极的国际治理机制。

questions.name: #711 Lecture Beginning
questions.en:
Don't miss the beginning of the lecture since it is very often most valuable part, for instance, because it reviews previous lectures or outlines objects and lecture structure.
If you easily get distracted by other students, sit near the front.
questions.zh:
别错过讲座的开头，因为那通常是最有价值的部分，比如会回顾之前的讲座或概述目标和讲座结构。
如果你容易被其他同学分心，就坐在前排附近。

Undergraduates may choose to major in any one of 125 academic majors.
The university's distinguished faculty includes internationally known scientists, authors and teachers who are committed to continuing the university's tradition in providing one of the highest quality undergraduate educations available.

questions.name: #713 Behavioral Science
questions.en:
Behavioral and social sciences research helps predict, prevent, and manage illness — in individuals and in whole populations.
This research also helps people change their behaviors, understand treatments, and learn how to stick with them.
Society's role is significant, too: access to health care affects decision-making and behavior.
questions.zh:
行为与社会科学研究有助于预测、预防和管理疾病——无论是针对个人还是整个人群。
这类研究还能帮助人们改变行为、理解治疗方案，并学会如何坚持执行。
社会的作用同样重要：医疗服务的可及性会影响人们的决策和行为。

questions.name: #714 Personal Libraries
questions.en:
Scholars build their own personal libraries to support not only particular projects but also general reading in their field.
They buy or make photocopies of materials when possible, so they can consult them frequently, mark pages and write annotation on them.
When moving into a new field, they add to their collections, usually concentrating on primary texts.
questions.zh:
学者们建立个人图书馆，不仅是为了支持特定项目，也是为了满足所在领域的一般阅读需求。
他们尽可能购买或复印资料，以便经常查阅、标记页面并做批注。
进入新领域时，他们会扩充自己的收藏，通常侧重于原始文献。

questions.name: #715 Mutual Politics
questions.en: In order to achieve the free flow of goods and services, with work and capital between the member countries, they needed to establish mutual politics in areas as diverse as agriculture, transport, and when they were concerned with a far wider range of issues.
questions.zh: 为了实现成员国之间商品、服务、劳动力和资本的自由流动，他们需要在农业、交通等不同领域建立共同政策，并处理更为广泛的问题。

questions.name: #716 Nebular Hypothesis
questions.en:
The most widely accepted model for planet formation, known as the nebular hypothesis, begins with a swirling disc of gas and dust — leftover material from the birth of a nearby star.
At some point in time, gravity triumphs over the pressure supporting this cosmic dust, which then starts to rotate, quickly collapsing under its own gravity.
questions.zh:
关于行星形成，目前最广为接受的模型是星云假说，它始于一颗邻近恒星诞生后残留的气体和尘埃形成的旋转盘。
在某个时刻，引力战胜了支撑这些宇宙尘埃的压力，尘埃开始旋转，并在自身引力作用下迅速坍缩。

questions.name: #717 Train Noise
questions.en:
There are other components, aside from the wheels and rails, that add to the noise a train makes when it passes.
Older trains had their air conditioning units underneath the carriage, but modern trains have been lowered to allow people with less mobility to enter the carriage more easily.
As a result, air conditioning units are now on top of the carriage, where they add to the train noise.
questions.zh:
除了车轮和铁轨，还有其他因素会增加火车经过时的噪音。
老式火车的空调机组装在车厢底部，但现代火车为了行动不便的人更容易上车而降低了底盘，所以空调机组现在装在车厢顶部，这也会增加火车噪音。
因此，空调机组现在装在车厢顶部，它们也会增加火车噪音。

questions.name: #718 Disabled People and Technology
questions.en:
The use of technologies for the inclusion and empowerment of persons with disabilities is not new — from the creation of Braille and the first hearing aid to the invention of the wheelchair.
For disabled persons, new assistive technology can make all the difference, while technology and innovation are breaking down the barriers to achieving full participation.
questions.zh:
利用科技来帮助残疾人融入社会、增强能力，这并不是什么新鲜事——从盲文、第一台助听器的发明，到轮椅的创造，都是如此。
对于残疾人来说，新的辅助技术可以带来天壤之别的改变，而技术与创新正在打破他们实现全面参与的障碍。

questions.name: #719 Robotic System
questions.en:
The robotic system is composed of a floating platform with eight cables that are connected to a mobile robot that will move around on the seafloor beneath it to collect waste items in a box, using a gripper, hook or suction device depending on the size of the litter.
The orientation of the robot can be controlled by adjusting the tension of the cables.
questions.zh:
这个机器人系统由一个漂浮平台和八根缆绳组成，缆绳连接到一台移动机器人上，这台机器人会在平台下方的海底移动，用夹爪、钩子或吸盘装置（根据垃圾大小选择）将废弃物收集到箱子里。
通过调整缆绳的张力，可以控制机器人的朝向。

questions.name: #720 Online Speech and Politics
questions.en:
Online speech has become such an influential way of experiencing politics today — not just participating in democratic processes like elections — but also the way we lead our daily democratic life through digital communication.
If these sorts of irreverent and vitriolic exchanges are so prominent online, then we need to see how we can bring nuance to understanding them.
questions.zh:
如今，网络言论已经成为体验政治的重要方式——不仅是在选举等民主进程中参与，更是通过数字通信来主导我们日常民主生活的方式。
如果这类无礼且尖刻的交流在网上如此突出，那么我们需要看看如何更细致地理解它们。

questions.name: #721 Turbine Blades
questions.en:
To withstand the forces of nature and the huge forces the rotation itself generates, blades are manufactured with a multilayer ‘coat of armour’.
Typically, the outer layer erodes during operation and the inner layers can become detached.
Although the lifespan of a turbine is theoretically 25 years, current medium-sized systems typically require extensive maintenance at about 10 years due to blade deterioration.
questions.zh:
为了抵御自然力量以及旋转本身产生的巨大力量，叶片采用多层‘铠甲’结构制造。
通常情况下，外层在运行中会磨损，内层可能脱落。
虽然涡轮机理论寿命为25年，但目前中型系统因叶片退化，通常在10年左右就需要大修。

questions.name: #722 Hydrogen Technology
questions.en:
Hydrogen will play several roles in our future.
For transport, we now see several manufacturers launching cars powered by electricity produced in a hydrogen fuel cell, and this will happen even more in the near future.
Fuel cell buses are also an attractive solution for public transport.
Also engineers are now even starting to consider using fuel cells and hydrogen to power trains.
questions.zh:
氢气在未来会扮演多个角色。
在交通方面，我们现在看到一些制造商推出了由氢燃料电池产生的电力驱动的汽车，而且这种情况在不久的将来会更多。
燃料电池公交车也是公共交通的一个有吸引力的解决方案。
此外，工程师们现在甚至开始考虑使用燃料电池和氢气来驱动火车。

questions.name: #723 Desalination
questions.en:
Desalination is the answer to long-term water security, but it’s also expensive and energy-intensive.
The good news is that scientists are developing some viable solutions.
The first desalination plant in Europe was built in Spain nearly a half-century ago.
Since then, facilities have sprung up in water-stressed regions throughout Europe.
questions.zh:
海水淡化是保障长期水安全的解决方案，但成本高昂且耗能巨大。
好消息是，科学家们正在开发一些可行的解决方案。
欧洲的第一座海水淡化厂大约半个世纪前建于西班牙。
自那以后，这类设施在欧洲水资源紧张的地区纷纷涌现。

questions.name: #724 Chemosignals
questions.en:
Studying how mouse brains process chemosignals will help researchers understand general principles of how their brains form social memories, and could help scientists identify what happens when these functions go wrong.
Eventually this may help scientists understand what happens in people whose ability to recognize others is impaired or those who have difficulties with social interactions caused by autism.
questions.zh:
研究小鼠大脑如何处理化学信号，有助于研究人员理解其大脑形成社交记忆的一般原理，并可能帮助科学家识别这些功能失常时发生的情况。
最终，这或许能帮助科学家了解那些识别他人能力受损的人，或由自闭症导致社交互动困难的人，其大脑中发生了什么。

questions.name: #725 New Form of Carbon
questions.en:
A newly created form of carbon in a mesh just one atom thick is tantalizing scientists with hints that it could sharply improve rechargeable batteries and allow wires so small that they can operate at a scale where metals fail.
The material is highly conductive and may prove able to store more electrical energy than even graphene, the astonishing atomic-thickness carbon honeycomb material identified nearly 20 years ago.
questions.zh:
一种新合成的碳材料，呈单原子厚度的网状结构，正让科学家们兴奋不已，因为它有望大幅提升充电电池的性能，并制造出小到金属都无法正常工作的纳米级导线。
这种材料导电性极强，其储存电能的能力甚至可能超越石墨烯——那种约20年前发现的、令人惊叹的单原子厚度的碳蜂窝材料。

questions.name: #726 Stratosphere
questions.en:
The stratosphere is the next layer up from Earth’s surface.
Temperatures in the stratosphere increase with altitude.
A high concentration of ozone, a molecule composed of three atoms of oxygen, makes up the ozone layer of the stratosphere.
This ozone absorbs some of the incoming solar radiation, shielding life on Earth from potentially harmful ultraviolet light.
questions.zh:
平流层是地球表面之上的下一层。
平流层的温度随高度增加而升高。
高浓度的臭氧——由三个氧原子组成的分子——构成了平流层的臭氧层。
这种臭氧吸收部分入射的太阳辐射，保护地球上的生命免受潜在有害的紫外线照射。

questions.name: #727 Glucose
questions.en:
The body uses glucose as its main source of energy.
Glucose comes from foods that contain carbohydrates, which is released and absorbed into the bloodstream after food is digested.
The glucose in the bloodstream needs to move into body tissues so that cells can use it for energy.
Excess glucose is also stored in the liver, or converted to fat.
questions.zh:
身体主要依靠葡萄糖来获取能量。
葡萄糖来自含碳水化合物的食物，这些食物被消化后，葡萄糖会释放并被吸收到血液中。
血液中的葡萄糖需要进入身体组织，这样细胞才能利用它产生能量。
多余的葡萄糖会储存在肝脏中，或者转化为脂肪。

questions.name: #728 Biomass
questions.en:
People have used biomass energy — energy from living things — since the earliest “cave men” first made wood fires for cooking or keeping warm.
Biomass is organic, meaning it is made of material that comes from living organisms, such as plants and animals.
The most common biomass materials used for energy are plants, wood, and waste.
questions.zh:
人类自最早的“穴居人”首次生火做饭或取暖以来，就一直使用生物质能——来自生物的能量。
生物质是有机物，意味着它由来自生物体（如植物和动物）的物质构成。
用于能源的最常见生物质材料是植物、木材和废弃物。

questions.name: #729 Altimeter
questions.en:
A simple barometric altimeter includes a sealed metal chamber, a spring, and a pointer that shows altitude in meters or feet.
The chamber expands as air pressure decreases and contracts as it increases, bending the spring and moving the pointer.
An altimeter can be mounted on an aircraft’s instrument panel or worn on a person’s wrist.
questions.zh:
简单的气压高度计包含一个密封的金属腔、一个弹簧和一个指针，指针显示以米或英尺为单位的高度。
当气压下降时，金属腔膨胀，气压上升时则收缩，从而弯曲弹簧并移动指针。
高度计可以安装在飞机的仪表盘上，也可以戴在人的手腕上。

questions.name: #730 Coriolis Effect
questions.en:
Prevailing winds are winds that blow from a single direction over a specific area of the Earth.
Areas where prevailing winds meet are called convergence zones.
Generally, prevailing winds blow east-west rather than north-south.
This happens because Earth’s rotation generates what is known as the Coriolis effect.
The Coriolis effect makes wind systems twist counter-clockwise in the Northern Hemisphere and clockwise in the Southern Hemisphere.
questions.zh:
盛行风是指在地球特定区域从单一方向吹来的风。
盛行风交汇的地方被称为辐合带。
通常，盛行风是东西走向而非南北走向。
这是因为地球自转产生了所谓的科里奥利效应。
科里奥利效应使风系在北半球逆时针旋转，在南半球顺时针旋转。

questions.name: #731 Icehouse Structures
questions.en:
The icehouse structures, of which four still remain intact, are located south of Sultan Kala.
These large, conically-domed earthen structures would have had sheets of ice built up on the ground level over the course of the winter to provide year-round ice supplies.
questions.zh:
至今仍有四座完好的冰库建筑，位于苏丹卡拉以南。
这些大型锥形土顶建筑，冬季时在地面层层结冰，以此提供全年用冰储备。

questions.name: #732 Patriarch
questions.en:
A patriarchal family is one run by the father or eldest male of a household.
He usually decides the duties of the women and children in the family.
In this role, the patriarch solves family disputes and divides the family’s wealth.
The patriarch is also the spiritual leader of the family because he is thought to be the closest to the spirits of the family’s ancestors.
questions.zh:
父权制家庭是指由父亲或家中最年长的男性管理的家庭。
他通常决定家中女性和孩子的职责。
在这个角色中，家长解决家庭纠纷并分配家庭财富。
家长也是家庭的精神领袖，因为他被认为与祖先的灵魂最为接近。

questions.name: #733 Here Be Dragons
questions.en:
Medieval mapmakers supposedly inscribed the phrase “Here Be Dragons” on maps showing unknown regions of the world.
Unfortunately, apart from an inscription on a globe, this claim is unfounded.
Although there were no dragons, and the inscription “Here Be Dragons” was virtually never used, some of the purported earliest mapmakers did have to deal with real and formidable megafauna.
questions.zh:
据说中世纪的制图师会在描绘未知世界的区域标上“此处有龙”。
可惜的是，除了一个地球仪上的刻字外，这种说法并无依据。
尽管没有龙，也几乎从未用过“此处有龙”的标注，但一些早期制图师确实要面对真实而凶猛的巨型动物。

questions.name: #734 Babylon
questions.en:
Outside the biblical tradition, Babylon intrigued Greek and Roman writers, who added to the rich store of legends that have come down to the present day.
Popular tales of Babylon’s fantastic structures may also be products of legends and confusion.
Yet to historians and archaeologists, Babylon is a real bricks-and-mortar place at the center of the vibrant Mesopotamian culture.
questions.zh:
在圣经传统之外，巴比伦也引起了希腊和罗马作家的兴趣，他们为流传至今的丰富传说增添了内容。
关于巴比伦奇异建筑的流行故事可能也是传说和误解的产物。
然而，对于历史学家和考古学家来说，巴比伦是一个真实存在的砖石之地，位于充满活力的美索不达米亚文化的中心。

questions.name: #735 Ants and Insulin
questions.en:
The scientists found that division of reproductive labor in ants arose when an ancient insulin signaling pathway, typically involved in maintaining nutrition and growth, became responsive to social cues.
In doing so, they also uncovered deeper insights into a process underlying how the environment gets under the skin to affect behavior, physiology, and the health and well-being of other members of a society.

questions.name: #736 Coffee
questions.en:
Coffee is a beloved beverage known for its ability to fine-tune your focus and boost your energy levels.
In fact, many people depend on their daily cup of coffee when they wake up to get their day started on the right foot.
In addition to its energizing effects, coffee has been linked to a long list of potential health benefits, giving you more reasons to get brewing.
questions.zh:
咖啡是一种受人喜爱的饮品，以其能精准提升专注力和增强精力而闻名。
事实上，很多人醒来后都依赖每天一杯咖啡来开启美好的一天。
除了提神醒脑的效果，咖啡还与一系列潜在的健康益处相关，这给了你更多理由去煮上一杯。
