questions.name: #737 Vaccines and Wildlife
questions.en:
The idea of ‘self-disseminating’ vaccines has floated through epidemiological circles for decades, conceived mainly as a tool for protecting the health of wildlife.
But evolutionary biologists have refreshed the proposal with evidence from their own modeling and other experimental work, which suggests that self-disseminating vaccines could be a safe and practical way to head off zoonotic pandemics as well.
questions.zh:
'自我传播'疫苗的想法在流行病学界流传了几十年，最初主要是作为保护野生动物健康的工具。
但进化生物学家用他们自己的模型和其他实验工作的证据更新了这一提议，表明自我传播疫苗也可能是一种安全且实用的方式来预防人畜共患的大流行病。

questions.name: #738 Alien Life
questions.en:
No planet will have a complex form of life that popped into existence all on its own.
Whatever life is like on an alien planet, it must have begun simply.
But if life is to achieve any kind of complexity, the only way that complexity can accumulate is if favorable changes and innovations are retained and unfavorable ones are lost.
questions.zh:
没有哪个行星上的复杂生命形式会是凭空出现的。
无论外星生命是什么样，它一定是从简单开始的。
但生命若要达到某种复杂程度，积累复杂性的唯一途径就是保留有利的变化和创新，淘汰不利的。

questions.name: #739 Black Hole
questions.en:
According to Einstein’s general theory of relativity, the gravity of a black hole is so intense that nothing can escape it.
The more sophisticated understanding of black holes developed by Stephen Hawking and his colleagues did not question this principle.
Hawking and others sought to describe matter in and around black holes using quantum theory, but they continued to describe gravity using Einstein’s classical theory.
questions.zh:
根据爱因斯坦的广义相对论，黑洞的引力极其强大，任何东西都无法逃脱。
斯蒂芬·霍金及其同事对黑洞的更深入理解并未质疑这一原理。
霍金和其他人试图用量子理论描述黑洞内部及周围的物质，但他们仍沿用爱因斯坦的经典理论来描述引力。

questions.name: #740 Bone Density
questions.en:
The bone density test is painless and quick.
It estimates how dense or thick your bones are by using X-rays.
The X-rays measure how much calcium and minerals are in a part of your bone.
The more minerals you have, the better, which means your bones are stronger, denser, and less likely to break.
questions.zh:
骨密度测试既无痛又快速。
它通过X光来估算你的骨骼密度或厚度。
X光可以测量你骨骼某一部分中钙和矿物质的含量。
矿物质越多越好，这意味着你的骨骼更强壮、更致密，也更不容易骨折。

questions.name: #741 Timekeeping
questions.en:
Over the past five years, through studies of the simplest conceivable clocks, the researchers have discovered the fundamental limits of timekeeping.
They’ve mapped out new relationships between accuracy, information, complexity, energy and entropy — the quantity whose incessant rise in the universe is closely associated with the arrow of time.
questions.zh:
过去五年里，研究人员通过研究能想到的最简单的时钟，发现了计时的基本极限。
他们描绘出了精度、信息、复杂性、能量和熵之间的新关系——熵在宇宙中不断增长，与时间之箭紧密相关。

questions.name: #742 Cow Feed
questions.en:
More than half of cow feed is actually grass, and farmers call it hay and silage.
While people often think dairy cows are fed a high-grain diet, in reality they eat the leaves and stems from corn, wheat and oats far more often than they are eating grain, like corn kernels.
questions.zh:
牛饲料里其实一半以上都是草，农民管它叫干草和青贮饲料。
虽然人们常以为奶牛吃的是高谷物饲料，但实际上它们吃玉米、小麦和燕麦的茎叶远比吃玉米粒这样的谷物要多得多。

questions.name: #743 Mathematical Languages
questions.en:
The mathematical language for talking about connections, which usually depends on networks — vertices and edges — has been an invaluable way to model real-world phenomena.
But a few decades ago, the emergence of giant data sets forced researchers to expand their toolboxes and, at the same time, gave them sprawling sandboxes to apply new mathematical insights.
questions.zh:
用来描述连接关系的数学语言通常依赖于网络——顶点和边——这已经成为模拟现实世界现象的宝贵工具。
但几十年前，大数据集的涌现迫使研究人员扩充他们的工具箱，同时也为他们提供了广阔的实验场来应用新的数学见解。

questions.name: #744 Voyage
questions.en:
A crew of scientists voyaged by ship from the southern tip of Chile into the frigid Antarctic to search for clues to one of the great unknowns of climate change.
They planned to crisscross a remote patch of sea near the spot where, a year earlier, another crew had injected a tankful of an inert chemical one mile below the surface.
questions.zh:
一队科学家乘船从智利最南端出发，驶入寒冷的南极洲，寻找气候变化中一个重大未知问题的线索。
他们计划在一年前另一队船员曾将一罐惰性化学物质注入海面下一英里处的那片偏远海域来回穿梭。

questions.name: #745 Palaeontology
questions.en:
The outsize influence of rich countries on paleontology could lead to a warped view of life's history, the researchers say.
Researchers studying large-scale trends in paleontology using resources are keenly aware that the fossil record is biased in myriad ways, including the age and type of rock in which fossils survive.
But little consideration is given to the biases of the collectors themselves.
questions.zh:
研究人员表示，富国在古生物学领域的巨大影响力可能导致人们对生命历史的看法出现偏差。
利用资源研究古生物学宏观趋势的研究人员深知，化石记录在诸多方面存在偏差，包括化石保存所在岩石的年龄和类型。
但很少有人考虑收藏者自身的偏见。
questions.full:
The outsize influence of rich countries on paleontology could lead to a warped view of life's history, the researchers say.
研究人员表示，富国在古生物学领域的巨大影响力可能导致人们对生命历史的看法出现偏差。
Researchers studying large-scale trends in paleontology using resources are keenly aware that the fossil record is biased in myriad ways, including the age and type of rock in which fossils survive.

But little consideration is given to the biases of the collectors themselves.

questions.name: #746 Nature and Cities
questions.en:
To thrive, cities must lean on nature.
That means having open green spaces and interconnected waterways to prevent floods, green roofs and walls that reduce temperatures and produce food, and forests planted as green belts to oxygenate urban areas and regenerate ecosystems.
questions.zh:
城市要繁荣，就必须依靠大自然。
这意味着要有开放的绿色空间和相互连通的水道来防洪，要有能降温并生产食物的绿色屋顶和墙壁，还要有作为绿化带种植的森林，为城市区域供氧并恢复生态系统。

questions.name: #747 Hydrogen Production
questions.en:
A solar fuels generation research program is focused on hydrogen production by means of reactive metal water splitting in a cyclic iron-based redox process.
Iron-based oxides are explored as an intermediary reactive material to dissociate water molecules at significantly reduced thermal energies.

铁基氧化物被研究作为中间反应材料，在显著降低的热能下分解水分子。

questions.name: #748 Domestic Cats
questions.en:
Domestic cats that are largely indoor hunt less than outdoor cats because they don’t have access to mice.
In the wild, feral kittens are taught how to kill prey by their mothers.
Domestic cats often fail to learn this skill, which is why you will see them "playing" with anything they catch, or they may bring the mouse to you to kill.
questions.zh:
主要待在室内的家猫比户外猫捕猎少，因为它们接触不到老鼠。
在野外，流浪猫妈妈会教小猫如何捕杀猎物。
家猫往往学不会这个技能，所以你常看到它们跟抓到的猎物“玩耍”，或者把老鼠叼到你面前让你杀。

questions.name: #749 Biodegradable Polymers
questions.en:
Biodegradable polymers have been used as carriers in drug delivery systems for more than four decades.
Early work used crude natural materials for particle fabrication, whereas more recent work has utilized synthetic polymers.
The commercial success of these polymers has led to further research in the field aimed at bringing forward new formulation types for improved delivery of various small molecule and biologic drugs.
questions.zh:
可生物降解的聚合物作为药物输送系统的载体已经使用了四十多年。
早期研究使用粗糙的天然材料制造颗粒，而近期研究则采用了合成聚合物。
这些聚合物的商业成功推动了该领域的进一步研究，旨在推出新的制剂类型，以改善各种小分子和生物药物的输送。

questions.name: #750 Winter Wheat
questions.en:
Although typically grown as a cash grain, winter wheat can provide most of the cover crop benefits of other cereal crops, as well as a grazing option prior to spring tiller elongation.
Wheat also is slower to mature than some cereals, so there is no rush to kill it early in spring and risk compacting soil in wet conditions.
questions.zh:
虽然冬小麦通常作为经济作物种植，但它能提供其他谷类作物的大部分覆盖作物效益，而且在春季分蘖伸长前还能作为放牧选择。
小麦比某些谷类作物成熟得慢，所以不必急于在早春杀死它，从而避免在潮湿条件下压实土壤的风险。

questions.name: #751 Archean Eon
questions.en:
During the Archean Eon, methane droplets in the air shrouded the young Earth in a global haze.
There was no oxygen gas on Earth.
Oxygen was only in compounds such as water.
Complex chemical reactions in the young oceans transformed carbon-containing molecules into simple, living cells that did not need oxygen to live.
Instead they made energy out of sulfur and other elements.
questions.zh:
在太古宙时期，空气中的甲烷液滴将年轻的地球笼罩在一片全球性的雾霾中。
地球上没有氧气。
氧气只存在于水等化合物中。
早期海洋中的复杂化学反应将含碳分子转化为简单的不需要氧气存活的活细胞。
相反，它们通过硫和其他元素来获取能量。

questions.name: #752 Digital Art
questions.en:
Digital art can be computer generated, scanned or drawn using a tablet and a mouse.
Thanks to improvements in digital technology, it is possible to download video onto computers, allowing artists to manipulate the images they had filmed with a video camera.
This gives artists a creative freedom, allowing them to cut and paste within moving images to create visual collages.
questions.zh:
数字艺术可以是电脑生成的、扫描的，或者用平板和鼠标绘制的。
得益于数字技术的进步，现在可以把视频下载到电脑上，让艺术家们能处理他们用摄像机拍摄的画面。
这赋予了艺术家创作自由，让他们能在动态影像中剪贴，制作出视觉拼贴作品。

questions.name: #753 Canceled Flights
questions.en:
New York, North Carolina and Iowa were some of the intended destinations of canceled flights that were supposed to leave from Southern California.
Those areas are in the path of a winter storm that covered some neighborhoods with over a foot of snow and drenched others with freezing rain on Monday.

questions.name: #754 Sea Breeze
questions.en:
The sea breeze is one of the most frequently occurring small-scale weather systems.
It results from the unequal sensible heat flux of the lower atmosphere over adjacent solar-heated land and water masses.
Owing to the large thermal inertia of a water body, during daytime the air temperature changes little over the water while over land the air mass warms.
questions.zh:
海风是最常见的小尺度天气系统之一。
它是由邻近的陆地和海洋在太阳照射下，下层大气的感热通量不均衡导致的。
由于水体热惯性大，白天水面上空气温变化很小，而陆地上的气团则升温明显。

questions.name: #755 Roman Army
questions.en:
There were two types of soldier in the Roman Army: the roman legionary and the auxiliaries.
The legionaries were the very best soldiers and the auxiliaries were actually non-Roman citizens.
Legionaries wore an undershirt made of linen and a woollen tunic.
The linen helped the soldiers to stay cool while the wool helped to trap heat, keeping the soldiers warm.
questions.zh:
罗马军队里有两种士兵：罗马军团兵和辅助兵。
军团兵是最精锐的士兵，而辅助兵其实不是罗马公民。
军团兵穿着亚麻内衣和羊毛短上衣。
亚麻帮助士兵保持凉爽，而羊毛则能锁住热量，让士兵保持温暖。
questions.full:
There were two types of soldier in the Roman Army: the roman legionary and the auxiliaries.
罗马军队里有两种士兵：罗马军团兵和辅助兵。
The legionaries were the very best soldiers and the auxiliaries were actually non-Roman citizens.
军团兵是最精锐的士兵，而辅助兵其实不是罗马公民。
Legionaries wore an undershirt made of linen and a woollen tunic.
军团兵穿着亚麻内衣和羊毛短上衣。
The linen helped the soldiers to stay cool while the wool helped to trap heat, keeping the soldiers warm.
亚麻帮助士兵保持凉爽，而羊毛则能锁住热量，让士兵保持温暖。

questions.name: #757 Biological Processes
questions.en:
For centuries, the study of biological processes has inspired fundamental mathematical developments, while mathematical analyses have been instrumental in developing a mechanistic understanding of biological observations.
This fruitful cross-fertilization has gained momentum over recent decades, thanks in part to extraordinary technological advancements in the biological sciences, as well as the rising availability of large-scale computational resources.
questions.zh:
几个世纪以来，对生物过程的研究推动了基础数学的发展，而数学分析也有助于从机制上理解生物观察结果。
近几十年来，这种富有成效的交叉融合势头更盛，部分得益于生物科学领域非凡的技术进步，以及大规模计算资源的日益普及。

questions.name: #758 Biodiversity Decline
questions.en:
Climate change and biodiversity decline are major challenges of our time.
Both are predominantly caused by human activities, with profound consequences for people and the ecosystems on which we depend.
Some actions we can undertake are beneficial in both areas, helping to mitigate and adapt to climate change as well as conserve and restore biodiversity.
questions.zh:

这两者主要由人类活动引起，对人类以及我们赖以生存的生态系统有着深远的影响。
我们可以采取的一些行动对这两个领域都有好处，既能帮助减缓和适应气候变化，也能保护和恢复生物多样性。

questions.name: #759 Beauty
questions.en:
Beauty is subjective, and as such it of course cannot be defined in absolute terms.
But we all know or feel when something is beautiful to us personally.
And in such instances, methods of physics and network science can be used to quantify and help us better understand what it is that evokes that pleasant feeling.
questions.zh:
美是主观的，因此当然无法用绝对的标准来定义。
但当我们个人觉得某样东西很美时，我们都能感知到。
在这种情况下，物理学和网络科学的方法可以用来量化并帮助我们更好地理解是什么引发了那种愉悦的感受。

questions.name: #760 Locomotion
questions.en:
Locomotion underpins a limitless array of animal behaviors and can be a rich source of inspiration for the design of modern machines.
Movement requires mechanical interaction with the physical environment to monitor and control musculoskeletal systems that may be complex with many degrees of freedom.
Recent advances in robotics have proven to be powerful in broadening our understanding of how animals run in a controlled manner.
questions.zh:
运动支撑着动物无数种行为，也能为现代机器设计提供丰富的灵感来源。
移动需要与物理环境进行机械互动，以监测和控制可能具有多个自由度的复杂肌肉骨骼系统。
机器人技术的最新进展有力地拓宽了我们对动物如何以可控方式奔跑的理解。

questions.en:
Films can be compelling when used well.
They have the power to change people’s perspectives and outlook on life.
When we consider it in education, it has become one of the ideal teaching methods for various reasons.
It helps to motivate learners to be more productive and look on a positive side of life.

它有助于激励学习者更有效率，并看到生活积极的一面。

questions.en:
When you have selected a topic, you will first have to familiarize yourself with the topic in order to clarify it.
In this way you will get a clearer idea of all aspects concerning the topic, definitions, facts and theories.
You will get to know related terms and concepts, the context and the various possible ways of approaching the topic.

你会了解到相关的术语和概念、背景知识，以及探讨这个主题的各种可能方法。

questions.name: #763 Peptic Ulcer
questions.en:
The most common peptic ulcer symptom is burning stomach pain.
Stomach acid makes the pain worse, as does having an empty stomach.
The pain can often be relieved by eating certain foods that buffer stomach acid or by taking an acid-reducing medication, but then it may come back.
The pain may be worse between meals and at night.
questions.zh:
消化性溃疡最常见的症状是胃部灼痛。
胃酸会让疼痛加剧，空腹时也如此。
吃某些能中和胃酸的食物或服用减少胃酸的药物常能缓解疼痛，但之后可能复发。
疼痛在餐间和夜间可能更严重。

questions.name: #764 Satellite Imagery
questions.en:
Commercial satellite imagery is currently in a sweet spot: powerful enough to see a car, but not enough to tell the make and model; collected frequently enough for a farmer to keep tabs on crops’ health, but not so often that people could track the comings and goings of a neighbor.
Federal regulations limit images taken by commercial satellites to a resolution of the length of a shoe.
questions.zh:
商业卫星图像目前正处于一个黄金时期：清晰度足以看清一辆汽车，但还不足以辨别其品牌和型号；采集频率足够让农民监测作物健康状况，但又不至于频繁到让人追踪邻居的日常出入。
联邦法规限制商业卫星拍摄的图像分辨率，只能达到一只鞋的长度那么清晰。

questions.name: #765 Hong Kong Development
questions.en:
Many stakeholders are concerned that Hong Kong is ‘losing its competitive edge’.
A recent research report finds that non-positive interventionism no longer works and Hong Kong’s research funding model needs improvement.
Hong Kong should rejuvenate technology development through high-level government leadership by informing government decision-making with professional and technical expertise, nurturing human capital and technological talent and facilitating innovation collaboration.
questions.zh:
很多利益相关方担心香港正‘失去竞争优势’。
一项最新研究报告指出，非积极干预主义已不再奏效，香港的研究资助模式需要改进。
香港应通过高层的政府领导来重振科技发展，具体做法包括：以专业和技术知识指导政府决策，培养人力资本和科技人才，以及促进创新合作。

questions.name: #766 Standardization
questions.en:
Standardization is the process of developing, promoting and possibly mandating standards-based and compatible technologies and processes within a given industry.
Standards for technologies can mandate the quality and consistency of technologies and ensure their compatibility, interoperability and safety.
A lack of standardization often manifests in large numbers of incompatible proprietary formats for a given technology and for technologies that must interoperate.
questions.zh:

questions.name: #767 Consultants
questions.en:
Consultants are generally brought in on the important decisions that are vital to the future of the company, to make sure the every angle is considered.
They can devote themselves entirely to the question at hand, while executives are normally busy with the actual running of the company.
Consultants also offer deep expertise in a particular industry or subject, such as market positioning or restructuring.
questions.zh:
通常，在涉及公司未来的重大决策时，会请顾问来确保方方面面都考虑周全。
顾问可以全身心投入当前问题，而高管们通常忙于公司的日常运营。
顾问还能在特定行业或领域提供深厚专业知识，比如市场定位或重组。

questions.name: #768 Two-pronged Policy
questions.en:
After a pandemic with major social and economic consequences, emerging and developing countries need to swiftly address a two-pronged policy objective: sovereign debt sustainability and being able to fund investment, especially investment with high economic and social returns.
So far, the international community has alleviated the liquidity strain among developing countries and quickened the mobilization of financial resources.
questions.zh:
经历了造成重大社会和经济后果的疫情后，新兴和发展中国家需要迅速应对一个双重政策目标：主权债务可持续性以及能够为投资提供资金，尤其是那些具有高经济和社会回报的投资。
到目前为止，国际社会已经缓解了发展中国家的流动性压力，并加快了金融资源的调动。

questions.name: #769 Belt and Road Initiative
questions.en:
China’s Belt and Road Initiative is enhancing development prospects and creating new business opportunities in Asia, one of the world’s most dynamic regions.
Announced in 2013, it is an ambitious plan to promote economic cooperation with countries around the world that has increasingly defined mainland China’s global engagement.
The official goals are to promote connectivity: policy coordination, facilities connectivity, unimpeded trade, financial integration and people-to-people bonds.
questions.zh:
中国的‘一带一路’倡议正在提升亚洲这个全球最具活力地区之一的发展前景，并创造新的商业机遇。
该倡议于2013年提出，是一项雄心勃勃的计划，旨在促进与全球各国的经济合作，它日益成为中国参与全球事务的标志性举措。
其官方目标是促进互联互通：政策沟通、设施联通、贸易畅通、资金融通和民心相通。

questions.name: #770 Smart Cities
questions.en:
Smart cities are emerging as major engines for deploying intelligent systems to enhance urban development.
In developing economies facing rapid urbanization and technological change, new cities are being built with smart technologies and ideals, complete with business districts and residential facilities to entice businesses and talents to relocate.
Governments tout the potential of such ‘greenfield’ smart cities for innovation and sustainability.
questions.zh:
智慧城市正成为部署智能系统以推动城市发展的重要引擎。
在面临快速城市化和技术变革的发展中经济体，新城正在以智能技术和理念建设，配备商业区和住宅设施，以吸引企业和人才迁入。
政府大力宣传这类‘绿地’智慧城市在创新和可持续发展方面的潜力。

questions.name: #771 Venture Capitals
questions.en:
Venture capitals and public funding authorities need to carefully consider the incentive issues of entrepreneurs when providing support.
In allocating resources to potentially competing innovators, there is a trade-off between the risk of innovation failure and rent dissipation: diverse investment lowers the risk of having no successful innovation but also reduces the expected profit from the post-innovation market.
questions.zh:
风投机构和公共资助机构在提供支持时，需要仔细考虑企业家的激励问题。
在向可能相互竞争的创新者分配资源时，需要在创新失败的风险与租金消散之间权衡：多元化投资降低了创新完全失败的风险，但也减少了创新后市场的预期利润。

questions.name: #772 Primitive Men
questions.en:
The findings of modern research support the view that the evolution of primitive men and their culture should be regarded as “unity”.
Yet this unity is exceedingly complex, and future research will doubtless enable us to make finer distinctions between the periods that people composed it.
questions.zh:
现代研究结果支持一个观点，即原始人类及其文化的进化应被视为一个“整体”。
然而，这个整体极其复杂，未来的研究无疑将帮助我们更细致地划分构成它的各个时期。

questions.name: #773 Infant Brain
questions.en:
Along with all that they have in common, infants also show unique individual traits.
Some are more active than others, some are more sociable and some are more interested in the world around them.
Infants earlier on show consistent differences in friendliness and anxiety level which form part of their early character.
questions.zh:
除了共同点之外，婴儿还表现出独特的个性特征。
有些比别的更活跃，有些更善于社交，有些则对周围的世界更感兴趣。
婴儿在早期就表现出友好和焦虑程度上的稳定差异，这些构成了他们早期性格的一部分。

questions.name: #774 Walking Tour
questions.en:
The information session is a 45-minute presentation conducted by an admission representative.
Immediately following the session is a 90-minute walking tour of the campus led by a student ambassador.
Walking tours of the campus generally include classroom buildings, a residence hall room, a dining hall, the library, athletic facilities, performing art facilities, and the student union.

说明会结束后，紧接着是由学生大使带领的90分钟校园徒步游览。
校园徒步游览通常包括教学楼、宿舍房间、食堂、图书馆、体育设施、表演艺术设施以及学生会大楼。

questions.name: #775 Medical Digitalization
questions.en:
In medicine, the application of information technology means the digitalization of medical records and the establishment of an intelligent network for sharing those records.
Other benefits flow from these technological changes.
In the past medicine has taken a paternalistic stance, with the all-knowing physician dispensing wisdom, but that is becoming increasingly untenable.
questions.zh:
在医学领域，信息技术的应用意味着病历的数字化以及建立用于共享这些病历的智能网络。
这些技术变革还带来了其他好处。
过去，医学采取了一种家长式的姿态，全知全能的医生传授智慧，但这越来越站不住脚了。

questions.name: #776 Regular Exercise
questions.en:
Regular exercise releases brain chemicals key for memory, concentration, and mental sharpness at the same time as lifting your mood, and lowering stress and anxiety all of which contribute to brain health.
Studies show that regular exercise helps you manage complex tasks, organize and razor-sharpen your focus which is great for those long revision sessions or particularly complex exam questions.

定期锻炼能释放对记忆力、注意力和思维敏锐度至关重要的脑内化学物质，同时还能改善情绪、降低压力和焦虑，这些都有助于大脑健康。
研究表明，定期锻炼有助于你处理复杂任务、进行组织整理并极大地集中注意力，这对于长时间的复习或特别复杂的考试题目非常有益。

questions.name: #780 Eagles
questions.en:
Neither golden eagles nor bald eagles are endangered species.
The US bald eagle population has more than quadrupled since 2009, from around 72,000 to 317,000 birds.
But the US golden eagle population is still relatively small – around 30,000 birds – and at risk of declining.
questions.zh:
金雕和白头海雕都不是濒危物种。
自2009年以来，美国白头海雕的数量已经增长了三倍多，从大约7.2万只增加到31.7万只。
但美国金雕的数量仍然相对较少——大约3万只——并且面临下降的风险。

questions.name: #783 Noise Restrictions
questions.en:
The noise restrictions are based on measurements on animals in captivity exposed to noise levels that induce a temporary threshold shift (TTS) in hearing.
The TTS onset threshold is the lowest noise exposure capable of inducing a small temporary reduction of hearing sensitivity, also known as auditory fatigue, with full recovery shortly after exposure.
questions.zh:
噪音限制是基于对圈养动物的测量，这些动物暴露在能引起暂时性听力阈值偏移（TTS）的噪音水平下。
TTS起始阈值是指能引起听力灵敏度小幅暂时下降的最低噪音暴露水平，这种下降也称为听觉疲劳，暴露后不久即可完全恢复。

questions.name: #788 Era of Mayan
questions.en:
The Classic Era of Mayan came to an end around 900 AD.
Why this happened is unclear; the cities were probably over-farming the land, so that a period of drought led to famine.
Recent geological research supports this, as there appears to have been a 200-year drought around this time.
questions.zh:
玛雅经典时期大约在公元900年结束。
其原因尚不明确；城市可能过度开垦土地，导致一段干旱期引发了饥荒。
近期的地质研究支持这一观点，因为大约在这个时期出现过持续200年的干旱迹象。

questions.name: #790 Electric Vehicles
questions.en:
Electric vehicles have arrived.
With technology led by Tesla, and all of the world's major car manufacturers following along behind, electric vehicles are now a common sight on the roads of most developed countries.
Yet the situation in less developed countries is rather different; the only African country to have started the change to electric vehicles is South Africa.
questions.zh:
电动车已经来了。
在特斯拉引领技术、全球主要汽车制造商紧随其后的背景下，如今在大多数发达国家的道路上，电动车已成为常见景象。
然而，欠发达国家的情况却大不相同；唯一开始向电动车转型的非洲国家是南非。

questions.name: #791 Neutron Stars
questions.en:
Neutron stars — the compressed remains of massive stars gone supernova — are the densest "normal" objects in the known universe (black holes are technically denser, but far from normal).
Just a single sugar-cube worth of neutron-star material would weigh 100 million tons here on Earth, or about the same as the entire human population.
questions.zh:
中子星是大质量恒星发生超新星爆炸后压缩形成的残骸，是已知宇宙中密度最大的“正常”天体（黑洞理论上密度更大，但远非正常）。
仅一块方糖大小的中子星物质，在地球上就重达一亿吨，大约相当于全人类的总重量。

questions.name: #792 Fireworks
questions.en:
A dramatic fireworks display can be the highlight of a summer.
It also can provide a feast for the senses.
Bright colors delight the eye.
Thunderous booms and whistles surprise the ear.
If you’re close to the show, you can feel the pressure waves that ripple from each exploding shell.
And folks downwind of the action can smell the burnt gunpowder that fueled each rocket — and perhaps even taste it in the air.
questions.zh:
一场壮观的烟花表演往往是夏日的重头戏。
它也能带来一场感官的盛宴。
绚丽的色彩令人赏心悦目。
雷鸣般的轰鸣和呼啸声让人耳目一新。
如果你离表演很近，还能感受到每枚烟花爆炸时产生的压力波。
而处于下风方向的人们，可以闻到推动火箭升空的火药味，甚至能在空气中尝到它的味道。

questions.name: #793 Clock Genes
questions.en:
What produce these effects are familiar to neuroscientists: external light and dark signals that help set our daily or circadian rhythms, “clock” genes that act as internal timekeepers, and neurons that signal to one another through connections called synapses.
But how these factors interact to freshen a brain once we do sleep has remained enigmatic.
questions.zh:
产生这些效应的因素神经科学家们都很熟悉：外部光线和黑暗信号帮助设定我们的日常节律或昼夜节律，“时钟”基因作为内部计时器，以及通过称为突触的连接相互传递信号的神经元。
但一旦我们入睡，这些因素如何相互作用来让大脑焕然一新，至今仍是个谜。

questions.name: #794 Cloud Seeding
questions.en:
Cloud seeding, a form of weather modification, is a way of attempting to change the amount of precipitation that comes from clouds.
Cloud seeding is carried out by dispersing substances into the air, but it also occurs due to ice nuclei in nature, most of which are bacterial in origin.
questions.zh:
人工增雨是一种天气调节手段，试图改变云层带来的降水量。
人工增雨通过向空气中播撒物质来实现，但自然界的冰核也会引发这一过程，其中大部分源自细菌。

questions.name: #795 Japan
questions.en:
Japan is the world's calculator superpower.
Japanese manufacturers have led sales of calculators for over 30 years in many countries.
Even in the age of personal computers, calculators are still essential in accounting jobs.
In addition, calculators with graphing capabilities have begun to be used in education.
questions.zh:
日本是全世界计算器领域的超级大国。
三十多年来，日本制造的计算器在许多国家一直销量领先。
即便在个人电脑时代，计算器在会计工作中仍然不可或缺。
此外，具备绘图功能的计算器已开始应用于教育领域。

questions.name: #796 Amphibians
questions.en:
Whether salamander, frog or toad, amphibians are some of the most diverse and far-flung animals on the planet.
However, they're disappearing, and experts are worried since frogs are considered bellwethers for the environment.
Their double life makes them unique.
It's through their skin that they breathe and drink water because their skin is so permeable.
questions.zh:
不管是蝾螈、青蛙还是蟾蜍，两栖动物都是地球上种类最多、分布最广的动物之一。
然而，它们正在消失，专家们很担忧，因为青蛙被认为是环境的预警指标。
它们的双重生活使它们与众不同。
它们通过皮肤呼吸和喝水，因为它们的皮肤渗透性很强。

questions.name: #798 Mediterranean Diet
questions.en:
Countries bordering the Mediterranean have built up a solid reputation for sunshine, great tasting food as well as impressive health statistics, featuring some of the lowest rates of heart disease, and increased life expectancy.
This has created a lot of attention towards the Mediterranean diet, which is not a typical weight loss diet, but more of a set of habits.
questions.zh:
地中海沿岸国家以阳光充沛、美食诱人以及令人瞩目的健康数据而闻名，心脏病发病率极低，人均寿命更长。
这使地中海饮食备受关注，它并非典型的减肥食谱，而更像是一套饮食习惯。

questions.name: #799 Intangible Assets
questions.en:
Intangible assets perform a number of distinctive functions in the life of each company.
Firstly, they witness the prosperity of the firm in its good name.
Such a position allows human resource management to employ professional workers and increase labor productivity.
Moreover, intangible assets guarantee future value for the firm.
And although it is difficult to destroy intangible assets, they can lose their importance in case of carelessness or business failure.
questions.zh:
在每个公司的生命周期中，无形资产发挥着若干独特的作用。
首先，它们通过公司的良好声誉见证了其繁荣。
这种地位使得人力资源部门能够聘请专业人才，从而提高劳动生产率。
此外，无形资产为公司未来的价值提供了保障。
尽管无形资产难以被摧毁，但如果管理不善或经营失败，它们可能会失去其重要性。

questions.name: #800 Motorcycle Crash
questions.en:
If you do experience a motorcycle crash, be aware the other driver will most likely blame you for the accident.
This includes the road, road conditions, any skid marks, road signs, construction, and anything else that may have contributed to the accident.
Not every accident requires an attorney but a knowledgeable local attorney can help you make sense of the process, as well as ensure that the other driver's insurance doesn't unfairly blame you for the accident.
questions.zh:
如果你真的遭遇了摩托车事故，要知道对方司机很可能会把责任推到你身上。
这包括道路、路况、任何刹车痕迹、路标、施工情况，以及其他任何可能导致事故的因素。
并非所有事故都需要律师，但一位熟悉当地情况的律师能帮你理清流程，并确保对方保险公司不会不公平地把事故责任归咎于你。

questions.name: #801 Clean Water
questions.en:
Many people are under the impression that the water which comes out of a plant is clean.
This is a common misconception: the function of a plant is to make the water cleaner, but it's not clean enough to drink.
It could be used in irrigation.
What a plant is trying to do is simply speed up a process that would naturally occur given more time.
This means that a plant can create water that is safe to enter back into the water system as it's so heavily diluted.
The river then continues the water purification, acting as a form of the fourth stage.
questions.zh:
很多人都觉得工厂里排出来的水是干净的。
这是个常见的误解：工厂的作用是让水变得更干净，但还没有干净到能喝的程度。
这种水可以用于灌溉。
工厂其实只是在加速一个自然发生的过程，只不过自然需要更长时间。
这意味着工厂生产的水可以安全地重新进入水循环，因为它被大量稀释了。
然后河流会继续净化水质，相当于第四阶段的处理。

questions.name: #802 Nikola Tesla
questions.en:
As the inventor of alternating-current technology, Nikola Tesla played a paramount role in the electricity used to power the entire world.
Tesla also worked diligently on a dream of supplying electrical power without wires.
Thomas Edison was also instrumental in shaping society today with his inventions.
Edison's design of the inside of the light bulb was the crucial key to making a light that would stay lit for hours instead of going out almost immediately.
questions.zh:
作为交流电技术的发明者，尼古拉·特斯拉在驱动全世界的电力应用中扮演了至关重要的角色。
特斯拉还孜孜不倦地追求着一个梦想：实现无需电线的电力供应。
托马斯·爱迪生的发明同样对塑造当今社会起到了重要作用。
爱迪生对灯泡内部的设计是让灯泡持续发光数小时而非瞬间熄灭的关键所在。

questions.name: #803 Immune Vigilance
questions.en:
The problem is that increased immune vigilance has a side effect: allergies.
Our speculation is that this is some kind of trade-off.
In the past you needed to resist some kind of pathogen, and the trade-off or sacrifice you have to make is increased responsiveness to nonpathogenic allergens.
So next time some of you get the springtime sniffles, blame your distant ancestor — the one with the heavy brow ridge.
questions.zh:
问题在于免疫系统过于警觉会带来一个副作用：过敏。
我们推测这算是一种权衡。
过去你需要抵抗某种病原体，而付出的代价或牺牲就是对非病原性过敏原的反应增强。
所以下次有人春天打喷嚏时，就怪你那长着浓眉的远祖吧。

questions.name: #804 Home Design
questions.en:
One of the major factors influencing future home design will be the probable change in climate, with hotter summers, colder winters, and the possibility of floods.
Consequently, houses will be built with better insulation and will also need ways of keeping cool in hot weather, whether that’s air conditioning or more shading of windows.
questions.zh:
影响未来住宅设计的主要因素之一可能是气候变化，夏天更热，冬天更冷，还有可能发生洪水。
因此，房屋的隔热性能会更好，还需要有在炎热天气里降温的方法，不管是空调还是给窗户多加些遮阳设施。

questions.name: #807 Standard of Living
questions.en:
Research has found we pursue more rewards when we become 'habituated' to a higher standard of living and compare ourselves to various standards.
What it takes to be happy depends on our prior expectations, but these expectations can change over time.
questions.zh:
研究发现，当我们适应了更高的生活水平，并不断与各种标准比较时，我们会追求更多的回报。
幸福的条件取决于我们之前的期望，但这些期望会随时间改变。

questions.name: #808 Gut Microbiome
questions.en:
Research has shown that the gut microbiome is important for human physiology and health.
Disturbances to the composition of the gut microbiome can be associated with chronic diseases such as gastrointestinal inflammatory disorders, neurological, cardiovascular and respiratory illnesses.
The human body has evolved strategies to ensure that a symbiotic relationship exists between the microbes in our gut and our cells.
questions.zh:

questions.name: #810 Space Telescope
questions.en:
James Webb Space Telescope was specifically designed to observe this light, which comes from some of the oldest galaxies to take form.
How did early stars and galaxies take shape?
What about the cosmic material that is undetectable, known as dark matter?
Is there evidence for it in the early eons of the universe?
These are some of the perplexing and fascinating questions that astronomers can begin unraveling with Webb.
questions.zh:
詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜就是专门用来观测这种光的，它来自一些最早形成的古老星系。
早期的恒星和星系是如何形成的？
那些无法探测到的宇宙物质，也就是暗物质，又是怎么回事？
在宇宙早期的漫长岁月里，有暗物质存在的证据吗？
这些正是天文学家借助韦伯望远镜可以开始解答的一些令人困惑又着迷的问题。

questions.name: #811 Earthquake
questions.en:
Investigations like this one have been plodding along for 40 years, and some studies — like one following the deadly Kobe quake in 1995 — have found similar correlations.
But study author Alasdair Skelton, a professor of geochemistry at Stockholm University, says the unpredictable study subject makes it tough to get funding because you can in no way guarantee a result.
So l get three years of money, but if there’s no earthquake, there's no result.
questions.zh:
像这样的调查已经进行了40年，一些研究——比如追踪1995年神户致命地震的那项——也发现了类似的关联。
但研究作者、斯德哥尔摩大学地球化学教授阿拉斯代尔·斯凯尔顿表示，这个不可预测的研究对象很难获得资金支持，因为你根本无法保证结果。
所以我拿到了三年的经费，但如果没发生地震，就没有结果。

questions.name: #812 Mosquito Diseases
questions.en:
To prevent mosquito-transmitted diseases, approaches based on genetic control of insect populations are being developed.
However, many of these strategies are based on highly invasive, self-propagating transgenes that can rapidly spread the trait into other populations of mosquitoes.
questions.zh:
为了防止蚊子传播的疾病，基于昆虫种群遗传控制的方法正在开发中。
然而，其中许多策略依赖于高度侵入性、自我传播的转基因，这些基因可以迅速将这一特性扩散到其他蚊子种群中。

questions.en:
Changes in climate affect, for example, the plant and animal life of a given area.
The presence of coal beds in North America and Europe along with evidence of glaciation in these same areas indicates that they must have experienced alternately warmer and colder climates than they now possess.

questions.name: #815 Political Scholars
questions.en:
Political scholars had historically recognized the social love of the mass media.
The impact of the mass media on the election and governing process has greatly increased over the last fifty years.
Tomorrow, the mass media will become the "central nervous system" for your society and the major source of public information.

政治学者历来认可大众媒体的社会关爱作用。
过去五十年间，大众媒体对选举和治理过程的影响大大增强。
明天，大众媒体将成为社会的'中枢神经系统'和公共信息的主要来源。

questions.name: #817 Blinking
questions.en:
Every few seconds, our eyelids automatically shutter and our eyeballs roll back in their sockets.
So why doesn't blinking plunge us into intermittent darkness and light?
New research shows that the brain works extra hard to stabilize our vision despite our fluttering eyes.
When our eyeballs roll back in their sockets during a blink, they don't always return to the same spot when we reopen our eyes.
questions.zh:
每隔几秒，我们的眼皮就会自动闭合，眼球在眼眶里向后转动。
那么，为什么眨眼不会让我们陷入忽明忽暗的交替中呢？
新研究表明，尽管眼睛在眨动，大脑会加倍努力来稳定我们的视觉。
当我们眨眼时眼球在眼眶里向后转动，再睁开时它们并不总能回到原来的位置。

questions.name: #818 Brain Efficiency
questions.en:
Efficiency is not your friend when it comes to cognitive growth.
In order to keep our brains making new connections and keep them active, you need to keep moving on to another challenging activity as soon as you reach the point of mastery in the one you were engaging in.
questions.zh:

为了让大脑不断建立新连接、保持活跃，一旦你在某个挑战性活动中达到精通程度，就得赶紧转向下一个有难度的任务。

questions.name: #819 Psychology
questions.en:
Psychology is the study of cognitions, emotions, and behavior.
Psychologists are involved in a variety of tasks.
Many spend their careers designing and performing research to understand how people behave in specific situations, how and why we think the way we do, and how emotions develop and what impact they have on our interactions with others.
questions.zh:
心理学研究的是人的认知、情绪和行为。

questions.name: #820 Central Idea
questions.en:
The central idea of this book concerns our blindness with respect to randomness, particularly the large deviations: why do we, scientists or nonscientists, hotshots or regular Joes, tend to see the pennies instead of the dollars?
Why do we keep focusing on the minutiae, not the possible significant large events, in spite of the obvious evidence of their huge influence?
questions.zh:
这本书的核心观点是关于我们对随机性的视而不见，尤其是那些巨大的偏差：为什么我们——无论是科学家还是普通人，成功人士还是平凡之辈——总是只看到小钱，而忽略了大钱？
为什么我们总是关注那些细枝末节，而不是可能发生的重大事件，尽管有显而易见的证据表明它们影响巨大？

questions.name: #821 Rapid Change
questions.en:
An environment of rapid change, technological innovations and increasing business competitiveness has highlighted the growing importance of management development.
In particular, the general movement towards great employee involvement and making things happen through people has emphasized an integrating rather than a controlling style of management.

questions.name: #823 Addictive Games
questions.en:
Bolstered by the result of laboratory experiments, researchers dare to say that gaming might be mentally enriching.
These scholars are the first to admit that games could be addictive, and indeed part of their research explores how games connect to the reward circuit of human beings.

这些学者率先承认游戏可能成瘾，而且他们研究的一部分正是探索游戏如何连接人类的奖赏回路。

questions.name: #824 Animal Fighting
questions.en:
When someone commits a criminal act, we always hope the punishment will match the offense.
But when it comes to one of the cruelest crimes, animal fighting, things rarely work out that way.
Dog-fighting victims are tortured and killed for profit and "sport", yet their criminal abusers often receive a minimal sentence for causing a lifetime of pain.
questions.zh:
当有人犯了罪，我们总希望惩罚能与罪行相称。
但说到最残忍的罪行之一——动物斗殴，情况往往并非如此。
斗狗受害者为了利益和“娱乐”而被折磨致死，然而给它们带来一生痛苦的罪犯却往往只受到很轻的判决。

questions.name: #825 Cultivated Language
questions.en:
In every cultivated language there are two great classes of words which, taken together, comprise the whole vocabulary.
First, there are those words with which we become acquainted in daily conversation, which we learn from the members of our own family and from our familiar associates, and which we should know and use even if we could not read or write.
questions.zh:
每种经过锤炼的语言里，都有两大类词汇，它们合起来构成了整个词汇库。
首先，有些词是我们日常对话中熟悉的，从家人和亲密伙伴那里学来的，即便不识字，我们也该认识并使用它们。

questions.name: #826 Circumcision
questions.en:
The role of women in promoting voluntary medical male circumcision uptake: research reveals the important role played by women in influencing men to undergo circumcision.
Women are also motivated to convince men to undergo male circumcision because of the benefits associated with them such as reduction of HIV transmission and cervical cancer.
questions.zh:
研究表明，女性在推动男性自愿接受包皮环切手术方面发挥了关键作用，她们能有效影响男性做出这一决定。
女性之所以积极说服男性接受包皮环切，是因为这能降低艾滋病传播和宫颈癌风险，对她们自身也有好处。

questions.name: #827 Early Puberty
questions.en:
Covid-19 pandemic is linked to early onset of puberty in some girls.
Several studies suggest that the number of girls starting puberty early has more than doubled amid the coronavirus outbreak, and experts are unsure about exactly why.

多项研究表明，疫情期间提前进入青春期的女孩数量翻了一倍多，专家们也不确定具体原因。

questions.name: #828 Meatless Diet

这种关联与社会经济状况、生活方式因素以及营养缺乏无关。

questions.name: #831 Window in Painting
questions.en:
We can see from the X-rays that at an early stage of painting, a window was painted at the left of the portrait.
It seems that there may have been two windows in the initial design for the portrait or that the window was moved at an early stage.
questions.zh:
从X光片中可以看到，在画作的早期阶段，肖像左侧曾画有一扇窗户。
这幅肖像最初的构图似乎可能有两扇窗户，或者窗户在早期阶段被移动过。

questions.name: #835 Macroeconomics
questions.en:
This report includes a huge swath of macroeconomics, such as the effects of tax reform, a new industrial policy, and understanding how to deal with the uncertainty inherent in global financial market.
But it also covers key areas of microeconomic policies, such as boosting laggardly rates of productivity.
questions.zh:
这份报告涵盖了宏观经济学的广阔领域，比如税制改革的影响、新产业政策，以及如何应对全球金融市场固有的不确定性。
但它也涉及了微观经济政策的关键领域，比如提振落后的生产率水平。

questions.name: #836 Flood Control
questions.en:
We've spent a lot of money over the last seventy years on flood control, and it's protected millions of people and has saved us billions of dollars.
We've built dams to hold back the waters.
We've built levees to keep the water off the people, and we've raised the ones that were originally started in seventeen eighteen.
questions.zh:
过去七十年里，我们在防洪上投入了大量资金，保护了数百万人，并节省了数十亿美元。
我们修建了大坝来阻挡洪水。
我们建造了堤坝来保护人们免受水患，并加高了那些最初于1718年修建的堤坝。

questions.name: #837 What We Want
questions.en:
We want a recreation in adulthood of what it felt like to be administered to and indulged.
In a secret part of our minds, we picture someone who will understand our needs, bring us what we want, to be immensely patient and sympathetic to us, act selflessly, and make it all better.
questions.zh:
我们希望在成年后能重温那种被照顾、被纵容的感觉。
在我们心底深处，我们想象着有一个人，能理解我们的需求，给我们想要的东西，对我们极其耐心和同情，无私地付出，让一切变得更好。

questions.name: #838 International Women's Day
questions.en:
International Women's Day is marked on March 8 every year.
Countries around the world celebrate it to give credit to the economic, political and social achievements of women and to show respect to their contributions in the development of their countries.
It's only in the beginning of the 20th century that the day was officially and internationally acknowledged due to the rapid industrialization and the social protest that it accompanied.
questions.zh:
每年的3月8日是国际妇女节。
世界各国都会庆祝这一天，以表彰女性在经济、政治和社会领域取得的成就，并表达对她们为国家发展所做贡献的敬意。
直到20世纪初，随着快速工业化及其伴随的社会抗议，这一天才正式获得国际认可。

questions.name: #839 Hernia
questions.en:
A hernia is a weakness or opening in the abdominal wall, which often results in soft tissue such as fat protruding through the abdominal muscles and occupying space under the skin.
The mechanism of the hernia is similar to what happens with a bulge in a damaged tire, where the inner tube, normally contained by the hard rubber of the tire, extends through a thin or weakened place.
questions.zh:
疝气就是腹壁出现了一个薄弱点或缺口，常常导致脂肪这类软组织从腹肌间挤出来，在皮肤下面形成一个鼓包。
疝气的原理跟轮胎鼓包差不多——轮胎的硬橡胶本该包住内胎，但如果某个地方变薄或变弱了，内胎就会从那里鼓出来。

questions.name: #840 Ecofuels
questions.en:
Fast growth in both world energy demand and carbon dioxide emissions due to fossil fuels has resulted in search for alternative sources which are not only renewable but also environment friendly.
One of these alternative source is ecofuels which are solid, liquid, or gaseous fuels primarily produced from biomass.
The solid ecofuels include wood, animal dung, municipal waste, and energy crops.
questions.zh:
全球能源需求快速增长，化石燃料导致的二氧化碳排放量也随之增加，这促使人们寻找既可再生又环保的替代能源。
其中一种替代能源是生态燃料，它是一种主要从生物质中提取的固体、液体或气体燃料。
固体生态燃料包括木材、动物粪便、城市垃圾和能源作物。

questions.name: #841 Copyright
questions.en:
Anyone who creates something artistic, such as fashion photos on the shoe, automatically has copyright to them.
It consists of a financial right that is possible to license or sell, and a non-profit right that cannot be agreed away.
The latter means that you always have the right to be mentioned in connection with your work being used.
questions.zh:
任何人创作的艺术作品，比如鞋子上的时尚照片，都自动拥有其版权。
它包含可许可或出售的财务权利，以及不可协议放弃的非营利权利。
后者意味着，当你的作品被使用时，你始终有权被提及。

questions.name: #842 Property Right
questions.en:
A common way of permitting others to use an intellectual property right is to give express permission for it.
This can be done in return for financial remuneration.
In such cases, the holder of an intellectual property right is often referred to as granting a license to use what the holder otherwise has exclusive rights to, subject to certain conditions.
questions.zh:
允许他人使用知识产权的一种常见方式是明确授权。
这通常是为了换取经济报酬。
在这种情况下，知识产权持有人通常被称为授予许可，允许他人在特定条件下使用持有人原本拥有专有权的权利。

This can be done in return for financial remuneration.

questions.name: #843 Frogs
questions.en:
Frogs have excellent night vision and are very sensitive to movement.
The bulging eyes of most frogs allow them to see in front, to the sides, and partially behind them.
When a frog swallows food, it pulls its eyes down into the roof of its mouth, to help push the food down its throat.
questions.zh:

大多数青蛙鼓起的眼睛能让它们看到前方、两侧以及部分后方。
青蛙吞咽食物时，会把眼睛下拉到口腔顶部，帮助把食物推下喉咙。

questions.name: #844 Home Fencing
questions.en:
The benefits of home fencing are not only as a barrier between the area of the house and the surrounding environment.
In simple words, a fence is a formation or structure that is above the ground and is generally vertical, with the intention of limiting an area or areas, protecting everything inside the fence, from threatening danger from outside the fence.
questions.zh:
家庭围栏的好处不仅仅在于它作为房屋区域与周围环境之间的屏障。
简单来说，围栏是一种高出地面、通常垂直的构造或结构，旨在限定某个或多个区域，保护围栏内的一切免受外部威胁的危害。

questions.name: #845 Supermassive Black Hole
questions.en:
Astronomers announced that they have finally assembled an image of the supermassive black hole at the center of our galaxy.
This image shows a bright ring surrounding the darkness, the telltale sign of the shadow of the black hole.
It reveals the turbulent, twisting region immediately surrounding the black hole in new detail.
questions.zh:
天文学家宣布，他们终于拼合出了我们银河系中心那个超大质量黑洞的图像。
这张图像显示了一个明亮的环围绕着黑暗区域，这正是黑洞阴影的明显标志。
它以前所未有的细节揭示了黑洞周围那个湍急、扭曲的区域。

questions.name: #846 Pocket Money
questions.en:
Giving pocket money to children as young as four or five years helps them start learning about the value of money and money management.
When children get pocket money, they have to make choices about spending or saving.
Pocket money can also help children learn about consequences, including the consequences of losing money or spending it unwisely.
Letting your children make a few mistakes is part of the learning process.
questions.zh:
从四五岁开始给孩子零花钱，能让他们从小了解钱的价值和理财。
孩子拿到零花钱后，就得在花和存之间做选择。
零花钱还能帮孩子理解后果，比如丢了钱或乱花钱会怎样。
让孩子犯点错，也是学习的一部分。

questions.name: #847 Washing Machine
questions.en:
Programs, such as delicate wash or color wash, are one of the features of washing machines, particularly fully-automatic washing machines, which gives you the choice when it comes to how you want to wash your clothes.
If you’re washing with a certain fabric, then programs help you find the optimal washing conditions for your laundry needs from selecting the right wash temperature to setting up your washing timing.
questions.zh:
像轻柔洗或颜色洗这样的程序是洗衣机的一大特色，尤其是全自动洗衣机，它们让你可以选择如何清洗衣物。
如果你在洗某种面料的衣服，这些程序能帮你找到最佳的洗涤条件，从选择合适的洗涤温度到设定洗涤时间，满足你的洗衣需求。

questions.name: #848 Particle Accelerator
questions.en:
Particle accelerators produce and accelerate beams of charged particles, such as electrons, protons and ions, of atomic and sub-atomic size.
They are used not only in fundamental research for an improved understanding of matter, but also in plethora of socioeconomic applications related to environmental monitoring, food quality, energy and aerospace technologies.

粒子加速器能产生并加速原子和亚原子尺寸的带电粒子束，比如电子、质子和离子。
它们不仅用于基础研究以增进对物质的理解，还广泛应用于环境监测、食品质量、能源和航空航天技术等社会经济领域。

questions.name: #849 Nuclear Safety
questions.en:
The prime responsibility for nuclear safety must rest with the person or organization responsible for these activities.
Regulating safety is a national responsibility.
However, radiation risks may transcend national borders, and international cooperation serves to promote and enhance safety globally by exchanging experience and by improving capabilities to mitigate any harmful consequences.
questions.zh:
核安全的首要责任必须由负责这些活动的人或组织承担。
安全监管是国家的责任。
然而，辐射风险可能超越国界，国际合作通过交流经验和提升缓解有害后果的能力，有助于在全球范围内促进和加强安全。

questions.name: #850 Flash Floods
questions.en:
Many floods take hours to come into full effect so they provide people with time to evacuate safely while salvaging as many of their valuable possessions as they can.
Sometimes, however, floods generate in minutes and give little warning to their formation.
These are known as flash floods, and can be extremely dangerous.
Flash floods are the top one weather-related cause of death in the United States.
questions.zh:
许多洪水需要数小时才能完全形成，因此人们有足够时间安全撤离，同时尽可能抢救贵重物品。
然而，有时洪水会在几分钟内形成，几乎没有任何预警。
这类洪水被称为山洪，极其危险。
在美国，山洪是导致死亡的头号气象相关原因。

questions.name: #851 Construction of Dams
questions.en:
The construction of dams is labour intensive.
Before construction begins, water is diverted or prevented from moving through the construction site.
After water is diverted, the foundation area is excavated, and sediments that will act as the foundation are repaired.
This is done to ensure the sediments won't shift or fail as a result of the load of the dam and reservoir.
questions.zh:
建造大坝是劳动密集型的工作。
在开始施工前，需要将水引开或阻止其流过施工现场。
水被引走后，要开挖地基区域，并对作为地基的沉积物进行修复。
这样做是为了确保沉积物不会因为大坝和水库的重量而移动或失效。

questions.name: #852 Eiffel Tower
questions.en:
Since the beginning, the Eiffel Tower drew attention and served as the theatre for numerous events in the life of Paris and France.
The Tower can be seen from many and various points around Paris and its suburbs.
It is photographed, filmed and replicated in all kinds of circumstances.
It naturally slipped into the role of symbolizing France in the collective imagination and in literature and poetry.
questions.zh:

从巴黎市区及郊区的很多地方都能看到这座铁塔。
它被以各种方式拍摄、录像和复制。
自然而然地，它在集体想象、文学和诗歌中成为了法国的象征。

questions.name: #853 Revolving Restaurants
questions.en:
The popular trend of revolving restaurants and bars began sometime in the early Sixties after the successful launch of such towering creations as the Space Needle.
But as the novelty wore off, the mechanical upkeep and maintenance of such ventures proved to be too costly for some entrepreneurs over time and many once-famous icons like Encounter Restaurant have since closed.
questions.zh:
旋转餐厅和酒吧这股热潮，大约始于六十年代初，那时像太空针塔这样的高耸建筑成功亮相后，便流行起来了。
但新鲜感一过，这类场所的机械维护成本对有些老板来说就太高了，时间一长，像 Encounter 餐厅这样曾经赫赫有名的地标，后来也关门了。

questions.name: #854 Stationary Bike
questions.en:
A stationary bike workout is a low-impact workout that uses smooth movements to strengthen bones and joints without putting much pressure on them.
Because your feet don’t lift off the pedals with a stationary bike, this option is kinder to your joints, but it still provides a challenging and effective workout.
questions.zh:

由于固定自行车骑行时脚不需要离开踏板，这种运动对关节更友好，但依然能提供有挑战且有效的锻炼。

questions.name: #855 Locusts
questions.en:
Titanic swarms of desert locusts resembling dark storm clouds are descending ravenously on the Horn of Africa.
They're roving through croplands and flattening farms in a devastating salvo experts are calling an unprecedented threat to food security.
On the ground, subsistence planters can do nothing but watch — staring up with horror and at their fields in dismay.
questions.zh:
铺天盖地的沙漠蝗虫群像黑色的风暴云一样，贪婪地扑向非洲之角。
它们横扫农田，摧毁农场，专家称这是一场对粮食安全构成空前威胁的毁灭性打击。
在地面上，自给自足的农民只能眼睁睁看着——惊恐地抬头望天，又绝望地看着自己的田地。

questions.en:
The most significant difference between an eating disorder and disordered eating is whether or not a person's symptoms and experiences align with the criteria defined by the American Psychiatric Association.

questions.name: #857 Turbine Blade
questions.en:
It’s not easy to make a wind turbine blade.
Conventional blades require a lot of labor.
They are a sandwich composed of fiberglass, sheets of balsa wood and a chemical called an epoxy thermoset resin.
A heat oven is required to give blades the proper shape, strength, smoothness and flexibility to catch the wind and turn the turbine.
questions.zh:
制造风力涡轮叶片可不容易。
传统叶片需要大量人力。
它们是一种夹层结构，由玻璃纤维、轻木片和一种叫环氧热固性树脂的化学物质组成。
需要加热炉才能让叶片拥有合适的形状、强度、光滑度和柔韧性，以便捕捉风力并转动涡轮。

questions.name: #858 Female Undergraduates
questions.en:
The most obvious change is that 46% of college undergraduates are now women.
When I went there, it was only the third year that women had been admitted, and then seemingly grudgingly: about 70% of students were male, and if there was a woman tutor she must have been a male impersonator.
questions.zh:
最明显的变化是，如今大学本科生中46%是女性。
我去那里的时候，那只是女性被录取的第三年，而且似乎还是勉强为之：当时约70%的学生是男性，即便有女导师，也一定是女扮男装的。

questions.name: #859 Global Changes
questions.en:
Globalization refers to a set of changes rather than a single change.
Many of these changes are social, cultural and political rather than purely economic, and one of the main drivers in addition to the global marketplace is the communication revolution.

这些变化许多是社会、文化和政治层面的，而不纯粹是经济层面的，除了全球市场之外，通信革命也是主要推动力之一。

questions.name: #860 War and Commodity
questions.en:
In the past, wars have led to inflation and higher commodity prices.
Fighting disrupts trade and prevents raw materials from being shipped from one country to another.
In second-world-war Britain, a banana was the highest of luxury.

冲突会扰乱贸易，阻碍原材料从一国运往另一国。
在二战时期的英国，一根香蕉就是顶级的奢侈品。

questions.name: #861 Reserve Bank
questions.en:
Most people do not realize that some banks literally make money by giving loans without having money on deposit.
The system is called fractional reserve banking and is used in most economies.
It sounds as though it is safe because it says that banks have to keep a fraction of their deposits with the Reserve Bank.
questions.zh:
大多数人没意识到，有些银行放贷赚钱时，手头根本没有存款。
这种制度叫部分准备金银行制，大多数经济体都在用。
听起来挺安全，因为规定银行得把一部分存款放在央行。

questions.name: #863 Essential Carbon
questions.en:
The carbon is essential to life on earth, but scientists still struggle to grasp its complexities.
Most research to date has focused on major sources of the greenhouse gas carbon dioxide, and the use of fossil fuels.
A new study has come to the counter-intuitive conclusion that plants might accumulate more carbon in the presence of predators and herbivores.
questions.zh:
碳对地球上的生命至关重要，但科学家们仍在努力理解其复杂性。
迄今为止，大多数研究都集中在温室气体二氧化碳的主要来源以及化石燃料的使用上。
一项新研究得出了一个反直觉的结论：在有捕食者和食草动物存在的情况下，植物可能会积累更多的碳。

questions.name: #864 Almonds
questions.en:
Eating a handful of almonds a day significantly increases the production of butyrate, a short-chain fatty acid that promotes gut health.
Whole-almond eaters had an additional 1.5 bowel movements per week compared to the other groups.
Eating almonds could also benefit those with constipation.

questions.name: #865 Affordable Childcare
questions.en:
Over the longer term, higher educational institutions are supported to either provide on-campus nursery space or work with established local nurseries to provide affordable childcare for students and staff.
This should be a standard for all universities and should be supported by the government to help universities and students and staff cover the costs.
questions.zh:
从长远来看，高等院校应得到支持，要么在校园内提供托儿空间，要么与当地成熟的托儿所合作，为学生和教职工提供负担得起的儿童保育服务。
这应该成为所有大学的标准，并得到政府的支持，以帮助大学、学生和教职工承担相关费用。

questions.name: #866 Cash-flow Problem
questions.en:
While costs are rising, artist fees are not, and tickets to regular shows are harder to move than ever.
Many fans aren’t ready to return to the crowded mosh; others are dealing with the cost of living crisis.
And with the exception of blockbuster shows, people who do buy tickets are tending to buy them last-minute, creating a cash-flow problem for artists.
questions.zh:
虽然成本在上涨，但艺术家们的酬劳却没涨，常规演出的门票比以往任何时候都难卖。
很多粉丝还没准备好回到拥挤的舞池；其他人则在应对生活成本危机。
除了那些火爆的演出，买票的人往往倾向于最后一刻才买，这给艺术家们带来了现金流问题。

questions.name: #867 Subjective and Objective
questions.en:
To understand how sharing affects a person’s subjective and objective knowledge, the researchers gave a group of students the opportunity to read and share a range of news articles.
The students then had to rate their subjective knowledge of each article before completing three multiple-choice questions that assessed their objective knowledge.
questions.zh:
为了了解分享如何影响一个人的主观和客观知识，研究人员让一组学生有机会阅读并分享一系列新闻文章。
然后，学生们需要先评估自己对每篇文章的主观知识，再完成三道选择题来测试他们的客观知识。

questions.name: #868 Eco-anxiety
questions.en:
Eco-anxiety refers to a fear of environmental damage or ecological disaster.
This sense of anxiety is largely based on the current and predicted future state of the environment and human-induced climate change.
Anxiety around environmental issues may stem from the awareness of a rising risk of extreme weather events, losses of livelihood or housing, fears for future generations, and feelings of helplessness.
questions.zh:

这种焦虑感主要源于环境现状以及人类活动引起的气候变化对未来的影响。
对环境问题的焦虑可能源于意识到极端天气事件风险增加、生计或住房损失、对后代的担忧以及无力感。

questions.name: #869 Liver Cancer
questions.en:
Liver cancer can be fatal, but experts are still working to understand how to best screen for and prevent liver cancer.
Data from a recent study suggests that a diet high in processed fiber could increase some people’s liver cancer risk.
Testing for the level of bile acids could help identify people at risk of developing liver cancer who may need a lower intake of fiber.
questions.zh:
肝癌可能致命，但专家们仍在努力研究如何最有效地筛查和预防肝癌。
最近一项研究的数据表明，高加工纤维的饮食可能会增加某些人患肝癌的风险。
检测胆汁酸水平有助于识别有肝癌风险、可能需要减少纤维摄入量的人群。

questions.name: #870 Mental Illness
questions.en:
In the not-so-distant past, society shunned people with mental health conditions.
Some people believed that evil spirits or divine retribution were responsible for mental illness.
Although this way of thinking has been extricated from society in much of the world, it still casts a long shadow.
questions.zh:
就在不久前，社会还排斥有心理健康问题的人。
有些人认为精神疾病是邪灵或天谴所致。
尽管这种思维方式在世界大部分地区已从社会中根除，但它仍然投下长长的阴影。

questions.name: #871 Historical Contingency
questions.en:
The teleology and historical contingency of biology make it unique among the sciences.
Both of these features stem from perhaps biology’s only general guiding principle: evolution.
It depends on chance and randomness, but natural selection gives it the appearance of intention and purpose.
Animals are drawn to water not by some magnetic attraction, but because of their instinct to survive.
questions.zh:
生物学因其目的性和历史偶然性而在科学中独树一帜。
这两个特点都源于生物学唯一的一般指导原则：进化。
它依赖于机遇和随机性，但自然选择使其看起来带有意图和目的。
动物被水吸引并非由于某种磁力，而是出于求生的本能。

questions.name: #872 Environmental Damage
questions.en:
Environmental damage does not affect all people equally.
For this reason, some people may feel anxiety around ecological issues more intensely.
Some parts of the world are more vulnerable to the effects of extreme weather, including coastal communities and low-lying areas.
Particularly, people whose livelihoods depend on the environment — such as those with jobs in fishing, tourism, and agriculture — are more likely to be affected.
questions.zh:
环境破坏对不同人群的影响并不均等。
因此，有些人对生态问题可能感到更强烈的焦虑。
世界上某些地区更容易受到极端天气的影响，包括沿海社区和低洼地区。
特别是那些生计依赖环境的人——比如从事渔业、旅游业和农业的人——更可能受到影响。

questions.name: #873 News Sharing
questions.en:
Social media is a powerful tool for making people feel more knowledgeable and may have benefits for people’s mental health.
‘Feeling smart can improve self-esteem,’ commented Dr. Ward.
Indeed, studies have shown that news sharing can lead to social learning and political engagement encouraging people to take more active roles in their communities.
questions.zh:
社交媒体是让人感觉更有见识的强大工具，可能对人们的心理健康有益。

事实上，研究表明，分享新闻可以促进社会学习和政治参与，鼓励人们在社区中发挥更积极的作用。

questions.en:
A lullaby or cradle song, is a soothing song or piece of music that is usually played for children.
The purposes of lullabies vary.
In some societies they are used to pass down cultural knowledge or tradition.
Lullabies can be found in many countries, and have existed since ancient times.

在某些社会中，它们被用来传承文化知识或传统。

questions.name: #875 Social Support
questions.en:
There’s a lot of research out there that suggests social media are a useful tool to stay connected to others.
In fact, those who use social media more also report feeling more social support.
However, all of this comes with a huge caveat: we simply don’t know about cause and effect.
questions.zh:

事实上，使用社交媒体越多的人，感受到的社会支持也越多。
然而，这一切都有一个巨大的前提：我们根本不知道其中的因果关系。

questions.name: #876 Sensitive Skin
questions.en:
People with generally sensitive skin have local reactions to chemicals, dyes, and fragrances present in products that come into contact with their skin.

有些人会对某些物质过敏，皮肤上可能出现反应。

questions.name: #877 Math Anxiety
questions.en:
People might think that they’re anxious about math because they’re bad at it, but it’s often the other way around.
They’re doing poorly in math because they’re anxious about it.
Some psychologists think that’s because math anxiety decreases a cognitive resource called working memory.
That’s the short-term memory system that helps you organize the information you need to complete a task.
questions.zh:
人们可能认为他们数学焦虑是因为数学不好，但实际情况往往相反。
他们数学成绩差是因为对数学感到焦虑。
一些心理学家认为，这是因为数学焦虑会减少一种叫做工作记忆的认知资源。
工作记忆是一种短期记忆系统，能帮你整理完成任务所需的信息。

questions.name: #878 Shopping Revolution
questions.en:
A huge shopping revolution is happening in China right now.
For instance, e-commerce in China is soaring.
It’s been growing at twice the speed of the United States and a lot of the growth is coming from mobile.
Every month, 500 million consumers are buying on mobile phones, and to put that into context, that is a total population of the United States, UK and Germany combined.
questions.zh:
中国正在经历一场巨大的购物革命。
例如，中国的电子商务正在迅猛发展。
其增长速度是美国的两倍，而且大部分增长来自移动端。
每个月有5亿消费者通过手机购物，打个比方，这相当于美国、英国和德国人口的总和。

questions.name: #879 Sensory Information
questions.en:
When you’re scared, your body will typically try to take in more sensory information.
So your face will open up as you breathe more deeply and scan the environment with your eyes.
On the other hand, when you’re disgusted, you’ll generally reject sensory information.

相反，当你感到厌恶时，通常会拒绝感官信息。

questions.name: #880 Odor Molecules
questions.en:
In fact, a lot of what we perceive as flavor comes from odor molecules that float up to our smell receptors through our mouths.
And as with taste, studies have shown the visual cues we get from color help us identify smells more quickly and accurately.
In fact, one study found that the source of a smell doesn't have to be the corresponding color.
questions.zh:
其实，我们感受到的很多味道都来自气味分子，它们通过口腔飘到我们的嗅觉受体上。
和味觉一样，研究表明颜色带来的视觉线索能帮助我们更快、更准确地识别气味。
事实上，一项研究发现，气味的来源并不一定需要和颜色对应。

questions.name: #881 Golden Goose
questions.en:
Successful economies and cultures are built on trust, but a number of high-profile data breaches and privacy intrusions have caused anxiety for consumers.
New legislation may be needed to bolster confidence in the digital marketplace, but we’ve got to be thoughtful about it.
So we don’t strangle the golden goose that we call the Internet.
questions.zh:
繁荣的经济和文化建立在信任之上，但一系列引人注目的数据泄露和隐私侵犯事件让消费者感到焦虑。
可能需要新的立法来增强人们对数字市场的信心，但我们必须慎重考虑。
这样才不会扼杀我们称之为互联网的这只金鹅。

questions.name: #882 American Birth Rates
questions.en:
Since its founding, America has enjoyed population growth famously fueled by high immigration rates, but Americans have historically had large families compared to other countries as well.
Birth rates today have fallen to their lowest point in history.
While birth rates have historically been connected to economic cycles, the present decline is happening during good economic times.
questions.zh:
自建国以来，美国一直享受着由高移民率推动的人口增长，但历史上美国人的家庭规模也比其他国家更大。
如今的出生率已降至历史最低点。
虽然出生率历来与经济周期相关，但当前的下降却发生在经济景气时期。

questions.name: #883 Recycling
questions.en:
The idea behind recycling is simple.
By breaking old products down and converting them into something usable again, we conserve natural resources.
Sadly it’s not that simple.
Recycling is deeply entwined with our economic system, and right now doesn’t make much economic sense.
It often costs more to recycle than it does to just throw things away, which is bad news for the environment.
questions.zh:
回收利用的理念其实很简单。
通过分解旧产品并将其转化为可再次使用的东西，我们节约了自然资源。
可惜事情没那么简单。
回收利用与我们的经济体系紧密相连，但目前在经济上并不划算。
回收往往比直接扔掉成本更高，这对环境来说是个坏消息。

questions.name: #884 Maturity and Kindness
questions.en:
For noble and very understandable reasons, we’ve come to associate maturity and kindness with a capacity not to give up on people.
But this broad and generous truth can be in danger of missing out on an important caveat that health and maturity may also require a subtle capacity to give up on one or two people.
questions.zh:
出于高尚且完全可以理解的原因，我们逐渐将成熟和善良与不放弃他人的能力联系在一起。
但这个广泛而慷慨的真理可能忽略了一个重要的告诫：健康和成熟可能也需要一种微妙的能力，去放弃一两个人。

questions.name: #885 Core Competence
questions.en:
The term core competence described a diversified corporation as a large tree.
The core products are the trunk and major limbs.
The business units are smaller branches, and the end products are the leaves.
The core competence is the root system that provides nourishment and stability.
It’s essentially what your organization knows about coordinating production and technology.

questions.name: #886 Busy People
questions.en:
Someone who looks extremely active, whose diary is filled from morning till night, who is always running to answer messages and meet clients may appear the opposite of lazy, but secretly, there may be a lot of avoidance going on beneath the outward frenzy.
Busy people can evade a different order of undertaking.
questions.zh:
有些人看起来精力充沛，日程从早排到晚，总是忙着回复消息、见客户，表面上一点都不懒，但暗地里，这种忙乱之下可能藏着很多逃避。
忙碌的人反而能避开另一类任务。

questions.name: #887 Yoga
questions.en:
But like other low-impact exercises, yoga reliably improves fitness and flexibility in healthy populations.
The practice has also been shown to be a potentially powerful therapeutic tool.
In studies involving patients with a variety of skeletal disorders, yoga was more helpful at reducing pain and improving mobility than other forms of low-impact exercise.

questions.name: #888 Lions and Lionesses
questions.en:
Lions and lionesses play different roles in the life of the pride.
The lionesses work together to hunt and help rear the cubs.
This allows them to get the most from their hard work, keeping them healthier and safer.
Being smaller and lighter than males, lionesses are more agile and faster.

雌狮们一起合作捕猎，并帮助抚养幼崽。
这样它们能从辛勤劳动中获得最大收益，保持更健康、更安全。
由于比雄狮更小更轻，雌狮更加敏捷和迅速。

questions.name: #889 Role of Surrounding
questions.en:
For as long as society has existed, we’ve understood the role of surrounding influences on our decision-making.
With idioms like “It takes a village to raise a child” and “You are the product of your environment,” we understand that to a great extent our upbringing, our parents and the society we grew up in influence our decision making process.
questions.zh:
自从人类社会存在以来，我们就明白周围环境对我们做决定的影响。
俗话说‘养一个孩子需要整个村庄’和‘你是环境的产物’，我们在很大程度上知道，我们的成长经历、父母以及成长的社会环境影响着我们的决策过程。

questions.name: #890 Carbon Footprint
questions.en:
The blame for over-consumption should not and cannot be placed solely on individuals.
Companies and corporations have a vested interest in making you buy more stuff because if they don’t, they go bankrupt.
This is why they slap green labels onto their products and advertise everywhere.
Indeed, the whole idea of a personal carbon footprint is a propaganda campaign created by a fossil fuel giant.
questions.zh:
过度消费的锅不应该、也不能全甩给个人。
公司和企业有切身利益让你多买东西，因为不这样他们就会破产。
所以他们到处给产品贴上绿色标签，铺天盖地做广告。
实际上，个人碳足迹这个概念本身就是一家化石燃料巨头搞出来的宣传把戏。

questions.name: #891 Plastics
questions.en:
If you walk into your kitchen, almost everything has encountered plastic in one way or another: the plastic bags you stuff into a drawer, your favorite cup, and even the packaging keeping those blueberries fresh.
Despite plastic’s ubiquity, we often forget where it comes from.
Indeed, when it comes to plastic, our efforts seem much more focused on what happens after rather than before we use it.
questions.zh:
走进厨房，你会发现几乎所有东西都以某种方式接触过塑料：塞进抽屉的塑料袋、你最喜欢的杯子，甚至让蓝莓保持新鲜的包装。
尽管塑料无处不在，我们却常常忘记它从何而来。
确实，提到塑料，我们的努力似乎更侧重于使用之后而非之前的情况。

questions.name: #892 Major Layoffs
questions.en:
As of Friday, Musk and Twitter had given no public notice of the coming layoffs, according to a spokesperson for California’s Employment Development Department.
That’s even though the Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification statute requires employers with at least 100 workers to disclose layoffs involving 500 or more employees, regardless of whether a company is publicly traded or privately held.
questions.zh:
截至周五，马斯克和推特仍未公开通知即将到来的裁员，加州就业发展部的一位发言人表示。
尽管《工人调整和再培训通知法》要求至少拥有100名员工的雇主披露涉及500名或以上员工的裁员，无论公司是上市公司还是私营企业。

questions.name: #893 Lunar Eclipse
questions.en:
For a lunar eclipse to occur, the Sun, Earth, and Moon must be roughly aligned in a line.
Otherwise, the Earth cannot cast a shadow on the Moon's surface and an eclipse cannot take place.
When the three bodies are aligned in a way that the Moon is partly covered by the Earth's umbra, a partial lunar eclipse is the result.
questions.zh:
要发生月食，太阳、地球和月球必须大致排成一条直线。
否则，地球无法在月球表面投下阴影，月食也就不会发生。
当这三个天体排列成月球部分被地球本影遮挡时，就会发生月偏食。

questions.name: #894 Impact of Psychology
questions.en:
Psychology is both an applied and academic field that benefits both individuals and society as a whole.
A large part of psychology is devoted to the diagnosis and treatment of mental health issues, but that is just the tip of the iceberg when it comes to the impact of psychology.

questions.name: #895 Good Stress
questions.en:
It is important to note that even "good" stress can lead to spikes in blood sugar levels.
Mental and physical stress, such as worrying about your job or getting sick, can create negative stress.
But even positive or exciting events, like riding on a roller coaster or winning an award, can create stress on your mind and body.
questions.zh:
值得注意的是，即使是“好的”压力也会导致血糖水平飙升。
心理和身体上的压力，比如担心工作或生病，会产生消极压力。
但即使是积极或激动人心的事件，比如坐过山车或获奖，也会给你的身心带来压力。

It is important to note that even "good" stress can lead to spikes in blood sugar levels.

questions.name: #896 Implicit Bias
questions.en:
Like other cognitive biases, implicit bias is a result of the brain's tendency to try to simplify the world.
Because the brain is constantly inundated with more information than it could conceivably process, mental shortcuts make it faster and easier for the brain to sort through all of this data.

questions.name: #897 Landing a New Job
questions.en:
With our current situation and the state of the global economy, there is a much lower chance of landing a new job anytime soon.
And it’s unclear when social distancing measures will end or what shape the economy will be in when you are able to return to work.

questions.name: #898 Falsifiable Science
questions.en:
Contemporary scholars who study scientific methodology are often frustrated by the implication that science is logically falsifiable.
The problem is that scientists can always make excuses to avoid falsifying a claim.
The discovery of Neptune is a famous case.
Astronomers had noticed irregularities in the orbit of Uranus.
One possibility was that these irregularities violated the theory currently used to explain planetary motion, and that this theory should be rejected.
questions.zh:
研究科学方法论的那些现代学者，常常因为“科学在逻辑上可以被证伪”这种说法而感到头疼。
问题在于，科学家们总能找到各种理由来回避证伪某个论断。
海王星的发现就是个著名的例子。
天文学家们早就注意到天王星轨道存在异常。
一种可能性是，这些异常现象违背了当时用来解释行星运动的理论，因此这个理论应该被抛弃。

questions.name: #899 Sportsmanship
questions.en:
Sportsmanship comes in many forms and helps make competitive games fun and enjoyable.
It fosters good habits and positive life skills both in and out of sports games, and is an important life skill for people of all ages.
It is also key to becoming a mature, respectful, and successful adult.

它也是成为成熟、受人尊敬且成功的成年人的关键。

questions.name: #901 Voting
questions.en:
Today, most American citizens over the age of 18 are entitled to vote in federal and state elections, but voting was not always a right for all Americans.
Because the Constitution did not specifically say who could vote, this question was largely left to the states in the 1800s.
While no longer explicitly excluded, voter suppression is a problem in many parts of the country.
questions.zh:
如今，大多数年满18岁的美国公民都有权在联邦和州选举中投票，但投票并非一直是所有美国人的权利。
由于宪法没有明确规定谁可以投票，这个问题在19世纪很大程度上由各州自行决定。
虽然不再明确被排除在外，但选民压制仍是美国许多地区的一个问题。

questions.name: #902 Natural Gas
questions.en:
Demand for natural gas has grown internationally in recent years, in part because it has a smaller carbon footprint than coal and other fossil fuels.
In Singapore, where the government has promoted increased use of natural gas, consumption has grown about ninefold in recent decades.
In some places, natural gas consumption has expanded as public opinion has turned against nuclear power.
questions.zh:
近年来，全球对天然气的需求不断增长，部分原因是其碳足迹比煤炭和其他化石燃料小。
在新加坡，政府推动增加天然气使用，近几十年来消费量增长了约九倍。
在一些地方，随着公众舆论反对核电，天然气的消费量也随之扩大。

questions.name: #903 Water and Health
questions.en:
Getting enough water every day is important for your health.
Drinking water can prevent dehydration, a condition that can cause unclear thinking, result in mood change, cause your body to overheat, and lead to constipation and kidney stones.
Water has no calories, so it can also help with managing body weight and reducing calorie intake when substituted for drinks with calories, such as sweet tea or regular soda.
questions.zh:
每天喝足量的水对健康很重要。
喝水能预防脱水，脱水会导致思维不清、情绪波动、身体过热，还会引起便秘和肾结石。
水不含卡路里，所以用它替代甜茶或普通汽水等高热量饮料，有助于控制体重和减少热量摄入。

questions.name: #904 Studying History
questions.en:
Studying history helps us understand how events in the past made things the way they are today.
Events in the past have displaced families and groups, changing the makeup of regions and often causing tensions.
Such events have also created government systems that have lasted generations beyond when they started.
And all of it affects each person alive today.
questions.zh:
学历史能帮我们弄明白过去的事情是如何造就了今天的模样。
过去的一些事件导致家庭和群体流离失所，改变了地区的构成，还常常引发紧张局势。
这些事件也催生了政府体系，这些体系在形成后延续了好几代人。
而这一切都影响着今天活着的每一个人。

questions.name: #906 Circadian Rhythm
questions.en:
An internal “body clock” regulates your sleep cycle, controlling when you feel tired and ready for bed or refreshed and alert.
This clock operates on a 24-hour cycle known as the circadian rhythm.
After waking up from sleep, you’ll become increasingly tired throughout the day.
These feelings will peak in the evening leading up to bedtime.
questions.zh:
你身体里有个生物钟，它控制着你的睡眠周期，决定你什么时候犯困想睡，什么时候精神饱满。
这个生物钟按照24小时的周期运转，也就是我们常说的昼夜节律。
睡醒之后，你会随着一天时间的推移越来越累。
这种困倦感会在晚上睡觉前达到顶峰。

questions.name: #907 Modern Technology
questions.en:
Modern technology has impacted every area of our lives and become a crucial factor in no time.
We even reached a point where everything we use in our daily life is directly or indirectly related to the technological advancement of some form.
So, modern technology cannot be avoided even if we intentionally wanted to.
questions.zh:
现代科技已经影响到我们生活的方方面面，并且迅速成为关键因素。
我们甚至到了这样的地步：日常生活中所用的一切都直接或间接地与某种形式的技术进步相关。
因此，即使我们有意避免，也无法避开现代科技。

questions.name: #909 Sportsmanship and Atheletes
questions.en:
Sportsmanship is an understanding of and commitment to fair play, ethical behavior and integrity, and general goodwill toward an opponent.
It is an affirmation that an athlete is disciplined enough to have perspective, maintain poise and do what is best for his or her teammates.
Being able to make appropriate behavioral choices in a pressure situation will often reveal a player’s character.
questions.zh:
体育精神是对公平竞争、道德行为、正直诚信以及对对手保持善意的理解和承诺。
它肯定了运动员足够自律，能够保持远见、镇定，并为队友做出最佳选择。
在压力下做出恰当的行为选择，往往能揭示一个运动员的品格。

questions.name: #910 Public Opinion
questions.en:
Public opinion stabilizes and integrates society because conflicts will be resolved through spirals of silence in favor of one opinion.
Wherever people live together in societies, public opinion will function as a mechanism of social control.
However, what specifically public opinion approves or rejects will change with time and differ from place to place.
questions.zh:
公众舆论能稳定并整合社会，因为冲突会通过沉默螺旋的方式偏向某一观点而得到解决。
无论人们在哪里共同生活，公众舆论都会作为一种社会控制机制发挥作用。
然而，公众舆论具体赞成或反对什么，会随着时间变化，并且因地而异。

The internet has grown in importance by many folds, over the process of decade.

questions.name: #912 Spiral of Silence
questions.en:
The spiral of silence is a mass communication theory introduced by Elizabeth to describe the process of public opinion formation.
He defines the “spiral of silence” as the process an individual experiences when he may find that the views he holds are losing ground; the more this appears to be so, the less he will be inclined to express his opinion.
questions.zh:
沉默螺旋是由伊丽莎白提出的大众传播理论，用来描述舆论形成的过程。
他把“沉默螺旋”定义为个人可能经历的过程：当他发现自己持有的观点逐渐失势时，越是这样，他就越不愿意表达自己的意见。

questions.name: #913 New Machines
questions.en:
Modern technology changed a lot from what we saw in the last decade or the past century.
New machines and gadgets are invented to make jobs easier like never before.
From the little tailor machine to the fastest car in the world, all got automated reducing the manual actions required to the least.
questions.zh:
现代科技和我们过去十年或上个世纪看到的已经大不一样了。

从最小的缝纫机到全球最快的汽车，全都实现了自动化，把需要手动操作的部分降到了最低。

questions.name: #914 Children and Sports
questions.en:
Parents and kids alike love sports, and it's easy to get caught up in a game and become focused on winning.
Yet there is much more to be gained from the sports experience than a winning record.
When children and teens are involved in sports, they are able to learn and put into practice values that will stay with them for the rest of their lives.
questions.zh:
家长和孩子都热爱运动，比赛时很容易投入其中，一心只想赢。

当儿童和青少年参与运动时，他们能够学习并践行那些将伴随他们一生的价值观。

questions.name: #915 Sampling
questions.en:
In statistics, a predetermined number of observations can be extracted from a larger population.
This is called sampling.
There are many sampling techniques adopted by researchers and statisticians and the type of sampling depends upon the analysis to be performed.
When it seems time consuming to obtain data from every member of the population, then sampling techniques are employed.
questions.zh:
在统计学中，可以从一个更大的群体中抽取预定数量的观测值。
这被称为抽样。
研究人员和统计学家采用多种抽样技术，而抽样类型取决于要进行的分析。
当从群体的每个成员那里获取数据似乎耗时过多时，就会采用抽样技术。

questions.en:
An archaic name is an older name for a chemical that predates the modern naming conventions.
It's helpful to know archaic names of chemicals because older texts may refer to chemicals by these names.
Some chemicals are sold under archaic names or may be found in storage labeled with the older names.

一些化学物质以古名出售，或者在存储时可能标有旧名称。

questions.name: #917 Concentration
questions.en:
Concentration is an expression of how much solute is dissolved in a solvent in a chemical solution.
There are multiple units of concentration.
Which unit you use depends on how you intend to use the chemical solution.
The most common units are mass percent, volume percent, and mole fraction.

浓度有多种单位。
使用哪种单位取决于你打算如何利用这种化学溶液。
最常见的单位是质量百分比、体积百分比和摩尔分数。

questions.name: #918 Light Speed
questions.en:
As far as we know, nothing can move faster than light.
According to Einstein's theories on relativity, it takes an infinite amount of energy to accelerate an object with mass up to the speed of light.
As a result, it would appear that having a spacecraft traveling at or exceeding the speed of light is simply impossible.

根据爱因斯坦的相对论，要把有质量的物体加速到光速，需要无穷多的能量。
这样一来，制造一艘达到或超过光速的飞船，似乎根本不可能。

questions.name: #919 Astronaut Candidates
questions.en:
People who want to become astronauts must be in top physical condition.
Each country's space program has health requirements for its space travelers.
They usually assess a candidate's fitness to withstand some pretty tough conditions.
For example, a good candidate must have the ability to endure the rigors of lift-off and to function in weightlessness.
questions.zh:
想成为宇航员的人必须拥有极佳的身体状况。
每个国家的太空计划对其太空旅行者都有健康要求。
他们通常会评估候选人是否能够承受一些相当严酷的条件。
例如，优秀的候选人必须能够承受发射时的剧烈考验并在失重状态下正常工作。

questions.name: #920 Mandarin
questions.en:
Because Mandarin is the most commonly spoken dialect, many people use the word Chinese to refer to it.
While roughly 70 percent of the country speaks Mandarin, many other dialects are spoken as well.
The languages are mutually intelligible to a varying degree, depending on how close the languages are to one another.

这些语言在相互理解程度上有所不同，取决于它们之间的接近程度。

questions.name: #921 Volcano Behaviors
questions.en:
There were various explanations for volcano behavior before the structure of the earth mantle as a semisolid material was developed.
For decades, awareness that compression and radioactive materials may be heat sources was discounted and volcanic action was often attributed to chemical reactions and a thin layer of molten rock near the surface.
questions.zh:

几十年来，人们忽视了压缩和放射性物质可能是热源，常将火山活动归因于化学反应和近地表的一层薄熔岩。

questions.name: #922 Yellowstone
questions.en:
Yellowstone was initially made famous due to its unique geology caused by its location on the North American plate, which for millions of years has slowly moved across a mantle hotspot via plate tectonics.
The Yellowstone Caldera is a volcanic system, the largest in North America, which has formed as a result of this hot spot and subsequent large volcanic eruptions.

黄石火山口是一个火山系统，也是北美最大的火山系统，它是由这个热点以及随后的大型火山喷发形成的。

questions.name: #923 Gray Wolf
questions.en:
The gray wolf is an extremely adaptable species and is one of those animal species that survived the last ice age.
The gray wolf's physical characteristics enabled it to adapt quickly to the harsh conditions of the ice age, and its cunning and adaptation helped it survive in the changing environment.
