questions.name: #924 Spanish
questions.en:
While Spanish is not a commonly heard language in most parts of Africa, Asia, and the majority of Europe, that hasn't stopped it from becoming the second most commonly spoken language.
The spread of the Spanish language is rooted in colonization.
Between the 15th and 18th centuries, Spain colonized much of South and Central of North America as well.

西班牙语的传播源于殖民化。
在15至18世纪期间，西班牙殖民了南美洲、中美洲以及北美洲的部分地区。

questions.name: #925 Electric Eel
questions.en:
A shock from an electric eel is like the brief, numbing jolt from a stun gun.
Normally, the shock can't kill a person.
However, the eels can cause heart failure or respiratory failure from multiple shocks or in persons with underlying heart disease.
More often, deaths from electric eels shocks occur when the jolt knocks a person in the water and they drown.

更多时候，电鳗电击致死是因为人受击后落入水中溺亡。

questions.en:
Exposition is a literary term that refers to the part of a story that sets the stage for the drama to follow: it introduces the theme, setting, characters, and circumstances at the story’s beginnings.
To understand what exposition is, look at how the writer sets the scene for the story and the characters within it.

要理解什么是铺垫，就看作者如何为故事及其中的角色设置场景。

questions.name: #928 Stratification
questions.en:
In Western countries, social stratification primarily occurs as a result of socioeconomic status in which a hierarchy determines the groups most likely to gain access to financial resources and forms of privilege.
Typically, the upper classes have the most access to these resources while the lower classes may get few or none of them, putting them at a distinct disadvantage.
questions.zh:
在西方国家，社会分层主要是由社会经济地位决定的，这种地位形成了一种等级制度，决定了哪些群体最有可能获得经济资源和各种特权。
通常，上层阶级最容易获得这些资源，而下层阶级可能几乎得不到什么，这让他们处于明显的不利地位。

questions.name: #930 Primitive Societies
questions.en:
Early in the field's history, anthropologists were almost all Europeans or Americans who conducted research in what they considered to be "primitive" societies that they believed were "untouched" by western influence.
Because of this mindset, the field has long been critiqued for its colonialist, condescending attitude toward non-western people and its inaccurate representations of their cultures.
questions.zh:
在这个领域发展初期，人类学家几乎全是欧洲人或美国人，他们在自己认为“原始”且“未受西方影响”的社会中进行研究。
由于这种思维模式，该领域长期以来因其对非西方人民的殖民主义、居高临下的态度以及对他们的文化不准确的描述而受到批评。

questions.name: #931 Melting Pot Theory
questions.en:
The melting pot theory of multiculturalism assumes that various immigrant groups will tend to “melt together,” abandoning their individual cultures and eventually becoming fully assimilated into the predominant society.
Typically used to describe the assimilation of immigrants, this theory is often illustrated by the metaphor of a foundry’s smelting pots in which the elements iron and carbon are melted together to create a single, stronger metal—steel.
questions.zh:
多元文化主义中的大熔炉理论认为，不同的移民群体倾向于“融合在一起”，放弃各自的独特文化，最终完全融入主流社会。
这一理论通常用来描述移民的同化过程，常被比作铸造厂的熔炉，其中铁和碳元素熔合在一起，形成一种更坚固的金属——钢。

这里也是多种野生动物的家园，其中许多属于大型动物，比如灰熊和野牛。

抽样间隔可以通过将整个群体除以所需样本量来计算得出。

questions.name: #939 Environmental Degradation
questions.en:
People are waking up to the problem of environmental degradation.
Efforts are being made all over the world to reduce carbon footprint and promote sustainable development.
Environmental conservation is no longer only about mandating factories to adopt greener practices or ensuring that vehicles on the road are checked regularly for their pollution levels.
It is wider than that and encompasses all industries.
questions.zh:
人们开始意识到环境恶化的问题了。
世界各地都在努力减少碳足迹，推动可持续发展。
环境保护不再只是要求工厂采用更环保的做法，或者确保路上车辆定期检查污染排放。
它的范围更广，涵盖了所有行业。

questions.name: #941 Academia
questions.en:
Academia’s mission is to make all research available for free to everyone in the world.
Upgrading to premium is a way to support this mission and help make all scholarship and science easily and freely accessible to everyone, not just those affiliated with well-endowed institutions.
Academia Premium also includes features such as Advanced Search and Extra Analytic.

Academia 高级版还包括高级搜索和额外分析等功能。

questions.name: #943 Ionizers
questions.en:
The role of ionizers is to purify the air with the help of electricity.
During this process, negative ions are created that discharge these ions into the air.
In this case, they are attached to particles with a positive charge.
Some of these harmful particles include smoke, bacteria and pollen.
The reaction between these ions helps purify the air inside your room office.
questions.zh:
电离器的作用是利用电力来净化空气。
在这个过程中，会产生负离子，并将这些离子释放到空气中。
然后，这些负离子会附着在带正电的颗粒上。
一些有害颗粒包括烟雾、细菌和花粉。
这些离子之间的反应有助于净化你房间或办公室内的空气。

questions.name: #944 Sustainability
questions.en:
On a planet with a growing population and shrinking natural resources, business-as-usual is no longer sustainable.
But sustainability is very often good for the bottom line, as it's in the best interest of businesses to responsibly manage our natural resources so we can continue to use them for years to come.
questions.zh:
在一个人口不断增长、自然资源日益减少的星球上，按老路子走已经行不通了。
不过，可持续性往往对盈利有好处，因为负责任地管理自然资源符合企业的长远利益，这样我们才能在未来多年里持续利用它们。

questions.name: #945 Email
questions.en:
Over the years, various internet services have been created to communicate remotely.
Social networks have been a revolution, as have instant messaging apps.
Since the beginning, there is also a timeless communication standard, representing one of the best tools for individuals and companies to communicate quickly: email.

questions.name: #946 Time Management
questions.en:
Time management is not that difficult, but it does require advanced thinking and staying on top of tasks that are coming up.
Whether the upcoming task is imminent or in the future, it should be recorded.
Whether it is recorded on a tech device or a paper notepad, the need is the same.

无论是记在电子设备上还是纸质笔记本上，需求都是一样的。

questions.name: #947 Hunter's Full Moon
questions.en:
The Hunter's full moon is the first full moon after the autumnal equinox, which marks the arrival of the colder months in the Northern Hemisphere.
At higher latitudes in the Northern Hemisphere, the moon therefore appeared larger than the full moons of the summer months, as it lingered relatively low above the horizon.
questions.zh:
猎人之月是秋分后的第一个满月，标志着北半球寒冷季节的到来。
在北半球高纬度地区，月亮因此显得比夏季的满月更大，因为它相对低垂在地平线上方。

questions.name: #948 Coffee Production
questions.en:
Climate change is intensifying and is putting the future of the entire coffee sector at risk.
Roughly half of the land used to grow coffee will decrease and will no longer be suitable for coffee production.
With effects from climate change rising at an alarming pace, higher temperatures are significantly impacting coffee cultivation at lower elevations.

随着气候变化的影响以惊人的速度加剧，高温正严重影响着低海拔地区的咖啡种植。

questions.name: #949 Topsoil
questions.en:
When agriculture fields replace natural vegetation, topsoil is exposed and can dry out.
The diversity and quantity of microorganisms that help to keep the soil fertile can decrease, and nutrients may wash out.
Soil can be blown away by the winds or washed away by rains.

土壤可能被风吹走，或被雨水冲走。

questions.name: #950 Died Stars
questions.en:
The Milky Way is a gargantuan graveyard.
Stars are born, burn out and die, but they don't just vanish — and the galaxy is haunted by their corpses.
Stars in the Milky Way that died billions of years ago went supernova and morphed into two types of objects.
With their outer layers blasted away by the force of the explosion, the cores that were left formed black holes.
questions.zh:
银河系是一个巨大的墓地。
恒星诞生、燃烧殆尽然后死亡，但它们不会凭空消失——银河系中遍布着它们的遗骸。
数十亿年前死亡的银河系恒星发生了超新星爆发，演变成了两类天体。
外层被爆炸威力炸飞后，剩下的核心形成了黑洞。

questions.name: #951 Theme Parks
questions.en:
Not all theme parks succeed when they are built.
Some theme parks may start, but close in the first few days due to declining business, poor management or an inability to respond to market changes.
Closure of theme park happens even at popular ones if visitors are disappointed with their inconsistent service quality or unchanged aging attractions.
questions.zh:
不是所有主题公园建起来都能成功的。
有些主题公园可能开了，但没几天就关了，因为生意越来越差、管理不善，或者跟不上市场变化。
就算是热门主题公园，如果服务质量不稳定、游乐设施老旧不变，游客失望了，也会关门。

questions.name: #952 Energy Bills
questions.en:
Across Europe, electricity and gas prices are skyrocketing – this is a massive burden for large sections of the population.
In Greece, too, energy bills have risen sharply in recent months.
Since the financial and economic crisis, many people are living on the edge of poverty.
questions.zh:

希腊也不例外，近几个月来能源账单大幅上涨。
自金融和经济危机以来，许多人生活在贫困边缘。

questions.name: #953 Shock Absorption
questions.en:
Spacecraft and launch pad equipment undergo extreme stress due to vibration during rocket launches.
To make sure that they remain functional in space, shock absorption technology was designed to protect the spacecraft.
During earthquakes, buildings and bridges undergo similar stress.
That is why the same shock absorption technology used for spacecraft is now used to strengthen buildings and bridges in earthquake-prone regions.
questions.zh:
火箭发射时产生的振动会让航天器和发射台设备承受极大的压力。
为了确保它们在太空中能正常工作，人们设计了减震技术来保护航天器。
地震时，建筑物和桥梁也会承受类似的压力。
因此，原本用于航天器的减震技术，现在也被用来加固地震多发地区的建筑物和桥梁。

questions.name: #954 Degraded Lands
questions.en:
The effects of soil erosion go beyond the loss of fertile land.
It has led to increased pollution and sedimentation in streams and rivers, clogging these waterways and causing declines in fish and other species.
Degraded lands are also often less able to hold onto water, which can worsen flooding.
Sustainable land use can help to reduce the impacts of agriculture and livestock.
questions.zh:
水土流失的影响远不止失去肥沃的土地。
它导致溪流和河流污染加重、沉积物增多，堵塞水道，造成鱼类及其他物种数量下降。
退化的土地往往保水能力更差，这可能会加剧洪水灾害。
可持续的土地利用有助于减轻农业和畜牧业带来的影响。

questions.name: #955 Scarce Land
questions.en:
Land is scarce in many parts of our fast-urbanizing world.
Few communities have the chance to create something brand-new on a significant piece of land — and even fewer can develop that land in a way that confronts climate change, generates jobs, and attracts investment.
questions.zh:
在我们这个快速城市化的世界里，许多地方土地稀缺。
很少有社区有机会在显著地块上创建全新的事物——而能够以应对气候变化、创造就业和吸引投资的方式来开发这片土地的社区更是少之又少。

questions.name: #956 Worsened Inequality
questions.en:
The COVID-19 pandemic and related shutdowns are challenging the effectiveness of civil and institutional structures around the world, resulting in interrelated crises for foreign policy, development, and economics.
Inequality has consequently worsened, both within and across borders, with fiscal and monetary policies exacerbating inequality by favoring the rich while leaving poorer people and countries behind.
questions.zh:
新冠疫情和相关的封锁措施正在考验全球各地民事和制度架构的有效性，给外交政策、发展和经济带来了相互关联的危机。
因此，不平等现象在国内外都加剧了，财政和货币政策偏向富人，却让贫困人口和国家掉队，进一步恶化了这种不平等。

questions.name: #957 City Life
questions.en:
More and more people are choosing to live in cities.
They offer better opportunities, better services, and sanctuary from conflict and the effects of climate change influences.
Yet large numbers of people are unable for various reasons to move to cities — skills mismatches, reluctance to sell land at a loss, and sometimes because of explicit policy restrictions that limit people’s movement within countries.
questions.zh:
越来越多的人选择住在城市。
城市提供更好的机会、更好的服务，并且是躲避冲突和气候变化影响的避风港。
然而，由于各种原因——技能不匹配、不愿亏本出售土地，有时甚至是因为国家内部限制人口流动的明确政策限制——大量的人无法迁往城市。

questions.name: #958 Diverse Population
questions.en:
The world is aging and becoming increasingly urban.
For the first time, there are more older persons than children under five, and more people are driven to cities for livelihoods, to have access to essential services and simply to enjoy their golden years.
How can we ensure cities welcome and nurture a diverse population in ways that are equitable for all?
questions.zh:
全球人口正在老龄化，城市化程度也越来越高。
如今，老年人数量首次超过了五岁以下儿童，越来越多的人为了生计、获取基本服务或安享晚年而迁往城市。
我们如何确保城市以公平的方式欢迎并滋养多元人口？

questions.name: #959 Public Spaces
questions.en:
Globally, about one-third of a city’s land area is covered by public spaces.
Despite this significance, the potential of public-space assets to transform cities and improve urban life is often overlooked.
The resulting degradation of public spaces into congested, vehicle-dominated, and polluted places often becomes a liability, exacerbating various city problems.
questions.zh:
全球范围内，城市大约三分之一的土地面积被公共空间覆盖。
尽管意义重大，但公共空间资产在改造城市和改善城市生活方面的潜力却常常被忽视。
结果，公共空间退化为拥挤、车辆主导且污染严重的地方，往往成为负担，加剧了各种城市问题。

questions.name: #960 Health Budget
questions.en:
The projected decline of government spending in many low income countries will restrict their ability to strengthen pandemic preparedness and limit their progress towards universal health coverage.
This will lead to growing inequalities between countries, threatening global stability, and prosperity.
Thus, governments need to give greater priority to health in budgets, and improve the efficiency of health spending.
questions.zh:
许多低收入国家预计将削减政府开支，这会限制它们加强疫情防控的能力，并阻碍其实现全民健康覆盖的进程。
这将导致国家间不平等加剧，威胁全球稳定与繁荣。
因此，各国政府需要在预算中优先考虑卫生领域，并提高卫生支出的效率。

questions.name: #961 Car Brakes
questions.en:
A car's brakes are one of its most important safety features and generally come in one of two types: disc or drum.
Disc brakes use a spinning disc, which is pinched between brake pads mounted on calipers to slow the motion of the car.
Drum brakes, on the other hand, use shoes that push outward to contact the inside of a spinning cylinder.
questions.zh:
汽车的刹车是最重要的安全特性之一，通常分为盘式刹车和鼓式刹车两种。
盘式刹车利用一个旋转的刹车盘，通过卡钳上的刹车片夹住它来减速。
而鼓式刹车则使用刹车蹄片向外推，接触旋转的鼓筒内侧来制动。

questions.name: #962 Frog Chorus
questions.en:
Frogs live almost everywhere, from tropical forests to frozen tundra and scorching deserts.
They sport an amazing range of survival strategies.
Many frogs are more colorful than the most dazzling birds, and their voices have filled the night with song since the dawn of the dinosaurs.
But the chorus is fading.
As humans change natural environments, frogs around the world are disappearing.
questions.zh:
从热带雨林到冰封冻原，再到酷热沙漠，青蛙几乎无处不在。
它们拥有各种令人惊叹的生存策略。
许多青蛙比最绚丽的鸟类还要色彩斑斓，自恐龙时代起，它们的歌声便响彻夜空。
但这场合唱正在渐渐消失。
随着人类改变自然环境，世界各地的青蛙正在消失。

questions.name: #963 Fence
questions.en:
Fences are not just designed to keep people and animals out, but they also keep things in, like children.
From a safety perspective, knowing your children are in a yard that is fenced offers solid peace of mind when it comes to their well-being.
Fences are also great for keeping pets in a confined, controlled area.
questions.zh:
围栏不仅是为了防止人和动物进入，也是为了把孩子之类的东西关在里面。
从安全角度看，知道孩子在有围栏的院子里，能让你的内心对孩子的安全感到踏实。
围栏也很适合把宠物限制在一个可控的区域内。

questions.en:
A well-crafted content marketing strategy places your business in the position of a thought leader, building brand preference as you inform and educate buyers.
Providing helpful and entertaining content can form a strong bond between your brand and customers that continues to grow and strengthen over time.

questions.name: #965 Oxygen on Moon
questions.en:
Oxygen can be found in many of the minerals in the ground around us, and the Moon is mostly made of the same rocks you’ll find on Earth.
Minerals such as silica and magnesium oxides dominate the Moon’s landscape.
All of these minerals contain oxygen, but not in a form our lungs can access.
questions.zh:
我们周围地下的许多矿物中都含有氧气，而月球主要由与地球上相同的岩石构成。
硅酸盐和氧化镁等矿物主导了月球的地貌。
所有这些矿物都含有氧，但并非以我们的肺能利用的形式存在。

questions.name: #966 NASA Astronaut
questions.en:
The requirements to be a NASA astronaut have changed over the years to better align with the agency’s mission and values.
A potential candidate must be a US citizen.
They also have to have a master’s degree from an accredited institution — acceptable degrees include engineering, biological science, or mathematics.
questions.zh:
成为NASA宇航员的要求这些年来一直在变，以便更好地契合该机构的使命和价值观。
潜在候选人必须是美国公民。
他们还必须拥有认可院校的硕士学位——可接受的学位包括工程、生物科学或数学。

questions.name: #968 Digging
questions.en:
The process of researching and securing a dig site can take years.
Digging is the field work of archaeology.
On occasion, archaeologists might need to move earth with bulldozers and backhoes.
Usually, however, archaeologists use tools such as brushes, hand shovels, and even toothbrushes to scrape away the earth around artifacts.
questions.zh:

挖掘就是考古学中的实地工作。
有时候，考古学家可能需要用推土机和反铲挖土机来移土。
不过，通常情况下，考古学家会使用刷子、手铲甚至牙刷这样的工具，来刮掉文物周围的泥土。

questions.name: #969 Natural Processes
questions.en:
Sometimes, natural processes can help preserve materials.
For example, sediments from floods or volcanic eruptions can encase materials and preserve them.
In one case, the chill of an Alpine glacier preserved the body of a man for more than five thousand years.
questions.zh:
有时候，自然过程能帮助保存材料。
比如，洪水或火山喷发带来的沉积物可以将材料包裹起来并保存下来。
有一个例子是，阿尔卑斯冰川的严寒保存了一具男子的尸体超过五千年。

questions.name: #970 Joint Venture
questions.en:
A joint venture is a business arrangement in which two or more parties agree to pool their resources for the purpose of accomplishing a specific task.
This task can be a new project or any other business activity.
In a joint venture, each of the participants is responsible for profits, losses, and costs associated with it.

在合资企业中，每个参与者都要承担相关的利润、亏损和成本。

questions.name: #971 Quantum Behavior
questions.en:
Particles can act like clumps of matter or ripple through space like waves, and they can even exist in two places at once.
A new device harnesses this strange quantum behavior to measure Earth’s gravity.
Slight changes in gravity from place to place reveal changes in the density of material beneath the sensor.
This allows the instrument to detect underground objects.
questions.zh:
粒子既可以像一团物质那样聚集，也可以像波一样在空间中波动，甚至还能同时存在于两个地方。
一种新设备利用这种奇特的量子行为来测量地球的重力。
不同地点重力的微小变化揭示了传感器下方物质密度的变化。
这使得该仪器能够探测到地下的物体。

questions.name: #972 Massive Asteroid
questions.en:
About 66 million years ago, a massive asteroid slammed into the Gulf of Mexico.
Not long afterward, all non-bird dinosaurs died as did many other species on land and in the sea.
Scientists don’t know the exact year this took place, but they now think they have figured out in what season it occurred: spring.
questions.zh:
大约6600万年前，一颗巨大的小行星撞击了墨西哥湾。
不久之后，所有非鸟类恐龙以及陆地和海洋中的许多其他物种都灭绝了。
科学家们不知道这具体发生在哪一年，但他们现在认为已经弄清楚了它发生的季节：春天。

questions.name: #973 Mutation
questions.en:
Our genes serve as an operating manual for cells of the body.
Genes tell cells what to do and when.
But copying errors in those operating manuals, known as mutations, can lead to misspelled instructions that can change how cells operate.
Scientists now know that some of those mutations can lead to disease.
questions.zh:
我们的基因就像身体的细胞操作手册。
基因告诉细胞该做什么以及何时做。
但这些操作手册中的复制错误，也就是突变，可能导致指令拼写错误，从而改变细胞的运作方式。
科学家现在知道，其中一些突变可能导致疾病。

questions.name: #974 Chinese Architecture
questions.en:
The most significant difference between traditional Chinese architecture and traditional western architecture is the construction material.
Most ancient western buildings were built up with stones, solemn and magnificent.
Most importantly, they survive today.
Ancient Chinese people were very good at using wood, and created the complex mortise and tenon joint structure to bring in the unique aesthetics for ancient Chinese wooden architecture.
questions.zh:
中国传统建筑和西方传统建筑最大的区别在于建筑材料。
大多数西方古建筑是用石头建造的，庄严而宏伟。
最重要的是，它们留存至今。
古代中国人非常擅长使用木材，并创造了复杂的榫卯结构，为古代中国木结构建筑带来了独特的美感。

questions.name: #975 Smell and Memory
questions.en:
When you take a deep whiff of your morning coffee, the smell of those fresh-roasted beans darts into parts of the brain responsible for emotional and memory processing, but our other senses don’t work in the same way.
That’s why smell can trigger a happy memory more quickly than touching the hot coffee mug or tasting that first sip.
questions.zh:
当你深深闻一口早晨的咖啡时，那些新鲜烘焙的咖啡豆的香气会迅速进入大脑中负责处理情感和记忆的区域，但我们的其他感官并不以同样的方式运作。
这就是为什么气味比触摸热咖啡杯或品尝第一口咖啡更能快速触发快乐的回忆。

questions.name: #976 Scent
questions.en:
Scientists suggest that there are a number of reasons that our bodies treat scent differently than other senses.
From hunting and gathering food to finding healthy mates, linking smells with memories that stir up desire, happiness, or even fear is biologically useful for humans.
Humans have one other thing to consider when scent is at play: context is key.
questions.zh:
科学家认为，我们的身体对气味的处理方式与其他感官不同，原因有很多。
从狩猎采集食物到寻找健康的伴侣，将气味与唤起欲望、快乐甚至恐惧的记忆联系起来，对人类来说具有生物学上的实用性。
当气味发挥作用时，人类还需要考虑另一件事：情境是关键。

questions.name: #977 Plants and Animals
questions.en:
No matter where we go on the planet, there are stunning plants, flowers, and animals that catch our attention.
They are two very important aspects of any ecosystem.
Of all the living organisms on the planet, the most commonly seen by us are the plant life and the animal life.

它们是任何生态系统中两个非常重要的方面。
在地球上所有的生物中，我们最常见到的是植物和动物。

questions.name: #978 Heart Disease
questions.en:
Heart disease is the leading cause of death for both men and women in the United States.
While often thought of as one illness, heart disease is actually an umbrella term that covers a range of heart conditions.
It includes diseases of the blood vessels, including coronary artery disease and peripheral artery disease and so on.
questions.zh:
在美国，心脏病是男性和女性的头号死因。
虽然常被看作一种疾病，但心脏病实际上是一个涵盖多种心脏问题的总称。
它包括血管疾病，比如冠状动脉疾病、外周动脉疾病等。

questions.name: #979 Quality Translation
questions.en:
As technology keeps growing, political and economic leaders have utilized cinema in changing and shaping people’s outlooks either for their own benefit or for the benefit of the people.
Quality translations are also readily available and extremely affordable for everyone these days, which makes it easy for filmmakers to reach their target audiences from all corners of the world in their mother tongue.
questions.zh:
随着科技的不断进步，政治和经济领袖们利用电影来改变和塑造人们的观念，无论这是为了他们自己的利益还是为了人民的利益。
如今，高质量的翻译不仅容易获得，而且对每个人来说都非常实惠，这使得电影制作人能够轻松地用母语触达世界各地的目标观众。

questions.name: #981 Hotter Tropics
questions.en:
The tropics are becoming hotter due to a combination of warming associated with deforestation and climate change, and that can reduce the ability of outdoor workers to perform their jobs safely.
Researchers are estimating how many safe working hours people living in the tropics have lost due to local temperature change associated with loss of trees.
questions.zh:

研究人员正在估算，由于树木减少导致当地气温变化，热带居民损失了多少安全工作时间。

questions.name: #982 Categorization
questions.en:
Categorization is the brain's tool to organize nearly everything we encounter in our daily lives.
Grouping information into categories simplifies our complex world and helps us to react quickly and effectively to new experiences.
Researchers identified neurons encoding learned categories and thereby demonstrated how abstract information is represented at the neuronal level.
questions.zh:
分类是大脑用来组织我们日常生活中几乎一切事物的工具。
将信息分组归类简化了我们复杂的世界，并帮助我们快速有效地应对新体验。
研究人员识别出了编码习得类别的神经元，从而展示了抽象信息如何在神经元层面被表征。

questions.name: #983 Navigational Abilities
questions.en:
Are animals' innate navigational abilities universal or are they restricted to their home environments?
Taking the premise to the extreme, the researchers designed a set of wheels under a goldfish tank with a camera system to record and translate the fish's movements into forward and back and side to side directions to the wheels.
questions.zh:
动物的天生导航能力是普遍存在的，还是仅限于它们熟悉的环境？
研究人员将这个前提发挥到极致，在鱼缸底下装了一套轮子，并配备摄像头系统来记录金鱼的动作，将其转化为轮子前后左右的移动指令。

questions.name: #984 Negative and Positive
questions.en:
Team members with what researchers call "negative affect" exhibit critical and persistent thinking that allows them to identify problems needing solutions.
On the other hand, team members with "positive affect" engage in broad and flexible thinking that expands their range of information and helps them see unusual and creative connections.
questions.zh:
研究人员所说的带有“负面情绪”的团队成员，会进行批判性和持续的思考，这让他们能够发现需要解决的问题。
另一方面，带有“正面情绪”的团队成员则进行广泛而灵活的思考，这扩展了他们的信息范围，并帮助他们看到不同寻常且富有创造性的联系。

questions.name: #985 Delay Discounting
questions.en:
Behavioral outcomes are devalued as a function of the delay until they are experienced.
This process, known as delay discounting, is reliably associated with cigarette smoking and other tobacco use.
Delay discounting is a potential therapeutic target in tobacco cessation.
Thus, understanding how delay discounting influences inter-temporal choice is critical and may lead to efficacious interventions for tobacco use.
questions.zh:
行为结果会随着体验它们的延迟时间而贬值。
这个过程被称为延迟折扣，它与吸烟及其他烟草使用密切相关。
延迟折扣是戒烟治疗中的一个潜在靶点。
因此，理解延迟折扣如何影响跨期选择至关重要，这可能为烟草使用带来有效的干预措施。

questions.name: #986 Blood Sugar
questions.en:
Most of the food you eat is broken down into sugar and released into your bloodstream.
When your blood sugar goes up, it signals your pancreas to release insulin.
When there isn’t enough insulin or cells stop responding to insulin, too much blood sugar stays in your bloodstream.
Over time, that can cause serious health problems, such as diabetes.
questions.zh:
你吃的大部分食物都会被分解成糖，然后释放到血液里。
当你的血糖升高时，会向胰腺发出信号，让它释放胰岛素。
当胰岛素不足或细胞对胰岛素不再反应时，过多的血糖就会留在血液中。
久而久之，这可能会导致严重的健康问题，比如糖尿病。

questions.name: #987 Roofing
questions.en:
Roofing your house rarely rates high on the list of fun and exciting home remodeling projects.
But when your home develops a leak, your attitude might take a sharp turn.
Suddenly, the prospect of a dry, tightly sealed house begins to look very attractive.
A beautiful new roof can also improve the curb appeal of your house.
questions.zh:
给房子换屋顶通常算不上什么有趣又刺激的家装项目。
但一旦家里开始漏水，你的态度可能就会来个一百八十度大转弯。
突然间，一个干爽严实的房子变得格外诱人。
漂亮的新屋顶还能让房子的外观增色不少。

questions.name: #988 Tropical Cyclone
questions.en:
A tropical cyclone is a generic term used by meteorologists to describe a rotating, organized system of clouds and thunderstorms.
The weakest tropical cyclones are called tropical depressions.
If a depression intensifies such that its maximum sustained winds reach thirty-nine miles per hour, the tropical cyclone becomes a tropical storm.
questions.zh:
气象学家用“热带气旋”这个通用术语来描述一种旋转的、有组织的云和雷暴系统。
最弱的热带气旋被称为热带低气压。
如果低气压增强，使其最大持续风速达到每小时三十九英里，那么热带气旋就变成了热带风暴。

questions.name: #989 Solid Waste Management
questions.en:
The solid waste management issue is the biggest challenge to the authorities of both small and large cities’ in developing countries.
This is mainly due to the increasing generation of such solid waste and the burden posed on the municipal budget.
In addition to the high costs, the solid waste management is associated with lack of understanding over different factors that affect the entire handling system.
questions.zh:
固体废物管理问题是发展中国家大小城市当局面临的最大挑战。
这主要是由于此类固体废物产生量不断增加，给市政预算带来了负担。
除了高成本之外，固体废物管理还涉及对影响整个处理系统的不同因素缺乏了解。

questions.name: #990 Female Hummingbirds
questions.en:
Female hummingbirds don flashy feathers to avoid being bothered by other hummingbirds.
They tend to have bright blue heads and throats.
But mate choice doesn’t seem to drive these females’ pretty plumage since males don’t appear to prefer the blue females.
Therefore, bright colors may help lady birds blend in with the guys, and as a result, feed for longer without harassment from other hummingbirds.

但配偶选择似乎并不驱动这些雌鸟的漂亮羽毛，因为雄性并不偏爱蓝色雌鸟。
因此，亮色可能帮助雌鸟融入雄鸟中，从而在没有其他蜂鸟骚扰的情况下更长时间地进食。

questions.name: #991 Atoms
questions.en:
Physicists thought they had a solid grasp on what made up matter.
They knew that atoms contained electrons surrounding a positively charged nucleus.
They also knew that each nucleus contained a number of protons and positively charged particles.
Combinations of those two particles made up all of the matter in the universe.

物理学家曾以为自己牢牢掌握了物质的构成。
他们知道原子含有围绕带正电原子核的电子。
他们还知道每个原子核含有若干质子和带正电粒子。
这两种粒子的组合构成了宇宙中所有的物质。

questions.name: #992 Welfare Programs
questions.en:
Most societies throughout history employed some strategies to help people in poverty meet basic needs.
Before the 20th century, religious groups and private charities often led such initiatives.
Today, these are called welfare programs, and they usually take the form of government-provided subsidies for housing and healthcare.
questions.zh:

在20世纪之前，宗教团体和私人慈善机构常常主导这类举措。
如今，这些被称为福利计划，通常以政府提供的住房和医疗补贴形式出现。

questions.name: #993 Phantom Rivers
questions.en:
For two summers in Pioneer Mountains, the roar of rushing white water filled the air.
But where the loud sounds prevailed, only gentle streams flowed by.
These phantom rivers were part of an experiment led by ecologist Dylan.
He and colleagues were testing a hypothesis that the sounds of nature influence where animals lived and how they forage.
questions.zh:
在先锋山脉的两个夏天，奔腾的白水轰鸣声响彻空中。
但在那些喧闹声曾经占据的地方，如今只有轻柔的溪流流淌。
这些幽灵般的河流是生态学家迪伦主导的一项实验的一部分。
他和同事们正在验证一个假设：自然的声音会影响动物的栖息地和觅食方式。

questions.name: #994 Culprit Fungi
questions.en:
As climate change brings more wildfires to the western United States, a rare fungal infection, valley fever, has also been on the rise.
It causes coughs, fevers and chest pain and can be deadly.
The culprit fungi thrive in soils in California and the desert Southwest.
Wildfires appear to stir up and send the soil-loving fungi into the air, where they can enter people’s lungs.
questions.zh:
随着气候变化给美国西部带来更多野火，一种罕见的真菌感染——山谷热——也随之增多。
它会引起咳嗽、发烧和胸痛，甚至可能致命。
这种致病真菌在加利福尼亚和西南部沙漠的土壤中繁茂生长。
野火似乎会搅动土壤，让这些喜土真菌飘散到空气中，从而进入人们的肺部。

questions.name: #995 Pig Kidney Transplantation
questions.en:
Surgeons in New York City successfully attached a pig kidney to a human patient and watched the pinkish organ function normally for 54 hours.
Such procedures have been done in nonhuman primates.
However, this is the first time that a pig kidney has been transplanted to a human body and not been immediately rejected.
questions.zh:
纽约市的外科医生成功将一颗猪肾连接到一名人类患者身上，并观察到这个粉红色器官正常工作了54小时。
这类手术此前已在非人灵长类动物身上进行过。
然而，这是首次将猪肾移植到人体内且没有立即发生排异反应。

questions.name: #996 Mental Illness
questions.en:
One of the great contributing factors to mental illness is the idea that we should at all costs and at all times be well.
We suffer far more than we should because of how long it can take many of us until we allow ourselves to fall properly and usefully ill.
questions.zh:
导致心理疾病的一大因素，就是那种认为我们应该不惜一切代价、时时刻刻都保持健康的心态。
我们承受的痛苦远远超过应有的程度，因为很多人要花很长时间才允许自己真正且有效地生病。

questions.name: #997 Movies
questions.en:
Movies are an integral part of us; they mirror what we believe and how we coexist as people.
It is easier to see our concerns, attitudes, flaws and strengths in films than it is to decipher them from our daily interactions.
When our prevalent beliefs and ideologies are challenged in films, we are sometimes able to interrogate ourselves and embrace change.
questions.zh:
电影是我们生活中不可或缺的一部分，它们反映了我们的信仰以及我们如何作为人类共存。
相比日常交往，我们更容易从电影中看到自己的关切、态度、缺点和优点。
当电影挑战我们普遍持有的信仰和意识形态时，我们有时能够审视自己并拥抱改变。

questions.name: #998 Heart Disease Diagnosis
questions.en:
Before a heart disease diagnosis is made, your healthcare provider will gather a full medical history and perform a physical exam.
If your doctor suspects heart disease, blood tests will be ordered to check your cholesterol and triglyceride levels, as well as look for proteins that could signal heart failure or plaque in your arteries.
questions.zh:
在确诊心脏病之前，你的医生会全面了解你的病史，并给你做个体检。
如果医生怀疑你有心脏病，就会安排抽血检查，看看你的胆固醇和甘油三酯水平，同时也会检测一些蛋白质，这些蛋白质可能提示心力衰竭或动脉斑块。

questions.name: #999 Seismic Mars
questions.en:
Until now, Mars has been generally considered a geologically dead planet.
An international team of researchers led by ETH Zurich now reports that seismic signals indicate volcanism still plays an active role in shaping the Martian surface.
questions.zh:
直到现在，火星通常被认为是一颗地质上死亡的星球。
由苏黎世联邦理工学院领导的一个国际研究团队现在报告称，地震信号表明火山活动仍在塑造火星表面方面发挥着积极作用。

questions.name: #1001 Pollution Reduction
questions.en:
Air pollution reduced when U.S. embassies around the world installed monitors and tweeted the Readings.
The resulting reductions in air pollution levels had large health benefits for residents in these cities, speaking to the potential efficacy of other monitoring and information interventions.
questions.zh:
当美国在世界各地的大使馆安装了监测器并发布读数后，空气污染有所减少。
这些城市空气污染水平的降低为居民带来了巨大的健康益处，这说明了其他监测和信息干预措施的潜在效果。

questions.name: #1002 Vitamin and Death
questions.en:
Vitamin D deficiency linked to premature death.
Over a 14-year follow-up period, researchers found that the risk for death significantly decreased with increased vitamin D concentrations, with the strongest effects seen among those with severe deficiencies.

questions.name: #1003 Pandemic
questions.en:
Belief that the COVID-19 pandemic was a hoax – that its severity was exaggerated or that the virus was deliberately released for sinister reasons – functions as a “gateway” to believing in conspiracy theories generally.
In study, pandemic skeptics were more likely to believe in 2020 election fraud.
questions.zh:
相信新冠疫情是一场骗局——认为其严重性被夸大，或者病毒是出于险恶目的故意释放的——这种想法通常是人们相信各种阴谋论的“入门券”。
研究中发现，对疫情持怀疑态度的人更有可能相信2020年大选存在舞弊。

questions.name: #1004 Abortions
questions.en:
The Texas law prohibiting abortion after detectable embryonic cardiac activity was associated with a decrease in in-state abortions and an increase in residents obtaining out-of-state abortions.
The proportion of out-of-state abortions obtained at 12 weeks increased significantly from 17.1% to 31%.
questions.zh:
德州禁止在检测到胚胎心脏活动后进行人工流产的法律，导致州内堕胎数量减少，而居民到外州堕胎的数量增加。
在12周时进行的外州堕胎比例从17.1%显著上升至31%。

questions.name: #1005 Stroke Risk
questions.en:
People in their 20s and 30s who drink moderate to heavy amounts of alcohol may be more likely to have a stroke as young adults than people who drink low amounts or no alcohol, according to a study.
The risk of stroke increased the more years people reported moderate or heavy drinking.

questions.name: #1006 Baby Hearing
questions.en:
Most babies start developing their hearing while still in the womb, prompting some hopeful parents to play classical music to their pregnant bellies.
Some research even suggests that infants are listening to adult speech as early as 10 weeks before birth, gathering the basic building blocks of their family's native tongue.
questions.zh:
大多数宝宝还在妈妈肚子里时就开始发育听力了，这让一些满怀期待的父母会对着孕肚播放古典音乐。
甚至有研究指出，婴儿在出生前10周就开始倾听成人的语言，收集他们母语的基本要素。

questions.name: #1007 Motivation to Fight
questions.en:
USA sexually ‘teased’ its troops in the First World War to make them fight harder.
Believing that sexually satisfied men could not be easily motivated, the aim of this teasing was to generate unmet sexual desire, which the War Department could leverage as motivation to fight.
questions.zh:
美国在第一次世界大战期间故意挑逗士兵的性欲，让他们更拼命打仗。
他们认为性满足的男人不容易被激励，所以这种挑逗的目的是制造未满足的性欲，这样军方就能拿它当动力来驱使士兵作战。

questions.name: #1008 Hybrid Rice
questions.en:
A new breed of rice that is a hybrid of an annual Asian rice and a perennial African rice could be a more sustainable option.
The hybrid rice was able to produce grain for 8 consecutive harvests over four years at a yield comparable to the standard annual Asian rice, with much lower costs and labour.
questions.zh:

这种杂交水稻在四年内连续八次收获，产量与标准的一年生亚洲稻相当，但成本和劳动力却低得多。

questions.name: #1010 New Textbook
questions.en:
This is a new, accessible and engaging textbook written by academics who also work as consultants with organizations undergoing change.
It offers a unique combination of rigorous theoretical exploration together with practical insights from working with those who are actually responsible for managing change.
questions.zh:
这是一本由既从事学术研究又为企业变革提供咨询的专家们编写的新教材，内容通俗易懂且引人入胜。
本书将严谨的理论探索与来自实际变革管理者的实践洞察独特地结合在一起。

questions.name: #1011 Word Radical
questions.en:
The word radical from the Latin word for roots means anyone who advocates fundamental change in the political system.
Literally, a radical is one who proposes to attack some political or social problems by going deep into the social or economic fabric to get at the root cause and alter this basic weakness.
questions.zh:
“激进”这个词源自拉丁语中的“根”，指的是主张对政治体系进行根本变革的人。
从字面上看，激进者是指那些深入社会或经济结构，从根源上解决政治或社会问题，并改变这一根本缺陷的人。

questions.name: #1012 Making Notes
questions.en:
The whole purpose of making notes is to aid your learning.
It is important to go back over them within a day of making them to make sure they make sense and make them legible for future revisions.
Also, going back over them should highlight the key questions of areas in which you want to do further reading.
questions.zh:
做笔记的根本目的是为了帮助你学习。
做完笔记后，最好在一天内再回顾一遍，确保内容清晰易懂，方便以后复习。
另外，回顾笔记还能帮你找出关键问题，明确哪些方面需要进一步阅读。

questions.name: #1013 Humanities
questions.en:
We believe in the inherent value of research in the humanities and social sciences.
And our research data agenda is given by the pursuit of new knowledge that will be of benefit of Australia and the world.

questions.name: #1014 Emigrants
questions.en:
In the late 16th and 17th centuries, many English, French and Dutch emigrants went to North America in search of gold and silver.
But they did not find it.
Instead, settlers were forced to support themselves by cultivating crops that they could sell in Europe, like tobacco, indigo and rice.

在16世纪末和17世纪，许多英国、法国和荷兰的移民前往北美寻找金银。
但他们并没有找到。
相反，定居者被迫通过种植烟草、靛蓝和水稻等能在欧洲销售的作物来维持生计。

questions.name: #1015 Natural Environment
questions.en:
The natural environment can be hazardous, and, with increased travel and leisure, people today are more likely than ever to be exposed to potentially life-threatening conditions.
Although the human body can adjust to some extent, it cannot cope with poisons or prolonged exposure to extremes of environment.
questions.zh:
自然环境可能很危险，随着旅行和休闲活动的增加，如今的人们比以往任何时候都更可能暴露在潜在致命的环境中。
尽管人体能在一定程度上自我调节，但无法应对毒素或长期处于极端环境中的情况。

questions.name: #1016 Learner Experience
questions.en:
We seek to improve learner's experience of education at college and help them to aspire, achieve and progress.
We must embed equality and diversity in everything we do, both as a provider and an employer.
We hope to prepare our students for work, higher education and citizenship by equipping our staff with the skills to meet this agenda.
questions.zh:
我们致力于提升学生在大学的学习体验，帮助他们树立志向、取得成就并不断进步。
作为教育提供者和雇主，我们必须将平等与多元化融入每一项工作中。
我们希望通过培养员工的能力来达成这一目标，从而帮助学生为就业、高等教育和公民责任做好准备。

questions.name: #1017 Expression
questions.en:
Expression became important during the romantic movement with artwork expressing a definite feeling, as in the sublime or dramatic.
Audience response was important, for the artwork was intended to evoke an emotional response.
This definition holds true today as artists look to connect with and evoke responses from their viewers.
questions.zh:
在浪漫主义运动期间，表达变得重要，艺术作品传达明确的情感，比如崇高或戏剧性的感受。
观众的反应很重要，因为艺术作品旨在唤起情感回应。
这个定义在今天仍然适用，因为艺术家们寻求与观众建立联系并引发他们的回应。

questions.name: #1018 Norms and Values
questions.en:
Members of a culture must conform to its norms for the culture to exist and function.
Hence, members must want to conform and obey rules.
They first must internalize the social norms and values that dictate what is normal for the culture.
Then they must socialize or teach norms and values to their children.
questions.zh:
一种文化的成员必须遵守其规范，文化才能存在并运作。
因此，成员必须愿意遵守规则并服从。
他们首先得内化那些决定文化常态的社会规范和价值观。
然后，他们必须将规范和价值观社会化，或者传授给他们的孩子。

questions.name: #1019 Attendance to Theater
questions.en:
Experts discuss the significance of attending the theater as a civic occasion, associated with the political and cultural achievements of Athens.
Through archeology and analyses of contemporary art forms such as decoration on pottery, a picture is built up of ancient Greek theater.
questions.zh:
专家们探讨了将观剧视为一种公民盛事的重要性，这与雅典的政治和文化成就息息相关。
通过考古学以及对陶器装饰等当代艺术形式的分析，古希腊戏剧的面貌逐渐被勾勒出来。

questions.name: #1020 Department Stores
questions.en:
In this course, we will explore how such things as department stores, nationally advertised brand-name goods, mass produced cars and suburbs transformed the American economy, society and politics.
The course is organized both thematically and chronologically.
Each period deals with a new development in the history of consumer culture.
questions.zh:
在这门课里，我们会探讨百货商店、全国性广告品牌商品、大规模生产的汽车和郊区等事物是如何改变美国的经济、社会和政治的。
这门课既按主题也按时间顺序来组织。
每个时期都涉及消费文化史上的一个新进展。

questions.name: #1021 Tortoise
questions.en:
The tortoise size and shell shape varies depending on where they live.
The shell is made of bone and is a dull brown color.
Their ribs, backbone and breastbone have become part of the shell, which is why you can never separate the tortoise from its shell.
questions.zh:
乌龟的大小和壳的形状取决于它们生活的地方。
龟壳由骨头构成，呈暗棕色。
它们的肋骨、脊椎和胸骨已经成了龟壳的一部分，所以永远无法将乌龟与壳分开。

questions.name: #1022 Enough Fluid
questions.en:
Your body is nearly two-thirds water.
And so it is really important that you consume enough fluid to stay hydrated and healthy.
If you don't get enough fluid you may feel tired, get headaches, and not perform at your best.
questions.zh:
你的身体将近三分之二是水。
因此，摄入足够的水分以保持水分充足和健康非常重要。
如果水分摄入不足，你可能会感到疲倦、头痛，并且无法发挥最佳状态。

questions.name: #1024 Tutor
questions.en:
Your tutor helps you make the most of your time at university by giving you guidance and support along the way.
All new students are allocated a personal tutor who will encourage you to get the most out of your course, direct you to other sources of support and help you achieve your goals.
questions.zh:
你的导师会在大学期间给你提供指导和支持，帮你充分利用好这段时间。

questions.name: #1026 William Shakespeare
questions.en:
Three hundred and eighty years after his death, William Shakespeare remains the central author of the English-speaking world; he is the most quoted poet and the most regularly produced playwright — and now among the most popular screenwriters as well.
Why is that, and who "is" he?
questions.zh:
威廉·莎士比亚去世已经三百八十年了，但他依然是英语世界的核心作家；他是被引用最多的诗人，作品上演最频繁的剧作家——如今也是最受欢迎的编剧之一。
为什么会这样，他究竟“是”谁？

questions.name: #1027 Statistics
questions.en:
Statistics are indicators of change and allow meaningful comparisons to be made.
While it may be the issues rather than the statistics as such that grab people's attention, it should be recognized that it is the statistics that informed the issues.
Statistical literacy, then, is the ability to accurately understand, interpret and evaluate the data that inform these issues.
questions.zh:
统计数据是变化的指标，能够让我们进行有意义的比较。
虽然吸引人们注意力的可能是问题本身而非统计数据，但应该认识到，正是这些数据为问题提供了信息依据。
因此，统计素养就是准确理解、解读和评估这些数据的能力，这些数据为问题提供了信息。

questions.name: #1029 Child Psychology
questions.en:
Within this free course, you will be introduced briefly to the discipline of child psychology and to theories and approaches that have been developed to help us understand and support children's lives by focusing on the individual children.
Psychologists can assess changes in their child's abilities over time, including their physical, cognitive, social, and emotional development.

在这门免费课程中，你将简要了解儿童心理学这门学科，以及那些通过关注个体儿童来帮助我们理解并支持儿童生活的理论和研究方法。
心理学家可以评估孩子能力随时间的变化，包括他们的身体、认知、社交和情感发展。

questions.name: #1030 Root Network
questions.en:
The networks of roots that plants use to absorb water and nutrients can encompass a space larger than the part of the plant visible above ground.
The nature of these roots systems can help plants adapt to challenging environments such as deserts.
For instance, mesquite trees can develop tap roots capable of digging more than 50 yards deep to reach water.
questions.zh:
植物用来吸收水分和养分的根系网络，其覆盖范围可能比地面以上的部分还要大。
这些根系系统的特性可以帮助植物适应像沙漠这样恶劣的环境。
例如，牧豆树能长出主根，深入地下50多码来获取水源。

questions.name: #1031 Urban Forests
questions.en:
A community's urban forest is an extension of its pride and community spirit.
Trees enhance community economic stability by attracting businesses and tourists as people tend to linger and shop longer along tree-lined streets.
Apartments and offices in wooded areas rent more quickly and businesses leasing office spaces in developments with trees reported higher productivity and fewer absences.
questions.zh:
一个社区的都市森林是其自豪感和社区精神的延伸。
树木能吸引商家和游客，因为人们更愿意在绿树成荫的街道上逗留和购物，从而增强社区的经济稳定性。
林区的公寓和办公室出租更快，而租用有树木的开发项目办公空间的企业报告称，员工生产力更高，缺勤更少。

questions.name: #1032 Innovative Product
questions.en:
An innovative new product or service can give a firm a head start over its rivals, which can be difficult for a new entrant to overcome.
If the new technology is also patented, then other firms cannot simply copy its design.
It is legally protected.

如果新技术还有专利保护，其他公司就不能简单抄袭它的设计。
这在法律上是受保护的。

questions.name: #1033 Agricultural Problems
questions.en:
Agricultural problems due to climate change of normal weather, water depletion and the collapse of soil have become big problems in all parts of the world.
Many are now focusing on ethics and family farming as a way to combat these issues.

如今，许多人将目光投向伦理道德和家庭农业，以此应对这些难题。

questions.name: #1034 Bill
questions.en:
The bill calls for the establishment of the National Landslide Hazards Reduction Program within one year of becoming law.
The program serves numerous functions, including to identify and understand landslide hazards and risks, reduce losses from landslides, protect communities at risk of landslides hazards, and improve communication and emergency preparedness.
questions.zh:
这项法案要求在其成为法律后一年内建立国家滑坡灾害减少计划。
该计划承担多项职能，包括识别和理解滑坡灾害与风险、减少滑坡造成的损失、保护面临滑坡风险的社区，以及改善沟通和应急准备。

questions.name: #1035 Basic Premise
questions.en:
The basic premise in the management of any system is the ability to minimize risk.
In the context of an ecosystem, one of the important questions is the integrity of the environment and how this integrity is compromised by management.
With mismanagement in ecosystems, the risk of permanent damage to the environment is very high.
questions.zh:
任何系统管理的基本前提都是能够将风险降到最低。
在生态系统中，一个重要的问题是环境的完整性，以及这种完整性如何因管理而受到损害。
如果生态系统管理不当，对环境造成永久性损害的风险非常高。

questions.name: #1036 Watershed
questions.en:
A watershed stores rainwater once it filters through the soil.
Once the watershed's soils are saturated, water will either percolate deeper, or runoff the surface.
This can result in freshwater aquifers and springs.
Also, water moves through the soil to seeps and springs, and is ultimately released into streams, rivers, and the ocean.
questions.zh:
雨水渗入土壤后，就会被流域储存起来。
一旦流域的土壤饱和，水要么向下渗透得更深，要么从地表流失。
这可以形成淡水含水层和泉水。
此外，水通过土壤渗入渗出点和泉眼，最终汇入溪流、河流和海洋。

questions.name: #1037 Choking
questions.en:
You ought to know what to do to help a person who is choking.
First, you stand behind the choking victim and put your arms around his or her waist.
Second, you make a fist and place the thumb side against the person’s stomach just above the navel, but below the ribs.
questions.zh:
你应该知道怎么帮助一个噎住的人。
首先，站在噎住的人身后，用双臂环住他或她的腰。
接着，握拳，将拇指侧抵住对方腹部，正好在肚脐上方、肋骨下方。

questions.name: #1038 Antecedents of Theater
questions.en:
In addition to exploring the possible antecedents of theater, scholars have also theorized about the motives that led people to develop theater.
Why did theater develop, and why was it valued after it ceased to fulfill the function of ritual?
Most answers fall back on the theories about the human mind and basic human needs.
questions.zh:
除了探索戏剧可能的起源，学者们还推测了促使人们发展戏剧的动机。
戏剧为何发展？当它不再履行仪式的功能后，为何仍受重视？
大多数答案都回归到关于人类心智和基本需求的理论。

questions.name: #1039 Oil
questions.en:
As oil becomes increasingly difficult to find, the search for it is extended into more-hostile environments.
The development of the oil field on the North Slope of Alaska and the construction of the Alaska pipeline are examples of the great expense and difficulty involved in new oil discoveries.

questions.name: #1040 Tickling
questions.en:
One of the strangest things about tickling is that it’s pretty much impossible for a person to tickle himself or herself.
The reason you can’t tickle yourself is that when you move a part of your own body, a part of your brain monitors the movement and anticipates the sensations that it will cause.
questions.zh:
关于挠痒痒最奇怪的一点是，人几乎不可能自己挠自己痒痒。
你无法自己挠自己痒痒的原因是，当你移动自己身体的某个部位时，大脑的一部分会监测这个动作并预判它会引起的感觉。

questions.name: #1041 Experiential Purchases
questions.en:
Experiential purchases are also more associated with identity, connection, and social behavior.
Looking back on purchases made, experiences make people happier than do possessions.
It's kind of counter to the logic that if you pay for an experience, like a vacation, it will be over and gone.
questions.zh:
体验型消费也更容易与身份认同、社交联系和行为联系在一起。
回顾过往的消费，体验比物品更能让人感到幸福。
这有点违背常理——如果你花钱买体验，比如一次度假，它很快就会结束并消失。

questions.name: #1042 Kitchen Sponge
questions.en:
Ask bacteria where they’d like to live, and they’ll answer: a kitchen sponge, please.
Sponges are microbe paradises, capable of housing 54 billion bacteria per cubic centimeter.
In addition to being damp, airy and loaded with food scraps, sponges provide an optimal physical environment for bacteria, researchers report February 10 in Nature Chemical Biology.
questions.zh:
要是问细菌想住哪儿，它们准会说：厨房里的海绵，谢谢。
海绵简直是微生物的天堂，每立方厘米能容纳540亿个细菌。
研究人员2月10日在《自然化学生物学》期刊上报告说，海绵不仅潮湿、通风、满是食物残渣，还为细菌提供了绝佳的物理环境。

questions.name: #1043 Heat and Humidity
questions.en:
Scientists have identified the maximum mix of heat and humidity a human body can survive.
Even a healthy young person will die after enduring six hours of 35-degree Celsius warmth when coupled with 100 percent humidity, but new research shows that threshold could be significantly lower.
questions.zh:
科学家已经确定了人体能承受的最高温湿度组合。
即使一个健康的年轻人，在35摄氏度且100%湿度的环境下撑过六小时也会死亡，但新研究表明这个临界值可能要低得多。

questions.name: #1044 Being Scared
questions.en:
Being scared to death boils down to our autonomic response to a strong emotion, such as fear.
For fear-induced deaths, the demise starts with our fight-or-flight response, which is the body’s physical response to a perceived threat.
This response is characterized by an increased heart rate, anxiety, perspiration, and increased blood glucose levels.
questions.zh:
吓得要死其实是我们面对恐惧这类强烈情绪时的自主反应。
因恐惧导致的死亡，始于我们的“战斗或逃跑”反应——这是身体对感知到的威胁做出的生理反应。
这种反应表现为心率加快、焦虑、出汗以及血糖水平升高。

questions.name: #1045 Black Lives Matter
questions.en:

As people around the world demand justice and equality, it is clear that there is still much work to be done to create a more just and equitable society.

questions.name: #1046 Deforestation
questions.en:
Deforestation of the Amazon rainforest contributes significantly to climate change, affecting the local ecosystem and the entire planet.
Trees absorb carbon dioxide from the atmosphere, regulating the Earth's climate.
When forests are destroyed, this carbon is released into the atmosphere, contributing to global warming and climate change.
questions.zh:
亚马逊雨林的砍伐大大加剧了气候变化，不仅影响当地生态，也波及整个地球。
树木从大气中吸收二氧化碳，调节地球的气候。
森林被毁后，这些碳会释放到大气中，导致全球变暖和气候变化。

questions.name: #1047 Dark Matter
questions.en:
Dark matter remains one of the greatest mysteries in astronomy.
Scientists know it exists because of its gravitational effects on visible matter, but they have yet to detect it directly.
Solving the mystery of dark matter could revolutionize our understanding of the universe.

questions.name: #1049 Climate Change
questions.en:
Climate change is not a distant threat but a present reality that is already affecting communities around the world through rising temperatures and extreme weather events.
Climate change is caused by human activities such as burning fossil fuels, deforestation, and agriculture.
Its impacts include more frequent heatwaves, droughts, floods, and storms that can damage infrastructure, harm ecosystems, and cause loss of life.
questions.zh:
气候变化不是遥远的威胁，而是当下的现实，它已经通过气温升高和极端天气事件影响着全球各地的社区。
气候变化是由人类活动引起的，比如燃烧化石燃料、砍伐森林和农业活动。
其影响包括更频繁的热浪、干旱、洪水和风暴，这些都可能破坏基础设施、危害生态系统并造成人员伤亡。

questions.name: #1050 Social Media
questions.en:
Social media has transformed the way we communicate and interact with others by enabling instant communication across distances and facilitating connections with people from diverse backgrounds.
However, it has also raised concerns about privacy and security as personal information can be easily shared or stolen online.
questions.zh:
社交媒体彻底改变了我们沟通和互动的方式，它让我们能即时跨越距离交流，更容易结识背景各异的人。
不过，这也引发了对隐私和安全的担忧，因为个人信息在网上很容易被分享或盗取。

questions.name: #1051 Good Health
questions.en:
Maintaining good health is essential for living a happy and fulfilling life.
Eating a balanced diet rich in fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and lean proteins, staying physically active for at least 30 minutes a day, and getting enough sleep are all important factors in achieving optimal health and preventing chronic diseases such as obesity, diabetes, and heart disease.
questions.zh:
保持身体健康对过上幸福充实的生活至关重要。
均衡饮食，多吃水果、蔬菜、全谷物和瘦肉蛋白，每天至少进行30分钟体育锻炼，并保证充足睡眠，这些都是实现最佳健康、预防肥胖、糖尿病和心脏病等慢性疾病的重要因素。

questions.name: #1053 Astronomy
questions.en:
Astronomy is a fascinating field that allows us to explore the mysteries of the universe, from the origins of stars and galaxies to the search for extraterrestrial life.
It requires advanced technology such as telescopes and spacecraft, as well as interdisciplinary collaboration between scientists from different fields.

天文学是个迷人的领域，让我们得以探索宇宙的奥秘，从恒星和星系的起源到寻找外星生命。
它需要望远镜和航天器等先进技术，也需要不同领域的科学家进行跨学科合作。

questions.en:
Geography is the study of the earth's physical features and human populations, providing insights into how our world is shaped and how we interact with it.
It encompasses topics such as climate, geology, demographics, and cultural practices, and informs decision-making in areas such as urban planning and disaster management.
questions.zh:
地理学是研究地球自然特征和人类分布的学科，它帮助我们理解世界如何被塑造以及我们如何与之互动。
这门学科涵盖气候、地质、人口统计和文化习俗等主题，并为城市规划、灾害管理等领域的决策提供依据。

questions.en:
Education is a crucial component of personal and societal growth, providing individuals with the knowledge and skills they need to succeed in life.
It encompasses formal schooling as well as informal learning opportunities such as workshops, apprenticeships, and online courses, and promotes critical thinking, creativity, and lifelong learning.

教育不仅包括正规的学校教育，还涵盖工作坊、学徒制和在线课程等非正式学习机会，并促进批判性思维、创造力和终身学习。

questions.name: #1058 Mental Health
questions.en:
The importance of mental health cannot be overstated, as it affects every aspect of our lives from relationships to productivity to physical health.
Seeking help when needed from qualified professionals such as therapists or psychiatrists, practicing self-care through activities such as meditation or exercise, and reducing stigma around mental illness are all important steps towards maintaining emotional well-being.
questions.zh:
心理健康的重要性怎么强调都不为过，因为它影响着我们生活的方方面面，从人际关系到工作效率再到身体健康。
在需要时向治疗师或精神科医生等合格专业人士寻求帮助，通过冥想或运动等活动进行自我关怀，以及减少对精神疾病的污名化，都是维护情绪健康的重要步骤。

questions.name: #1059 Ecology
questions.en:
The study of ecology helps us understand how living organisms interact with each other and their environment, providing insights into how we can protect and preserve natural ecosystems for future generations.
It encompasses topics such as biodiversity, conservation biology, and ecosystem services.
questions.zh:
生态学的研究帮助我们理解生物之间以及生物与环境如何相互作用，从而让我们知道如何保护和维护自然生态系统，为子孙后代留下宝贵的财富。
它涵盖了生物多样性、保护生物学和生态系统服务等主题。

questions.en:
Neuroscience is the interdisciplinary field that seeks to understand the brain and nervous system, drawing on knowledge from biology, psychology, physics, and other disciplines.
It encompasses a wide range of research areas, from molecular and cellular neuroscience to cognitive and behavioral neuroscience, each with its unique set of tools and techniques.

questions.name: #1061 Environmental Justice
questions.en:
Environmental justice seeks to address inequities in environmental protection by ensuring that all communities have access to clean air, water, and land regardless of race or socioeconomic status.
It requires collaboration between environmental advocates, policymakers, and affected communities.
Environmental justice also recognizes that certain communities are disproportionately affected by environmental hazards like pollution and climate change, and seeks to redress these imbalances through targeted policies and interventions.
questions.zh:
环境正义旨在解决环境保护中的不平等问题，确保所有社区无论种族或经济状况如何，都能享有清洁的空气、水和土地。
这需要环保倡导者、政策制定者和受影响社区之间的合作。
环境正义还认识到，某些社区受到污染和气候变化等环境危害的影响尤为严重，并试图通过有针对性的政策和干预措施来纠正这些不平衡。

questions.name: #1062 Campus Life
questions.en:
Campus life is a unique experience that offers students the opportunity to learn, grow, and connect with others in a supportive and intellectually stimulating environment.
From attending classes and participating in extracurricular activities to socializing with friends and exploring new interests, college provides a wealth of opportunities for personal and academic development.

校园生活是一种独特的体验，让学生在充满支持和激发智力的环境中学习、成长、与他人建立联系。
从上课、参加课外活动，到与朋友交往、探索新兴趣，大学为个人和学术发展提供了丰富的机会。

questions.name: #1063 Technology
questions.en:
Technology has transformed the way we learn and interact with information, from online learning platforms to virtual reality simulations that offer new ways of engaging with course material.
These tools can enhance the learning experience by providing more flexibility, interactivity, and customization than traditional classroom methods.
For example, online learning platforms like Coursera or edX offer students access to courses from top universities around the world.
questions.zh:
技术彻底改变了我们学习和获取信息的方式，从在线学习平台到虚拟现实模拟，这些都为课程材料的互动提供了新途径。
这些工具能提升学习体验，相比传统课堂方法，它们提供了更大的灵活性、更强的互动性和更高的个性化程度。
例如，像Coursera或edX这样的在线学习平台让学生能够接触到世界各地顶尖大学的课程。

questions.name: #1064 Academic Success
questions.en:
Academic success requires a combination of hard work, dedication, and effective study habits, such as time management, active reading, and critical thinking.
Students who excel academically are those who are able to balance their coursework with other responsibilities, prioritize their assignments according to deadlines and importance, and engage with the material in a meaningful way that promotes deep learning.
questions.zh:
学业有成需要勤奋、投入和高效的学习习惯相结合，比如管理时间、主动阅读和批判性思考。
学业出色的学生，往往能平衡课业与其他责任，根据截止日期和重要性安排作业优先级，并有意义地钻研材料，从而促进深度学习。

questions.name: #1066 College Application Process
questions.en:
The college application process can be daunting, but with careful planning, research, and preparation, students can maximize their chances of getting accepted to their top-choice schools.
This process typically involves researching colleges and universities that match one's interests and qualifications, preparing for standardized tests like the SAT or ACT, and crafting a compelling personal statement or essay that highlights one's strengths and achievements.
questions.zh:
申请大学的过程可能会让人望而生畏，但只要仔细规划、研究和准备，学生就能最大程度地提高被心仪学校录取的机会。
这个过程通常包括研究符合自己兴趣和条件的大学，准备SAT或ACT等标准化考试，以及撰写一篇能突出自己优势和成就的引人入胜的个人陈述或论文。

questions.name: #1067 Online Education
questions.en:
Online education has opened up new opportunities for students who may not have access to traditional campus-based programs, allowing them to pursue their academic goals from anywhere in the world.
Online courses offer greater flexibility and convenience than traditional classroom-based courses, allowing students to study at their own pace and on their own schedule.

在线课程比传统课堂课程更灵活方便，学生可以按照自己的节奏和时间安排来学习。

questions.name: #1068 Space Exploration
questions.en:
Space exploration has expanded our horizons and deepened our understanding of the universe, from the first moon landing to the discovery of exoplanets orbiting distant stars.
Through space missions and telescopic observations, scientists have unraveled cosmic mysteries, studied celestial bodies in detail, and gained insights into the origins and evolution of our universe.
questions.zh:
太空探索拓宽了我们的视野，加深了我们对宇宙的理解，从首次登月到发现绕遥远恒星运行的系外行星，皆是如此。
通过太空任务和望远镜观测，科学家们解开了宇宙的奥秘，详细研究了天体，并深入了解了宇宙的起源与演化。

questions.name: #1069 Artificial Intelligence
questions.en:
Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming many aspects of modern society, from healthcare and finance to transportation and entertainment.
AI refers to the development of computer systems that can perform tasks that typically require human intelligence, such as speech recognition, decision-making, and problem-solving.
With AI algorithms becoming increasingly sophisticated through machine learning techniques, we are witnessing advancements in autonomous vehicles, natural language processing systems, recommendation engines, and more.
questions.zh:
人工智能正在改变现代社会的方方面面，从医疗和金融到交通和娱乐。
人工智能指的是开发能够执行通常需要人类智能的任务的计算机系统，比如语音识别、决策和问题解决。
随着AI算法通过机器学习技术变得越来越复杂，我们正见证着自动驾驶汽车、自然语言处理系统、推荐引擎等领域的进步。

questions.name: #1070 Nature
questions.en:
Nature is a source of wonder and inspiration, offering a rich diversity of life forms and ecosystems that are essential to our survival and well-being.
From the depths of the ocean to the highest peaks of the mountains, nature provides a wealth of opportunities for exploration and discovery.
It is through our interactions with nature that we can learn valuable lessons about resilience, adaptability, and interconnectedness.
questions.zh:
大自然充满了奇妙与灵感，它提供了丰富多样的生命形态和生态系统，这对我们的生存和幸福至关重要。
从海洋深处到高山之巅，大自然为探索和发现提供了无数机会。
正是通过与自然的互动，我们才能学到关于韧性、适应性和相互关联性的宝贵经验。

questions.name: #1071 Arctic Region
questions.en:
The Arctic region is one of the most fragile ecosystems on Earth, with melting ice caps and rising temperatures threatening many species that call this region home.
Protecting this vital ecosystem will require international cooperation on issues like reducing greenhouse gas emissions and preserving biodiversity.
questions.zh:
北极地区是地球上最脆弱的生态系统之一，冰盖融化和气温升高正威胁着许多栖息于此的物种。
保护这一重要生态系统需要国际社会在减少温室气体排放和保护生物多样性等问题上携手合作。

questions.name: #1072 Age of Exploration
questions.en:
The Age of Exploration in the 15th and 16th centuries saw European explorers travel around the world in search of new trade routes and territories.
While this era brought about many significant advances in science, navigation, and cartography, it also had negative consequences like colonization and exploitation of indigenous peoples.
questions.zh:
15和16世纪的大航海时代，欧洲探险家们环游世界，寻找新的贸易路线和领土。
虽然这个时代带来了科学、航海和制图学上的许多重大进步，但也带来了殖民和剥削原住民等负面影响。

questions.name: #1073 Online Learning
questions.en:
Online learning has become increasingly popular in recent years, offering students the flexibility to pursue their education from anywhere with an internet connection.
However, online learning also requires self-discipline and strong time management skills to stay on track and complete coursework on time.
Additionally, online learning may not be the best fit for all students, as some may prefer the structure and social interaction of traditional classroom settings.
questions.zh:
近年来，在线学习越来越受欢迎，它让学生能够灵活地在任何有网络的地方继续学业。
不过，在线学习也需要自律和良好的时间管理能力，才能跟上进度并按时完成课程。
另外，在线学习可能并非适合所有学生，因为有些人更偏爱传统课堂的条理性和社交互动。

questions.name: #1074 Writing
questions.en:
Writing is an important skill for academic success and professional development.
Some tips for improving writing skills include practicing regularly, seeking out feedback from peers or instructors, and reading widely to develop a strong foundation in grammar, syntax, and style.
Additionally, developing strong writing skills can help students in a wide range of careers, from journalism to marketing to law.
questions.zh:
写作是学业成功和职业发展的重要技能。
提高写作技巧的一些建议包括定期练习、寻求同伴或老师的反馈，以及广泛阅读以打下语法、句法和风格方面的坚实基础。
此外，培养强大的写作能力可以帮助学生从事从新闻到市场营销再到法律等广泛的职业。

questions.name: #1075 Innovation
questions.en:

It is important to support innovation through funding for research and development as well as education in STEM fields (science, technology, engineering, and math).
Additionally, promoting innovation can help address global challenges like climate change or public health crises.

通过资助研发以及加强科学、技术、工程和数学领域的教育来支持创新很重要。
此外，促进创新有助于应对气候变化或公共卫生危机等全球性挑战。

questions.name: #1076 Quantum Computing
questions.en:
Quantum computing is a new type of computing that uses quantum bits (qubits) instead of traditional bits to perform calculations.
It has the potential to solve complex problems that are beyond the capabilities of classical computers by leveraging quantum phenomena like superposition and entanglement.

通过利用叠加和纠缠等量子现象，它有望解决那些经典计算机无法处理的复杂问题。

questions.name: #1077 Classroom Technology
questions.en:
Classroom technology can enhance teaching and learning by providing interactive and engaging experiences for students.
It includes tools like smart boards, tablets, and online resources that can help students stay engaged and motivated.
However, it also requires careful planning and implementation to ensure that it aligns with learning goals and supports student success.
questions.zh:

这些技术包括智能白板、平板电脑和在线资源等工具，能帮助学生保持专注和积极性。
然而，它也需要仔细规划和实施，以确保与学习目标一致并支持学生取得成功。

questions.name: #1078 Organic Farming
questions.en:
Organic farming is a sustainable practice that promotes biodiversity and protects the environment from harmful chemicals and pesticides.
Organic farming prioritizes soil health and uses natural methods to control pests and diseases instead of relying on synthetic chemicals.
By supporting organic farming practices, we can promote healthier ecosystems and protect the health of our planet.
questions.zh:
有机农业是一种可持续的耕作方式，它有助于促进生物多样性，并保护环境免受有害化学物质和农药的侵害。
有机农业把土壤健康放在首位，采用自然方法来控制病虫害，而不是依赖化学合成物质。
通过支持有机农业实践，我们可以促进更健康的生态系统，并保护地球的健康。

questions.name: #1083 Recycling
questions.en:
Recycling is a powerful tool for reducing waste and conserving resources.
By recycling paper, plastic, glass, and metal, we can reduce the amount of waste sent to landfills and conserve natural resources.
Recycling also saves energy and reduces greenhouse gas emissions.
To maximize the benefits of recycling, we should strive to reduce our consumption of single-use products and prioritize the use of recycled materials.
questions.zh:
回收是减少浪费和保护资源的有效手段。
通过回收纸张、塑料、玻璃和金属，我们可以减少送往垃圾填埋场的废物量，并节约自然资源。
回收还能节省能源，减少温室气体排放。
为了最大化回收的好处，我们应该努力减少一次性产品的消费，并优先使用回收材料。

如果这些挑战得不到解决，可能会导致经济停滞，并降低社区的生活质量。

questions.name: #1085 Planetary Rings
questions.en:
Planetary rings are some of the most spectacular features in our solar system, consisting of countless particles orbiting around a planet.
They are formed by a variety of processes, including collisions between moons and gravitational interactions with nearby planets.
Studying planetary rings can provide insights into the formation and evolution of planetary systems.
questions.zh:
行星环是太阳系中最壮观的景象之一，由无数围绕行星运行的粒子组成。
它们通过多种过程形成，包括卫星之间的碰撞以及与附近行星的引力相互作用。
研究行星环可以让我们深入了解行星系统的形成和演化。

questions.name: #1087 Solar System
questions.en:
The formation of the solar system is a complex and fascinating process that began over 4.6 billion years ago.
It involved the collapse of a giant molecular cloud, the formation of a protostar, and the accretion of dust and gas into planets, moons, and asteroids.
Understanding this process can provide insights into the origins of life and the formation of other planetary systems.
questions.zh:
太阳系的形成是一个复杂而迷人的过程，始于超过46亿年前。
它涉及巨大分子云的坍缩、原恒星的形成，以及尘埃和气体聚集成行星、卫星和小行星。
理解这一过程可以为我们揭示生命起源和其他行星系统形成的奥秘。

questions.name: #1089 Extraterrestrial Life
questions.en:
The search for extraterrestrial life has fascinated scientists and the public alike for decades.
With advances in technology and the discovery of exoplanets, the possibility of finding life beyond Earth is becoming increasingly likely.
However, the search remains challenging, requiring innovative approaches and sophisticated instruments.
questions.zh:

然而，这项探索仍然充满挑战，需要创新的方法和精密的仪器。

questions.name: #1090 Balanced Diet
questions.en:
A balanced diet is crucial for maintaining good health.
It provides the nutrients and energy needed for optimal bodily function and can prevent chronic diseases such as cancer, diabetes, and heart disease.
By eating a variety of fruits, vegetables, whole grains, lean proteins, and healthy fats, we can ensure that our body receives the nutrients it needs.

通过摄入多样的水果、蔬菜、全谷物、瘦肉蛋白和健康脂肪，我们可以确保身体获得所需的营养。

questions.name: #1091 Water Conservation
questions.en:
Water is a precious resource that we must conserve to ensure its availability for future generations.
We can do this by fixing leaks, using low-flow toilets and showerheads, and avoiding wasteful practices like leaving the tap running while brushing our teeth.
Conserving water also helps to protect aquatic habitats and wildlife that depend on healthy water sources.
questions.zh:
水是一种宝贵的资源，我们必须节约用水，以确保子孙后代也能用上它。
我们可以通过修好漏水的水管、使用节水马桶和淋浴头，以及避免刷牙时让水龙头一直开着这种浪费行为来做到这一点。
节约用水也有助于保护依赖健康水源的水生栖息地和野生动物。

questions.name: #1092 Childhood Education
questions.en:
Early childhood education plays a crucial role in a child's development.
It provides a strong foundation for future learning and helps children develop social, emotional, and cognitive skills.
High-quality early childhood education programs can make a positive impact on children's lives and their future success.

高质量的幼儿教育项目能对孩子的生活和未来成功产生积极影响。

questions.name: #1093 Social Media
questions.en:
Social media has become ubiquitous in modern society, but its impact on mental health is still being studied.
Research suggests that social media use can lead to feelings of loneliness, anxiety, and depression, highlighting the need for responsible use and regulation.
It is important for individuals to be mindful of their social media use and to seek support if they are experiencing negative effects on their mental health.
questions.zh:
社交媒体在现代社会已经无处不在，但它对心理健康的影响仍在研究中。
研究表明，使用社交媒体可能导致孤独、焦虑和抑郁情绪，这凸显了负责任使用和监管的必要性。
个人需要注意自己的社交媒体使用习惯，如果心理健康受到负面影响，应及时寻求支持。

questions.name: #1095 Positive Psychology
questions.en:
Positive psychology is a relatively new field that emphasizes the promotion of well-being and positive emotions rather than just the treatment of mental illness.
Positive psychologists study topics such as happiness, gratitude, and resilience.
By promoting positive emotions and behaviors, positive psychology interventions can improve mental health outcomes.

积极心理学家研究诸如幸福、感恩和韧性等主题。
通过促进积极情绪和行为，积极心理学的干预措施可以改善心理健康状况。

questions.name: #1096 Pursuing Academics
questions.en:
Pursuing academics is a challenging and rewarding endeavor that requires dedication, hard work, and effective study strategies.
Achieving academic goals and succeeding in chosen fields can be accomplished by setting objectives, managing time efficiently, seeking assistance when necessary, and developing a growth mindset that embraces challenges and values learning.

要达成学业目标并在所选领域取得成功，可以通过设定目标、高效管理时间、必要时寻求帮助，以及培养成长型思维——这种思维能让你拥抱挑战、重视学习——来实现。

questions.name: #1097 Monkey
questions.en:
A monkey that received a kidney from a genetically engineered miniature pig lived for more than two years after the transplant.
Scientists took a molecular red pen to donor pigs’ genomes, editing the animals’ organs to be more of a match for humans.
Such an editing strategy could one day make it more likely for people’s bodies to accept organs from different species.
questions.zh:
一只猴子在接受了基因改造迷你猪的肾脏后，存活了两年多。
科学家们对供体猪的基因组进行了分子层面的修改，使其器官更适配人类。
这种编辑策略有朝一日或许能提高人体接受异种器官的可能性。

questions.name: #1099 Great Barrier Reef
questions.en:
The Great Barrier Reef is the world's largest coral reef system, stretching over 2,300 kilometers off the coast of Australia.
It is a complex and diverse ecosystem that supports thousands of species of marine life, including fish, turtles, sharks, and dolphins, and is considered one of the seven natural wonders of the world.
questions.zh:

questions.name: #1100 Mona Lisa

The painting's enigmatic expression and subtle details have captivated viewers for centuries and inspired countless interpretations and analyses by art historians and critics.

questions.name: #1101 Wine Quality
questions.en:
Researchers show that weather plays an important role in determining wine quality.
By analyzing 50 years’ worth of wine critic scores from the Bordeaux wine region in relation to that year’s weather, the researchers showed that higher quality wine is made in years with warmer temperatures, higher winter rainfall, and earlier, shorter growing seasons.
questions.zh:
研究人员发现，天气对葡萄酒品质有重要影响。
通过分析波尔多产区50年来的葡萄酒评论家评分与当年天气的关系，研究人员发现，在气温更高、冬季降雨更多、生长季更早且更短的年份，产出的葡萄酒品质更高。

questions.name: #1102 Jellyfish
questions.en:
Even without a central brain, jellyfish can learn from past experiences like humans, mice, and flies, scientists report for the first time.
They trained Caribbean box jellyfish (Tripedalia cystophora) to learn to spot and dodge obstacles.
The study challenges previous notions that advanced learning requires a centralized brain and sheds light on the evolutionary roots of learning and memory.
questions.zh:
科学家首次报告，即使没有中央大脑，水母也能像人类、老鼠和苍蝇一样从过去的经验中学习。
他们训练加勒比箱水母（Tripedalia cystophora）学会发现并躲避障碍物。
这项研究挑战了此前认为高级学习需要中央大脑的观点，并揭示了学习与记忆的进化根源。

questions.name: #1103 Learning from Others
questions.en:
People are constantly learning from others without even being aware of it.
Social learning avoids laborious trial and error; the wheel does not have to be reinvented each time.
But where does this ability come from, which forms the basis of cultural learning and consequently for the evolutionary success of the human species?
questions.zh:
人们总在不知不觉中向他人学习。
社会学习避免了费力的试错过程；我们不必每次都重新发明轮子。
但这种能力从何而来？它构成了文化学习的基础，进而也是人类物种进化成功的关键。

questions.name: #1104 Culinary Arts
questions.en:
Culinary arts is the art of preparing and cooking food.
It encompasses a wide range of skills and techniques, from knife skills and flavor balancing to plating and presentation.
The culinary industry includes many different types of establishments, such as restaurants, cafes, bakeries, and catering companies, and offers a variety of career paths for aspiring chefs and food professionals.

烹饪艺术就是准备和烹饪食物的艺术。
它涵盖了一系列广泛的技能和技巧，从刀工和口味平衡到摆盘和呈现。
烹饪行业包括许多不同类型的场所，比如餐厅、咖啡馆、面包店和餐饮公司，并为有志成为厨师和食品专业人士的人提供了多种职业道路。

questions.name: #1105 Amazon Forest
questions.en:
A very unexpected discovery has surprised the world.
The Amazon Forest, thought to be a reservoir of wildlife and primitive indigenous settlements, was also the seat of advanced civilizations.
By advanced, we mean that they were large urban societies with civic and ritualistic activities, in contrast with nomadic small tribes.
questions.zh:

亚马逊雨林，一直被认为是野生动物和原始土著居民的聚集地，也曾是先进文明的所在地。
所谓先进，是指它们拥有城市社会和礼仪活动的大型社会，与游牧的小部落形成对比。

Psychology is the scientific study of human behavior and mental processes.
Understanding the complexities of the human mind allows psychologists to develop effective interventions and treatments for a wide range of mental health challenges, which can improve the quality of life for individuals and communities alike.

questions.name: #1107 Nature

The sun dipped below the horizon, casting a warm golden glow over the tranquil meadow.
The gentle breeze whispered through the tall grass, creating a soothing melody.
The scent of wildflowers filled the air, as butterflies danced from petal to petal.
Birds chirped their evening lullabies, while a stream trickled nearby.

questions.name: #1108 Music
questions.en:
Music is a universal language that transcends cultural boundaries.
It evokes emotions and memories, bringing people together in harmony.
Whether it's classical, pop, or rock, music has the power to inspire and uplift.
It's a form of self-expression that touches the hearts of millions worldwide.
questions.zh:
音乐是一种超越文化界限的通用语言。
它能唤起情感和回忆，让人们和谐地聚在一起。
无论是古典、流行还是摇滚，音乐都有激励和鼓舞人心的力量。
这是一种自我表达的方式，触动了全世界数百万人的心。

Love is a powerful force that transcends boundaries and defies logic.
It can bring immense joy and profound pain, often simultaneously.
Love is the gentle touch that heals wounds and the flame that ignites passion.
It is the unspoken words that convey understanding and the shared laughter that creates memories.

爱是治愈伤口的温柔触碰，也是点燃激情的火焰。
爱是无需言语的理解，也是共同欢笑创造的回忆。

questions.name: #1110 History
questions.en:
Centuries ago, in a time long forgotten, great civilizations rose and fell, leaving behind a legacy etched in the annals of history.
From the majestic pyramids of Egypt to the grandeur of ancient Rome, each era had its triumphs and tribulations.
The tales of conquerors and visionaries, heroes and villains, continue to captivate our imagination.
questions.zh:
几百年前，在一个久被遗忘的时代，伟大的文明兴衰更迭，在历史长卷中留下了深深的印记。
从宏伟的埃及金字塔到壮丽的古罗马，每个时代都有它的辉煌与坎坷。
征服者与梦想家、英雄与恶棍的故事，至今仍让我们心驰神往。

questions.name: #1111 Dreams
questions.en:
Dreams are the landscapes where our deepest desires take flight.
They are the whispers of our subconscious, revealing hidden aspirations and fears.
Dreams can be elusive, slipping through our fingers like sand, or they can be powerful motivators that propel us forward.
They are the canvases on which we paint our hopes and aspirations.
questions.zh:
梦境是一片风景，我们最深切的渴望在那里展翅高飞。
它们是潜意识的低语，揭示出隐藏的渴望与恐惧。
梦境可能难以捉摸，像沙子一样从指缝中溜走，也可能成为强大的动力，推动我们前进。
它们是一块画布，我们在上面描绘自己的希望和抱负。

questions.name: #1112 Travel
questions.en:
Traveling is an exciting way to explore new places and cultures.
It broadens our horizons and fosters understanding between people from different backgrounds.
From exotic foods to stunning landscapes, every trip creates lasting memories.
It's an adventure that enriches our lives and teaches us valuable lessons about ourselves and the world around us.
questions.zh:
旅行是一种令人兴奋的方式，可以探索新的地方和文化。
它开阔了我们的视野，促进了不同背景的人们之间的理解。
从异国美食到壮丽景观，每一次旅行都会留下难忘的回忆。
这是一场冒险，丰富了我们的生活，也让我们对自己和周围的世界有了宝贵的认识。

questions.name: #1113 Air Taxi
questions.en:
The air taxi market is almost ready for take off, with companies such as Boeing, Hyundai, Airbus and Toyota building fleets to have commuters flitting through the sky.
Europe and the US have both drafted new rules to pave the way for air taxis to begin operations within the decade, with Australia's Civil Aviation Safety Authority (CASA) to follow suit.
questions.zh:
空中出租车市场差不多要起飞了，波音、现代、空客和丰田这些公司都在打造机队，让通勤者能穿梭于天空。
欧洲和美国都已经草拟了新规，为空中出租车在本十年内投入运营铺路，澳大利亚民航安全局（CASA）也将效仿。

questions.name: #1115 Building Meaningful Relationships
questions.en:
Building meaningful relationships is fundamental to human happiness and well-being.
Whether it's with family, friends, or romantic partners, healthy relationships provide support, love, and a sense of belonging.
Nurturing relationships requires open communication, trust, and empathy.
Investing time and effort into building strong connections enriches our lives and provides a support system during challenging times.
questions.zh:
建立有意义的人际关系是获得幸福和身心健康的基础。
无论是与家人、朋友还是伴侣，健康的关系都能带来支持、关爱和归属感。
维系关系需要坦诚沟通、信任和换位思考。
投入时间和精力去建立牢固的联系，能丰富我们的生活，并在困难时期提供支持。

questions.name: #1116 Molecular Crystals
questions.en:
A team researchers has discovered molecular crystals capable of capturing iodine -- one of the most common radioactive fission products -- and other pollutants.
The versatile crystals could be used for nuclear waste management and other energy-related applications and move the world closer to a net-zero future.
questions.zh:
一个研究团队发现了一种分子晶体，能够捕获碘——最常见的放射性裂变产物之一——以及其他污染物。
这种多用途晶体可用于核废料管理及其他能源相关领域，推动世界迈向净零排放的未来。

questions.name: #1117 Businiess
questions.en:
Business is a dynamic force that shapes economies and societies.
It embodies the spirit of entrepreneurship, driving innovation and growth.
From startups challenging the status quo to multinational corporations shaping global markets, the business world is a vibrant ecosystem where strategic thinking, risk management, and adaptability are paramount.

它体现了企业家精神，推动创新和增长。

questions.name: #1118 Speech Production
questions.en:
Speech production is a complex neural phenomenon that has left researchers explaining it tongue-tied.
Separating out the complex web of neural regions controlling precise muscle movement in the mouth, jaw and tongue with the regions processing the auditory feedback of hearing your own voice is a complex problem.
questions.zh:
说话是个复杂的神经现象，让研究人员解释起来都结结巴巴的。
要把控制嘴巴、下巴和舌头精细肌肉运动的神经网络，与处理听到自己声音的听觉反馈的区域分开，是个复杂的问题。

questions.name: #1119 3D Printing Method
questions.en:
Scientists have used 3D printing technology to create a specialized brain tissue that mimics the cerebral cortex.
By utilizing human stem cells, they were able to implant these engineered structures into mouse brain slices, where they seamlessly integrated with the existing tissue.
This groundbreaking technique shows promise for future applications in treating brain injuries.
questions.zh:
科学家利用3D打印技术制造出了一种模拟大脑皮层的特殊脑组织。
通过使用人类干细胞，他们将这些工程化结构植入小鼠脑切片中，这些结构无缝地融入了现有组织。
这项突破性技术为未来治疗脑损伤带来了希望。

questions.name: #1120 Renewable Energy
questions.en:
The world is increasingly turning to renewable energy sources to combat climate change and reduce reliance on fossil fuels.
Solar, wind, and hydroelectric power are among the key alternatives being explored.
Governments and industries are investing in research and infrastructure to harness these clean energy sources, paving the way for a more sustainable future.
questions.zh:
全球正越来越多地转向可再生能源，以应对气候变化并减少对化石燃料的依赖。
太阳能、风能和水电是目前探索的主要替代能源。
政府和行业正在投资于研究和基础设施，以利用这些清洁能源，为更可持续的未来铺平道路。

questions.name: #1121 Urbanization
questions.en:
Global urbanization is a significant trend, with more people moving to cities in search of better opportunities.
This rapid urban growth presents challenges such as housing, transportation, and environmental sustainability.
Urban planners and policymakers are working towards creating smart, livable cities that prioritize efficient infrastructure, green spaces, and social inclusivity.
questions.zh:
全球城市化是一个重要趋势，越来越多的人为了寻求更好的机会而涌入城市。
这种快速的城市增长带来了住房、交通和环境可持续性等方面的挑战。
城市规划者和政策制定者正致力于打造智能、宜居的城市，优先考虑高效的基础设施、绿色空间和社会包容性。
