questions.name: #1122 Cybersecurity
questions.en:
With increased reliance on digital technologies, cybersecurity is a critical concern.
Protecting sensitive data, preventing cyberattacks, and safeguarding privacy are paramount.
Governments, businesses, and individuals must stay vigilant, implementing robust security measures and promoting cyber hygiene practices to mitigate risks in an interconnected world.
questions.zh:
随着对数字技术的依赖越来越大，网络安全成了一个关键问题。
保护敏感数据、防范网络攻击和维护隐私安全是重中之重。
政府、企业和个人都必须保持警惕，采取强有力的安全措施并推广网络卫生习惯，以在这个互联互通的世界里降低风险。

questions.name: #1123 Milky Way's Warp
questions.en:
Observational data has revealed that the Milky Way is warped and has flared edges, but scientists have been unable to explain why until now.
Astronomers have conducted calculations that provide a complete explanation for this phenomenon, and there is strong evidence suggesting that the Milky Way is surrounded by a halo of dark matter that is not aligned with its center.
questions.zh:
观测数据显示，银河系是弯曲的，边缘呈喇叭状展开，但科学家此前一直无法解释原因。
天文学家通过计算对这一现象给出了完整解释，并有有力证据表明，银河系被一个不与其中心对齐的暗物质晕所包围。

questions.name: #1124 Wildlife Conservation
questions.en:
Protecting biodiversity and preserving ecosystems are vital for maintaining ecological balance.
Efforts to conserve endangered species, combat wildlife trafficking, and establish protected areas are ongoing.
Education and awareness play a crucial role in promoting sustainable practices and fostering a sense of responsibility towards the natural world.
questions.zh:
保护生物多样性和维护生态系统对维持生态平衡至关重要。
保护濒危物种、打击野生动物贩卖以及建立保护区的工作一直在进行中。
教育和意识提升在推广可持续实践、培养对自然世界的责任感方面起着关键作用。

questions.name: #1125 Space Exploration
questions.en:
The exploration of space continues to captivate human curiosity.
Robotic missions and manned expeditions contribute to our understanding of the universe and the potential for extraterrestrial life.
Space agencies and private companies are collaborating to advance space travel technologies and pave the way for future interplanetary exploration.

机器人任务和载人探险让我们更了解宇宙，也探索外星生命的可能性。
航天机构和私营公司正合作推进太空旅行技术，为未来的星际探索铺路。

questions.name: #1127 WiFi
questions.en:
A group of researchers have put forward a new approach that allows for high-quality imaging of stationary objects using only WiFi signals.
Their technique involves using the Geometrical Theory of Diffraction along with Keller cones to track the edges of the objects.
This method has also made it possible to read the English alphabet through walls using WiFi signals.
questions.zh:
一组研究人员提出了一种新方法，仅使用WiFi信号就能对静止物体进行高质量成像。
他们的技术结合了衍射几何理论和凯勒锥，用于追踪物体的边缘。
这种方法还使得通过WiFi信号隔墙读取英文字母成为可能。

questions.name: #1128 Sports
questions.en:
The stadium erupted with thunderous cheers as the athlete sprinted towards the finish line.
With every stride, determination burned in their eyes, fueled by the crowd's electrifying energy.
The race was a display of raw athleticism and unwavering spirit.
In that moment, they embodied the essence of sportsmanship – pushing beyond limits, embracing challenges, and inspiring others to chase their dreams.

当运动员冲向终点线时，体育场爆发出雷鸣般的欢呼声。
每一步，他们眼中都燃烧着决心，被观众激动人心的能量所点燃。
这场比赛展现了纯粹的竞技实力和坚定的意志。
那一刻，他们体现了体育精神的核心——突破极限、迎接挑战，并激励他人追逐梦想。

questions.name: #1129 Kepler-452b
questions.en:
The discovery of a new exoplanet has ignited excitement among astronomers worldwide.
Dubbed Kepler-452b, this Earth-like planet orbits a star similar to our sun in the habitable zone.
With a radius 1.5 times that of Earth, it offers the potential for liquid water and a stable atmosphere.
questions.zh:
一颗新系外行星的发现让全球天文学家兴奋不已。
这颗名为开普勒-452b的类地行星，运行在一颗类似太阳的恒星的宜居带内。
它的半径是地球的1.5倍，可能存在液态水和稳定的大气层。

The silver screen lights up with the flicker of images, transporting us to different worlds, different times, and different lives.
Film is an art form that allows us to explore the beauty and complexity of the human experience in all its glory.

从宏大的史诗到细腻的人物刻画，电影这种媒介能捕捉想象力，触动心灵。

questions.name: #1131 Health and Wellness
questions.en:
In the pursuit of holistic well-being, self-care becomes an act of self-love.
It is a gentle reminder to nourish the body, mind, and soul.
From mindful meditation that calms the racing thoughts to nourishing meals that fuel vitality, each choice becomes a step towards a healthier, happier life.
Embracing self-care is an empowering journey of self-discovery, where one finds balance, inner peace, and a renewed sense of purpose.
questions.zh:
追求整体健康的过程中，自我关怀就是一种自爱的表现。
它温柔地提醒我们要滋养身体、心灵和灵魂。
从让纷乱思绪平静下来的正念冥想，到为活力提供能量的滋养餐食，每一个选择都是迈向更健康、更快乐生活的一步。
拥抱自我关怀是一段赋能的自我发现之旅，在其中找到平衡、内心平静和焕然一新的目标感。

questions.name: #1132 Travel
questions.en:
As the plane soared above the clouds, memories of the journey flooded the traveler's mind.
The sights, sounds, and scents of distant lands lingered like treasures in their heart.
Each adventure was a lesson learned, an experience that enriched their soul and broadened their perspective.
It was a reminder that in travel, we discover not just new places but also ourselves.

当飞机在云层之上翱翔时，旅途中的回忆涌上旅行者的心头。
远方土地的风光、声响和气息，像珍宝一样在心中萦绕。
每一次冒险都是一堂课，一次丰富心灵、开阔视野的经历。
这提醒我们，旅行中发现的不仅是新地方，还有我们自己。

questions.name: #1133 Bees
questions.en:
Bees are more than just buzzing insects; they play an essential role in our ecosystem.
Bees pollinate flowers, fruits, and vegetables, resulting in the production of food.
Without them, the world's food supply would be severely affected.
Sadly, bees have been in danger due to the use of pesticides, changes in land use, and global warming.
questions.zh:
蜜蜂不只是嗡嗡叫的昆虫，它们在生态系统中扮演着至关重要的角色。
蜜蜂为花卉、水果和蔬菜授粉，从而促进食物的生长。
没有它们，全球的食物供应将受到严重影响。
不幸的是，由于农药的使用、土地利用变化和全球变暖，蜜蜂正面临危险。

questions.name: #1134 Secondary Health Effects
questions.en:
According to a recent study, the occurrence of non-communicable diseases such as hypertension, hyperlipidemia, diabetes, and mental illnesses has risen following the Fukushima disaster and the COVID-19 pandemic.
This highlights the need to enhance health promotion strategies and recommendations in the aftermath of such disasters.
questions.zh:
最近一项研究表明，福岛核事故和新冠疫情后，高血压、高血脂、糖尿病和精神疾病等非传染性疾病的发病率有所上升。
这凸显了在这些灾难过后加强健康促进策略和建议的必要性。

questions.name: #1135 Cell Maps
questions.en:
An international team of scientists has charted the genetic, cellular, and structural composition of both the human brain and the brains of non-human primates.
This comprehension of brain structure facilitates a more profound understanding of the cellular underpinnings of brain functions and malfunctions, which can help to create more precise therapeutic treatments for individuals with mental illnesses and other brain disorders.
questions.zh:
一个国际科学家团队绘制了人类大脑和非人灵长类大脑的遗传、细胞和结构图谱。
对大脑结构的这种理解有助于更深入地了解大脑功能与功能障碍的细胞基础，从而能够为患有精神疾病和其他脑部疾病的人制定更精确的治疗方案。

questions.name: #1136 Water on Mars
questions.en:
A meteorite that originated from Mars billions of years ago provides insights into past impact events on the red planet.
The presence of oxidized minerals from the Martian crust within the meteorite suggests the involvement of water during the impact that formed it.
This discovery contributes to a better understanding of the role of water in the formation of planets, bridging some gaps in our knowledge.
questions.zh:
一块数十亿年前来自火星的陨石，让我们得以一窥这颗红色星球上过去的撞击事件。
陨石中来自火星地壳的氧化矿物表明，在形成它的撞击过程中有水参与。
这一发现有助于我们更好地理解水在行星形成中的作用，填补了知识上的一些空白。

questions.name: #1140 Dog Training
questions.en:
Training your dog can provide a number of benefits, such as improving their temperament and obedience, and increasing their overall happiness and well-being.
It is important to begin training early on, using positive reinforcement techniques such as treats and praise.
Consistency is key in training, and it's important to establish clear rules and boundaries for your dog to follow.
questions.zh:
训练你的狗有很多好处，比如改善它们的性情和服从性，还能提高它们整体的幸福感和健康水平。
尽早开始训练很重要，要用零食和表扬这类正面强化技巧。
训练中保持一致性是关键，得给你的狗设定明确的规矩和界限让它们遵守。

questions.name: #1141 Beach Vacation
questions.en:
The sun beats down on the golden sands of the beach, as waves crash rhythmically against the shore.
The salty air fills your lungs as you kick off your shoes and feel the cool sand between your toes.
You spread out your towel and relax, as the gentle hum of beach-goers and seagulls drowns out the stresses of everyday life.
questions.zh:
太阳炙烤着海滩上金黄色的沙子，海浪有节奏地拍打着海岸。
你踢掉鞋子，感受脚趾间凉爽的沙子，咸咸的空气充满你的肺。

questions.name: #1142 Coffee
questions.en:
Coffee is more than just a beverage – it's a way of life.
From the bold aroma to the rich taste, coffee provides a daily boost of energy and happiness.
It's true that some people are sensitive to caffeine, but coffee can still be enjoyed in moderation.
And with so many different brewing methods and flavors to choose from, there's a perfect cup of coffee out there for everyone.
questions.zh:
咖啡不仅仅是一种饮品，它更是一种生活方式。
从浓郁的香气到醇厚的口感，咖啡每天都能给你带来能量和快乐。
确实有些人对咖啡因敏感，但适量饮用咖啡仍然可以享受其美味。
而且，有那么多不同的冲泡方法和风味可供选择，总有一杯完美的咖啡适合每个人。

questions.name: #1143 Croatian Coast
questions.en:
I stood at the edge of the cliff, feeling the wind whip through my hair as I looked out at the vast sea below.
The colors of the water ranged from a deep navy blue to a sparkling turquoise.
I took a deep breath of the salty sea air and felt a sense of peace wash over me.
This was the beauty of the Croatian coast.
questions.zh:
我站在悬崖边，海风呼啸着吹过我的头发，俯视着下方辽阔的大海。
海水的颜色从深海军蓝渐变到闪闪发光的碧绿色。
我深深吸了一口带着咸味的海风，感到一阵宁静涌上心头。
这就是克罗地亚海岸的美景。

questions.name: #1144 ATP
questions.en:
Adenosine triphosphate, or ATP, is the molecule that provides energy for most biological processes in living cells.
It is often referred to as the "molecular unit of currency" within the cell.
ATP is formed through a process called cellular respiration, which occurs in the mitochondria of cells.

它常被称为细胞内的“分子能量货币”。
ATP是通过一种称为细胞呼吸的过程形成的，该过程发生在细胞的线粒体中。

questions.name: #1145 Grandmother's Garden
questions.en:
As a child, I used to spend hours playing in my grandmother's garden.
She had an array of colorful flowers and herbs growing throughout the yard, and she would teach me about each one.
She had a particular love of lavender, and I remember her telling me stories about how she used to dry it and make sachets to put in her drawers.
questions.zh:
小时候，我常常在祖母的花园里一玩就是好几个小时。
她的院子里种满了五颜六色的花和香草，她会教我认识每一种。
她特别喜欢薰衣草，我记得她给我讲过她以前怎么把薰衣草晾干，做成香囊放在抽屉里。

questions.name: #1146 Great Barrier Reef
questions.en:
Did you know that the Great Barrier Reef is the largest living structure on Earth?
This incredible natural wonder spans over 2,300 km and is home to thousands of species of marine life.
Unfortunately, it's also under threat due to climate change and other environmental factors.
In fact, nearly half of the reef has already died in the past few decades.
questions.zh:
你知道吗，大堡礁是地球上最大的活体结构？
这个令人惊叹的自然奇观绵延超过2300公里，是数千种海洋生物的家园。
不幸的是，由于气候变化和其他环境因素，它也面临着威胁。
实际上，在过去几十年里，近一半的珊瑚礁已经死亡。

questions.name: #1147 Exploring the City
questions.en:
The city is full of life and energy.
Tall buildings tower over busy streets, while the sound of horns and chatter echoes through the air.
The scent of street food wafts through the alleys, luring people to stop and take a bite of the locals' favorite street snacks.
As day turns to night, the city lights up with neon signs and twinkling stars in the sky.
questions.zh:
这座城市充满了生机与活力。
高楼大厦俯视着繁忙的街道，喇叭声和交谈声在空中回荡。
街头小吃的香味飘过小巷，吸引人们驻足品尝当地人最爱的小吃。
当白天转为夜晚，城市被霓虹灯和天空中闪烁的星星点亮。

questions.name: #1148 Forest
questions.en:
The forest was a symphony of sound and color, the rustling of leaves and the chirping of birds creating a harmonious melody.
The trees towered above, their branches reaching towards the sky.
The air was fresh and invigorating, filled with the scent of pine and earth.
In this natural oasis, the hustle and bustle of the city felt worlds away.
questions.zh:
森林里声音和色彩交织成一首交响曲，树叶沙沙作响，鸟儿叽叽喳喳，奏出和谐的旋律。
树木高耸入云，枝丫伸向天空。
空气清新提神，弥漫着松树和泥土的气息。
在这片自然绿洲里，城市的喧嚣仿佛远在天边。

questions.name: #1149 Ancient Diamonds
questions.en:
Formed millions to billions of years ago, diamonds can shine light into the darkest and oldest parts of the Earth's mantle.
The analysis of ancient, superdeep diamonds dug up from mines in Brazil and Western Africa, has exposed new processes of how continents evolved and moved during the early evolution of complex life on Earth.
questions.zh:
钻石形成于数百万到数十亿年前，能够照亮地幔中最黑暗、最古老的部分。
对从巴西和西非矿场挖出的古老超深钻石的分析，揭示了在地球复杂生命早期演化过程中，大陆如何演变和移动的新过程。

questions.name: #1150 Alzheimer’s Disease
questions.en:
Researchers have published a study that addresses possible associations between chronic stress, mild cognitive impairment and Alzheimer’s disease.
The study shows how people aged between 18 and 65 with a previous diagnosis of chronic stress and depression were more likely than other people to be diagnosed with mild cognitive impairment or Alzheimer’s disease.
questions.zh:
研究人员发表了一项研究，探讨慢性压力、轻度认知障碍和阿尔茨海默病之间可能存在的关联。
该研究表明，18至65岁之间曾被诊断患有慢性压力和抑郁症的人，比其他人群更容易被诊断为轻度认知障碍或阿尔茨海默病。

questions.name: #1151 Major Source of Pollution
questions.en:
Fine chemical and pharmaceutical manufacturing are major sources of air pollution, with recent studies showing the carbon footprint of the pharmaceutical industry to be heavier than the automotive industry.
Beyond greenhouse gas emissions, the pharmaceutical industry is also responsible for other serious environmental impacts, such as water pollution from wastewater released by manufacturers.
questions.zh:
精细化工和制药生产是空气污染的主要来源，最近的研究表明，制药行业的碳足迹比汽车行业还要重。
除了温室气体排放，制药行业还造成其他严重的环境影响，例如制造商排放的废水导致的水污染。

questions.name: #1152 Hydrogen Stations
questions.en:
Stations shutting down for unscheduled maintenance reduces hydrogen fueling availability to consumers and may slow the adoption of these types of fuel cell electric vehicles, the researchers noted.
The use of what is known as a prognostic health monitoring model would allow hydrogen stations to reduce these unscheduled events.
questions.zh:
研究人员指出，加氢站因非计划维护而关闭，会减少消费者的氢燃料供应，并可能减缓这类燃料电池电动汽车的普及。
采用所谓的预测性健康监测模型，可以让加氢站减少这些非计划事件的发生。

questions.name: #1153 Counting Seals
questions.en:
Counting seals is harder than it may appear.
Surveys typically assess numbers at seal breeding beaches, but these figures are skewed because most male fur seals at South Georgia don't usually breed until they are ten-years old, and then only for two to three years.
That means some 80% of the male population is missing from surveys, and how researchers account for this can overstate the overall count.
questions.zh:
数海豹比看起来要难。
调查通常评估海豹繁殖海滩的数量，但这些数字有偏差，因为南乔治亚岛大多数雄性毛皮海豹通常要到十岁才繁殖，而且只持续两到三年。
这意味着约80%的雄性种群在调查中缺失，而研究人员对此的估算方式可能会高估总数。

questions.name: #1154 Nitrogen Fertilizer
questions.en:
The growing global population needs sufficient food.
Its production causes overfertilization and increased nitrogen concentration in agriculture, which negatively affects the population, climate, and ecosystems.
According to new models, however, today's crop production might be maintained with a far smaller global fertilizer consumption, if nitrogen fertilizer would be used more homogeneously across global croplands.
questions.zh:
全球人口不断增长，需要足够的食物。
粮食生产导致过度施肥，农业中氮浓度上升，这对人口、气候和生态系统都产生了负面影响。
然而，根据新模型，如果全球农田更均匀地使用氮肥，那么目前的作物产量或许可以在大幅减少全球肥料用量的情况下得以维持。

questions.name: #1155 Heat Shock Response
questions.en:
This "heat shock response" of cells is a classic model of biological adaptation, part of the fundamental processes of life -- conserved in creatures from single-celled yeast to humans -- that allow our cells to adjust to changing conditions in their environment.
For years, scientists have focused on how different genes respond to heat stress to understand this survival technique.
questions.zh:
细胞的这种“热休克反应”是生物适应的经典模型，是生命基本过程的一部分——从单细胞酵母到人类，这种反应在生物体中都是保守的，它让我们的细胞能够适应环境条件的变化。
多年来，科学家们一直专注于研究不同基因如何响应热应激，以理解这种生存机制。

questions.name: #1156 Alexander Fleming
questions.en:
The legendary Alexander Fleming, who famously discovered penicillin, once said 'never to neglect an extraordinary appearance or happening.' And the path of science often leads to just that.
New research is turning the page in our understanding of harmful bacteria and how they turn on certain genes, causing disease in our bodies.
questions.zh:
传奇人物亚历山大·弗莱明，也就是发现青霉素的那位，曾说过‘永远不要忽视不寻常的现象或事件。’而科学之路往往正是如此。
新研究正在改写我们对有害细菌的理解，揭示了它们如何激活特定基因，从而在人体内引发疾病。

questions.name: #1157 Grey Whale
questions.en:
Eastern North Pacific gray whales are one of the few populations of large whales that have recovered to what may be similar numbers that existed prior to commercial whaling.
As the population has approached levels close to what their Arctic feeding areas can support, they have likely become more sensitive to environmental conditions due to competition for limited resources.
questions.zh:

随着种群数量接近其北极觅食区所能支撑的极限，由于争夺有限资源，它们可能对环境条件变得更加敏感。

questions.name: #1158 Tropical Crops
questions.en:
The tropics were identified as having a heightened vulnerability to the interaction of climate change and land use, meaning crops such a coffee, cocoa, mango and watermelon which all rely on insect pollination are at the greatest risk.
These crops play vital roles in both local economies and global trade and their reduction could cause increased income insecurity for millions of small-scale farmers in these regions.
questions.zh:
研究发现，热带地区更容易受到气候变化和土地利用相互作用的冲击，这意味着像咖啡、可可、芒果和西瓜这些依赖昆虫授粉的作物面临的风险最大。
这些作物在地方经济和全球贸易中都扮演着重要角色，它们的减产可能导致这些地区数百万小农户的收入更加不稳定。

questions.name: #1159 Tree Ring
questions.en:
With each passing year, trees add a ring around their trunks.
The ring width is determined by the climate they experience.
Favorable conditions mean wider rings and unfavorable conditions mean thinner.
As climate varies from year to year, it creates time-specific patterns like a bar code in the growth of trees within a region.
questions.zh:
每过一年，树木的树干上就会多一圈年轮。
年轮的宽度取决于它们经历的气候。
有利条件意味着年轮更宽，不利条件则更窄。
由于气候逐年变化，它会在一个地区树木的生长中形成像条形码一样的时间特定图案。

questions.name: #1160 Large Marimo
questions.en:
Large marimo are now thought to be exclusively found in Lake Akan, and as seen from the data, even there they have become threatened.
Therefore, it is necessary to propose measures to protect marimo from global warming, such as utilizing the cooler river water that flows into the marimo colony.

因此，有必要提出保护毬藻免受全球变暖影响的措施，例如利用流入毬藻群落的较凉河水。

questions.name: #1161 Protein Songs
questions.en:
Likewise, several of the proteins in the study were chosen for their similarities to the key attributes of the Fantasy-Impromptu style.
Most of the 18 proteins tested regulate functions including human emotion, cognition, sensation, or performance which the authors say connect to the emotional and expressive of the genre.
questions.zh:
同样，研究中的几种蛋白质因其与幻想即兴风格关键特征的相似性而被选中。

questions.en:
Those who switched from precarious to secure employment had a 20 percent lower risk of death, regardless of what happened afterward, compared to those who remained in precarious employment.

questions.name: #1163 Conversation
questions.en:
Time is one of humanity’s greatest blind spots.
We experience it as days, months, or years.
But nature functions on much grander scales, measured in centuries, millennia and even longer intervals often lumped together as “deep time.” As paleontologists, we were trained to think in deep time.
Yet, as conservationists, we’ve come to realize that time can be confounding.
questions.zh:
时间是人类最大的盲点之一。
我们以天、月或年来体验它。
但自然运行的尺度要大得多，以世纪、千年甚至更长的间隔来衡量，这些通常被统称为“深时”。作为古生物学家，我们被训练用深时来思考。
然而，作为环保主义者，我们逐渐意识到时间可能会令人困惑。

questions.name: #1164 Cats are Perfect
questions.en:
Cats have nailed this one thing so well that they all do it and just come up with slightly different sizes.
That’s why they’re perfect, evolutionarily.
They don’t need variation.
They might get bigger or smaller, but they don’t change anything else because they’re doing it just right otherwise.
They’re not jacks-of-all-trades; they’re masters of one.
questions.zh:
猫把这件事做得太好了，以至于它们都这么做，只是体型略有不同。
这就是为什么它们在进化上如此完美。
它们不需要变异。
它们可能变大或变小，但不会改变其他任何东西，因为其他方面它们已经做得恰到好处了。
它们不是万金油；它们是某一领域的专家。

questions.name: #1165 Valley Fever
questions.en:
Valley fever's mortality rate is about one death per 1,000 infections, according to infectious disease physician John Galgiani, director of the University of Arizona's Valley Fever Center for Excellence.
It doesn't need to be so high.
There are medications to treat it, but patients often receive incorrect diagnoses.
questions.zh:
据亚利桑那大学山谷热卓越中心主任、传染病医生约翰·加尔贾尼称，山谷热的死亡率约为每1000例感染中有一人死亡。
这个数字本不必这么高。
虽然有药物可以治疗这种病，但患者经常被误诊。

questions.name: #1166 Dangerous Superbugs
questions.en:
Antibiotics either directly kill bacteria or slow their growth, leaving the immune system to finish the job.
The drugs work in several ways — by preventing bacteria from building sturdy walls or making copies of their DNA, for instance.
Growth-slowing antibiotics usually disrupt ribosomes, the factories in which bacterial cells make proteins.
questions.zh:
抗生素要么直接杀死细菌，要么减缓它们的生长，让免疫系统来完成剩下的工作。
这些药物有几种作用方式——比如阻止细菌构建坚固的细胞壁或复制它们的DNA。
抑制生长的抗生素通常会破坏核糖体，也就是细菌细胞内制造蛋白质的工厂。

questions.name: #1167 Unicorn
questions.en:
Unicorns roam free in fantasy novels and children’s stories, not so much in the real world, much less the cold, analytical ones of math and philosophy.
But it turns out that these logical disciplines are only one misstep away from proving the existence of the long-adored mythic creatures—or proving any absurdity.
questions.zh:
独角兽在奇幻小说和儿童故事里自由漫步，但在现实世界中可不多见，更别提数学和哲学这些冷静、分析性的领域了。
但事实证明，这些逻辑学科只需一步之差，就能证明这些长久以来备受喜爱的神话生物的存在——或者证明任何荒谬之事。

questions.name: #1168 Human Brain
questions.en:
Researchers have created the largest atlas of human brain cells so far, revealing more than 3,000 cell types — many of which are new to science.
The work, published in a package of 21 papers today in Science, Science Advances and Science Translational Medicine, will aid the study of diseases, cognition and what makes us human, among other things, say the authors.
questions.zh:
研究人员绘制了迄今为止最大的人类脑细胞图谱，揭示了超过3000种细胞类型——其中许多是科学界首次发现。
该研究今天以21篇论文的形式发表在《科学》《科学进展》和《科学转化医学》上，作者表示，这项工作将有助于研究疾病、认知以及人类特质等领域。

questions.name: #1169 Climate Misinformation
questions.en:
Scientists have found no evidence that natural forces have contributed to our planet’s current global warming problem, but a middle school student reading a crisp new book from the nation’s top science textbook publisher might think otherwise.
“Due to both human and natural activities,” the child would read, “the amount of carbon dioxide in the air has increased.”
questions.zh:
科学家们尚未发现自然因素导致当前全球变暖问题的证据，但一名中学生若翻阅一本由国家顶级科学教材出版社出版的全新书籍，可能会得出相反的结论。
孩子会读到这样一句话：“由于人类活动和自然活动的共同作用，空气中的二氧化碳含量增加了。”

questions.name: #1170 Electricity
questions.en:
Every online interaction relies on a scaffolding of information stored in remote servers—and those machines, stacked together in data centers worldwide, require a lot of energy.
Around the globe, data centers currently account for about 1 to 1.5 percent of global electricity use, according to the International Energy Agency.
And the world’s still-exploding boom in artificial intelligence could drive that number up a lot — and fast.
questions.zh:
每一次在线互动都依赖于远程服务器中存储的信息框架，而这些机器堆叠在全球各地的数据中心里，消耗着大量能源。
根据国际能源署的数据，目前全球数据中心的用电量约占全球总用电量的1%到1.5%。
而全球仍在爆发式增长的人工智能可能会让这个数字大幅且快速地上升。

questions.name: #1171 Aurora
questions.en:
Many ancient people associated the auroras with fire, which is understandable: the sky can glow with ripples of yellow and red, as if it is itself aflame or perhaps instead reflecting some distant over-the-horizon conflagration on the ground.
But the lights come in many other colors, too: green is the most common, and purple and pink can make appearances, too.
Sometimes auroras can even glow an electric blue.
questions.zh:
很多古人把极光跟火联系起来，这也不难理解：天空会泛起黄红相间的波纹，仿佛自己着了火，或者是在映照地平线外某场遥远的大火。
不过极光还有很多其他颜色：绿色最常见，紫色和粉色也会出现。
有时候极光甚至会发出电光蓝。

Many ancient people associated the auroras with fire, which is understandable: the sky can glow with ripples of yellow and red, as if it is itself aflame or perhaps instead reflecting some distant over-the-horizon conflagration on the ground.

questions.name: #1172 Kidney Transplant
questions.en:
People seeking a kidney transplant often have to wait years for a donor organ to become available—and many die before ever receiving one.
Xenotransplantation, in which organs from one species are transplanted into another, could alleviate the organ shortage.
But bridging millions of years of evolutionary divergence between two species is a tall order, so for decades organ xenotransplantation was largely impractical.
questions.zh:
想要换肾的人常常要等上好几年才能等到捐献的器官，很多人还没等到就走了。
异种移植，就是把一个物种的器官移植到另一个物种体内，这或许能缓解器官短缺的问题。
但要想跨越两个物种之间数百万年的进化差异，难度实在太大，所以几十年来异种器官移植基本行不通。

questions.name: #1173 Extreme Heat
questions.en:
Extreme heat is a major public health threat, especially when it is unseasonable and where people are less acclimated to higher temperatures.
Among the most vulnerable populations are the very young, the elderly, those with existing health conditions such as heart disease and those without access to air-conditioning.
People who work outdoors are also particularly susceptible to heat illness and heat stroke.
questions.zh:
极端高温是重大的公共卫生威胁，尤其是在不合时宜的时段以及人们不太适应高温的地区。
最脆弱的群体包括幼儿、老年人、患有心脏病等基础疾病的人，以及没有空调可用的人。
在户外工作的人也特别容易患上热疾病和中暑。

questions.name: #1174 Ancient Footprint
questions.en:
Fossilized human footprints found in New Mexico’s White Sands National Park were almost certainly made more than 20,000 years ago, during the height of the last ice age, according to new research.
The study, published on Thursday in Science, overthrows decades of thinking about when humans arrived in North America.
questions.zh:
新研究显示，在新墨西哥州白沙国家公园发现的化石人类脚印几乎可以肯定是在两万多年前、末次冰期最盛期留下的。
这项周四发表在《科学》杂志上的研究颠覆了数十年来关于人类何时抵达北美的认知。

questions.name: #1175 Nightmare
questions.en:
As terrible as whatever visions that are running through their head might be, waking someone from a nightmare is more likely to ensure that they’ll remember the bad dream.
And if someone appears physically distressed in their sleep like this, it’s more likely that they’re having a night terror than a nightmare; night terrors are different neurological experiences.
questions.zh:
不管他们脑子里闪过的画面有多可怕，把一个人从噩梦中叫醒，反而更可能让他们记住这个噩梦。
如果有人睡觉时像这样表现出身体上的痛苦，那他们更可能是在经历夜惊而非噩梦；夜惊是另一种神经体验。

questions.name: #1176 Planets
questions.en:
For decades, astronomers have endeavored to forecast with confidence the fate of planetary systems, including our own, throughout the cosmos.
And these experts’ predictions have one central principle: to confidently guess what will eventually befall a planet, you have to know the size of its star.
questions.zh:
几十年来，天文学家一直努力自信地预测整个宇宙中行星系统的命运，包括我们自己的太阳系。
而这些专家的预测有一个核心原则：要自信地猜测一颗行星最终会遭遇什么，你必须知道其恒星的大小。

questions.name: #1177 Dengue and Vaccine
questions.en:
In 2022, Europe saw more cases of locally acquired dengue than in the whole of the previous decade.
The rise marks both a public health threat and a corresponding market opportunity for dengue vaccines and treatments; news that should spur the pharmaceutical industry to boost investment into the neglected disease.
questions.zh:
2022年，欧洲本地感染的登革热病例比过去十年加起来还多。
这一增长既是公共卫生威胁，也为登革热疫苗和治疗药物带来了相应的市场机遇；这一消息应能激励制药行业加大对这种被忽视疾病的投资。

questions.name: #1178 AI
questions.en:
There are alien minds among us.
Not the little green men of science fiction, but the alien minds that power the facial recognition in your smartphone, determine your creditworthiness and write poetry and computer code.
These alien minds are artificial intelligence systems, the ghost in the machine that you encounter daily.
questions.zh:
我们身边存在着一些异类心智。
不是科幻小说里的小绿人，而是那些驱动你手机人脸识别、决定你信用评分、还能写诗和编程的异类心智。
这些异类心智就是人工智能系统，是你每天都会遇到的机器中的幽灵。

questions.name: #1179 6G Networks
questions.en:
High-speed Internet access has become crucial in a world where school, business, personal life and emergency communications increasingly take place through a handheld device.
But surprisingly large swaths of the U.S. still lack a speedy-enough broadband or cellular connection.
One potential solution could be a sixth-generation cellular network, which experts say will add a space-based system to ground-based coverage options.
questions.zh:
如今，学校、商务、个人生活以及紧急通讯越来越依赖手持设备，高速互联网接入变得至关重要。
但令人惊讶的是，美国仍有大片区域缺乏足够快速的宽带或蜂窝网络连接。
一个可能的解决方案是第六代蜂窝网络，专家称它将在现有地面覆盖基础上增加一个天基系统。

questions.name: #1180 AI anxiety
questions.en:
It’s logical for humans to feel anxious about artificial intelligence.
After all, the news is constantly reeling off job after job at which the technology seems to outperform us.
But humans aren’t yet headed for all-out replacement.
And if you do suffer from so-called AI anxiety, there are ways to alleviate your fears and even reframe them into a motivating force for good.
questions.zh:
人类对人工智能感到焦虑是合乎逻辑的。
毕竟，新闻里不断报道一个又一个工作岗位上，这项技术似乎都比我们表现得更出色。
但人类还没有全面被取代的危机。
如果你确实患有所谓的AI焦虑，有办法缓解你的恐惧，甚至将其转化为积极向上的动力。

questions.name: #1181 Moderate Drinking
questions.en:
Now a growing body of research says any alcohol raises the chance of premature death from a variety of causes.
About half of cases of liver disease are attributed to drinking.
Alcohol is also a potent carcinogen.
It can cause cancer because it breaks down in the body to form a compound called acetaldehyde, which damages DNA.
That damage can lead to at least seven types of cancer.
questions.zh:
如今，越来越多的研究指出，任何酒精摄入都会增加因多种原因早逝的风险。
约半数的肝病病例都与饮酒有关。
酒精也是一种强效致癌物。
它之所以能致癌，是因为在体内分解后会形成一种名为乙醛的化合物，这种物质会损伤DNA。
这种损伤至少能导致七种癌症。
questions.full:
Now a growing body of research says any alcohol raises the chance of premature death from a variety of causes.
如今，越来越多的研究指出，任何酒精摄入都会增加因多种原因早逝的风险。

约半数的肝病病例都与饮酒有关。

酒精也是一种强效致癌物。

questions.name: #1182 Wine’s True Origins
questions.en:
Early farmers, the revised story goes, migrated from western Asia toward Iberia and brought table vines with them.
Along the way the farmers crossbred the table vines with local wild grapevines.
The earliest crossbreeding probably happened in what is now Israel and Turkey, creating muscat grapes, which are high in sugar—good for eating and fermenting.

根据修正后的说法，早期农民从西亚迁移到伊比利亚半岛，并带去了食用葡萄藤。
沿途，农民们将食用葡萄藤与当地的野生葡萄藤进行杂交。
最早的杂交可能发生在现在的以色列和土耳其地区，从而培育出了麝香葡萄，这种葡萄含糖量高，适合食用和发酵。

questions.name: #1183 Live in Space
questions.en:
Humans evolved for and adapted to conditions on Earth.
Move us off our planet, and we start to fail—physically and psychologically.
The cancer risk from cosmic rays and the problems that human bodies experience in microgravity could be deal-breakers on their own.
Moreover, there may not be a viable economic case for sustaining a presence on another world.
questions.zh:
人类是在地球环境下进化并适应了这里的生活。
一旦离开地球，我们的身体和心理就开始出问题。
宇宙射线带来的癌症风险，以及微重力环境下人体出现的种种问题，单拎出来就足以让人望而却步。
更何况，在另一个星球上维持人类存在，可能根本划不来。

questions.name: #1184 Dreams
questions.en:
Dreaming happens mostly (though not always exclusively) during rapid eye movement sleep.
During this sleep stage, brain activity looks similar to that in a waking brain, with some very important differences.
Key among them: during REM sleep, the areas of the brain that transfer memories into long-term storage—as well as the long-term storage areas themselves—are relatively deactivated.
questions.zh:
做梦主要发生在快速眼动睡眠期间，尽管并非完全如此。
在这个睡眠阶段，大脑活动看起来与清醒时相似，但有一些非常重要的区别。
其中关键的一点是：在快速眼动睡眠期间，大脑中将记忆转移到长期存储的区域以及长期存储区域本身都相对不活跃。

questions.name: #1185 Animals
questions.en:
Many animals use different modes of communication simultaneously, just as humans use body language and gestures while talking.
Any actions made immediately before, during, or after uttering sounds could provide important context for understanding what an animal is trying to convey.
Traditionally, researchers have cataloged these behaviors in a list known as an ethogram.
questions.zh:
许多动物会同时使用多种交流方式，就像人类在说话时会配合肢体语言和手势一样。
在发出声音之前、期间或之后立即做出的任何动作，都可能为理解动物想要传达的信息提供重要的背景。
传统上，研究人员会将这类行为编录成一份清单，称为“行为谱”。

questions.name: #1186 Rat’s Eye
questions.en:
It’s unclear why the animals look forever young, but it may be because their native lakes never dried up, at least not before Spanish colonizers started draining lakes near present-day Mexico City to control flooding in the 1600s.
Other amphibians that live in areas with transient streams or lakes mature from water-living young into adults capable of thriving on land or in water.
questions.zh:
这些动物为何看起来永远年轻还不清楚，但可能是因为它们原生的湖泊从未干涸过，至少在17世纪西班牙殖民者为了控制洪水而排干如今墨西哥城附近的湖泊之前是这样。
其他生活在季节性溪流或湖泊地区的两栖动物，会从水生幼体成长为既能在陆地也能在水中生存的成体。

questions.name: #1187 Is Math Real
questions.en:
Math has a reputation for supplying concise, black-or-white answers to questions.
Getting straightforward math questions right or wrong is often presented as the litmus test of whether someone has mathematical ability.
But that view of math is simplistic.
Rather than a tool for obtaining objective right answers, math is a method for asking questions and exploring the possibilities those questions raise.
questions.zh:
数学以给出简洁、非黑即白的答案而闻名。
能否答对简单的数学题，常被当作衡量一个人数学能力的试金石。
但这种对数学的看法过于简单化了。
数学不是用来获取客观正确答案的工具，而是一种提问并探索问题所引发的可能性的方法。

questions.name: #1188 Spider Silk
questions.en:
Spider silk is prized for its unrivaled strength and toughness.
But figuring out a way to mass-produce it is no easy feat.
Spiders cannot be put to work to pump out the fibers the way silkworms can: They’re extremely territorial and inclined to eat their neighbors, and they refuse to keep at the task for long.
questions.zh:
蜘蛛丝因其无与伦比的强度和韧性而备受珍视。
但想找到大规模生产它的方法绝非易事。
蜘蛛不能像蚕一样被用来大量吐丝：它们领地意识极强，还爱吃掉邻居，而且不肯长时间持续工作。

questions.name: #1189 Depression
questions.en:
Teenagers in the United States are in crisis.
That news got hammered home earlier this year following the release of a nationally representative survey showing that over half of high school girls reported persistent feelings of “sadness or hopelessness” — common words used to screen for depression.
Almost a third of teenage boys reported those same feelings.
questions.zh:
美国青少年正陷入危机。
今年早些时候，一项全国性调查的结果进一步证实了这一消息：超过一半的高中女生表示持续感到“悲伤或绝望”——这是筛查抑郁症的常用表述。
几乎三分之一的男生也有同样的感受。

questions.name: #1190 Effective Healers
questions.en:
Effective healers accompany sufferers on a journey toward wellness.
Healing tools include the deft use of suggestion, confession, memory, ritual and medicines.
Healers find ways to provide consolation and hope, enabling their wounded charges to engage with meaningful work and find purpose in life.
questions.zh:
好的治疗者会陪伴患者，一起走向康复。
治疗的手段包括巧妙运用暗示、倾诉、回忆、仪式和药物。
治疗者们想方设法给予安慰和希望，让受伤的人能够投入有意义的工作，找到生活的目标。

questions.name: #1191 Race Car Drivers
questions.en:
Where the drivers blinked was surprisingly predictable, the team found.
The drivers had a shared pattern of blinking that had a strong connection with acceleration, such that drivers tended not to blink while changing speed or direction — like while on a curve in the track — but did blink while on relatively safer straightaways.
questions.zh:
研究团队发现，司机眨眼的时机出人意料地有规律可循。
司机们有一个共同的眨眼模式，与加速密切相关：他们在改变速度或方向时——比如在赛道的弯道上——往往不眨眼，但在相对安全的直道上则会眨眼。
questions.full:
Where the drivers blinked was surprisingly predictable, the team found.
研究团队发现，司机眨眼的时机出人意料地有规律可循。
The drivers had a shared pattern of blinking that had a strong connection with acceleration, such that drivers tended not to blink while changing speed or direction — like while on a curve in the track — but did blink while on relatively safer straightaways.

questions.name: #1192 Storing Bottled Water
questions.en:
If you plan to keep a supply of bottled water at home, you should store it at room temperature or colder, out of direct sunlight and far from any chemicals or solvents.
For instance, don't put it near any gasoline or paint thinners.
Your garage is probably not a good storage place for bottled water.
questions.zh:
如果你打算在家里储备瓶装水，应该把它放在室温或更低温度下，避免阳光直射，远离化学品或溶剂。
比如，不要放在汽油或油漆稀释剂附近。
你的车库可能不是存放瓶装水的好地方。

questions.name: #1193 Spring Water
questions.en:
Spring water comes from a protected, underground water source from which the water flows to the surface on its own.
It may be collected either at the surface spring or through a sanitary, protected hole drilled directly into the source feeding the spring.
If the water is collected through a hole drilled into the source, it has to have exactly the same composition as the water in the surface spring.
questions.zh:
泉水来自一个受保护的地下水源，水会自行涌出地表。
它可以从地表泉眼收集，也可以通过一个卫生、受保护的钻孔直接进入补给泉源的水层收集。
如果水是通过钻孔进入水源收集的，那么它的成分必须与地表泉水的成分完全相同。

questions.name: #1194 Steel
questions.en:
Steel is an alloy of two elements: iron and carbon.
Steel alloys vary in their ratio of iron to steel as well as any additional metals present.
For example, to create stainless steel, you would combine steel with chromium.
Carbon steel contains a higher percentage of carbon, making it stronger than other steel alloys.

钢是由铁和碳两种元素组成的合金。
不同钢合金的铁碳比例以及所含的其他金属元素各不相同。
例如，要制造不锈钢，你需要将钢与铬结合。
碳钢含有更高比例的碳，因此比其他钢合金更坚固。

questions.en:
Tattoos are a popular form of self-expression and artistry, allowing individuals to adorn their bodies with meaningful symbols and designs.
Whether you're considering getting your first tattoo or adding to your existing collection, it's important to choose a design with a significance that resonates with you.

questions.name: #1196 Mutation
questions.en:
Think of your community's traffic.
When the traffic lights are functioning, drivers (usually) behave.
Break a light, and everything comes to a standstill.
Within our bodies, we could liken that broken traffic light to a DNA mutation — one that has the potential to mess up our body's everyday operations.
So where lightning might knock out a traffic light, what causes mutations in DNA?
questions.zh:
想想你所在社区的交通吧。
当交通灯正常工作时，司机们（通常）会守规矩。
一旦闯了红灯，一切就会陷入停滞。
在我们体内，可以把那个坏掉的红绿灯比作DNA突变——一个可能扰乱身体日常运作的突变。
那么，闪电能让交通灯失灵，又是什么导致了DNA突变呢？

questions.name: #1197 Astrology
questions.en:
Before we dive into the specifics of sun signs, it's essential to understand the basics of astrology.
Astrology is a complex study that explores the relationship between celestial bodies and human behavior.
It is based on the belief that the positions and movements of these celestial bodies can influence our lives and personalities.
questions.zh:
在深入探讨太阳星座的具体内容之前，了解占星学的基础知识至关重要。
占星学是一门复杂的学科，研究天体与人类行为之间的关系。
它基于这样一种信念：天体的位置和运动可以影响我们的生活和个性。

questions.name: #1198 Time Zone
questions.en:
It's strange to think that time zones were invented as a way of reducing confusion rather than causing it.
Since solar time varies as you move even a short distance from one spot to another across the planet, for most of human history, the time of day varied everywhere.
questions.zh:
说来也怪，时区的发明本是为了减少混乱，而不是制造混乱。
由于太阳时随你在星球上从一个地方移动到另一个地方而变化，哪怕距离很短，在人类历史的大部分时间里，各地的时间都不相同。

questions.name: #1199 Climate Change
questions.en:
Largely driven by human activity, climate change has been messing with the traditional concept of four seasons for a while now.
Scientists have discovered that as the planet warms up, the tropics have been expanding by 0.1 to 0.2 degrees of latitude every decade, so that places that once had four seasons are shifting to having just two.
questions.zh:
气候变化主要是人类活动引起的，它已经扰乱传统的四季概念一段时间了。
科学家发现，随着地球变暖，热带地区每十年会向南北扩展0.1到0.2个纬度，导致原本四季分明的地方逐渐变成只有两季。

questions.name: #1200 Clean Air Act
questions.en:
Over the next couple of decades, Americans became more and more concerned with the chemicals that were being released into the air and the effects they could have on people's health and the environment.
Lawmakers came together from both sides of the aisle, ultimately drafting and unanimously passing the Clean Air Act of 1970.

来自两党的立法者共同合作，最终起草并一致通过了1970年的《清洁空气法案》。

questions.name: #1201 White Noise
questions.en:
We sometimes use the term "white noise" as a catch-all for ambient noises that drown out different sounds.
But it turns out there's something special about this particular combination of frequencies — experts have even found that the soothing sound of white noise helps people stay asleep.
Buckle up for a primer on different types of ambient noise and how they affect your daily life.
questions.zh:
我们有时会用“白噪音”这个词来统称那些能掩盖各种声响的环境噪音。
但事实证明，这种特定的频率组合确实有些特别——专家甚至发现，白噪音的舒缓声音能帮助人们保持睡眠。
准备好了解不同类型的环境噪音及其如何影响你的日常生活吧。

questions.name: #1202 Lionfish
questions.en:
A lionfish can expand its stomach more than 30 times in volume when eating a large meal.
It's also capable of long-term fasting, and can go without food for more than 12 weeks without dying.
It doesn't help matters that lionfish start reproducing when they are less than 1 year old and can lay up to 30,000 eggs every four days, and have very few natural predators.
questions.zh:
狮子鱼在吃大餐时，胃部体积能膨胀超过30倍。
它还能长期禁食，不吃东西超过12周也不会死。
更糟的是，狮子鱼不到1岁就开始繁殖，每四天能产下多达3万颗卵，而且天敌极少。

questions.name: #1203 Black Bears
questions.en:
Whereas black bears climb trees throughout their lives, brown bears stop doing this when they grow up.
The two species are crafty omnivores who'll eat a wide range of plant and animal matter.
Sometimes this means competing for the same resources; British Columbian salmon are hunted by black and brown bears alike.
questions.zh:
黑熊一辈子都会爬树，但棕熊长大后就不这么干了。
这两种动物都是狡猾的杂食者，吃各种各样的植物和动物。
有时这意味着它们会争夺相同的资源；不列颠哥伦比亚省的鲑鱼就同时被黑熊和棕熊捕食。

questions.name: #1204 Arabian Desert
questions.en:
The Arabian Desert, not to be confused with the Syrian Desert or North Arabian Desert, is the fourth-largest desert in the world.
It is second in total land mass for subtropical deserts, with an expansive surface area of 1 million square miles scattered across the Arabian Peninsula.
The Arabian Desert is also home to 102 endemic species of mammals and 310 various species of birds.
questions.zh:
阿拉伯沙漠，不要与叙利亚沙漠或北阿拉伯沙漠混淆，是世界上第四大沙漠。
它是亚热带沙漠中总面积第二大的，面积达100万平方英里，遍布阿拉伯半岛。
阿拉伯沙漠还栖息着102种特有哺乳动物和310种不同鸟类。

questions.name: #1205 Bad Luck
questions.en:
Mathematics and symbolism often play a significant role in superstitions, and the number three is no exception.
In many cultures, three is seen as a symbol of balance and completeness.
The triangle, with its three sides, represents stability and harmony.
The Pythagoreans, an ancient Greek philosophical school, regarded three as the first true number.
questions.zh:
数学和象征意义在迷信中常常扮演重要角色，数字三也不例外。
在许多文化中，三被视为平衡与完整的象征。
三角形有三条边，代表着稳定与和谐。
毕达哥拉斯学派，一个古希腊哲学流派，将三视为第一个真正的数字。

questions.name: #1206 Industrial Revolution
questions.en:
The Industrial Revolution was a transformative period that unfolded from the late 18th century to the 19th century.
Characterized by a shift from manual labor to mechanized production, this era marked a significant shift from agrarian and manual labor-based economies to mechanized production and industrialization.
questions.zh:
工业革命是一个从18世纪末延续到19世纪的变革时期。
这个时代以从手工劳动转向机械化生产为特点，标志着从农业和手工劳动为主的经济向机械化生产和工业化的重大转变。

questions.name: #1207 Number 1
questions.en:
Number 1 represents strong leadership qualities, innovation, and unexplored potential.
Individuals associated with this number possess a unique set of skills and abilities that set them apart.
They have a natural inclination towards taking charge and initiating new projects.
While they may have a tendency towards self-centeredness, they are generally righteous and kind-hearted leaders.
questions.zh:
数字1代表着强大的领导力、创新精神以及未被发掘的潜力。
与这个数字相关的人拥有一套独特的技能和才能，这让他们与众不同。
他们天生就喜欢掌控局面并启动新项目。
虽然他们可能有点以自我为中心，但总体上是正直且心地善良的领导者。

questions.name: #1208 Leo in Relationships
questions.en:
In relationships, Leo individuals are passionate and generous partners.
They bring excitement and vitality to their romantic connections, making every moment feel like an adventure.
Leo individuals value loyalty and admiration from their partners and seek relationships that allow them to shine and be appreciated.
However, their need for constant attention and validation can sometimes create challenges in relationships, as they may require their partner's undivided adoration.
questions.zh:
在感情中，狮子座的人是充满激情且慷慨的伴侣。
他们为恋情带来刺激与活力，让每一刻都像是一场冒险。
狮子座的人看重伴侣的忠诚与崇拜，追求能让自己闪耀并被欣赏的关系。
然而，他们渴望持续关注和认可，有时会给关系带来挑战，因为他们需要伴侣毫无保留的倾慕。

questions.name: #1209 Content Marketers
questions.en:
There's an entire industry dedicated to marketing products and services through web articles, videos and social media posts.
Digital marketers write blog posts, produce videos and maintain social media channels for both large corporations and mom-and-pop shops.
But that type of targeted content is exactly what generative AI is designed to create.

有一个完整的行业专门通过网络文章、视频和社交媒体帖子来营销产品和服务。
数字营销人员为大型企业和夫妻店撰写博客文章、制作视频并维护社交媒体渠道。
但这类针对性内容正是生成式人工智能被设计用来创造的。

questions.name: #1210 Dishwasher
questions.en:
There's a common misconception that the dishwasher fills up with water, so many people choose to wash dishes by hand instead of using the dishwasher because they believe it's more efficient.
The reality is, according to ENERGY STAR, certified dishwashers use less than 4 gallons of water per cycle compared to hand-washing, which can use 4 gallons of water every two minutes.
questions.zh:
很多人误以为洗碗机里会积满水，所以宁愿手洗也不用洗碗机，觉得手洗更省水。
实际上，根据能源之星的数据，认证洗碗机每次循环用水不到4加仑，而手洗每两分钟就可能用掉4加仑水。

questions.name: #1211 Statistics
questions.en:
Statistics is a bit of a mix between mathematics and probability.
The point of statistics is to describe processes you can observe out in the world — the height of oak trees or the likelihood a vaccine will work to fend off disease — without having to measure every oak tree in the world or vaccinate every person before deciding how effective a drug is.
questions.zh:
统计学有点像数学和概率的结合体。
统计学的意义在于，你不用测量世界上每一棵橡树，也不用给每个人都接种疫苗，就能描述你观察到的各种现象——比如橡树的高度，或者疫苗抵御疾病的有效性。

questions.name: #1212 Rotation
questions.en:
The Earth, our celestial home, is in perpetual motion, gracefully rotating through space.
This continuous rotation gives us the cycle of day and night, shapes our seasons, and influences our climate.
Over geological time spans, it's gradually slowing down, which has led to speculation about what would happen if the Earth stopped rotating altogether.
questions.zh:
地球，我们宇宙中的家园，一直在不停地旋转，优雅地穿梭于太空。
这种持续的旋转带来了昼夜交替，塑造了四季，也影响了我们的气候。

questions.name: #1213 Windmills
questions.en:
This popularity was driven by the simplicity of windmills as mechanical energy generators.
By simply putting a windmill with many vanes up, you could quickly garner access to a free mechanical energy source.
Through the spinning of the blades, that rotational energy could be used to drive machines through gearing or used to push and pull water from the ground with simple water sucker-rod pumps.
questions.zh:
风车作为机械能产生器，其简单性推动了它的普及。
只要竖起一个带有很多叶片的风车，你就能迅速获得免费的机械能源。
通过叶片的旋转，这种旋转能量可以通过齿轮传动来驱动机器，或者用简单的抽水杆泵从地下抽水。

questions.en: Humanity took a step forward into that future recently, when Israeli scientists revealed that they've developed a new type of brain-machine interface, which for the first time has allowed a human operator to control a nanobot implanted inside the body of a living creature (in this case a cockroach), simply by using his thoughts.

questions.name: #1215 Wildfire Prevention
questions.en:
Although forest thinning and controlled burning remove carbon in the short term, living trees are more likely to survive a subsequent wildfire.
In the long term, that’s a good outcome for carbon and climate.
Living trees continue to absorb and store carbon from the atmosphere, as well as provide critical seeds and shade for seedlings to regenerate, grow and recover the carbon lost to fires.
questions.zh:
虽然森林疏伐和控制性燃烧短期内会移除碳，但活树在后续野火中存活的几率更高。
从长远来看，这对碳和气候都是有利的结果。
活树不仅能持续从大气中吸收并储存碳，还能为幼苗的再生、生长和恢复火灾损失的碳提供关键的种子和荫蔽。

questions.name: #1216 Hurricane Harvey
questions.en:
The human toll of Hurricane Harvey is staggering, with 68 direct deaths and 35 indirect deaths attributed to the storm.
The loss of life is a sobering reminder of the destructive power of such natural disasters.
But beyond the lives lost, the impact on those who survived the storm cannot be overstated.

然而，除了逝去的生命，这场风暴对幸存者的影响也不容忽视。

questions.name: #1217 Dictaphones
questions.en:
During the early to mid-1900s, dictaphones continued to evolve, with advancements in recording technology.
The introduction of magnetic tape in the 1950s brought a more affordable and reliable storage medium for sound data.
This innovation led to the production of speech recording devices with improved recording capacity, including the popular cassette tapes.
questions.zh:
在20世纪初到中期，录音机不断发展，录音技术也在进步。
20世纪50年代磁带的引入为声音数据提供了更便宜、更可靠的存储介质。
这一创新催生了录音容量更大的语音记录设备，包括流行的盒式磁带。

questions.name: #1218 Remember Being Babies
questions.en:
Most adults can't recall life's earliest moments unless the events are reinforced by others who often retell them, or the memories are triggered by photographs or other cues.
It's a phenomenon scientists call childhood amnesia.
While you may have been able to recall and describe your second birthday party in great detail for months after it happened, a year later those memories may have faded and, eventually, are lost altogether.
questions.zh:
大多数成年人记不起生命最初的那些时刻，除非这些事件经常被他人反复讲述而得到强化，或者通过照片或其他线索触发记忆。
这种现象被科学家称为童年失忆症。
虽然你或许能在事情发生后的几个月里详细回忆并描述你两岁的生日派对，但一年后那些记忆可能已经淡去，最终完全消失。

questions.name: #1219 Phone Hygiene
questions.en:
It's been estimated that people touch their phone hundreds, if not thousands, of times a day.
And while many of us wash our hands regularly after say, going to the bathroom, cooking, cleaning or gardening, we are much less likely to consider washing our hands after touching our phones.
But given how disgusting and germ-infested phones can be, maybe it's time to think more about mobile phone hygiene.
questions.zh:
据估计，人们每天触摸手机的次数少则数百次，多则上千次。
虽然很多人会在上厕所、做饭、打扫或园艺之后规律地洗手，但很少有人会想到摸完手机后也要洗手。
但鉴于手机可能变得又脏又满是细菌，或许是时候多关注一下手机卫生了。

questions.name: #1220 Fingerprint
questions.en:
One of life's great marvels is that, much like snowflakes, no two fingerprints are alike.
This goes even for identical twins, who split from the very same egg.
In fact, fingerprints are so unique that we actually have different prints on each and every digit.
Although it's not entirely impossible for two fingerprints to match up, the odds are way against it, at 1 in 64 billion.
questions.zh:
人生的一大奇迹是，指纹就像雪花一样，没有两个是完全相同的。
即使是同卵双胞胎，他们来自同一个卵子，指纹也各不相同。
实际上，指纹非常独特，我们每个手指上的纹路都不一样。
虽然两个指纹完全匹配并非绝对不可能，但概率极低，低至640亿分之一。

questions.name: #1221 School buses
questions.en:
Every single school bus in the United States is painted the exact same color.
However, a century ago, kids were transported to school by all kinds of random vehicles.
Because there were no federal standards, it was up to states or individual school districts to hire buses, trucks and even horse-drawn wagons to ferry kids to and from school.
questions.zh:
美国每一辆校车都涂着完全相同的颜色。
然而，一个世纪前，孩子们乘坐各种五花八门的车辆去上学。
由于没有联邦标准，各州或学区自行雇佣巴士、卡车，甚至马车来接送孩子上下学。

questions.name: #1222 Bubbles
questions.en:
People love bubbles, they love to blow them, pop them and fit inside them.
Bubbles aren't just for entertainment; they are the crisp effervescence in our sodas and sparkling water, and some doctors are even using microscopic bubbles to deliver medicine more effectively.
Whether for entertainment or scientific study, scientists have been turning their attention to why bubbles pop.
questions.zh:
人们喜欢泡泡，喜欢吹泡泡、戳泡泡，甚至把自己装进泡泡里。
泡泡不只是用来玩的；它们还是汽水和苏打水里清爽的气泡，有些医生甚至用微小的泡泡来更有效地输送药物。
无论是为了娱乐还是科学研究，科学家们一直在关注泡泡为什么会破灭。

questions.name: #1223 Harvest Moon
questions.en:
The harvest moon is the full moon closest to the autumnal equinox, typically in late September or early October.
Typically, the moon rises about 50 minutes later each day, but the same doesn't go for harvest moons.
The rising harvest moon appears in the night sky about 25 minutes later than the previous night's moon — a much shorter time between moonrises.
questions.zh:
丰收月是离秋分最近的满月，通常在九月底或十月初。
通常，月亮每天会推迟大约50分钟升起，但丰收月并非如此。
丰收月升起时，每晚只比前一夜晚约25分钟出现在夜空中——月出之间的间隔短得多。

questions.name: #1224 Earth’s Composition
questions.en:
Our planet consists of several earth’s layers, each playing a vital role in Earth’s overall structure and function.
From the core, nestled deep within Earth’s center, to the mantle and the crust that forms the surface we live on, understanding these layers provides valuable information about the geological processes that have shaped our planet.
questions.zh:
我们的地球由多个地层组成，每一层对地球的整体结构和功能都起着至关重要的作用。
从深埋在地心的地核，到地幔，再到构成我们生活表面的地壳，了解这些层次能让我们深刻认识塑造地球的地质过程。

questions.name: #1225 Neptune
questions.en:
Neptune, the most distant gas giant in our solar system, is home to some of the most powerful winds ever observed.
Faster than the speed of sound, these winds are more powerful than those on any other planet in our solar system, including Jupiter and Saturn.
Neptune’s atmosphere is primarily composed of hydrogen and helium.
questions.zh:
海王星，我们太阳系中最遥远的气态巨行星，拥有迄今观测到的最强风暴。
这些风暴速度超过音速，比太阳系中包括木星和土星在内的任何其他行星上的风暴都要猛烈。
海王星的大气主要由氢和氦构成。

questions.name: #1226 Insects
questions.en:
Most insects aren't pests.
Of the 1million-ish insect species we know of, only around 1 percent of them are classified as pests.
Insects pollinate our gardens, break down waste in the soil and sometimes eat the insects we want to discourage hanging out in our vegetable and flower beds.
questions.zh:
大多数昆虫并不是害虫。
在我们已知的大约100万种昆虫中，只有大约1%被归类为害虫。
昆虫为我们的花园授粉，分解土壤中的废物，有时还会吃掉那些我们不希望它们在菜园和花坛里滋生的昆虫。

questions.name: #1227 Peppermint
questions.en:
Peppermint grows best in partial shade, where it has some protection from the midday sun of hot summer days.
The plant needs frequent watering, but overall, it doesn't need much encouragement to grow.
In fact, because it grows like a weed, it's not a great idea to plant peppermint too close to other herbs or vegetables because it can easily crowd them out.
questions.zh:
薄荷在半阴环境下长得最好，这样可以避开炎炎夏日正午的暴晒。
这种植物需要频繁浇水，但总的来说，它不需要太多照料就能茁壮成长。
事实上，由于它像野草一样疯长，最好不要把薄荷种得离其他香草或蔬菜太近，因为它很容易就把它们挤掉。

questions.name: #1228 Community Gardens
questions.en:
Around the world, city residents build gardens on balconies, rooftops and small strips of land.
A March 2023 study published in the journal Ecology Letters confirms that beyond offering food and an outlet for cultivating outdoor space, urban gardens provide benefits for the humans, insects, and animals who inhabit these leafy respites from city life.
questions.zh:
在世界各地，城市居民在阳台、屋顶和小块土地上建造花园。
2023年3月发表在《生态学快报》上的一项研究证实，除了提供食物和培育户外空间的途径外，城市花园还为居住在这些绿色休憩地的人类、昆虫和动物带来了益处。

questions.name: #1229 Big Mansions
questions.en:
Most people are overjoyed to have a couple thousand square feet to call their own, but the world's ultra-wealthy are living in far more space than that.
From ultramodern mansions to historically significant properties, there are a handful of truly huge houses scattered around the world, each with their own perks and amenities.
questions.zh:
大多数人能有几千平方英尺的私有空间就欣喜若狂了，但全球超级富豪们住的面积远不止于此。
从超现代豪宅到具有历史意义的房产，世界各地散落着一些真正庞大的住宅，每座都有其独特的优势和设施。

questions.name: #1230 License Plates
questions.en:
Initially, license plates were issued to last the life of the vehicle, but by the 1920s, registration renewal became a thing.
During this time, states began experimenting with different methods of creating license plates.
Typically, the front of the registration card would have the registration number in large, centered numbers while the back would have the abbreviated name of the state and a two- or four-digit year of validity.
questions.zh:
起初，车牌是一次性发放，随车用到报废，但到了20世纪20年代，车牌续期就出现了。
这段时间里，各州开始尝试用不同方法制作车牌。
通常，登记卡正面中央会印有大号登记号码，背面则有州名缩写和两到四位数的有效年份。

questions.name: #1231 White Smoke
questions.en:
White smoke from the exhaust is typically caused by water vapor, coolant leaks, and other engine-related issues.
When temperatures inside the engine rise, steam may form, which could be an indication of a cracked cylinder head.
A malfunctioning head gasket or other engine component can also result in white exhaust smoke, which can be a serious cause for concern if left unaddressed.
questions.zh:
排气管冒白烟通常是由水蒸气、冷却液泄漏或其他发动机问题引起的。
当发动机内部温度升高时，可能会形成蒸汽，这可能是气缸盖破裂的迹象。
缸垫或其他发动机部件故障也可能导致排气管冒白烟，如果不及时处理，可能会引发严重问题。

questions.name: #1232 Renting a Car
questions.en:
At 18, you can be called for jury duty, sign up for the military draft and get married without parental consent.
But one thing you may not be able to do is rent a car.
This is because many companies won't rent a car to anyone under the age of 21, and those that do will often charge a hefty additional fee for the "privilege."
questions.zh:
到了18岁，你可能会被叫去当陪审员，可以报名参军，也可以不经父母同意就结婚。
但有一件事你可能做不了——租车。
这是因为许多公司不会把车租给21岁以下的人，而那些愿意租的，往往会为这种“特权”收取高额的附加费。

questions.name: #1233 Hitting a Deer
questions.en:
The risk of hitting a deer varies by time of day, day of the week, the monthly lunar cycle and seasons of the year.
These accident cycles are partly a function of driver behavior – they are highest when traffic is heavy, drivers are least alert and driving conditions are poorest for spotting animals.
They are also affected by deer behavior.
questions.zh:
撞到鹿的风险会因一天中的时段、一周中的日子、每月的月相以及一年中的季节而有所不同。
这些事故周期部分取决于驾驶员的行为——在交通繁忙、驾驶员最不警觉以及观察动物的驾驶条件最差时，事故率最高。
它们也受到鹿的行为的影响。

questions.name: #1234 Old English
questions.en:
The earliest speakers of English spoke Old English.
It developed in a turbulent period of British history.
This was just after the Romans had left Britain, around 1,600 years ago.
The Romans had colonized Britain but they abandoned the country in the fifth century because the Roman empire was collapsing all around them.
questions.zh:

那是在罗马人离开英国之后不久，大约1600年前。
罗马人曾殖民英国，但在五世纪时他们抛弃了这片土地，因为周围的罗马帝国正在崩溃。

questions.name: #1235 Sushi
questions.en:
The origins of sushi can be traced back to ancient China, where the preservation of fish was a necessity.
During the second century A.D., the Chinese began fermenting fish by wrapping it in rice and allowing it to ferment over time.
The rice was discarded, and the fish was consumed.
Sushi made its way to Japan in the 8th century, introduced by Buddhist monks who used fermentation techniques to preserve fish.
questions.zh:
寿司的起源可以追溯到古代中国，当时保存鱼类是必要的。
公元二世纪，中国人开始通过将鱼包裹在米饭中并让其发酵来腌制鱼。
米饭被丢弃，鱼被食用。
寿司在8世纪传入日本，由使用发酵技术保存鱼类的佛教僧侣引入。

questions.name: #1236 Baby Smell
questions.en:
That new baby smell could also serve an evolutionary purpose – for example, to help a mother identify her baby more easily, similar to how babies can identify their mothers by smell almost immediately.
Several studies have shown that most mothers can identify their babies by smell alone.
It may also help a woman bond to her baby.
questions.zh:
新生儿身上那种味道可能也有进化上的意义，比如帮助妈妈更容易认出自己的孩子，就像宝宝几乎能立刻通过气味认出妈妈一样。
多项研究表明，大多数妈妈单凭气味就能认出自己的宝宝。
这还可能帮助女性与宝宝建立情感纽带。

questions.name: #1237 Water Vapor
questions.en:
In cold weather or during startup, water vapor present in the exhaust system can create white smoke, while blue smoke might be an indication of a different issue.
Exhaust emissions, a natural byproduct of the combustion process, are typically harmless, as they dissipate quickly once the engine warms up.
questions.zh:

尾气是燃烧过程的自然产物，通常无害，因为发动机热起来后很快就散掉了。

questions.name: #1238 IPOs
questions.en:
IPOs give the company's initial investors a chance to make a return that justifies the risk they took in backing it early on.
Their own shares stand to grow in value as they become worth the price that they're trading on the stock market.
And the legions of investors who buy shares in the newly-public company stand to watch their stake rise quickly in value as well.
questions.zh:
首次公开募股让公司的早期投资者有机会获得回报，以证明他们当初支持公司所承担的风险是值得的。
他们自己的股票价值有望增长，因为它们在股市上的交易价格会变得合理。
而众多购买这家新上市公司股票的投资者，也有望看到自己的持股价值迅速攀升。

questions.name: #1239 Mosquitoes
questions.en:
How mosquitoes seek out and feed on their hosts are important factors in how a virus circulates in nature.
Mosquitoes spread diseases by acting as carriers of viruses and other pathogens: A mosquito that bites a person infected with a virus can acquire the virus and pass it on to the next person it bites.

蚊子通过携带病毒和其他病原体来传播疾病：如果蚊子叮咬了感染病毒的人，它就可能感染病毒，然后通过叮咬下一个人将病毒传播出去。

questions.name: #1240 Monkeypox
questions.en:
Countries that are members of the United Nations are obligated to report cases of unusual diseases that have the potential to become global health threats.
In May 2022, more than a dozen countries in Europe, the Americas and other regions of the world that had never before had cases of monkeypox started to report cases occurring within their borders.
questions.zh:

2022年5月，欧洲、美洲及世界其他地区十多个从未出现过猴痘病例的国家开始报告境内出现病例。

questions.name: #1241 Our Ears
questions.en:
Our ears are highly sensitive to loud noise.
Even very short exposures to high-level sounds – that’s anything above 132 decibels – can cause permanent hearing loss for some people.
That’s true even if it’s just a brief blast; a single gunshot or fireworks explosion can cause immediate damage to the ear.
questions.zh:
我们的耳朵对巨大的噪音非常敏感。
即使是极短暂的强音暴露——超过132分贝的任何声音——也可能导致某些人永久性听力损失。
即便只是一声短暂的巨响，比如一声枪响或烟花爆炸，也能立即对耳朵造成损伤。

questions.name: #1242 Medicare
questions.en:
Medicare was created in 1965 as a safety net health insurance program for older Americans.
All Americans over 65 years old qualify for Medicare health coverage regardless of preexisting conditions, and Medicare covers a significant portion of the costs of doctor's office visits, treatments and surgeries, and prescription medications, although Medicare recipients also pay annual premiums and out-of-pocket costs.
questions.zh:
医疗保险是1965年推出的，旨在为美国老年人提供健康保险安全网。
所有65岁以上的美国公民，无论是否有既往病史，都有资格享受医疗保险的保障。医疗保险承担了大部分看病、治疗、手术和处方药的开支，不过参保人每年也需要缴纳保费并自付一部分费用。

questions.en:
Brown is the most common eye color in the world — between 70 and 80 percent of the world's population have eyes that are some shade of brown, from the darkest dark brown to light brown.

questions.name: #1244 Baby Formula Shortage
questions.en:
Shortages of certain products, like meat or toilet paper are certainly annoying and inconvenient.
That said, people can live without them, so it's not such a big deal in the grand scheme of things.
However, the baby formula shortage of 2022 is pretty scary stuff for parents of infants, not to mention adults who have medical conditions that require such products to survive.

话说回来，没有它们人们也能活，所以从大局看也不是什么大不了的事。
但2022年的婴儿配方奶粉短缺，对婴儿父母来说相当可怕，更别提那些需要靠这类产品维持生命的成年人了。

questions.name: #1245 Steps
questions.en:
There are several variables for calculating the distance a person can cover in 10,000 steps per day, including their height, stride length and physical ability, as well as the terrain.
You can use a step count goal of 10,000 average daily steps as a personal activity benchmark to promote accountability and healthy habits in daily life.
questions.zh:
一个人每天走一万步能走多远，取决于好几个因素，比如身高、步幅、体能，还有路况。
你可以把每天平均走一万步作为个人活动目标，这样能督促自己养成健康的生活习惯。

questions.name: #1246 Federal Reserve
questions.en:
The Federal Reserve is not funded by Congress.
Instead, it's funded by the interest earned on securities it buys, plus fees it receives for services it provides to banking institutions, including check clearing and fund transferring.
All net earnings of the Federal Reserve Banks are transferred to the U.S. Treasury.
questions.zh:
美联储不是由国会拨款资助的。
相反，它的资金来自于它购买的证券所赚取的利息，以及它为银行机构提供服务（包括支票清算和资金转账）所收取的费用。
美联储银行的所有净收益都上缴给美国财政部。

questions.name: #1247 GDP
questions.en:
Using GDP alone as a measure of a nation’s wealth only tells you half of the story.
Bigger and more populous countries have a distinct advantage, since they have more workers to produce more goods and services.
The only way to make an apples-to-apples comparison is to calculate each country’s GDP per capita.
questions.zh:
单靠GDP来衡量一个国家的财富，只能说明问题的一半。
面积更大、人口更多的国家有明显优势，因为它们有更多劳动力来生产更多商品和服务。
进行公平比较的唯一方法是计算每个国家的人均GDP。

questions.name: #1248 Air Pollution
questions.en:
The government is proposing a new initiative to address the issue of air pollution in urban areas.
The initiative aims to identify and mitigate the sources of pollution, reduce the impact of air pollution on public health, and improve air quality in cities.
This program will require collaboration between different stakeholders, including government agencies, businesses, and citizens.

这个项目需要不同利益相关方之间的合作，包括政府机构、企业和市民。

questions.name: #1249 Disaster Preparedness Program
questions.en:
A comprehensive disaster preparedness program is being launched to enhance community resilience and response capabilities.
The program includes initiatives to educate communities about potential hazards, develop emergency response plans, and improve communication systems for timely warnings and alerts during emergencies.
The initiative also focuses on developing disaster-resistant infrastructure and promoting sustainable land use practices to reduce the impact of disasters on communities.
questions.zh:
一项全面的备灾计划正在启动，旨在增强社区的韧性和应对能力。
该计划包括教育社区了解潜在危险、制定应急响应计划以及改进通信系统以便在紧急情况下及时发出警告和警报。
该倡议还专注于建设抗灾基础设施和推广可持续的土地利用方式，以减少灾害对社区的影响。

questions.name: #1250 Historic Preservation
questions.en:
Preserving historic buildings and landmarks is not only important for maintaining a community's identity but also for enhancing economic stability.
Historic preservation attracts tourists who are interested in the unique character and history of a place.
Visitors are more likely to spend time and money in areas with well-preserved historic buildings, contributing to the local economy.

游客更愿意在有保存完好的历史建筑的区域消费时间和金钱，从而促进当地经济。

For example, grandparents may introduce their grandchildren to traditional cultural activities, while younger family members may introduce older adults to new forms of cultural expression.
The dynamic interplay between generations within a household can create unique opportunities for shared cultural experiences.

家庭内代际间的动态互动，能为共同的文化体验创造独特的机会。

questions.name: #1254 Cultural Identity
questions.en:
Cultural identity is shaped by a variety of factors, including social norms and values.
To maintain cultural integrity and function, members must conform to these norms and values.
However, conformity can also limit individual expression and creativity.
Balancing cultural conformity with personal identity and autonomy is a complex process that requires ongoing negotiation and reflection.
questions.zh:
文化认同是由多种因素塑造的，包括社会规范和价值观。
为了保持文化的完整性和功能，成员必须遵守这些规范和价值观。
然而，从众也可能限制个人的表达和创造力。
在文化从众与个人身份和自主性之间取得平衡是一个复杂的过程，需要持续的协商和反思。

questions.name: #1255 Power of Artistic Expression
questions.en:
Artistic expression has been a powerful form of communication throughout history.
From the Romantic movement to the present day, artists have sought to convey emotions and connect with their audience.
Whether through visual art, music, or performance, artists aim to evoke a range of responses, from joy and inspiration to introspection and contemplation.
questions.zh:
纵观历史，艺术表达一直是一种强有力的交流方式。
从浪漫主义运动至今，艺术家们始终致力于传达情感并与观众建立联系。
无论是通过视觉艺术、音乐还是表演，艺术家们都旨在唤起从喜悦和灵感到内省与沉思等一系列反应。

questions.name: #1256 World Around Us
questions.en:
The world around us can pose a danger, especially as travel and recreational activities become more common.
This means that people are now at a greater risk of encountering life-threatening situations.
While the human body can adapt to some degree, it is not equipped to handle toxins or long-term exposure to extreme environmental conditions.
questions.zh:
我们周围的世界可能带来危险，尤其是随着旅行和休闲活动越来越普遍。
这意味着人们现在面临危及生命的情况的风险更高。
虽然人体能在一定程度上适应，但无法处理毒素或长期暴露于极端环境条件。

questions.name: #1257 Rice Cultivation
questions.en:
A potentially more sustainable choice in rice cultivation could be the development of a new rice breed that combines the traits of an annual Asian rice variety and a perennial African rice variety.
This hybrid rice has demonstrated impressive performance, producing grain continuously for eight consecutive harvests over a span of four years.
questions.zh:
在水稻种植中，一种可能更可持续的选择是培育一种新型水稻品种，它结合了一年生的亚洲水稻品种和多年生的非洲水稻品种的特性。
这种杂交水稻表现出了令人瞩目的性能，在四年内连续八次收获，持续产出稻谷。

questions.name: #1258 Science of Smiling
questions.en:
Smiling is a universal sign of happiness and positivity, but did you know that it also has a physiological effect on the body?
When you smile, your brain releases endorphins, which are natural painkillers and mood boosters.
This may be why smiling is so contagious and can have a positive impact on those around you.
questions.zh:
微笑是快乐和积极的普遍标志，但你知道吗？它还对身体有生理影响。
当你微笑时，大脑会释放内啡肽，这是一种天然的止痛剂和情绪提升剂。
这可能就是为什么微笑如此有感染力，并能对周围人产生积极影响的原因。

questions.name: #1259 Neuromorphic Computing
questions.en:
As advancements continue to be made in neuromorphic computing, the integration of targeted magnetic waves and other innovative techniques holds promise for creating more efficient and powerful AI systems.
These developments could revolutionize various fields, including robotics, image recognition, and natural language processing.
The future of neuromorphic computing is bright and full of exciting possibilities.
questions.zh:
随着神经形态计算的不断进步，结合定向磁波和其他创新技术，有望打造出更高效、更强大的人工智能系统。
这些进展可能会彻底改变机器人技术、图像识别和自然语言处理等多个领域。
神经形态计算的未来光明且充满激动人心的可能性。

questions.name: #1261 Happy Sounds
questions.en:
Research published in the journal of Neuroscience suggests that happy sounds, such as laughter, are infectious.
When people hear these sounds, their brains activate the premotor cortical region, which prepares facial muscles to move.
This may explain why laughter and other happy sounds can spread so easily from person to person.
questions.zh:
《神经科学》期刊上的一项研究表明，笑声这类快乐的声音具有感染力。
当人们听到这些声音时，大脑会激活前运动皮层区域，为面部肌肉的运动做准备。
这或许能解释为什么笑声和其他快乐的声音能如此轻易地在人与人之间传播。

questions.en:
Online shopping environments offer unique advantages that traditional brick-and-mortar stores cannot match.
One of the most significant benefits is the ability to create highly interactive retail interfaces that can be customized to individual preferences.
This level of personalization can enhance the shopping experience and improve customer satisfaction.

这种个性化程度能提升购物体验，并提高顾客满意度。

questions.name: #1263 Decline or Empowerment
questions.en:
While opponents view beauty pageants as symbols of decline, others argue that they can be platforms for empowerment and self-expression.
Supporters highlight the opportunities these contests provide for personal growth, public speaking, and community involvement.
It is essential to foster a dialogue that explores the potential positive aspects of beauty pageants while addressing concerns about objectification.
questions.zh:
尽管反对者将选美比赛视为堕落的象征，但另一些人认为它们可以成为赋权与自我表达的平台。
支持者强调这些比赛为个人成长、公共演讲和社区参与提供了机会。

questions.name: #1264 Personal Development
questions.en:
Regardless of whether parents are perceived as strict or lenient, their upbringing style can have a significant impact on their children's personal development.
Strict parenting may promote discipline and structure, while lenient parenting may foster creativity and independence.
It is essential to recognize the potential impact of upbringing on children and strive to create a nurturing environment that supports their growth.
questions.zh:
不管家长是严格还是宽松，他们的教养方式都会对孩子的个人成长产生重要影响。
严格的管教可能培养纪律和条理，而宽松的管教则可能激发创造力和独立性。
认识到教养方式对孩子潜在的影响至关重要，要努力营造一个支持他们成长的养育环境。

questions.name: #1265 Burdens of Marriage
questions.en:
The financial pressure associated with marriage can be daunting, but with careful planning and communication, couples can navigate these burdens successfully.
Prioritizing financial stability, setting a realistic budget for wedding expenses, and making informed decisions about housing options can help alleviate some of the financial stress.
questions.zh:
婚姻带来的经济压力可能让人望而却步，但只要精心规划、坦诚沟通，夫妻双方就能顺利应对这些负担。
优先考虑财务稳定、为婚礼开销制定切实可行的预算，并在住房选择上做出明智决策，有助于缓解部分经济压力。

questions.name: #1266 Green
questions.en:
Green is a refreshing and rejuvenating color that is often associated with nature and growth.
It has a calming effect and can promote feelings of balance and harmony.
Green is also believed to have healing properties, making it a popular choice for healthcare settings.
Its soothing effects make it an ideal color for relaxation spaces like living rooms and bedrooms.

人们也相信绿色有治愈功效，因此在医疗环境中很受欢迎。
它的舒缓作用使其成为客厅和卧室等放松空间的理想颜色。

Students should prioritize their coursework and ensure that they have enough time to study and complete assignments.
Effective time management skills are crucial for balancing academics and extracurriculars successfully.

高效的时间管理能力是成功平衡学业与课外活动的关键。

questions.name: #1268 Lunar Observation
questions.en:
To observe the rare lunar events on Wednesday night, find a location with an unobstructed view of the sky.
The optimal time to view the super blue moon is just after sunset when it is on the horizon and takes on a deep orange color.
Binoculars or a telescope can enhance the viewing experience.
Don't miss this chance to witness a rare and awe-inspiring display of celestial beauty.
questions.zh:
想在周三晚上观测罕见的月象，找个视野开阔、没有遮挡的地方。
观赏超级蓝月的最佳时机是日落之后，此时它刚升上地平线，呈现深橙色。
用双筒望远镜或天文望远镜能提升观赏体验。
别错过这次机会，去见证一场罕见而震撼的天体美景。

questions.name: #1269 Space Exploration
questions.en:
Space exploration has captivated human imagination for centuries, offering glimpses into the mysteries of the universe and inspiring scientific innovation.
However, space exploration also raises ethical questions about its cost, safety, and impact on Earth's environment.
As we continue to explore space, it is important to balance our curiosity with responsible practices that prioritize safety and sustainability.
questions.zh:
几个世纪以来，太空探索一直吸引着人类的想象力，让我们得以一窥宇宙的奥秘，并激发了科学创新。
然而，太空探索也引发了关于其成本、安全以及对地球环境影响的伦理问题。
在我们继续探索太空的同时，重要的是要在好奇心与优先考虑安全和可持续性的负责任做法之间取得平衡。

questions.name: #1270 Hummingbird
questions.en:
Hummingbirds are highly maneuverable fliers, flitting forward and backward as they home in on flowers.
But in the dense foliage many inhabit, they often encounter gaps that are too narrow for their wingspan.
Since they can't bend their wings in flight, how do they get through?
Researchers used high-speed cameras to capture their movements, discovering two unique strategies.
questions.zh:
蜂鸟是极其灵活的飞行者，能在花朵间前后穿梭。
但它们栖息的茂密枝叶中，常有窄于翼展的缝隙。
既然飞行中无法弯曲翅膀，它们如何穿过？
研究人员用高速摄像机捕捉其动作，发现了两种独特策略。

questions.name: #1271 Sharks
questions.en:
Sharks and rays are important marine species that play a significant role in maintaining the balance of the ocean ecosystem.
However, their populations have been declining due to overfishing, habitat loss, and climate change.
A new study by scientists has revealed that these threatened species are being caught off the coast of northern Cyprus, posing a threat to their survival.
questions.zh:
鲨鱼和鳐鱼是重要的海洋物种，在维持海洋生态平衡中扮演着关键角色。
然而，由于过度捕捞、栖息地丧失和气候变化，它们的数量一直在下降。
科学家的一项新研究显示，这些濒危物种正在塞浦路斯北部海岸被捕获，这威胁到了它们的生存。

questions.name: #1272 Future Population
questions.en:
Researchers have investigated how changes in urban land and population will affect future populations' exposures to weather extremes under climate conditions at the end of the 21st century.
They used a data-driven model to predict how urban areas across the country will grow by 2100, and found that how a city is laid out or organized spatially has the potential to reduce population exposures to future weather extremes.
questions.zh:
研究人员调查了城市土地和人口的变化将如何在21世纪末的气候条件下影响未来人口对极端天气的暴露程度。
他们利用数据驱动模型预测了全国城市地区到2100年的发展情况，并发现城市的空间布局或组织方式有可能减少未来人口对极端天气的暴露。

questions.name: #1273 Digital Data
questions.en:
A team of researchers has developed a custom-built 'data-to-music' algorithm that can transform digital data into sound, making it easier to comprehend and analyze.
The use of sound to represent data has the potential to revolutionize the way we interpret and understand complex information, particularly in fields such as science, medicine, and engineering.
questions.zh:

用声音来呈现数据，有可能彻底改变我们解读和理解复杂信息的方式，尤其是在科学、医学和工程等领域。

questions.name: #1274 Carbon Capture
questions.en:
Scientists have developed a process that removes CO2 from coal-burning power plant emissions in a way that is similar to how soda lime works in scuba diving rebreathers.
Their research offers an alternative but simpler strategy for carbon capture and requires 24 percent less energy than industrial benchmark solutions.
questions.zh:
科学家们开发出一种方法，能从燃煤发电厂的排放物中去除二氧化碳，其原理类似于潜水呼吸器中苏打石灰的作用。
他们的研究为碳捕获提供了一种更简单的替代方案，所需能量比工业基准解决方案少24%。

questions.name: #1275 AI Use
questions.en:
Similar to how chatbots may sometimes generate false information or fabricate responses, machine learning models developed for scientific purposes can also produce misleading or inaccurate results.
However, researchers have recently introduced a novel statistical method that enables the safe utilization of AI predictions to evaluate scientific hypotheses.
questions.zh:

不过，研究人员最近引入了一种新颖的统计方法，使得安全利用人工智能预测来评估科学假说成为可能。

questions.name: #1276 Soft Robotics
questions.en:
Researchers have used fossil evidence to engineer a soft robotic replica of pleurocystitids, a marine organism that existed nearly 450 million years ago and is believed to be one of the first echinoderms capable of movement using a muscular stem.
This groundbreaking achievement in soft robotics provides insights into the ancient marine organism's locomotion.
questions.zh:
研究人员利用化石证据，制造出了一种软体机器人复制品，模拟的是近4.5亿年前存在的一种海洋生物——pleurocystitids，它被认为是首批能够通过肌肉柄移动的棘皮动物之一。
这项软体机器人领域的突破性成就，为我们了解这种古老海洋生物的移动方式提供了新视角。

questions.name: #1277 New Internet Addiction
questions.en:
Young people spend an average of six hours a day online, primarily using their smartphones, according to new research.
Older people (those 24 years and older) spend 4.6 hours online.
This research highlights the significant impact of digital technology on our daily lives and underscores the need for continued exploration of how we can balance our online and offline activities for optimal well-being.

新研究显示，年轻人平均每天上网6小时，主要使用智能手机。

这项研究凸显了数字技术对我们日常生活的重大影响，并强调了持续探索如何平衡线上与线下活动以实现最佳福祉的必要性。

questions.name: #1278 Ginger
questions.en:
The pungent and flavorful taste of ginger makes it a popular ingredient in many cuisines.
It is also known for its medicinal properties, such as aiding digestion and reducing inflammation.
However, the cultivation of ginger is a labor-intensive process that requires careful attention to soil quality, temperature, and humidity.
Despite these challenges, ginger remains a highly sought-after spice around the world.
questions.zh:
姜那辛辣又带劲的味道，让它成了很多菜系里常见的调料。
它还有药用价值，比如帮助消化、减轻炎症。
不过种姜是个费时费力的活儿，得仔细盯着土质、温度和湿度。
尽管有这些麻烦，姜在世界各地还是抢手的香料。

questions.name: #1279 Echidna
questions.en:
A long-beaked echidna named after Sir David Attenborough and last seen by scientists in 1961 has been photographed for the first time in an Indonesian tropical forest.
An international team of researchers worked with local communities to deploy over 80 camera traps to film the elusive animal.
Besides rediscovering the echidna, the team uncovered a wealth of species completely new to science.
questions.zh:
一种以大卫·爱登堡爵士命名的长喙针鼹，科学家上次见到它还是在1961年，最近首次在印度尼西亚的热带雨林中被拍到。
一个国际研究团队与当地社区合作，部署了80多个相机陷阱来拍摄这种难以捉摸的动物。
除了重新发现这种针鼹，团队还发现了一大批科学界完全未知的新物种。

questions.name: #1280 Animal Calls
questions.en:
A recent study by Western researchers found that when animals produce sounds while sitting on the ground, like the chirping of crickets, their volume and range can increase by up to ten times.
This discovery challenges the conventional belief in the field of animal communication that the ground impedes sound transmission.
questions.zh:
西方研究人员最近的一项研究发现，当动物在地面上发出声音时，比如蟋蟀的鸣叫，其音量和传播范围可以增加多达十倍。
这一发现挑战了动物交流领域的一种传统观念，即地面会阻碍声音传播。

Researchers conducting experiments with a novel technique for sequencing individual cells have made a surprising discovery that challenges our existing knowledge of genetic rules.
By examining the genome of a protist, they have identified a distinctive deviation in the DNA code that marks the end of a gene.

questions.name: #1282 Carbon-capture Tree
questions.en:
Due to the growing urgency of the climate crisis, there has been a significant increase in the establishment of commercial tree plantations as a means to counterbalance excessive carbon emissions.
However, experts argue that these carbon-offset plantations may have negative impacts on biodiversity and other vital functions of ecosystems.
questions.zh:
由于气候危机日益紧迫，商业林场的建立大幅增加，以此来抵消过多的碳排放。
然而，专家认为这些碳抵消林场可能对生物多样性和生态系统的其他关键功能产生负面影响。

questions.name: #1283 Coevolution
questions.en:
Based on a recent study, it is believed that the initial louse species to inhabit a mammalian host originally evolved as parasites of birds.
This transition, which occurred tens of millions of years ago, marked the beginning of the enduring relationship between mammals and lice.
This coevolutionary process provided ample opportunities for lice to expand their presence to other mammalian species.
questions.zh:

这种共同进化的过程为虱子提供了充足的机会，使其扩展到其他哺乳动物物种中。

questions.name: #1284 Adult Coral
questions.en:
Recent research suggests that adult fragments of a coral species exhibit improved tolerance to bleaching and a faster recovery when exposed to symbionts that have evolved to withstand higher temperatures.
Interestingly, the study also found that the treatment with these heat-evolved symbionts did not negatively impact the coral's growth.

最近有研究表明，珊瑚成体碎片在接触到进化出耐高温能力的共生体后，对白化的耐受性会提高，恢复速度也会加快。
有趣的是，研究还发现，用这些耐热共生体处理珊瑚，并不会对它们的生长造成负面影响。
