questions.en:
Significant progress has been made towards achieving photochemical upconversion in a solid state, bringing us one step closer to realizing a breakthrough in various fields such as renewable energy, water purification, and advanced healthcare.

questions.name: #1286 Brain Inflammation
questions.en:
Severe inflammation in early childhood is a clinically known risk factor for developing autism and schizophrenia.
Now, for the first time, scientists from the University of Maryland School of Medicine (UMSOM) have discovered that inflammation alters the development of vulnerable brain cells, and this could have mechanistic links to neurodevelopmental disorders.

来自马里兰大学医学院的科学家首次发现，炎症会改变脆弱脑细胞的发育，这可能与神经发育障碍有机制上的联系。

questions.name: #1287 Preying on Worms
questions.en:
Scientists find that the 'feel good' brain chemical dopamine regulates anxious worm behavior in the presence of nipping predators.
The findings illuminate how this dopamine-regulated brain pathway may be related to anxiety and could provide insight into human conditions such as post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD).
questions.zh:
科学家发现，当有捕食者在旁边咬来咬去时，那种让人感觉良好的脑化学物质多巴胺会调节蠕虫的焦虑行为。
这些发现揭示了这条由多巴胺调节的大脑通路可能与焦虑有关，并可能为理解人类创伤后应激障碍等疾病提供线索。

questions.en:
Faster communications have irrevocably altered the way we communicate and interact with others, ushering in a new era of interconnectedness that has transformed the world into an interconnected global village.
The emergence of cutting-edge technologies such as the internet and mobile devices has enabled us to transmit information at unprecedented speeds.

questions.en:
Credit Cards are a ubiquitous form of payment that have revolutionized the way we conduct transactions.
With a credit card, individuals can make purchases without having to carry cash or worry about the availability of funds.
Credit cards also offer a range of benefits such as cashback rewards, travel points, and purchase protection.

信用卡还提供一系列好处，比如返现奖励、旅行积分和购物保护。

questions.name: #1290 Pollution Reduction
questions.en:
Pollution Eeduction is a pressing issue that requires immediate attention.
The increase in greenhouse gas emissions and other pollutants has led to a range of environmental problems, including global warming, air pollution, and water contamination.
To address this issue, it is essential to take a proactive approach towards pollution reduction.

温室气体排放和其他污染物的增加导致了一系列环境问题，包括全球变暖、空气污染和水污染。
为了解决这个问题，必须采取积极主动的方法来减少污染。

questions.name: #1291 Roman Soldiers
questions.en:
Known for their discipline, organization, and superior training, the Roman soldiers were highly skilled and well-equipped.
The army consisted of various specialized units, including infantry, cavalry, and auxiliary troops recruited from conquered territories.
They employed innovative tactics such as the famous "testudo" formation and utilized advanced weaponry and siege engines.
questions.zh:
罗马士兵以纪律严明、组织有序和训练有素著称，他们技艺高超且装备精良。
军队由多种专业部队组成，包括步兵、骑兵以及从被征服地区招募的辅助部队。
他们采用创新战术，比如著名的“龟甲阵”，并使用了先进的武器和攻城器械。

This student-centered approach promotes self-expression, creativity, and personal development.

questions.name: #1293 Paraphrasing
questions.en:
Paraphrasing involves restating information or ideas in one's own words while maintaining the original meaning.
Paraphrasing helps to avoid plagiarism and demonstrates a deeper understanding of the source material.
To paraphrase effectively, one must carefully analyze the original text, identify the main ideas, and rephrase them using different words and sentence structures.
questions.zh:
改写就是用你自己的话重新表达信息或观点，同时保持原意不变。
改写有助于避免抄袭，并展现出对原始材料更深层次的理解。
要有效改写，必须仔细分析原文，抓住主要观点，然后用不同的词汇和句式重新表达。

questions.name: #1294 Passionate Individuals
questions.en:
When someone is passionate about what they do, they are more likely to invest time and effort into mastering their craft and pushing the boundaries of their potential.
Passionate individuals often inspire others with their dedication and unwavering commitment.
Passion has the power to transform our lives and make a positive impact on the world around us.
A Recurring Dream
Every time I close my eyes, a recurring dream haunts me without fail.
I find myself in a mysterious forest, where towering trees rustle with every whisper of the wind.
I walk along an endless path, desperately searching for an exit that eludes me.
Each time I wake, a sense of unease and confusion lingers.
Thymus
The thymus, a vital organ nestled within the chest, plays a pivotal role in immune function.
Despite its small size, this gland orchestrates the maturation of T-cells, the guardians of our immune system.
Like a conductor leading an orchestra, the thymus guides these cells through a complex process of education and selection.
Stone Tools
Stone tools have been essential tools for human survival throughout history.
These primitive implements, crafted from rocks and shaped by skilled hands, enabled early humans to hunt, gather, and build shelters.
Stone tools served as a testament to our ancestors' resourcefulness and adaptability in the face of challenges.
questions.zh:
当一个人对自己所做的事情充满热情时，他们更愿意投入时间和精力去精通自己的技艺，并不断突破自己的潜力边界。
充满热情的人常常以他们的专注和坚定不移的承诺激励着他人。
热情有能力改变我们的生活，并对我们周围的世界产生积极的影响。
一个反复出现的梦

我发现自己身处一片神秘的森林，参天大树随着风的每一声低语而沙沙作响。
我沿着一条无尽的小路行走，拼命寻找一个逃避我的出口。
每次醒来，一种不安和困惑的感觉挥之不去。
胸腺
胸腺是位于胸腔内的一个重要器官，在免疫功能中起着关键作用。
尽管这个腺体很小，但它指挥着T细胞的成熟，这些细胞是我们免疫系统的守护者。
就像指挥家指挥乐团一样，胸腺引导这些细胞经历一个复杂的教育和选择过程。
石器
在历史上，石器一直是人类生存的重要工具。
这些原始工具由岩石制成，经过熟练的双手打造，使早期人类能够狩猎、采集和建造住所。
石器证明了我们的祖先在面对挑战时的机智和适应能力。

questions.name: #1298 Rates of Depression
questions.en:
Rates of depression have been a growing concern in recent years, particularly among adolescents and adults.
In the United States, it is estimated that 4.1 million adolescents aged 12 to 17 have experienced at least one major depressive episode.
This indicates a rising trend in depression rates among adolescents.
questions.zh:
近年来，抑郁症发病率越来越令人担忧，尤其是在青少年和成年人中。
据估计，美国有410万12至17岁的青少年至少经历过一次重度抑郁发作。
这表明青少年抑郁症发病率呈上升趋势。

questions.name: #1299 William Shakespeare
questions.en:
William Shakespeare, the renowned English playwright and poet, is widely regarded as one of the greatest writers in the English language.
Born in Stratford-upon-Avon, England, around April 23, 1564, Shakespeare's works continue to captivate audiences with their profound insights into human nature and enduring literary brilliance.
questions.zh:
威廉·莎士比亚，这位著名的英国剧作家和诗人，被广泛认为是英语文学史上最伟大的作家之一。
1564年4月23日左右出生于英格兰埃文河畔斯特拉特福，莎士比亚的作品以其对人性的深刻洞察和持久的文学魅力，至今仍令观众着迷。

questions.name: #1300 Tutors
questions.en:
Tutors play a crucial role in education by providing personalized instruction tailored to the needs of each student.
They can help students with homework, test preparation, and clarifying difficult concepts.
Tutors often employ various teaching strategies and techniques to engage students and enhance their learning experience.
questions.zh:
家教在教育中扮演着关键角色，他们根据每个学生的需求提供个性化的指导。
他们能帮助学生完成作业、准备考试，并解释复杂的概念。
家教通常采用多种教学策略和技巧，以吸引学生并提升他们的学习体验。

questions.en:
Norms and values are important concepts in sociology that shape human behavior and social interactions.
Values are the fundamental beliefs that guide individuals' actions, while norms are the expectations that society has for people's behavior.
In other words, values determine what is right or wrong, while norms determine what is acceptable or not.
questions.zh:
规范和价值是社会学中塑造人类行为和社会互动的重要概念。
价值观是指导个人行为的基本信念，而规范则是社会对人们行为的期望。
换句话说，价值观决定什么是对或错，而规范则决定什么是可接受或不可接受的。

questions.name: #1302 Natural Environments
questions.en:
The environment consists of various components that interact and influence each other.
For instance, the atmosphere provides the air we breathe, while bodies of water like rivers, lakes, and oceans support diverse aquatic ecosystems.
Landscapes encompass forests, grasslands, mountains, and deserts, each with its unique characteristics and biodiversity.
questions.zh:
环境由各种相互影响、相互作用的组成部分构成。
例如，大气提供了我们呼吸的空气，而河流、湖泊和海洋等水体则支撑着多样的水生生态系统。
景观包括森林、草原、山脉和沙漠，每种都有其独特的特征和生物多样性。

questions.name: #1303 Video Games
questions.en:
Video games have been criticized for promoting violence, addiction, and sedentary behavior.
Some studies suggest a correlation between violent video games and aggressive behavior, although the causal relationship is still debated.
Additionally, excessive gaming can lead to addiction and negative health consequences, such as obesity and eye strain.
questions.zh:

一些研究表明暴力电子游戏与攻击性行为之间存在关联，尽管因果关系仍有争议。
此外，过度游戏可能导致成瘾和负面健康后果，比如肥胖和眼睛疲劳。

questions.name: #1304 Immune System
questions.en:
Maintaining a healthy immune system is essential for overall well-being.
A balanced diet, regular exercise, adequate sleep, and stress management can all contribute to a strong immune system.
Additionally, vaccinations can help stimulate the immune system's response to specific pathogens, providing protection against infectious diseases.
questions.zh:
保持健康的免疫系统对整体健康至关重要。
均衡饮食、规律运动、充足睡眠和压力管理都有助于增强免疫系统。
此外，疫苗接种能刺激免疫系统对特定病原体的反应，从而预防传染病。

questions.name: #1305 Shakespeare's Writing Style
questions.en:
Shakespeare's writing style is characterized by the use of stylized language and rhetorical devices.
He often employed extended metaphors and conceits in his poetry, creating rich and vivid imagery.
Some of his notable themes include love, power, ambition, fate, and the human condition.
His works explore the depths of human emotions and the complexities of human relationships.
questions.zh:
莎士比亚的写作风格以使用华丽语言和修辞手法为特点。
他常在诗歌中运用扩展隐喻和奇思妙想，营造出丰富生动的意象。
他的一些著名主题包括爱情、权力、野心、命运以及人类境况。
他的作品深入探讨了人类情感的深度和人际关系的复杂性。

questions.name: #1306 Globalization
questions.en:
Globalization has transformed the world economy, facilitating the flow of goods, services, and capital across borders.
It has led to increased competition and efficiency, as businesses seek to expand their markets and reduce costs.
However, globalization has also contributed to economic inequality, as some countries and individuals have benefited more than others.
questions.zh:
全球化改变了世界经济，促进了商品、服务和资本在各国之间的流动。
它带来了更激烈的竞争和更高的效率，因为企业都希望扩大市场、降低成本。
然而，全球化也加剧了经济不平等，因为一些国家和个人从中获益更多。

questions.name: #1307 Matthew Brady
questions.en:
Matthew Brady was an American photographer who is widely recognized as one of the pioneers of photography in American history.
He was born around 1822-1824 and passed away on January 15, 1896.
Brady is best known for his iconic photographs depicting scenes from the American Civil War.
He studied under Samuel Morse, the inventor of the daguerreotype technique in America.
questions.zh:
马修·布雷迪是一位美国摄影师，被广泛认为是美国摄影史上的先驱之一。
他出生于1822年至1824年间，于1896年1月15日去世。
布雷迪最出名的是他拍摄的美国内战场景的标志性照片。
他曾师从塞缪尔·莫尔斯，后者是美国达盖尔银版摄影术的发明者。

questions.name: #1308 Prevalence of Depression
questions.en:
The prevalence of depression has increased significantly in recent years, with rates ranging from 10% to 20% in the general population.
Adolescents and children are also affected by this disorder.
Various factors, including genetic predisposition, neurochemical imbalances, and psychosocial stressors, contribute to the development of depression.
questions.zh:

青少年和儿童也受到这种疾病的影响。
遗传倾向、神经化学失衡以及心理社会压力等多种因素都会导致抑郁症的发生。

Tortoises, a group of reptiles belonging to the Testudinidae family, are intriguing creatures with unique biological characteristics.
These chelonians have evolved over millions of years, adapting to various ecosystems around the world.
Their most distinctive feature is their shell, which consists of an upper carapace and a lower plastron, providing exceptional protection against predators and environmental challenges.

它们最显著的特征是龟壳，由背甲和腹甲组成，能有效抵御捕食者和环境挑战。

Climate change, deforestation, pollution, and overexploitation of natural resources are some of the major threats facing the natural environment.
Addressing these challenges requires a comprehensive understanding of the complex interactions between humans and the natural environment, as well as a commitment to sustainable development and responsible environmental stewardship.

From the moment they are born, infants possess the ability to hear and distinguish various sounds in their environment.
The auditory system undergoes rapid development during the first years of life, with critical periods for the acquisition of language and speech perception.

听觉系统在生命的最初几年里迅速发展，其中存在语言习得和语音感知的关键期。

questions.name: #1312 Eagles
questions.en:
Eagles are found throughout the world, inhabiting diverse ecosystems such as forests, mountains, and coastal regions.
They play a crucial role in maintaining the balance of their ecosystems by regulating prey populations.
Many species of eagles are threatened by habitat loss, hunting, and pollution, highlighting the need for conservation efforts to protect these magnificent birds and their ecological contributions.

鹰遍布全球，生活在森林、山脉和沿海地区等多种多样的生态系统中。

许多种类的鹰正面临栖息地丧失、捕猎和污染的威胁，这凸显了保护这些壮丽鸟类及其生态贡献的必要性。

questions.name: #1313 Meditation
questions.en:
Research has shown that regular meditation can reduce stress, anxiety, and depression, as well as improve sleep quality, cognitive function, and immune system response.
Meditation is also associated with increased feelings of compassion, empathy, and self-awareness.
By cultivating a regular meditation practice, individuals can enhance their overall health and well-being.

冥想还与增强同情心、同理心和自我意识有关。
通过培养定期冥想的习惯，人们可以提升整体健康和幸福感。

questions.name: #1314 Robotics
questions.en:
The integration of robotics with artificial intelligence and machine learning enables robots to adapt and learn from their surroundings, improving their capabilities and flexibility.
However, the widespread adoption of robotics in manufacturing raises concerns about job displacement and the need for reskilling workers.
It is crucial to strike a balance between automation and human labor to ensure sustainable employment and equitable economic development.
questions.zh:
机器人与人工智能和机器学习的结合，让机器人能够适应环境并从中学习，从而提升自身的能力和灵活性。
不过，机器人在制造业中的广泛普及引发了人们对岗位流失以及工人需要再培训的担忧。
关键是要在自动化和人力劳动之间找到平衡，以确保就业的可持续性和经济的公平发展。

questions.name: #1315 Spanish and French
questions.en:
Spanish is known for its phonetic pronunciation, with consistent spelling and pronunciation rules.
It has a relatively simple verb conjugation system compared to French.
On the other hand, French is renowned for its complex verb conjugations and intricate pronunciation, with many silent letters and liaisons.
French also has a rich literary tradition and is widely spoken in various parts of the world, particularly in Europe and Africa.
questions.zh:
西班牙语以其发音清晰著称，拼写和发音规则都很一致。
跟法语比起来，它的动词变位系统要简单一些。
相比之下，法语以复杂的动词变位和发音著称，有很多不发音的字母和连读。
法语还有丰富的文学传统，在世界很多地方都有人使用，尤其是在欧洲和非洲。

questions.name: #1316 Hazard Assessment
questions.en:
The evaluation and identification of potential hazards in the workplace is a crucial process known as hazard assessment.
This systematic examination involves a comprehensive analysis of work environments, equipment, and processes to determine potential sources of harm to workers.
Hazard assessment is a fundamental component of occupational health and safety programs, and it is a legal requirement in many jurisdictions.
questions.zh:
识别和评估工作场所潜在危险的过程叫做危害评估，这非常重要。
这种系统性检查需要对工作环境、设备和流程进行全面分析，找出可能对工人造成伤害的来源。
危害评估是职业健康与安全项目的基本组成部分，而且在很多地方是法律要求。

questions.name: #1317 Evolution of Taste
questions.en:
A group of researchers from the University of Cologne, in partnership with scientists from the Leibniz Institute for Food Systems Biology in Freising, has made an intriguing finding regarding the presence of a bitter taste receptor in twelve distinct species of cartilaginous fish, including sharks and rays.
This newly discovered receptor falls under the category of taste receptors type 2 (T2R).
questions.zh:
科隆大学的一个研究团队与弗赖辛莱布尼茨食品系统生物学研究所的科学家合作，发现了一个有趣的现象：包括鲨鱼和鳐鱼在内的十二种软骨鱼体内存在一种苦味受体。
这种新发现的受体属于第二类味觉受体（T2R）。

questions.en:
Elephants, belonging to the family Elephantidae, are large terrestrial mammals known for their remarkable intelligence and social behavior.
They are characterized by their long trunks, tusks, and large ears.
Elephants are herbivores, primarily feeding on grasses, leaves, and fruits.
They play a crucial role in shaping their ecosystems as seed dispersers and vegetation modifiers.

作为种子传播者和植被改造者，它们在塑造生态系统方面扮演着关键角色。

questions.name: #1319 Bookkeepers
questions.en:
Bookkeepers are strategic partners in financial management.
They possess a deep understanding of financial systems, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
Bookkeepers provide valuable insights into financial performance, contribute to strategic planning, and assist in the formulation of financial policies.
They collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to ensure transparency and accountability in financial reporting.

他们对财务系统、风险管理和法规遵从有深刻的理解。

他们与组织内各利益相关方合作，确保财务报告的透明度和问责制。

研究人员给出了一个有趣的

questions.en:
Virtual reality (VR) is not only a technology for games and entertainment, but also has potential in science and medicine.
Researchers at Ruhr University Bochum, Germany, have now gained new insights into human perception with the help of VR.

questions.name: #1322 Unwritten Rules
questions.en:
When we talk about unwritten rules, we refer to the informal norms and expectations that guide social interactions.
They are not explicitly stated but are understood by members of a particular group or community.
Unwritten rules can relate to behavior, communication, dress, and other aspects of social interaction.
They are often learned through observation and experience rather than formal instruction.
questions.zh:
说到不成文的规定，我们指的是那些指导社交活动、非正式的规范和期望。
它们没有被明确说出来，但特定群体或社区的成员都心知肚明。
不成文的规定可能涉及行为、交流、着装以及社交互动的其他方面。
它们通常是通过观察和经验学来的，而不是通过正式的教导。

questions.name: #1323 Planet Formation
questions.en:
Theories have long proposed that icy pebbles forming in the cold, outer regions of protoplanetary disks -- the same area where comets originate in our solar system -- should be the fundamental seeds of planet formation.
The main requirement of these theories is that pebbles should drift inward toward the star due to friction in the gaseous disk, delivering both solids and water to planets.
questions.zh:
长期以来，理论认为在寒冷的原行星盘外层区域——也就是我们太阳系中彗星起源的地方——形成的冰砾应该是行星形成的基本种子。
这些理论的主要要求是，由于气体盘中的摩擦，冰砾应该向内飘向恒星，从而向行星输送固体和水。

questions.name: #1324 8,000 Steps
questions.en:
An international study led by the University of Granada (UGR) has provided the first scientific proof for how many steps you need to take per day to significantly reduce the risk of premature death: 8,000.
Given the average length of a human stride (76 centimeters for men and 67 centimeters for women), taking 8,000 steps is equivalent to walking approximately 6.4 kilometers a day.
questions.zh:
由格拉纳达大学领导的一项国际研究首次提供了科学证据，证明每天需要走多少步才能显著降低早逝风险：8000步。
考虑到人类步幅的平均长度（男性76厘米，女性67厘米），走8000步相当于每天步行约6.4公里。

questions.name: #1325 High-protein Diet
questions.en:
A 10-week muscle-building and dietary program involving 50 middle-aged adults found no evidence that eating a high-protein diet increased strength or muscle mass more than consuming a moderate amount of protein while training.
The intervention involved a standard strength-training protocol with sessions three times per week.
None of the participants had previous weightlifting experience.
questions.zh:
一项为期10周、涉及50名中年人的增肌与饮食计划发现，与训练期间摄入适量蛋白质相比，高蛋白饮食并未显著增强力量或增加肌肉量。
该干预措施采用标准力量训练方案，每周进行三次训练。
所有参与者均无举重经验。

questions.name: #1326 Surface Water
questions.en:
Research indicates that over billions of years, surface water has been transported deep into the Earth by descending, or subducted, tectonic plates.
Upon reaching the core-mantle boundary, about 1,800 miles below the surface, this water triggers a profound chemical interaction, altering the core's structure.
questions.zh:
研究表明，在数十亿年的时间里，地表水通过下沉或俯冲的构造板块被输送到地球深处。
当这些水到达地表以下约1800英里的地核-地幔边界时，会引发深刻的化学相互作用，改变地核的结构。

questions.name: #1327 Dream
questions.en:
Why do we dream?
A product of our brain's neurophysiology, dreaming is a complex experience that can take on many emotional tones and simulate reality to varying degrees.
As a result, there is still no clear answer to this question.
A study compared the dreams of two forager communities, in Tanzania and the Democratic Republic of Congo, with those of individuals living in Europe and North America.
questions.zh:
我们为什么会做梦？
梦境是我们大脑神经生理活动的产物，这种复杂的体验能引发各种情绪，并在不同程度上模拟现实。
因此，这个问题至今仍没有明确的答案。
一项研究比较了坦桑尼亚和刚果民主共和国两个采集部落的梦境，与欧洲和北美居民的梦境进行了对比。

questions.name: #1328 Cycads
questions.en:
Like their lumbering grazers, most cycads have gone extinct.
Their disappearance from their prior habitats began during the late Mesozoic and continued into the early Cenozoic Era, punctuated by the cataclysmic asteroid impact and volcanic activity that mark the K-Pg boundary 66 million years ago.
However, unlike the dinosaurs, somehow a few groups of cycads survived to the present.
questions.zh:
像那些行动迟缓的食草动物一样，大多数苏铁已经灭绝了。
它们从原本栖息地消失的过程始于中生代晚期，一直持续到新生代早期，其间还经历了6600万年前白垩纪-古近纪界线时灾难性的小行星撞击和火山活动。
然而，与恐龙不同，不知怎么地，有几类苏铁存活到了现在。

questions.name: #1329 Head Lice
questions.en:
A new analysis of lice genetic diversity suggests that lice came to the Americas twice -- once during the first wave of human migration across the Bering Strait, and again during European colonization.
Marina Ascunce, currently at the USDA-ARS, and colleagues, report these findings in a new study published November 8 in the open-access journal PLOS ONE.
questions.zh:

目前在美国农业部农业研究局工作的玛丽娜·阿松斯及其同事在11月8日发表于开放获取期刊《PLOS ONE》的一项新研究中报告了这些发现。

questions.name: #1330 Wildfires
questions.en:
Extratropical forests are globally significant because they store vast quantities of carbon in vegetation and permafrost soils.
Approximately 91 per cent of these forests in the northern hemisphere are underlain by permafrost.
When fires occur in these regions, they emit large amounts of carbon dioxide (CO2) and other greenhouse gases compared to other regions.
questions.zh:

北半球约91%的这种森林下方都有永久冻土。
当这些地区发生火灾时，与其他地区相比，它们会排放大量的二氧化碳和其他温室气体。

questions.name: #1331 Remains of Planet
questions.en:
In the 1980s, geophysicists made a startling discovery: two continent-sized blobs of unusual material were found deep near the center of the Earth, one beneath the African continent and one beneath the Pacific Ocean.
Each blob is twice the size of the Moon and likely composed of different proportions of elements than the mantle surrounding it.
questions.zh:
20世纪80年代，地球物理学家有了一个惊人发现：在地球深处靠近地核的位置，有两块大陆大小的异常物质，一块在非洲大陆下方，另一块在太平洋下方。
每块物质的体积是月球的两倍，其元素构成比例很可能与周围的地幔不同。

questions.name: #1332 Sociologists
questions.en:
Sociologists are interested in a wide range of topics, from the micro-level interactions between individuals to the macro-level structures of society.
They seek to identify patterns and trends in social behavior, and to develop theories that explain these phenomena.
Through their research, sociologists aim to contribute to our understanding of society and to help address social problems.
questions.zh:
社会学家感兴趣的话题非常广泛，从个体间的微观互动到社会的宏观结构都有涵盖。
他们试图找出社会行为中的模式和趋势，并发展出解释这些现象的理论。
通过研究，社会学家希望能加深我们对社会的理解，并帮助解决社会问题。

questions.name: #1333 Arctic Ocean
questions.en:
It may not be very well known, but the Arctic Ocean leaks enormous amounts of the potent greenhouse gas methane.
These leaks have been ongoing for thousands of years but could be intensified by a future warmer ocean.
The potential for this gas to escape the ocean, and contribute to the greenhouse gas budget in the atmosphere, is an important mystery that scientists are trying to solve.
questions.zh:
可能很多人不知道，北冰洋正在大量泄漏强效温室气体甲烷。
这些泄漏已经持续了数千年，但未来海洋变暖可能会加剧这一现象。
这种气体有可能从海洋中逸出，并增加大气中的温室气体总量，这是科学家们正试图解开的一个重要谜团。

questions.name: #1335 Stripes and Spots
questions.en:
According to Benjamin Alessio, an undergraduate researcher in the Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering, many biological inquiries share a common theme of exploring how complex patterns and shapes develop from a spherical cluster of cells.
The study employs a basic physical and chemical mechanism to account for a complex biological phenomenon.
questions.zh:
化学与生物工程系的本科生研究员本杰明·阿莱西奥表示，许多生物学研究都有一个共同主题，即探索复杂的图案和形状是如何从一个球形的细胞簇中发育出来的。
这项研究利用基本的物理和化学机制来解释一个复杂的生物现象。

questions.name: #1336 Liquid Metals
questions.en:
Liquid metals hold the potential to revolutionize the chemical industry and address its environmental impact.
By testing a new technique, researchers aim to replace the energy-intensive chemical engineering processes that have been in use since the early 20th century.
This innovative approach offers a promising solution to "greening" the industry by reducing its carbon footprint and minimizing resource consumption.
questions.zh:
液态金属有潜力彻底改变化学工业，并解决其对环境的影响。
通过测试一种新技术，研究人员旨在取代自20世纪初以来一直使用的高能耗化学工程流程。
这种创新方法为“绿化”行业提供了有前景的解决方案，能减少碳足迹并最小化资源消耗。

questions.name: #1337 Sea Levels
questions.en: Paul Goddard, an assistant research scientist in the Department of Earth and Atmospheric Sciences at the College of Arts and Sciences at Indiana University, has stated that even if the world manages to achieve the ambitious goal of limiting global warming to 1.5 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels, which we are currently not on track to do so, there will still be a significant rise in sea levels.
questions.zh: 印第安纳大学文理学院地球与大气科学系的助理研究员保罗·戈达德表示，即使全球成功实现将全球变暖限制在比工业化前水平高1.5摄氏度的宏伟目标——而我们目前并未按计划推进——海平面仍将显著上升。

questions.name: #1338 Black Holes
questions.en:
Conventional theories about black holes, based on Einstein's theory of General Relativity, typically explain how static or spinning black holes can exist on their own, isolated in space.
Black holes in pairs would eventually be thwarted by gravity attracting and colliding them together.
However, this is true if one assumes the Universe is standing still.
But what about one which is constantly moving?
questions.zh:
基于爱因斯坦广义相对论的传统黑洞理论，通常解释静态或旋转的黑洞如何独自存在于太空中。
成对的黑洞最终会因引力相互吸引并碰撞而受阻。
然而，如果假设宇宙是静止的，这确实成立。
但如果宇宙在不断运动呢？

questions.name: #1339 Corporate Psychopath
questions.en:
Around 1% of the adult population are defined as psychopaths, meaning they possess no conscience, shame, guilt, or ability to experience love for or feel empathy towards other people.
Dr Boddy will discuss how they appear as potentially effective leaders, how they get to the top and what they do once they have achieved leadership.
questions.zh:
大约1%的成年人被定义为心理变态者，这意味着他们没有良心、羞耻感、内疚感，也无法去爱或同情他人。
博迪博士将讨论他们如何看起来像是潜在的有效领导者，如何爬到高层，以及一旦获得领导地位后会做些什么。

questions.name: #1340 Chemical Bonds
questions.en:
The hardness of materials is determined by the strength of the chemical bonds that are formed between the electrons of the neighboring atoms.
For example, the bonds in diamond are very strong, so it is one of the hardest materials known.
The bonding is rooted in the laws of quantum mechanics.
questions.zh:

例如，钻石中的化学键非常强，因此它是已知最硬的物质之一。
这种键合源于量子力学的规律。

questions.name: #1341 Changing Temperatures
questions.en:
Changing temperatures shift the energy balance of ecosystems – from plants that produce energy from sunlight to the animals that consume plants and other animals – subsequently altering the sensory worlds that animals experience.
It is likely that climate change will challenge all of their senses, from sight and taste to smell and touch.
questions.zh:
温度变化会改变生态系统的能量平衡——从利用阳光制造能量的植物，到以植物和其他动物为食的动物——进而改变动物所感知到的感官世界。
气候变化很可能会挑战它们的所有感官，从视觉、味觉到嗅觉和触觉。
questions.full:
Changing temperatures shift the energy balance of ecosystems – from plants that produce energy from sunlight to the animals that consume plants and other animals – subsequently altering the sensory worlds that animals experience.
温度变化会改变生态系统的能量平衡——从利用阳光制造能量的植物，到以植物和其他动物为食的动物——进而改变动物所感知到的感官世界。
It is likely that climate change will challenge all of their senses, from sight and taste to smell and touch.
气候变化很可能会挑战它们的所有感官，从视觉、味觉到嗅觉和触觉。

questions.name: #1342 Vanilla
questions.en:
Dairy products such as ice cream and yogurt have relied on natural vanilla for many years, McBride points out.
In the U.S., Food & Drug Administration rules state that vanilla ice cream must get its flavor from natural vanilla.
If the flavor comes partially or fully from another source, the company must stamp “vanilla flavored” or “artificial vanilla” on the front of the package, a likely turnoff to consumers.
questions.zh:
麦克布莱德指出，像冰淇淋和酸奶这样的乳制品多年来一直依赖天然香草。
在美国，食品药品监督管理局规定，香草冰淇淋的香味必须来自天然香草。
如果香味部分或全部来自其他来源，公司必须在包装正面标注“香草味”或“人造香草”，这很可能会让消费者反感。

questions.name: #1343 3D Printing
questions.en:
3D printing is advancing rapidly, and the range of materials that can be used has expanded considerably.
While the technology was previously limited to fast-curing plastics, it has now been made suitable for slow-curing plastics as well.
These have decisive advantages as they have enhanced elastic properties and are more durable and robust.
questions.zh:
3D打印技术发展迅猛，可使用的材料种类也大大增加了。
过去这项技术只能用于快速固化的塑料，现在也能适用于慢速固化的塑料了。
这类塑料具有决定性的优势，因为它们弹性更好，更耐用、更结实。

questions.name: #1344 Carbon Sink
questions.en:
The largest terrestrial carbon sink on Earth is the planet's soil.
One of the big fears is that a warming planet will liberate significant portions of the soil's carbon, turning it into carbon dioxide (CO2) gas, and so further accelerate the pace of planetary warming.

地球上最大的陆地碳汇是土壤。
人们非常担心的是，全球变暖会释放土壤中的大量碳，将其转化为二氧化碳气体，从而进一步加速全球变暖的速度。

questions.name: #1346 Creativity
questions.en:
In the creative condition, the students were told to think of a friend who did something special and think of them as their "creative friend" who could help them solve any problem.
This type of creativity training is called perspective-shifting, in which the kids look at a problem through the eyes of someone else.
Social Learning
People are constantly learning from others without even being aware of it.
Social learning avoids laborious trial and error; the wheel does not have to be reinvented each time.
But where does this ability come from, which forms the basis of cultural learning and consequently for the evolutionary success of the human species?
Pancreatic Cancer
Pancreatic cancer is tricky to manage because it spreads easily and early, and the tumors have a unique biological makeup.
But, researchers made a breakthrough by learning about the genetic changes that occur during tumor migration -- and also found a drug that can obstruct the process.
Earthquake Strikes
When an earthquake strikes, smaller quakes known as aftershocks can continue to shake the area for days to years after the original earthquake occurred.
These smaller quakes decrease over time and are part of the fault's readjustment process following the original quake.
While aftershocks are smaller in magnitude than the main shock, they can still damage infrastructure and impede recovery from the original earthquake.
Hummingbird
Most birds can bend their wings at the wrist, pulling arched wings close to their bodies to navigate their way through dense vegetation like branches.
But hummingbird wings aren’t as flexible.
Because the wings stick straight out from a hummingbird’s body, getting through tight spaces requires some tricky maneuvering.
Bonobos
Individuals that tended to engage in cooperative behavior within their group were more likely to interact with bonobos in the other group that had the same tendency.
This cooperation doesn’t appear to be solely motivated by immediate reciprocation, the researchers say.
For instance, during the study, only 14 percent of bonobos that shared food with a partner in the other group had the deed reciprocated.
Molecules
Normally, heat is what gets evaporation going, causing water molecules in the liquid to jostle more vigorously.
That extra energy can break some of the bonds between molecules in the liquid, allowing molecules to escape as water vapor.
Based on how much heat goes in, scientists can calculate the amount of evaporation expected.
Cooked Vegetables
Recent trends in raw food diets overlook the fact that some vegetables are more nutritious when cooked.
Cooking methods like steaming or roasting can enhance the availability of essential nutrients in vegetables such as asparagus, mushrooms, and spinach.
This process releases important vitamins and antioxidants, which are sometimes trapped within the vegetables’ cell walls.
Mice and Plants
Japanese researchers at Nagoya University have uncovered new aspects of the interaction between mast seeding plants like bamboo and field mice.
Their study reveals that mice behavior, influenced by species, environment, and season, plays a crucial role in seed dispersal and forest ecosystem health, challenging existing theories about seed storage and consumption.
Heart Health
A study from UCL and the University of Sydney shows that substituting just a few minutes of daily sitting with moderate exercise can greatly benefit heart health.
It also showed the benefit of light activity, standing, and sleeping compared with sitting.
This finding, part of research involving more than 15,000 individuals, underscores the significant health impact of even small changes in daily physical activity.
Strawberries
A recent study demonstrates that strawberries, consumed daily for 12 weeks, can improve memory and reduce depressive symptoms in middle-aged, overweight adults.
This improvement is attributed to the anti-inflammatory effects of anthocyanins in strawberries, highlighting the fruit’s role in cognitive health.
Diabetes
Increasing levels of obesity, poor diet, and increased sedentary behavior are driving a rapid rise in the number of cases of type 2 diabetes worldwide.
In 2021, 537 million adults were estimated to have diabetes worldwide, with an increasing number diagnosed at younger ages.
Hair Follicles
When it comes to engineering human skin, hair may at first seem superfluous.
However, hair follicles are quite important: They produce sweat, helping regulate body temperature, and they contain stem cells that help skin heal.
Hair follicles are also an entry point for topical drugs and cosmetics, making them an important part of dermatological testing.
Imprinted Genes
In mice, there is some evidence that an unusual phenomenon in mammals called genomic imprinting impacts parenting behavior.
Mammals inherit two copies of each gene -- one from each parent -- and usually, each copy is expressed equally in the cell.
With imprinted genes, however, only one copy is expressed, either the one inherited from the father or the mother.
Alzheimer's Disease
Some 160,000 people have some form of dementia in Sweden, Alzheimer's disease being the most common, a figure that is rising with our life expectancy.
At the same time, many new diagnostic methods and early-intervention therapies have been developed in recent years, which foregrounds the need to identify more risk factors for the disease.
questions.zh:
在创意条件下，学生们被告知要想象一个做了特别事情的朋友，并把他们当作能帮助解决任何问题的“创意伙伴”。
这种创造力训练叫做视角转换，即孩子们通过他人的眼光来看待问题。
社会学习
人们常常在不知不觉中向他人学习。
社会学习避免了费力的试错过程；不必每次都重新发明轮子。
但这种能力从何而来？它构成了文化学习的基础，进而也推动了人类物种在进化上的成功。
胰腺癌
胰腺癌很难对付，因为它容易早期扩散，而且肿瘤具有独特的生物学特性。
但研究人员通过了解肿瘤迁移过程中的基因变化取得了突破，还发现了一种可以阻止这一过程的药物。
地震来袭
当地震发生时，被称为余震的较小地震可能会在原始地震发生后持续数天到数年。
这些较小的地震会随时间减少，是断层在原始地震后重新调整过程的一部分。
虽然余震的震级小于主震，但它们仍可能破坏基础设施，阻碍灾后恢复。
蜂鸟
大多数鸟类可以弯曲翅膀的腕部，将弓形的翅膀贴近身体，以便在茂密的植被（如树枝）中穿行。
但蜂鸟的翅膀不那么灵活。
因为蜂鸟的翅膀从身体笔直伸出，通过狭窄空间需要一些巧妙的机动。
倭黑猩猩
倾向于在群体内进行合作行为的个体，更可能与其他群体中有同样倾向的倭黑猩猩互动。
研究人员表示，这种合作似乎并非仅仅出于即时互惠的动机。
例如，在研究期间，只有14%的倭黑猩猩在与其他群体的伙伴分享食物后得到了回报。
分子
通常，热量促使蒸发发生，使液体中的水分子更剧烈地运动。
这种额外能量可以打破液体中分子间的一些键，使分子以水蒸气的形式逸出。
根据输入的热量，科学家可以计算出预期的蒸发量。
熟蔬菜
生食饮食的近期趋势忽略了一个事实：有些蔬菜煮熟后更有营养。
蒸或烤等烹饪方法可以提高芦笋、蘑菇和菠菜等蔬菜中必需营养素的利用率。
这个过程会释放重要的维生素和抗氧化剂，这些物质有时被困在蔬菜的细胞壁内。
老鼠与植物
名古屋大学的日本研究人员揭示了竹子等大量结果植物与田鼠之间相互作用的新方面。
他们的研究表明，受物种、环境和季节影响的老鼠行为，在种子传播和森林生态系统健康中起着关键作用，挑战了关于种子储存和消耗的现有理论。
心脏健康
伦敦大学学院和悉尼大学的一项研究表明，每天仅用几分钟的适度运动代替久坐，就能极大地有益于心脏健康。
研究还显示了轻度活动、站立和睡觉相对于久坐的好处。
这项涉及超过15000人的研究结果强调，即使是日常身体活动的小小改变，也会对健康产生显著影响。
草莓
最近一项研究表明，中年超重成年人每天食用草莓，持续12周，可以改善记忆力并减少抑郁症状。
这种改善归因于草莓中花青素的抗炎作用，突显了这种水果在认知健康中的作用。
糖尿病
肥胖率上升、不良饮食以及久坐行为的增加，正在全球范围内推动2型糖尿病病例的快速增长。
2021年，全球估计有5.37亿成年人患有糖尿病，且确诊年龄越来越年轻。
毛囊
在工程化人类皮肤时，毛发起初可能显得多余。
然而，毛囊非常重要：它们产生汗液，帮助调节体温，并且含有帮助皮肤愈合的干细胞。
毛囊也是外用药物和化妆品的进入点，使其成为皮肤测试的重要组成部分。
印记基因
在小鼠中，有证据表明哺乳动物中一种称为基因组印记的罕见现象会影响育儿行为。
哺乳动物继承每个基因的两个拷贝——一个来自父亲，一个来自母亲——通常每个拷贝在细胞中表达量相等。
然而，对于印记基因，只有一个拷贝被表达，要么是来自父亲的，要么是来自母亲的。
阿尔茨海默病
瑞典约有16万人患有某种形式的痴呆症，其中阿尔茨海默病最为常见，这一数字随着预期寿命的延长而上升。
同时，近年来开发了许多新的诊断方法和早期干预疗法，这凸显了识别更多该疾病风险因素的必要性。

倭黑猩猩
Individuals that tended to engage in cooperative behavior within their group were more likely to interact with bonobos in the other group that had the same tendency.
倾向于在群体内进行合作行为的个体，更可能与其他群体中有同样倾向的倭黑猩猩互动。
This cooperation doesn’t appear to be solely motivated by immediate reciprocation, the researchers say.
研究人员表示，这种合作似乎并非仅仅出于即时互惠的动机。
For instance, during the study, only 14 percent of bonobos that shared food with a partner in the other group had the deed reciprocated.
例如，在研究期间，只有14%的倭黑猩猩在与其他群体的伙伴分享食物后得到了回报。
Molecules
分子
Normally, heat is what gets evaporation going, causing water molecules in the liquid to jostle more vigorously.
通常，热量促使蒸发发生，使液体中的水分子更剧烈地运动。
That extra energy can break some of the bonds between molecules in the liquid, allowing molecules to escape as water vapor.
这种额外能量可以打破液体中分子间的一些键，使分子以水蒸气的形式逸出。
Based on how much heat goes in, scientists can calculate the amount of evaporation expected.
根据输入的热量，科学家可以计算出预期的蒸发量。

熟蔬菜
Recent trends in raw food diets overlook the fact that some vegetables are more nutritious when cooked.
生食饮食的近期趋势忽略了一个事实：有些蔬菜煮熟后更有营养。
Cooking methods like steaming or roasting can enhance the availability of essential nutrients in vegetables such as asparagus, mushrooms, and spinach.
蒸或烤等烹饪方法可以提高芦笋、蘑菇和菠菜等蔬菜中必需营养素的利用率。
This process releases important vitamins and antioxidants, which are sometimes trapped within the vegetables’ cell walls.
这个过程会释放重要的维生素和抗氧化剂，这些物质有时被困在蔬菜的细胞壁内。

老鼠与植物

名古屋大学的日本研究人员揭示了竹子等大量结果植物与田鼠之间相互作用的新方面。
Their study reveals that mice behavior, influenced by species, environment, and season, plays a crucial role in seed dispersal and forest ecosystem health, challenging existing theories about seed storage and consumption.
他们的研究表明，受物种、环境和季节影响的老鼠行为，在种子传播和森林生态系统健康中起着关键作用，挑战了关于种子储存和消耗的现有理论。

心脏健康

伦敦大学学院和悉尼大学的一项研究表明，每天仅用几分钟的适度运动代替久坐，就能极大地有益于心脏健康。

研究还显示了轻度活动、站立和睡觉相对于久坐的好处。

毛囊也是外用药物和化妆品的进入点，使其成为皮肤测试的重要组成部分。

瑞典约有16万人患有某种形式的痴呆症，其中阿尔茨海默病最为常见，这一数字随着预期寿命的延长而上升。

同时，近年来开发了许多新的诊断方法和早期干预疗法，这凸显了识别更多该疾病风险因素的必要性。

questions.name: #1348 Earthquake Strikes
questions.en:
When an earthquake strikes, smaller quakes known as aftershocks can continue to shake the area for days to years after the original earthquake occurred.
These smaller quakes decrease over time and are part of the fault's readjustment process following the original quake.
While aftershocks are smaller in magnitude than the main shock, they can still damage infrastructure and impede recovery from the original earthquake.

questions.name: #1350 Bonobos
questions.en:
Individuals that tended to engage in cooperative behavior within their group were more likely to interact with bonobos in the other group that had the same tendency.
This cooperation doesn’t appear to be solely motivated by immediate reciprocation, the researchers say.
For instance, during the study, only 14 percent of bonobos that shared food with a partner in the other group had the deed reciprocated.
questions.zh:

研究人员表示，这种合作似乎并非仅仅出于即时互惠的动机。
例如，在研究期间，只有14%的倭黑猩猩在向另一群体的伙伴分享食物后得到了回报。

questions.name: #1351 Molecules
questions.en:
Normally, heat is what gets evaporation going, causing water molecules in the liquid to jostle more vigorously.
That extra energy can break some of the bonds between molecules in the liquid, allowing molecules to escape as water vapor.
Based on how much heat goes in, scientists can calculate the amount of evaporation expected.

这些额外的能量可以破坏液体中分子间的一些键，使分子以水蒸气的形式逸出。
根据输入的热量多少，科学家可以计算出预期的蒸发量。

questions.name: #1352 Vegetable Nutrition
questions.en:
Recent trends in raw food diets overlook the fact that some vegetables are more nutritious when cooked.
Cooking methods like steaming or roasting can enhance the availability of essential nutrients in vegetables such as asparagus, mushrooms, and spinach.
This process releases important vitamins and antioxidants, which are sometimes trapped within the vegetables’ cell walls.
questions.zh:
最近生食饮食的流行趋势忽略了一个事实：有些蔬菜煮熟后更有营养。
像蒸或烤这样的烹饪方法可以增强芦笋、蘑菇和菠菜等蔬菜中必需营养素的可用性。
这个过程会释放出重要的维生素和抗氧化剂，它们有时被锁在蔬菜的细胞壁内。

questions.name: #1353 Mice and Plants
questions.en:
Japanese researchers at Nagoya University have uncovered new aspects of the interaction between mast seeding plants like bamboo and field mice.
Their study reveals that mice behavior, influenced by species, environment, and season, plays a crucial role in seed dispersal and forest ecosystem health, challenging existing theories about seed storage and consumption.
questions.zh:
名古屋大学的日本研究人员揭示了像竹子这样的结籽植物与田鼠之间互动的新方面。
他们的研究显示，受物种、环境和季节影响的老鼠行为，在种子传播和森林生态系统健康中起着关键作用，这挑战了关于种子储存和消耗的现有理论。

questions.name: #1354 Heart Health
questions.en:
A study from UCL and the University of Sydney shows that substituting just a few minutes of daily sitting with moderate exercise can greatly benefit heart health.
It also showed the benefit of light activity, standing, and sleeping compared with sitting.
This finding, part of research involving more than 15,000 individuals, underscores the significant health impact of even small changes in daily physical activity.
questions.zh:
伦敦大学学院和悉尼大学的一项研究表明，每天只需用适度运动代替几分钟的久坐，就能对心脏健康大有裨益。
研究还显示，与坐着相比，轻度活动、站立和睡眠也有好处。
这项涉及超过1.5万人的研究发现，即使日常体力活动发生微小变化，也会对健康产生显著影响。

questions.name: #1355 Strawberries
questions.en:
A recent study demonstrates that strawberries, consumed daily for 12 weeks, can improve memory and reduce depressive symptoms in middle-aged, overweight adults.
This improvement is attributed to the anti-inflammatory effects of anthocyanins in strawberries, highlighting the fruit’s role in cognitive health.
questions.zh:

这种改善归功于草莓中花青素的抗炎作用，凸显了这种水果对认知健康的益处。

questions.en:
Increasing levels of obesity, poor diet, and increased sedentary behavior are driving a rapid rise in the number of cases of type 2 diabetes worldwide.
In 2021, 537 million adults were estimated to have diabetes worldwide, with an increasing number diagnosed at younger ages.

questions.name: #1357 Hair Follicles
questions.en:
When it comes to engineering human skin, hair may at first seem superfluous.
However, hair follicles are quite important: They produce sweat, helping regulate body temperature, and they contain stem cells that help skin heal.
Hair follicles are also an entry point for topical drugs and cosmetics, making them an important part of dermatological testing.
questions.zh:
说到人造皮肤，毛发起初可能显得多余。
但毛囊其实很重要：它们产生汗液，帮助调节体温，还含有帮助皮肤愈合的干细胞。
毛囊也是外用药和化妆品的入口，因此成为皮肤测试的重要部分。

questions.name: #1358 Imprinted Genes
questions.en:
In mice, there is some evidence that an unusual phenomenon in mammals called genomic imprinting impacts parenting behavior.
Mammals inherit two copies of each gene -- one from each parent -- and usually, each copy is expressed equally in the cell.
With imprinted genes, however, only one copy is expressed, either the one inherited from the father or the mother.
questions.zh:
在小鼠身上，有证据表明哺乳动物中一种名为基因组印记的特殊现象会影响育儿行为。
哺乳动物继承每个基因的两个副本——一个来自父亲，一个来自母亲——通常情况下，每个副本在细胞中表达量相等。
然而，对于印记基因，只有一个副本会表达，要么是来自父亲的副本，要么是来自母亲的副本。

questions.name: #1359 Alzheimer's Disease
questions.en:
Some 160,000 people have some form of dementia in Sweden, Alzheimer's disease being the most common, a figure that is rising with our life expectancy.
At the same time, many new diagnostic methods and early-intervention therapies have been developed in recent years, which foregrounds the need to identify more risk factors for the disease.

与此同时，近年来许多新的诊断方法和早期干预疗法被开发出来，这凸显了识别更多疾病风险因素的必要性。

questions.name: #1360 Society
questions.en:
Societies face numerous challenges, including inequality, discrimination, and social injustice.
It's important to recognize these issues and work towards building a more equitable and compassionate society.
By raising awareness, supporting marginalized communities, and advocating for social justice, we can work towards creating a better future for all.
questions.zh:
社会面临着诸多挑战，包括不平等、歧视和社会不公。
认识到这些问题并努力建设一个更公平、更有同情心的社会很重要。
通过提高认识、支持边缘化社区以及倡导社会正义，我们可以为所有人创造更美好的未来。

questions.name: #1361 Bacteria
questions.en:
A novel approach has been developed that enables researchers to track gene expression during the development of bacterial communities over time and space.
Using this cutting-edge technique, scientists have demonstrated for the first time that bacteria collaborate and exchange nutrients across generations when they form communities.

利用这一尖端技术，科学家首次证明细菌在形成群落时会跨代协作并交换营养物质。

questions.name: #1362 Violence in Ancient Societies
questions.en:
A recent study, co-authored by a researcher from Tulane University, has found evidence suggesting that violence was a prevalent aspect of life within ancient hunter-gatherer communities.
The study examined skeletal remains dating back 10,000 years from burial sites in northern Chile, specifically looking for signs of trauma.
These findings provide insights into the historical prevalence of violence among early human societies.
questions.zh:
一项由杜兰大学研究员共同参与的最新研究发现，有证据表明暴力是古代狩猎采集群体生活中普遍存在的一个方面。
该研究考察了智利北部墓葬遗址中距今一万年的骨骼遗骸，专门寻找创伤迹象。
这些发现为早期人类社会中暴力的历史普遍性提供了见解。

questions.name: #1363 Workplace Stress
questions.en:
Work and personal lives underwent enormous disruption during the pandemic, with people working from home experiencing increased loneliness and a range of mental health issues.
Under normal circumstances, the younger generations of workers need additional support from their managers and that was exacerbated during the pandemic, when we saw that relative newcomers to the workforce did not cope as well under the pressures of remote working.
questions.zh:

正常情况下，年轻员工需要管理者给予更多支持，而疫情期间这种需求更加突出，我们看到刚入职的新人在远程工作的压力下表现得并不好。

questions.name: #1364 'Rewire' Themselves
questions.en:
Contrary to the commonly-held view, the brain does not have the ability to rewire itself to compensate for the loss of sight, an amputation or stroke, for example, say scientists.
The researchers argue that the notion that the brain, in response to injury or deficit, can reorganize itself and repurpose particular regions for new functions, is fundamentally flawed -- despite being commonly cited in scientific textbooks.
questions.zh:
科学家表示，与普遍观点相反，大脑并没有能力通过自我重组来弥补失明、截肢或中风等造成的损伤。
研究人员认为，尽管科学教科书中常提及，但那种认为大脑在受伤或功能缺失后能自我重组并为新功能重新分配特定区域的观点，从根本上就是错误的。

questions.name: #1365 Bear Genes
questions.en:
The internal clocks of grizzly bears appear to keep ticking through hibernation, according to a genetic study.
This persistence highlights the strong role of circadian rhythms in the metabolism of many organisms including humans.
The genetic study confirmed observational evidence that bears' energy production still waxes and wanes in a daily pattern even as they slumber for several months without eating.
questions.zh:
一项基因研究表明，灰熊体内的生物钟似乎在冬眠期间仍在运转。
这种持续性凸显了昼夜节律在包括人类在内的许多生物的新陈代谢中扮演的重要角色。
这项基因研究证实了观察到的证据：即使熊连续数月不吃不喝地沉睡，它们的能量产生仍然以每日的节奏起伏变化。

questions.name: #1366 Sense of Taste
questions.en:
Pavlov proposed over a century ago that the sight, smell and taste of food are important for regulating digestion.
More recent studies in the 1970s and 1980s have also suggested that the taste of food may restrain how fast we eat, but it's been impossible to study the relevant brain activity during eating because the brain cells that control this process are located deep in the brainstem.
questions.zh:
一个多世纪前，巴甫洛夫就提出，食物的外观、气味和味道对调节消化很重要。
后来在20世纪70年代和80年代的研究也表明，食物的味道可能会影响我们进食的速度，但由于控制这一过程的脑细胞位于脑干深处，一直无法研究进食时相关的脑部活动。

questions.name: #1368 Underground Networks
questions.en:
Plants possess an intricate system of roots that extends far beyond what meets the eye.
These underground networks serve a crucial purpose in absorbing water and nutrients from the soil.
This remarkable feature enables plants to thrive in demanding environments like deserts.
Mesquite trees, for example, have tap roots that can delve over 50 yards deep in search of water.
questions.zh:
植物拥有一个复杂的根系系统，其延伸范围远超我们所见。
这些地下网络在从土壤中吸收水分和养分方面起着关键作用。
这一非凡特性使植物能够在沙漠等严酷环境中茁壮成长。
例如，牧豆树的直根可以深入地下超过50码寻找水源。

questions.name: #1369 Cultural Attendance
questions.en:
A person's demographic and social background can influence their attendance at cultural venues and events.
Household composition, in particular, plays a significant role in shaping cultural preferences.
For instance, families with young children are more likely to visit theme parks and amusement centers, while single individuals may be more inclined to attend concerts and art galleries.

questions.name: #1371 Baby's Senses
questions.en:
The development of a baby's senses begins in the womb, with hearing being one of the earliest to emerge.
Parents have been known to play music to their unborn babies, hoping to stimulate their cognitive development.
Recent research shows that babies can even start hearing adult speech as early as 10 weeks before birth, providing them with an early exposure to the sounds and rhythms of their family's language.

最新研究表明，婴儿甚至在出生前10周就能听到成人的说话声，这让他们早早接触到家庭语言的语音和节奏。

questions.name: #1372 Vitamins
questions.en:
While vitamins are essential for maintaining overall health and well-being, excessive or inadequate intake may have adverse effects.
Research suggests that certain vitamins, such as vitamin D and vitamin E, may play a role in reducing the risk of mortality from specific causes, such as cardiovascular disease or cancer.

questions.name: #1373 University Terms
questions.en:
University terms are typically divided into semesters or quarters, with each term lasting several months.
The academic calendar may also include summer sessions or intersessions, which offer additional opportunities for students to take courses and accelerate their degree progress.
University terms are structured to provide students with a clear timeline for completing their coursework and earning their degrees.
questions.zh:

校历中可能还包括夏季学期或短期课程，为学生提供额外机会选修课程并加快学位进度。
大学学期的设置旨在为学生提供清晰的课程完成与学位获取时间表。

questions.name: #1374 Personal Library
questions.en:
Building a personal library requires careful consideration and a discerning eye for selecting literary works that resonate with one's intellectual curiosity.
Beyond being a physical manifestation of one's intellectual journey, personal libraries serve as a sanctuary for intellectual stimulation and contemplation.

它为深度阅读、批判性思考和探索新思想提供了一方净土。

questions.name: #1375 Excessive Job Hours
questions.en:
Research has shown that excessive job hours, such as working long hours or overtime, can lead to negative outcomes, including increased stress levels, fatigue, and decreased job satisfaction.
Additionally, long work hours have been associated with adverse health effects, such as increased risk of cardiovascular disease and mental health issues.
questions.zh:
研究表明，工作时间过长，比如长时间工作或加班，会导致负面结果，包括压力增大、疲劳加剧和工作满意度下降。
此外，长时间工作还与不良健康影响有关，比如增加心血管疾病和心理健康问题的风险。

questions.name: #1376 Pursuit of Wellness
questions.en:
The pursuit of wellness has gained increasing attention in recent years due to its potential benefits for preventing chronic diseases, promoting longevity, and improving quality of life.
However, achieving optimal wellness requires a holistic approach that considers the unique needs and circumstances of each individual.
Wellness interventions and programs should be tailored to the specific needs of individuals and communities.
questions.zh:
近年来，追求健康越来越受到关注，因为它有助于预防慢性病、延长寿命并提高生活质量。
然而，要达到最佳健康状态，需要采取整体性的方法，考虑每个人的独特需求和情况。
健康干预和项目应根据个人和社区的具体需求量身定制。

questions.name: #1377 Natural Movement
questions.en:
Basically, when we are standing still, our bodies are constantly making adjustments in order to keep us stable.
For example, if someone bumps into us when we are standing in line, our legs make a wide range of movements that we are not even necessarily aware of in order to keep us upright.

例如，排队时如果有人撞到我们，我们的腿部会做出一系列我们甚至未必意识到的动作来保持直立。

questions.name: #1378 Susceptibility
questions.en:
A susceptibility to gain weight may be written into molecular processes of human cells, a new study indicates.
The proof-of-concept study with a set of 22 twins found an epigenetic signature in buccal or cheek cells appearing only for the twins who were obese compared to their thinner siblings.
questions.zh:

这项概念验证研究对22对双胞胎进行了分析，发现与较瘦的兄弟姐妹相比，肥胖双胞胎的口腔或脸颊细胞中存在一种表观遗传特征。

questions.name: #1379 Pig Kidneys
questions.en:
The first research study that has undergone peer review has been released, demonstrating the successful transplantation of genetically modified pig kidneys into a human who was brain-dead.
These kidneys replaced the original kidneys of the recipient and were of clinical-grade quality.
The success of this transplant shows that xenotransplantation could be a solution to the global shortage of organs for transplant.
questions.zh:
首项经过同行评审的研究已发布，展示了将基因改造猪肾成功移植到脑死亡患者体内。
这些肾脏替换了受体的原有肾脏，且达到临床级质量。
这次移植的成功表明，异种移植或可成为解决全球移植器官短缺问题的方法。

questions.name: #1380 Health
questions.en:
Your body is at war; your immune system is in endless battle against a host of enemies including bacteria, viruses, parasites and, more often than you would like or are aware, cancer cells.
Thankfully, your white blood cells are "cut-throat killer cells" patrolling the body, ready to engulf, entrap or dissolve unwanted visitors.
questions.zh:
你的身体就像战场，免疫系统无休止地与细菌、病毒、寄生虫以及比你想象或意识到的更频繁的癌细胞等敌人作战。
幸好，你的白细胞是“冷酷无情的杀手细胞”，在体内巡逻，随时准备吞噬、困住或溶解不受欢迎的入侵者。

questions.name: #1381 Eye Issues
questions.en:
During the winter season, various eye issues can arise due to harsh weather conditions.
Excess tearing and watery eyes, often caused by cold air and icy winds can lead to eye redness and inflammation.
This can often be due to dry eyes from the combination of entering and exiting the cold weather and rooms that have been heated with central heating.
questions.zh:
冬天天气恶劣，眼睛容易出现各种问题。
冷风和冰风经常导致眼泪过多、眼睛水汪汪，进而引起眼睛发红和发炎。
这通常是由于眼睛干燥造成的，因为人们在寒冷的室外和用中央供暖的室内之间来回进出。

questions.name: #1382 Nervous System
questions.en:
Your nervous system allows you to think, move and feel.
But there’s a whole other part of the nervous system that is largely outside of your control, operating automatically and quite independently from your conscious mind—and it keeps you alive.

但神经系统中还有另一大部分基本不受你控制，它自动运行，与你的意识相当独立——正是它维持着你的生命。

questions.name: #1383 Winter Months
questions.en:
As the nights draw in and the days turn a little gloomy, the winter months can often have an impact on our mental and physical health.
With that in mind, a trip to sunnier climates might be exactly what you need to give your wellbeing a boost.
questions.zh:
随着夜晚变长、白天变得有些阴郁，冬季往往会影响我们的身心健康。
考虑到这一点，去阳光更充足的地方旅行或许正是提升幸福感所需要的。

questions.name: #1384 Sleep Schedule
questions.en:
Maintaining a consistent sleep schedule is crucial for a good night's sleep in autumn when daylight hours are shorter and the body's internal clock can be disrupted.
Going to bed and waking up at the same time each day helps regulate your circadian rhythm, allowing your body to anticipate when it's time to sleep and when it's time to wake, promoting deeper and more restful sleep.
questions.zh:
秋天白天变短，生物钟容易乱，保持规律的作息对睡个好觉特别重要。
每天固定时间睡觉和起床能帮你调节生物钟，让身体知道什么时候该睡、什么时候该醒，这样睡得才更沉、更香。

questions.name: #1385 Sadness and Distress
questions.en:
There is a big difference between sadness and distress.
Feeling a bit sad or angry is normal in your day to day life, and can be triggered by a range of different things.
However, if you are feeling increasingly angry, frustrated, helpless or confused then you may be suffering from something which requires a professional to step in.
questions.zh:
悲伤和痛苦之间有很大的区别。
在日常生活中，感到有点悲伤或愤怒是正常的，可能由各种不同的事情触发。
但是，如果你感到越来越愤怒、沮丧、无助或困惑，那么你可能正遭受某种需要专业人士介入的情况。

questions.name: #1386 Songbirds
questions.en:
Songbirds do indeed have perfect pitch.
A scientific study has shown that various songbirds, including zebra finches and white-throated sparrows, are much better at determining, distinguishing and remembering isolated pitches than human beings or rats.
Even when human subjects were provided with a second sound for comparison, they were far less skilled at determining its pitch than songbirds.
questions.zh:
鸣禽确实拥有完美的音准。
一项科学研究表明，包括斑胸草雀和白喉麻雀在内的多种鸣禽，在辨别、区分和记忆孤立音高方面，远比人类或老鼠更擅长。
即使给人类受试者提供第二个声音作为比较，他们在判断音高方面的能力也远不如鸣禽。

questions.name: #1387 Perfect Pitch
questions.en:
Early experiences with music play a role in human beings.
Most babies have perfect pitch, and this is usually preserved if they are given music lessons at an early age.
Speaking a tonal language such as Mandarin—where words can have different meanings depending on tone and pitch—also help to develop perfect pitch.
questions.zh:
早期接触音乐对人的成长有重要影响。
大多数婴儿拥有绝对音感，如果从小接受音乐训练，这种能力通常能保持下来。
说像普通话这样的声调语言——其中词语的含义会因声调和音高而不同——也有助于培养绝对音感。

questions.name: #1388 Death Experiences
questions.en:
These days it seems near death experiences are a common phenomenon.
The research team named above, which studied hundreds of cases to narrow down the medical definition, discovered that around fifteen per cent of people who have been resuscitated from a coma after cardiac arrest have had these experiences.

上述研究团队研究了数百个案例以缩小医学定义的范围，他们发现，在心脏骤停后从昏迷中苏醒的人中，约有百分之十五有过这种经历。

questions.name: #1389 Grey Zone
questions.en:
The researchers concluded that millions of people around the world may have inhabited a "grey zone" between living and dying, in which they have had an out-of-body experience.
People often wake up profoundly changed, no longer fearing death and resolved to live a better life.

人们醒来后往往判若两人，不再畏惧死亡，并决心活出更精彩的人生。

questions.name: #1390 Existentialism
questions.en:
Existentialism is a philosophical movement that explores the nature of human existence and the individual's struggle to find meaning in a chaotic and absurd world.
It emphasizes personal freedom, responsibility, and the importance of subjective experience.
Existentialist thinkers like Jean-Paul Sartre and Friedrich Nietzsche delve into concepts such as authenticity, anxiety, and the inevitability of death.
questions.zh:
存在主义是一种哲学思潮，探讨人类存在的本质，以及个体在混乱荒诞的世界中寻找意义的挣扎。
它强调个人自由、责任以及主观体验的重要性。
让-保罗·萨特和弗里德里希·尼采等存在主义思想家深入探讨了真实性、焦虑以及死亡的必然性等概念。

questions.name: #1391 Cats
questions.en:
Cats are popular pets around the world.
They are known for their playful nature, soft fur, and independent personalities.
Many people enjoy having cats as companions, as they can provide comfort and entertainment.
However, it is important to take care of cats properly by providing them with food, water, and regular veterinary check-ups.
questions.zh:
猫是全球都很受欢迎的宠物。
它们以顽皮的天性、柔软的毛发和独立的个性而闻名。
许多人喜欢养猫作伴，因为它们能带来安慰和乐趣。
不过，要好好照顾猫，必须为它们提供食物、水，并定期带它们去看兽医。

questions.name: #1392 Earworms
questions.en:
Like the science of yawns, the reason for earworms is fascinating.
They are a form of auditory imagery where we perceive tone in the brain in the absence of actually hearing it.
“The auditory cortex is located in the temporal lobe of the brain,” says Samata Sharma, MD, director of addiction consult psychiatry at Brigham and Women’s Hospital in Boston, who has published research on this topic.
questions.zh:
就像打哈欠的科学一样，耳朵里挥之不去的旋律也很有意思。
这是一种听觉意象，我们在没有实际听到声音时，大脑中却能感知到曲调。
波士顿布莱根妇女医院成瘾咨询精神病学主任萨马塔·沙玛医学博士说：“听觉皮层位于大脑的颞叶。”她曾发表过关于这一主题的研究。

questions.name: #1393 Seven Natural Wonders
questions.en:
The natural world is an incredible place.
There are soaring mountains and rolling sand dunes, spectacular beaches and shimmering lakes, steaming geysers and bubbling volcanoes—and so much more.
Although it’s all truly dazzling, there are a few destinations and sights around the world that stand out from the rest.
And the most significant of all are the seven natural wonders of the world.
questions.zh:
自然界是一个令人叹为观止的地方。
这里有高耸的山脉和起伏的沙丘，壮丽的海滩和波光粼粼的湖泊，热气腾腾的间歇泉和咕嘟冒泡的火山——远不止这些。
尽管这一切都令人眼花缭乱，但世界上还有一些地方和景观格外引人注目。
而其中最了不起的就是世界七大奇迹。

questions.name: #1394 Puzzles
questions.zh:
你可能听说过拼图和其他益智游戏能锻炼大脑，提升记忆力、注意力、思维速度、创造力和解决问题的能力——这可能是真的，也可能不是。
科学家们也意见不一。
但我们知道它们非常有趣，是保持投入和娱乐的好方法。

questions.name: #1395 Emotional Strength
questions.en:
How can you be prepared for what’s ahead in life, good or bad?
Building emotional strength can help you learn how to be confident in handling its twists and turns.
But emotional strength doesn’t mean pushing aside or suppressing negative feelings or emotions; instead, it means acknowledging them and finding healthy ways to process and respond to them.
questions.zh:
面对生活中可能发生的好事或坏事，你该如何做好准备？
培养情感韧性有助于你学会自信地应对生活中的曲折。
但情感韧性并不意味着忽视或压抑负面情绪；相反，它意味着承认这些情绪，并找到健康的方式去处理和回应它们。

questions.name: #1397 Black Death
questions.en:
The Second Plague Pandemic of the mid-14th century, also known as the Black Death, killed 30-60 percent of the European population and profoundly changed the course of European history.
New research suggests that this plague, potentially through resulting changes in diet and hygiene, may also be associated with a shift in the composition of the human oral microbiome toward one that contributes to chronic diseases in modern-day humans.
questions.zh:
14世纪中叶的第二次鼠疫大流行，也就是黑死病，导致了欧洲30%到60%的人口死亡，并深刻改变了欧洲历史的进程。
新研究表明，这场瘟疫可能通过引发饮食和卫生习惯的变化，也导致人类口腔微生物组的组成发生了转变，使其更倾向于引发现代人的慢性疾病。

questions.name: #1398 Domesticated Rabbits
questions.en:
Domesticated rabbits come in all sizes and colors, including tiny Netherland Dwarfs, floppy-eared French lops, Flemish Giants, and fluffy Angoras.
These breeds belong to Europe's only rabbit species, originally limited to the Iberian Peninsula and Southern France and used for meat and fur since the last Ice Age, culminating in domestication about 1,500 years ago.
questions.zh:
家兔大小颜色各异，有小巧的荷兰侏儒兔、耳朵耷拉的法国垂耳兔、佛兰德巨兔和毛茸茸的安哥拉兔。
这些品种都属于欧洲唯一的兔子物种，最初只分布于伊比利亚半岛和法国南部，自上一个冰河时代起就被用于获取肉和皮毛，最终在大约1500年前被驯化。

questions.name: #1399 Monster Waves
questions.en:
Long considered myth, freakishly large rogue waves are very real and can split apart ships and even damage oil rigs.
Using 700 years' worth of wave data from more than a billion waves, scientists at the University of Copenhagen and University of Victoria have used artificial intelligence to find a formula for how to predict the occurrence of these maritime monsters.
questions.zh:
长期以来被视为传说的巨浪其实真实存在，它们能撕裂船只，甚至破坏石油钻井平台。
哥本哈根大学和维多利亚大学的科学家利用超过十亿个波浪中长达700年的波浪数据，通过人工智能找到了一种预测这些海上巨兽出现的方法。

questions.name: #1400 Sunspot Cycle
questions.en:
Scientists at the Center of Excellence in Space Sciences India located at IISER Kolkata have made a significant finding regarding the connection between the Sun's magnetic field and its sunspot cycle.
This discovery allows for the prediction of the timing of the peak in solar activity.
Their research suggests that solar cycle 25 is approaching its maximum intensity and is expected to happen within a year.
questions.zh:
位于印度科学教育与研究学院加尔各答分校的印度空间科学卓越中心的科学家们，在太阳磁场与其黑子周期的关联性方面取得了一项重要发现。
这一发现使得预测太阳活动高峰的时间成为可能。
他们的研究表明，第25个太阳周期正接近其最大强度，预计将在一年内发生。

questions.name: #1401 Rare Marine Amoeba
questions.en:
Scientists have recently rediscovered and managed to cultivate Rhabdamoeba marina, a rare marine amoeba that has been documented in only two instances over the past hundred years.
By studying this cultured strain, they conducted a thorough examination of its genetic sequence, unveiling the amoeba's phylogenetic position for the first time.
questions.zh:
科学家们最近重新发现并成功培育了一种名为Rhabdamoeba marina的罕见海洋变形虫，过去一百年里仅有两例记录。
通过研究这个培养的菌株，他们对其基因序列进行了彻底分析，首次揭示了这种变形虫的系统发育位置。

科学家们最近重新发现并成功培育了一种名为Rhabdamoeba marina的罕见海洋变形虫，过去一百年里仅有两例记录。
By studying this cultured strain, they conducted a thorough examination of its genetic sequence, unveiling the amoeba's phylogenetic position for the first time.
通过研究这个培养的菌株，他们对其基因序列进行了彻底分析，首次揭示了这种变形虫的系统发育位置。

questions.name: #1402 Quantum Computers
questions.en:
Quantum physicists show that imperfect timekeeping places a fundamental limit to quantum computers and their applications.
The team claims that even tiny timing errors add up to place a significant impact on any large-scale algorithm, posing another problem that must eventually be solved if quantum computers are to fulfill the lofty aspirations that society has for them.
questions.zh:
量子物理学家指出，不精确的计时会从根本上限制量子计算机及其应用。
该团队称，即使是微小的计时误差也会累积起来，对任何大规模算法产生重大影响，这构成了量子计算机要实现社会对其寄予的崇高期望所必须解决的又一个问题。

questions.name: #1403 Building Blocks
questions.en:
While life on Earth is relatively new, geologically speaking, the ingredients that combined to form it might be much older than once thought.
The simplest amino acid, carbamic acid, could have formed alongside stars or planets within interstellar ices.
The findings could be used to train deep space instruments like the James Webb Space Telescope to search for prebiotic molecules in distant, star-forming regions of the universe.
questions.zh:
虽然从地质学角度看，地球上的生命相对年轻，但形成生命的成分可能比我们原先以为的要古老得多。
最简单的氨基酸——氨基甲酸，可能是在星际冰中与恒星或行星一同形成的。
这些发现可以用来训练像詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜这样的深空仪器，在宇宙中遥远的恒星形成区搜寻前生物分子。

questions.name: #1404 Light-driven Machinery
questions.en:
Chemists have developed a bioinspired supramolecular approach to convert photo-switchable molecules from their stable state into metastable one with low-energy red light.
Their work enables fast, highly selective, and efficient switching, providing new tools for energy storage, activation of drugs with light, and sensing applications.
questions.zh:
化学家们开发了一种受生物启发的超分子方法，利用低能量的红光将光开关分子从稳定状态转化为亚稳态。
他们的工作实现了快速、高选择性和高效的开关转换，为能量储存、光激活药物以及传感应用提供了新工具。

questions.name: #1405 Mental Health Problems
questions.en:
Many mental health problems emerge during adolescence.
Among these are disorders such as depression and anxiety, which manifest as 'internalizing' symptoms, including low mood and worrying.
Other conditions such as attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) manifest as 'externalizing' symptoms, such as impulsive behavior.
questions.zh:
很多心理健康问题在青少年时期开始出现。
其中包括抑郁和焦虑这类障碍，表现为‘内化’症状，比如情绪低落和过度担忧。
其他像注意力缺陷多动症（ADHD）这样的状况则表现为‘外化’症状，例如冲动行为。

questions.name: #1406 Subjective Beliefs
questions.en:
The concept that a placebo or sham treatment can mimic genuine treatment effects is well-established in science.
While researchers have closely monitored this phenomenon, it has been typically catalogued separately from the in-depth analyses of the actual treatment outcomes.
What sets our study apart is that we have brought together these two datasets -- subjective beliefs and objective treatment measures.
questions.zh:
在科学界，安慰剂或虚假治疗能模拟真实治疗效果这一概念早已得到公认。
尽管研究人员一直密切关注这一现象，但它通常被单独记录，与对实际治疗结果的深入分析分开。
我们研究的独特之处在于，将这两个数据集——主观信念与客观治疗指标——整合到了一起。

questions.name: #1407 Christmas
questions.en:
People love celebrating Christmas for plenty of reasons, but one of the best things about the holiday is getting together with loved ones to do fun Christmas activities.
Telling the newest Christmas jokes, sharing funny Christmas memes and even solving clever Christmas riddles bring out the holiday humor.
You’re busting a gut before you know it!
questions.zh:
人们喜欢过圣诞节的原因有很多，但节日里最棒的事情之一就是和亲人聚在一起做些有趣的圣诞活动。
讲最新的圣诞笑话、分享搞笑的圣诞梗图，甚至猜几个巧妙的圣诞谜语，都能让节日幽默感爆棚。
你还没反应过来就已经笑破肚皮了！

questions.name: #1408 Income Inequality
questions.en:
Income inequality is a significant social issue that affects communities worldwide.
The gap between the rich and the poor continues to widen, leading to social unrest and economic instability.
To address this issue, governments can implement policies that promote equitable distribution of resources and opportunities.

贫富差距持续扩大，引发了社会动荡和经济不稳定。
为解决这一问题，政府可以推行促进资源和机会公平分配的政策。

questions.name: #1409 Intermittent Fasting
questions.en:
Intermittent fasting is a popular dietary trend that involves alternating periods of fasting and eating.
Proponents claim that it can lead to weight loss, improved insulin sensitivity, and other health benefits.
However, there are also potential risks such as nutrient deficiencies and eating disorders.
It is important to consult with a healthcare professional before starting any fasting regimen.
questions.zh:
间歇性禁食是一种流行的饮食趋势，即在禁食和进食之间交替进行。
支持者声称它能带来体重减轻、改善胰岛素敏感性等健康益处。
然而，也存在营养缺乏和饮食失调等潜在风险。
在开始任何禁食计划前，咨询医疗专业人士很重要。

questions.name: #1410 Social Value of Offsets
questions.en:
The Social Value of Offsets (SVO) is an economic framework that will help policymakers calculate how much carbon should be stored in temporary offsets to make it equivalent to a permanent CO2 emission.
Using the SVO metric the researchers estimate that an offset sequestering one ton of carbon for 50 years is equivalent to between 0.3 to 0.5 tons permanently locked away.
questions.zh:

研究人员利用SVO指标估算，一个封存一吨碳50年的抵消相当于永久封存0.3到0.5吨碳。

questions.name: #1411 Work and Play
questions.en:
The study across three countries led by the Department of Psychology's Dr Paul Hanel discovered people who prioritized achievement over enjoyment were less happy on the next day.
Whereas those who aimed for freedom said they had a 13% increase in well-being, recording better sleep quality and life satisfaction.
questions.zh:
由心理学系的保罗·哈内尔博士牵头，在三个国家进行的研究发现，那些把成就看得比快乐更重要的人，第二天幸福感更低。
而那些追求自由的人则表示，他们的幸福感提升了13%，睡眠质量更高，生活满意度也更好。

Whereas those who aimed for freedom said they had a 13% increase in well-being, recording better sleep quality and life satisfaction.
而那些追求自由的人则表示，他们的幸福感提升了13%，睡眠质量更高，生活满意度也更好。

questions.name: #1412 Brittle Stars
questions.en:
Relatives of starfish, brittle stars spend most of their time hiding under rocks and crevices in the ocean or burrowing in the sand.
These shy marine creatures have no brain to speak of -- just nerve cords running down each of their five wiggly arms, which join to form a nerve ring near their mouth.

这些害羞的海洋生物几乎没有大脑——只有神经索沿着它们五条扭动的腕足延伸，并在嘴附近汇合成一个神经环。

questions.name: #1413 Disinformation
questions.en:
Melting of glaciers, rising sea levels, extreme heat waves: the consequences of climate change are more visible than ever, and the scientific community has confirmed that humans are responsible.
Yet studies show that a third of the population still doubts or disputes these facts.
The cause is disinformation spread by certain vested interests.
questions.zh:
冰川融化、海平面上升、极端热浪：气候变化的后果比以往任何时候都更明显，科学界已经证实人类对此负有责任。
然而研究表明，仍有三分之一的人对这些事实持怀疑或争议态度。
原因在于某些既得利益者散布的虚假信息。

questions.name: #1414 Luminescence Dating
questions.en:
At this great age, putting a date on finds is very challenging and we used luminescence dating to do this.
These new dating methods have far reaching implications -- allowing us to date much further back in time, to piece together sites that give us a glimpse into human evolution.

在这么古老的时代，给发现物确定年代非常困难，我们使用了光释光测年来完成这项工作。
这些新的测年方法具有深远的意义——让我们能够追溯到更久远的过去，拼凑出那些让我们一窥人类进化历程的遗址。

questions.name: #1415 New Catalyst
questions.en:
Now, Northwestern University chemists have developed a new catalyst that quickly, cleanly and completely breaks down Nylon-6 in a matter of minutes -- without generating harmful byproducts.
Even better: The process does not require toxic solvents, expensive materials or extreme conditions, making it practical for everyday applications.
questions.zh:
现在，西北大学的化学家们研发出一种新催化剂，能在几分钟内快速、清洁且彻底地分解尼龙-6，且不产生有害副产品。
更棒的是，这个过程不需要有毒溶剂、昂贵材料或极端条件，使其适用于日常应用。

questions.name: #1416 Scientific Consensus
questions.en:
Although scientific consensus on human responsibility -- reaffirmed by the sixth report of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) -- has been in place for decades, a third of the population still doubts or disputes it.
This phenomenon can be explained by the disinformation spread by certain companies and lobbies over the last 50 years.
questions.zh:
尽管政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）的第六次报告再次确认了人类责任的科学共识，且这一共识已存在数十年，但仍有三分之一的人对此持怀疑或反对态度。
这一现象可以解释为过去50年间某些公司和游说团体散布的虚假信息所致。

questions.name: #1417 Recycled Plastics
questions.en:
When researchers analyzed pellets made from recycled plastic gathered in 13 countries, they discovered numerous harmful substances, such as pesticides and pharmaceuticals.
As a result, the scientists concluded that recycled plastics are unsuitable for many applications and pose a challenge to the establishment of a circular economy.
questions.zh:
研究人员对从13个国家收集的再生塑料颗粒进行分析时，发现了大量有害物质，比如杀虫剂和药品。
因此，科学家们得出结论，再生塑料在许多应用场景中都不适用，并且对建立循环经济构成了挑战。

questions.name: #1418 Struggling With Computers
questions.en:
An endlessly rotating beach ball, a program that crashes without saving data or systems that require illogical procedures or simply do not work.
Unfortunately, struggling with computers is still a familiar situation for most of us.
Tearing your hair out over computers that do not work remains very common among users, according to new Danish research.
questions.zh:
一个不停旋转的沙滩球、一个没保存就崩溃的程序，或者需要不合逻辑的操作步骤、干脆无法运行的系统。
不幸的是，对我们大多数人来说，和计算机斗智斗勇仍然是家常便饭。
丹麦一项新研究显示，用户因电脑无法正常工作而抓狂的情况依然非常普遍。

questions.name: #1419 Trisauropodiscus
questions.en:
Numerous fossil sites in southern Africa preserve distinctive three-toed footprints that have been named Trisauropodiscus.
For many years, researchers have debated what animals might have left these tracks, as well as precisely how many different species (technically called ichnospecies) of Trisauropodiscus there are.

多年来，研究人员一直在争论可能是哪些动物留下了这些足迹，以及究竟有多少种不同的 Trisauropodiscus（学术上称为 ichnospecies）。

questions.name: #1420 Ocean Warming
questions.en:
Increasing concentrations of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere from human activity traps heat within the climate system, warming air, the land surface, the oceans, and melting polar ice.
Oceans do by far the most work, absorbing more than 90 per cent of the excess human-generated heat accumulated in the Earth's climate system, moderating atmospheric temperature rises.
questions.zh:
人类活动导致大气中温室气体浓度上升，热量被困在气候系统内，使得空气、地表和海洋变暖，并导致极地冰层融化。
海洋承担了绝大部分工作，吸收了地球气候系统中超过90%由人类活动产生的多余热量，从而减缓了大气温度的上升。

questions.name: #1421 Computers
questions.en:
Even though our computers are now better than 15 years ago, they still malfunction between 11 and 20 per cent of the time, a new study concludes.
The researchers behind the study therefore find that there are major gains to be achieved for society by rethinking the systems and involving users more in their development.
questions.zh:
一项新研究发现，尽管现在的电脑比15年前更先进，但仍有11%到20%的时间会出现故障。
因此，这项研究的研究人员认为，通过重新设计系统并让用户更多地参与开发，社会可以取得重大进步。

questions.name: #1422 MAROON-X Instrument
questions.en:
Using the MAROON-X instrument on the Gemini-North Telescope, the team was able to identify and measure the abundance of 11 chemical elements in the atmosphere of the planet.
Those include rock-forming elements whose abundances are not even known for giant planets in the Solar System such as Jupiter or Saturn.
questions.zh:
研究团队借助双子北座望远镜上的MAROON-X仪器，成功识别并测量了该行星大气中11种化学元素的丰度。
这些元素中包括造岩元素，而即使是太阳系中的木星或土星这样的巨行星，其造岩元素的丰度也尚未可知。

questions.name: #1423 Better Cybersecurity
questions.en:
A new form of random number generator for encryption, created at Linköping University in Sweden, has the potential to make digital information exchange safer, more cost-effective, and environmentally friendly.
The researchers involved in the study believe that this innovative technology could open up possibilities for a novel form of quantum communication.

questions.name: #1424 Novel Composite
questions.en:
A team of researchers has announced the creation of a novel composite material with the ability to alter its properties based on temperature changes, allowing it to execute specific tasks.
These materials are expected to be incorporated into the next wave of self-governing robotics that can engage with the surrounding environment.

这些材料有望被整合到下一代能与周围环境互动的自主机器人中。

questions.name: #1425 Civil Unrest
questions.en:
The new analysis of frailties within the UK's food system has been led by researchers from the University of York and Anglia Ruskin University, and is published in the journal Sustainability.
In the study, civil unrest is classified as over 30,000 people in the UK suffering violent injury in one year through events such as demonstrations and violent looting.
questions.zh:
一项由约克大学和安格利亚鲁斯金大学的研究人员主导的新分析，揭示了英国食品体系中的脆弱环节，该分析已发表在《可持续发展》期刊上。
在这项研究中，公民骚乱被定义为一年内英国有超过3万人因示威和暴力抢劫等事件遭受暴力伤害。

questions.name: #1426 Roosmalens' Dwarf Porcupine
questions.en:
A new study has provided valuable insights into the Roosmalens' dwarf porcupine, a neotropical species that has been poorly understood until now.
This research, conducted after 22 years of limited knowledge, reveals important information about its distribution, evolutionary relationships, and potential risks to its conservation.
questions.zh:
一项新研究为我们提供了关于罗斯马伦侏儒豪猪的宝贵见解，这种新热带物种此前一直鲜为人知。
这项研究在知识匮乏了22年之后进行，揭示了关于其分布、进化关系以及保护方面潜在风险的重要信息。

questions.name: #1427 Evolutionary Changes
questions.en:
A groundbreaking study on recent evolutionary changes in natural populations has been conducted by a team of international researchers.
The study utilized a vast genomic dataset, one of the largest ever assembled for animals in their natural habitat, which included almost 4,000 Darwin's finches.
questions.zh:
一个国际研究团队对自然种群近期的进化变化进行了一项开创性研究。
该研究利用了迄今为止最大的动物自然栖息地基因组数据集之一，包含了近4000只达尔文雀的数据。

questions.name: #1428 Dog-assisted Interventions
questions.en:
A recent study published in the open-access journal PLOS ONE suggests that dog-assisted interventions can effectively reduce stress levels in children, regardless of whether they have special needs or not.
The study, conducted by Kerstin Meints and colleagues from the University of Lincoln, UK, measured salivary cortisol levels to determine the impact of these interventions.
questions.zh:
一项近期发表在开放获取期刊《PLOS ONE》上的研究表明，狗辅助干预能有效降低儿童的压力水平，无论这些孩子是否有特殊需求。
这项由英国林肯大学的Kerstin Meints及其同事进行的研究，通过测量唾液皮质醇水平来评估这些干预措施的效果。

questions.name: #1429 Depression and Anxiety
questions.en:
In recent years in the UK we have seen an increase in mental health problems among young people, so there has been an increased focus on how to support students.
Here we have found concerning evidence that students may have a higher risk of depression and anxiety than their peers of the same age who are not in higher education.
questions.zh:
近年来，英国青少年的心理健康问题日益增多，因此如何为学生提供支持成为了关注的焦点。
我们在此发现了令人担忧的证据：大学生患抑郁和焦虑的风险可能高于同龄的非高等教育人群。

questions.name: #1430 Impaired Brain Function
questions.en:
Scientists have achieved the restoration of impaired brain function in mice models of stroke by utilizing small molecules, which may hold promise as a potential therapy for stroke recovery in the future.
Tadeusz Wieloch, explains that the treatment has demonstrated the ability to partially restore communication between nerve cells in significant areas of the brain that are affected by stroke.
questions.zh:
科学家们利用小分子成功恢复了中风模型小鼠受损的大脑功能，这有望成为未来中风康复的潜在疗法。
Tadeusz Wieloch 解释说，该治疗已显示出能够部分恢复受中风影响的重要脑区中神经细胞之间的通讯。

questions.name: #1431 Food Waste
questions.en:
One of the complex agricultural problems is the issue of food waste.
Food waste refers to the discarding of edible food at various stages of the food supply chain, from production to consumption.
This not only represents a significant loss of resources but also has environmental implications, such as greenhouse gas emissions from decomposing food waste in landfills.
questions.zh:
农业面临的复杂问题之一就是食物浪费。
食物浪费指的是从生产到消费的各个供应链环节中，可食用食物被丢弃的现象。
这不仅意味着资源的巨大损失，还会带来环境问题，比如垃圾填埋场中食物残渣分解产生的温室气体排放。

questions.name: #1432 Urban Forests
questions.en:
Urban forests play a crucial role in promoting urban sustainability and resilience.
They contribute to climate change mitigation by sequestering carbon dioxide through photosynthesis.
Urban forests also help manage stormwater runoff by absorbing and filtering rainwater, reducing the risk of flooding.
Furthermore, these green spaces provide social and psychological benefits, such as stress reduction and improved mental well-being.
questions.zh:
城市森林在推动城市可持续发展和增强韧性方面起着关键作用。
它们通过光合作用吸收二氧化碳，有助于减缓气候变化。
城市森林还能吸收和过滤雨水，减少洪水风险，从而帮助管理雨水径流。
此外，这些绿色空间还能带来社交和心理上的益处，比如减轻压力、改善心理健康。

questions.en:

questions.name: #1434 Communication Networks
questions.en:
A recent study has revealed the significance of communication and expertise in organizations and their impact on group performance.
The researchers investigated the process of individuals joining communication networks and how selection procedures affect group performance.
The findings indicate that individuals who communicate more during training are more likely to be selected as a central member of the network.

研究结果表明，在培训期间沟通更频繁的人更有可能被选为网络的核心成员。

questions.name: #1435 Headaches
questions.en:
Individuals who suffer from concussions often experience moderate to severe headaches in the weeks following the injury.
However, a recent study has discovered that a combination of two commonly used anti-nausea medications, administered intravenously in the emergency room, may provide more effective relief for these headaches compared to a placebo.
