questions.name: #1436 Plants
questions.en:
Plants play a crucial role in ecosystems, serving as a foundation and contributing to human well-being by providing resources such as food and medicine.
In order to gain a deeper understanding of how plants can adapt and remain resilient in the face of challenges like climate change, scientists have developed an innovative mathematical model.

为了更深入地理解植物如何在气候变化等挑战面前适应并保持韧性，科学家们开发了一种创新的数学模型。

questions.name: #1437 Cryptocurrency Mining
questions.en:
Amid the global water crisis, the process of cryptocurrency mining has been found to consume a substantial amount of water, with predictions of an even greater demand in the future.
A recent study has provided the first extensive calculation of the amount of water used by Bitcoin.
The researcher has expressed concern over the potential impact on drinking water if this practice continues without proper regulation.
questions.zh:
在全球水资源危机中，加密货币挖矿被发现消耗大量水，预计未来需求会更大。
最近一项研究首次全面计算了比特币的用水量。
研究人员担心，如果这种做法在没有适当监管的情况下继续下去，可能会对饮用水产生影响。

questions.name: #1438 Migraines
questions.en:
Individuals who suffer from migraines often struggle to find a treatment that is both reliable and effective, with limited information available regarding how different medications compare to one another.
However, a recent study has utilized data from almost 300,000 smartphone app users to aid in medication decisions for those with migraines.

不过，最近一项研究利用了近30万智能手机应用用户的数据，来帮助偏头痛患者做出用药决策。

questions.name: #1439 Vocal Learning
questions.en:
The European starling is known for its impressive vocal abilities.
These versatile songbirds have the ability to learn a wide range of warbles, whistles, calls, and songs throughout their lives, making them one of the most advanced avian vocal learners.
A recent study published in Science has discovered that starlings also excel in problem-solving tasks.
questions.zh:
欧洲椋鸟以其惊人的发声能力而闻名。
这些多才多艺的鸣禽一生中能够学习各种啁啾、哨音、叫声和歌曲，使它们成为最先进的鸟类发声学习者之一。
《科学》杂志最近发表的一项研究发现，椋鸟在解决问题方面也很出色。

questions.name: #1440 Telescopes
questions.en:
Astronomers have conducted an impressive observation campaign using a total of 12 telescopes, both on land and in space, including three facilities belonging to the European Southern Observatory (ESO).
The study has revealed the peculiar behavior of a pulsar, which is a dead star that spins at an incredibly fast rate.
questions.zh:
天文学家们动用包括欧洲南方天文台（ESO）三台设备在内的总共12台望远镜，在陆地和太空中开展了一次令人瞩目的观测活动。
这项研究揭示了一颗脉冲星的奇特行为，这种死亡的恒星以惊人的速度旋转。

questions.name: #1441 Blood Pressure
questions.en:
The correlation between elevated blood pressure levels and a multitude of health complications is widely acknowledged.
However, recent studies have shed light on an equally concerning aspect.
Researchers have discovered that these fluctuations in blood pressure can not only be detrimental to overall health but also act as a potential precursor to the development of dementia and vascular disease.
questions.zh:
血压升高与多种健康问题之间的关联是公认的。
不过，最近的研究揭示了另一个同样令人担忧的方面。
研究人员发现，血压的波动不仅可能损害整体健康，还可能成为痴呆症和血管疾病发展的潜在前兆。

questions.name: #1442 Himalayan Glaciers
questions.en:
A team of international researchers has uncovered a fascinating phenomenon: in response to rising global temperatures, Himalayan glaciers are actively working to preserve themselves by cooling the air in contact with their ice surface.
However, it remains unclear how long these glaciers can continue to fight back against the effects of climate change.
questions.zh:
一组国际研究人员发现了一个有趣的现象：为了应对全球气温上升，喜马拉雅冰川正通过冷却与其冰面接触的空气来努力保护自己。
然而，这些冰川还能在气候变化的影响下坚持多久，目前尚不清楚。

questions.en:
Across the globe, there is a widespread effort to explore methods for extracting carbon dioxide from the atmosphere or power plant emissions and transforming it into a valuable resource.
Among the various ideas being explored, the concept of converting carbon dioxide into a stable fuel shows significant promise.

在众多探索中的想法里，将二氧化碳转化为稳定燃料的概念显示出巨大潜力。

questions.name: #1445 Diapers
questions.en:
In Germany, over 100,000 tons of diapers are discarded each year, resulting in the wastage of valuable resources.
Diaper liners, which contain special polymers known as superabsorbers, are among the materials that end up in landfills.
However, researchers have made significant progress in enhancing the recycling process for these liners, leading to substantial improvements.
questions.zh:
在德国，每年有超过10万吨的尿布被丢弃，造成宝贵资源的浪费。
尿布内衬含有被称为高吸水性聚合物的特殊材料，最终被填埋处理。
然而，研究人员在改进这些内衬的回收工艺方面取得了重大进展，带来了显著的改善。

questions.en:
This time the University is running a series of workshops for final year students on how to do well in interviews.
These sessions will help participants prepare effectively for and perform at their best during later job interviews.
The workshop tutors have an excellent record of success in helping students acquire the positions they desire.

工作坊的导师们在帮助学生获得理想职位方面有着出色的成功记录。

questions.name: #1448 Subgenre
questions.en:
Variations kept the genre alive.
From the mid 19th century onwards, when mass literacy grew, adventure became a popular subgenre of fiction.
Although not exploited to its fullest, adventure has seen many changes over the years - from being constrained to stories of knights in armor to stories of high-tech espionage.
questions.zh:
变化让这一流派得以延续。
从19世纪中期开始，随着大众识字率的提高，冒险小说成为广受欢迎的虚构文学子类型。
尽管未被充分发掘，冒险小说多年来经历了诸多变化——从局限于身穿盔甲的骑士故事，发展到高科技间谍故事。

questions.name: #1450 Mass Strandings
questions.en:
Mass strandings of whales are a recurring issue in Australia and New Zealand.
In recent years, multiple events have highlighted the severity of this problem.
For instance, in April 2024, around 160 pilot whales stranded on a Western Australian beach, prompting a significant rescue operation by marine biologists and wildlife officers.
questions.zh:
鲸鱼大规模搁浅在澳大利亚和新西兰是一个反复出现的问题。
近年来，多起事件凸显了这一问题的严重性。
例如，2024年4月，约160头领航鲸在西澳大利亚一处海滩搁浅，促使海洋生物学家和野生动物官员展开大规模救援行动。

questions.name: #1452 Smart Cooking
questions.en:
You don't have to spend a lot of time in the kitchen on weekends, say nutrition experts and home chefs who promote "smart cooking" habits.
The trend, which has taken off on social media and in lifestyle magazines this year, encourages simple meal prep, batch cooking, and the use of time-saving appliances to reduce stress.
Instead of spending hours chopping and stirring, families are choosing healthier grab-and-go options, or assembling meals in under 30 minutes, leaving more time for rest, hobbies, and socializing.
questions.zh:
营养专家和倡导“智慧烹饪”习惯的家庭厨师表示，你其实不用在周末花太多时间待在厨房里。
今年在社交媒体和生活方式杂志上流行起来的这股潮流，鼓励简单的备餐、批量烹饪以及使用省时的小家电来减轻压力。
与其花几个小时切菜搅拌，许多家庭更倾向于选择健康的即食食品，或者在30分钟内完成一顿饭的准备工作，从而留出更多时间用于休息、爱好和社交。

questions.name: #1453 Community Gardening
questions.en:
We bring together people, resources, and education to benefit lives and neighborhoods through community gardening.
From our beginnings, American Community Gardening Association has encouraged networking among members to share community gardening information, experience, and best practices.
We also offer formal educational opportunities, such as local and regional workshops, webinars, publications, and online resources.
Our acclaimed annual conferences, hosted in a different city each year, bring together community garden practitioners, sponsors, and researchers from around the world.
questions.zh:
我们把人、资源和教育汇聚在一起，通过社区园艺来改善生活和社区。
从一开始，美国社区园艺协会就鼓励成员之间建立联系，分享社区园艺的信息、经验和最佳实践。
我们还提供正式的教育机会，比如本地和区域的研讨会、网络讲座、出版物以及在线资源。
我们备受赞誉的年度会议每年在不同城市举办，汇聚了来自世界各地的社区园艺从业者、赞助商和研究人员。

questions.name: #1454 Visit to Canada
questions.en:
The best time to visit Canada is during fall months, when mild temperatures and vibrant fall foliage make scenic drives, hiking, and outdoor exploration especially enjoyable.
Travel guides often highlight autumn—especially from late September through October—as a peak season for color changes in Ontario, Quebec, and other regions of the country.
questions.zh:
游览加拿大的最佳时间是秋季，那时气候温和，秋叶绚烂，自驾、徒步和户外探索格外惬意。
旅游指南常推荐秋季——尤其是九月下旬到十月——作为安大略、魁北克等地赏枫的旺季。
